STR_A3_DLCB_Campaign_Apex: Take on the role of a NATO CTRG special operator in the 1-4 player "Apex Protocol" co-op campaign. It consists of highly replayable missions, featuring a drop-in / drop-out multiplayer structure, and the difficulty scales up or down based on the number of players.
STR_A3_DLCB_Showcase_EndGame: Experience the End Game mode in a singleplayer environment. Secure and upload valuable schematics on Tanoa before the enemy is able to stop you.
STR_A3_DLCB_EG_scenario04: Use sea, air and land vehicles to secure victory over the valuable schematics on Balavu island.
STR_A3_DLCB_EG_scenario05: Battle through the city of Moddergat and the nearby jungle to secure and upload the valuable schematics during intense infantry combat.
str_a3_mission_failed_friendly_fire: Friendly fire will not be tolerated!
str_a3_mission_failed_orders_disobeyed: You disobeyed direct orders and seriously jeopardized the operation.
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_unload_desc: Land at the Kamino base heliport and unload the squad.
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_transport_de: Transport the Viper SF team to Kamino base.
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_take_off_des: Board the transport helicopter and take off ASAP.
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_showcase_sum: Take on Arma 3's rotor-wing flight. Transport a Quick Reaction Force to the scene of an attack on one of our facilities.
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_rtb_desc: Return to Base. Land on the starting position at hangar A6.
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_resupply_low: Refill your ammo and fuel at Camp Rogain.
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_resupply_des: Fly to Camp Rogain and refill ammo and fuel. Await further intel.
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_fly_to_kamin: Follow the pre-planned route and land at Kamino base.
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_destroy_mort: Destroy enemy mortar emplacements located on a rocky island, east of the coast, 800m away.
Seek and destroy the enemy mortars bombarding Mike-26.
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_destroy_enem: Stop enemy vehicles en route to Mike-26.
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_deploy_troop: Land at Mike-26 base and unload the squad.
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_defend_base_: Coordinate with Griffin and defend Mike-26 from enemy forces.
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_debriefing_e: Thanks to well executed aerial support, ground forces managed to fend off both attacks on Mike-26 and Kamino base. Enemy forces were decimated.
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_briefing_sit:
%3Kamino base%1 has come under attack. We believe enemy forces have linked up with local guerrillas and have launched a surprise hit-and-run assault.
A motorized Quick Response Force has been dispatched to the %3area%1, but our forces are in need of immediate relief. Three SF squads - Vipers Red, Blue and Green - are preparing an assault. These teams will be deployed by helicopter = callsigns Hydra, Chimera and Dragon - dispatched from %2Stratis airfield%1.
With aerial support, they should be able to fight off the enemy forces until ground reinforcements arrive.
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_briefing_sig:
%3Griffin%1 - Central command; located at Stratis airfield
%4Tiger%1 - Kamino base command
%2Hydra%1 - Transport helicopter; transporting team Viper-Red
%2Chimera%1 - Transport helicopter; transporting team Viper-Blue
%2Dragon%1 - Transport helicopter; transporting team Viper-Green
%2Viper-Red%1 - SF team; carried by Hydra
%2Viper-Blue%1 - SF team; carried by Chimera
%2Viper-Green%1 - SF team; carried by Dragon
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_briefing_mis:
Transport the Quick Response Force to %2our base%1 and provide air support. Hold the base until ground reinforcements arrive.<br \>
Be ready for more intel as the situation develops.
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_briefing_exe:
1. Board the %2helicopter%1 and wait for the Viper team to embark, then take off.
2. Transport the Viper team to the %3Kamino sector%1, landing at a safe spot nearby the %3base%1.
3. Provide the %3base defenders%1 with air support until ground forces arrive.
4. Return to the %2Stratis airfield%1 when you've completed your objectives.
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_titlecard: SHOWCASE: HELICOPTERS - Air-to-Ground Combat, Infantry Transport, Huge Terrain
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_x40_land_at_: Be advised, we've got enemy movement around Mike-26.
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_x50_landed_a: Be advised, Hydra is rearming at Rogain
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_x45_land_at_: Hydra, deploy Viper-red at Mike-26 and report back.

str_a3_showcase_helicopters_x20_enemy_ve: Hydra reporting ... one alpha victor has stopped just north of Mike-26.
Enemy units disembarking, moving towards the facility.
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_x15_enemy_ve: Hydra reporting ... vehicles have halted north of Mike-26.
Enemy units disembarking, moving towards the facility.
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_x10_low_on_a: Copy that, proceed to resupply at Camp Rogain.
This is Hydra, we're running low on ammo.
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_x05_idle_get: We need to take off, asap.
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_65_fly_home_: Well done, Hydra! Ground forces will take care of the remaining enemy presence. Return to the air base.
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_55_go_kamino: Roger, we need your support at Kamino asap. Vipers blue and green are pinned down.
Enemy forces have set up a firing position on a rocky islet to the east of the Kamino base.
Fly there and neutralize the mortar emplacements.
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_53_resupplie: Griffin, this is Hydra, we're good to go here.
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_50_resuppy_b: Understood. Proceed to the resupply point at Camp Rogain.

str_a3_showcase_helicopters_25_bombardme: Understood. Locate and engage those mortars.
Griffin, Mike-26 is under sustained mortar attack. Unable to land, acknowledge!
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_10_enemy_veh: Hydra, be advised, we've got two alpha victors approaching the radar facility from the west.
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_05_in_heli_b: Hydra, drop the response team at the Kamino base and await further intel.
str_a3_showcase_helicopters_01_intro_bas: Griffin to all teams, get to your vehicles!
We've got reports of multiple contacts to the east.
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_diary_execution: %6 Infiltrate %2the camp%1 and steal the parked car%5%7 Drive to a position overlooking the %3military depot%1%5%8 Destroy any vehicles stationed there using the roof-mounted automatic grenade launcher%5%9 Move to the %4rendezvous point%1 and leave the island
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_diary_mission_t: Acquire a heavily-armed vehicle and disrupt enemy logistics by destroying their central %2vehicle depot%1.
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_diary_signal_te: %2Viper Black%3 - you%1%4Viper Green%3 - strike team; tasked to sabotage the radar array%1Griffin - command
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_diary_situation: With the entire island firmly under enemy control, command wants us to disrupt their comms and logistics network.%1%1One team, Viper-Green, is already in position and is poised to sabotage the %2radar array%3. We need you, call sign Viper-Black, to strike a blow against the enemy's vehicle depot.%1%1An unorthodox opportunity has presented itself in the form of a weakly defended base and a heavily-armed vehicle. We'll turn the enemy's firepower against them and exfiltrate amid the resulting confusion.
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_diary_summary_t: Try out Arma 3's new vehicle handling. Infiltrate the enemy base, steal the car, and enjoy the fire-power of its mounted weapons.
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_end1_text: Not only did you fulfill your primary objective, you also made sure Viper-Green made it back alive. Exceptional job.
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_end2_text: You failed to destroy the enemy vehicles, but at least you made sure Viper-Green made it back alive.
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_end3_text: The loss of Viper-Green is unfortunate, but you completed your mission. That is important. Good job.
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_end4_text: The mission was a total disaster. Not only are the enemy vehicles still intact, but we've also lost Viper-Green. You are not worthy of your rank.
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_endloser_text: You are stranded in enemy territory.
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_task1_text: Steal the enemy vehicle parked in %1the camp%2.
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_task2_text: Destroy all the vehicles parked in the %1military depot%2.
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_task3_text: We need a further diversion so that Bravo-Green can retreat. Blowing up the radio tower near the main town should do the trick.
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_task4_text: Rendezvous with your escort and leave the island to complete your assignment.
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_titlecard: SHOWCASE: VEHICLES - Improved Driving Physics, Picture-in-Picture, Steal the Car!
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_x10_green_dead_: It looks like we lost team Green. I'm calling off the response team, Sergeant. Get out of there. Griffin out.
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_x05_depot_hardc: You had us worried for a moment there, Sergeant. Let's get you home. Griffin out.
Griffin, Viper-Black. Objective Two complete. I decided to improvise. Over.
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_x01_car_dead_hq: This is a massive setback, Sergeant. Abort the mission and continue to the exfil point. Griffin out.
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_x01_car_dead_pl: Griffin, uh, this is Viper-Black. I... Well, the target vehicle is combat ineffective. Over.
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_25_end_dvr_0: Good to see you, Sergeant. The boat's ready. Let's go.
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_20_green_ok_grn: This is Viper-Green, looks like they've called off their chopper. I think we can finally get out of here, over.
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_20_green_ok_hq_: Copy, report in once you reach the exifil point. Viper-Black, good job. Griffin out.
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_15_green_troubl: Viper-Green to Griffin, we've been compromised. Repeat, Viper-Green is compromised. Please advise, over.
Negative, Griffin. We had to pull back to point Sigma, but it in a couple minutes, we'll be screwed anyway. Over.
Viper-Green, can you make it to the exfil point? Over.
It's up to you, Viper-Black. We're dispatching a response team, but they're at least 10 minutes out. Viper-Green, hold your position. Griffin out.
Griffin... I can make enough noise here so they'll have to divert some of their units my way, over.
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_10_depot_hq_0: Good job, Sergeant, now let's get you home. Griffin out.
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_10_depot_pla_0: Griffin, Viper-Black. Objective Two complete. Moving to the RV. Over.
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_05_steal_hq_0: Copy that. Keep your distance and let the grenades do the work. They won't see this coming. Griffin out.
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_05_steal_pla_0: Viper-Black to Griffin. Hijack successful. Moving to objective Two. Over.
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_01_start_grn_0: Griffin, Viper-Green. ETA to objective: 5 minutes. Out.
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_01_start_hq_0: Griffin to Vipers Black and Green, report status, over.
str_a3_showcase_vehicles_01_start_pla_0: Viper-Black reporting in. I have visual on objective One. Out.
str_a3_showcase_scuba_diary_execution_te: %6 Swim to the bay and deactivate all three mines we've detected there%3%7 A %11speedboat%1 is guarding the area - you can sabotage its engine so long as you remain undetected and the vessel doesn't start moving%3%8 Eliminate the AA patrol stationed in %4the camp%1 and acquire a missile launcher - you can call in a mortar strike provided by %5Echo%1%3%9 Engage the chopper patrolling the western coastline%3%10 Make your way back to %2your team%1 and leave the area
str_a3_showcase_scuba_diary_mission_text: Deactivate the underwater mines in %2the bay%1 and eliminate the chopper patrolling the coastline.
str_a3_showcase_scuba_diary_signal_text: %2Omega%3 - your team%1%4Echo%3 - mortar team; stationed at camp Maxwell and providing support%1Papa Bear - command
str_a3_showcase_scuba_diary_situation_te: Following the OPFOR invasion, we've made a last stand in the south of the island. We desperately need to establish a safe route for reinforcement and resupply, and command has identified %3this camp%1 as our best shot.%4%4However, we've discovered that it's reinforced by a deployment of underwater mines, and protected by a garrison of enemy forces, including naval and air support.%4%4Other elements of your team, call sign Omega, have already taken up positions in a %2valley%1 to the south of %5the bay%1. Join them and execute your tasks.
str_a3_showcase_scuba_diary_summary_text: Dive into Arma 3's new underwater environment. Swim undetected up the coastline and assault an enemy position.
str_a3_showcase_scuba_end1_text: The enemy no longer controls the bay. This should enable us to receive badly needed supplies.
str_a3_showcase_scuba_endloser_text: Friendly fire will not be tolerated!
str_a3_showcase_scuba_sitrep_text: On the west coast of Stratis
str_a3_showcase_scuba_task1_text: Deactivate all 3 mines in the bay.
str_a3_showcase_scuba_task5_text: Shoot down the helicopter patrolling the shoreline. You can find an AA launcher somewhere in the enemy camp.
str_a3_showcase_scuba_task6_text: Find a missile launcher in %2the camp%3. An anti-air team stationed there at the moment should have one, and another is almost certainly in their vehicle. If you run out of rockets, search the buildings in the camp for an ammo dump.%1%1You can call in a mortar strike to create some chaos.
str_a3_showcase_scuba_task7_text: Use an AA missile to bring the chopper down.
str_a3_showcase_scuba_task8_text: If you sabotage %2the boat%3 guarding the bay, it will remain static after the shells start falling, allowing you to first target the camp itself.%1%1To sabotage the boat, swim beneath it and use the Action Menu.
str_a3_showcase_scuba_task9_text: Return to your team to be escorted back to our position.
str_a3_showcase_scuba_welcome: Cpl. Ben Kerry, TF Aegis%3Ftelio bay
str_a3_showcase_scuba_titlecard: SHOWCASE: SCUBA - Special Equipment, Deactivating Mines, Underwater Infiltration
str_a3_showcase_scuba_10_end_hq_0: Acknowledged, Omega, fine work out there. Out.
str_a3_showcase_scuba_10_end_ker_0: Enough fun for today... let's head home.
str_a3_showcase_scuba_10_end_ker_1: Papa Bear, Omega here. Objective complete, ready to RTB, over.
str_a3_showcase_scuba_01_start_hq_0: Papa Bear to Omega. Maintain radio silence during the op. Report in once you complete your objectives. Papa Bear out.
str_a3_showcase_scuba_01_start_jim_0: Good luck, Corporal. Take a deep breath.
str_a3_showcase_scuba_01_start_ker_0: Thanks, Jimmy. Alright, here we go.
str_a3_showcase_infantry_showcase_summar: Engage in Arma 3's infantry combat. Follow your leader and move through the valley to support a friendly squad pinned down by enemy forces.
str_a3_showcase_infantry_friendly_fire: Friendly fire will not be tolerated!
str_a3_showcase_infantry_debriefing_end3: Bravo were killed and we were forced to retreat.
str_a3_showcase_infantry_debriefing_end2: You successfully rescued our forces and neutralized the mortar, despite being forced to retreat. Given the situation, that's the best outcome we could have hoped for.
str_a3_showcase_infantry_debriefing_end1: You successfully rescued our forces and neutralized the spotters, despite being forced to retreat. Given the situation, that's the best outcome we could have hoped for.
str_a3_showcase_infantry_briefing_situat: Hours ago, enemy forces launched a sudden attack from the north. They're steadily advancing south, driving us into the sea.%1Bravo has been pinned down by a swift assault on their position; now, they're trapped inside the %2village%3 and are in need of support. We're stretched thin and need to make a stand.%4An advanced element of your team has taken up a position in the valley. Regroup and report in, Alpha.
str_a3_showcase_infantry_briefing_signal: %1Alpha%2 - your team%3%4Bravo%5 - friendly fireteam pinned down in the village%6%7Charlie%8 - Supporting element%9Papa Bear - command
str_a3_showcase_infantry_briefing_missio: Clear the area of enemy forces with the assistance of %1Charlie%2 and reinforce the village.
str_a3_showcase_infantry_briefing_execut:
1. Regroup with your point man
2. Proceed cautiously through the valley towards the village
3. Clear the area of enemy forces
str_a3_showcase_infantry_bis_village_des: Bravo are pinned down in %1the village%2. Clear it out.
str_a3_showcase_infantry_bis_spotters_de: Mortars have opened fire on the %1village%2. Eliminate them before we sustain heavy casualties.
str_a3_showcase_infantry_bis_rtb_desc: Enemy artillery is inbound. Fall back to the forests.
str_a3_showcase_infantry_bis_pointman_de: A member of your squad took point. Regroup with him and report in.
str_a3_showcase_infantry_bis_defend_desc: Your squad mate is down! Cover the medic as he tries to stabilize him.
str_a3_showcase_infantry_titlecard: SHOWCASE: INFANTRY - Overhauled Animations, Improved Weapon Handling, Refined Radio Chatter
str_a3_showcase_infantry_x10_bravo_dead_: Papa Bear to all units, we've lost comms with Bravo. Presumed KIA. Fall back, ASAP. Papa Bear out.
str_a3_showcase_infantry_70_retreat_pap_: Papa Bear to all squads, retreat immediately! I say again, retreat immediately!
Heavy artillery inbound... Get out of there! Fall back to the forest. Papa Bear out.
str_a3_showcase_infantry_50_spotters_loc: Spotters located. Patching in the live-feed.
str_a3_showcase_infantry_45_in_position_: Charlie in position. Scanning hills to the north.
str_a3_showcase_infantry_40_charlie_supp: This is Charlie. We'll assist with locating the spotters.
str_a3_showcase_infantry_36_volunteered_: Corporal Kerry, you've just been volunteered!
str_a3_showcase_infantry_35_mortars_bra_: Spotters must be nearby! Someone's got to find them and take them out!
str_a3_showcase_infantry_30_town_clear_b: All right, Alpha... looks like we're clear. Thanks for the assist.
Papa Bear, this is Bravo. We've taken casualties, but the village is ours. Please advise, over.
str_a3_showcase_infantry_30_town_clear_p: Copy that. Alpha, Bravo, entrench your position and await further orders. Charlie's now en route with support for your wounded. Out.
str_a3_showcase_infantry_27_ridgelines_a: Contacts on the ridge-lines! Focus your fire!
str_a3_showcase_infantry_25_keep_moving_: Papa Bear, we're a man down and OPFOR backup is flooding into the valley! We've got to fall back!
Dammit. Okay... okay, we keep moving, Bravo still needs our support!
That's a negative Alpha, Bravo can't hold out much longer. You must hit the village now! Over!
str_a3_showcase_infantry_23_negative_pap: Alpha-3, be advised, no support available.
Sorry guys, we're stretched thin here. Papa Bear out.
str_a3_showcase_infantry_20_no_hope_med_: Alpha-3 to Papa Bear, Jackson's bleeding out...
...I don't have the supplies to deal with this - requesting support at our position, over!
str_a3_showcase_infantry_10_medic_alp_0: Papa Bear, this is Alpha. We've got casualties. Standby for update.
str_a3_showcase_infantry_10_medic_alp_1: Concentrate your fire down the valley!
str_a3_showcase_infantry_05_pointman_dea: Doc, check on him! The rest of you, covering fire!
str_a3_showcase_infantry_01_enemy_spotte: Copy that, Private. Sit tight, we're almost there, out.
Papa Bear, this is Alpha. Be advised, contacts spotted near the village. Do we engage? Over.
Sir, I've got lots of enemy movement here... looks like they're outflanking Bravo, over.
Solid copy, Alpha Lead. Clear to engage. Papa Bear out.
str_a3_mp_coop_m01_task2_text: The helicopters on the airfield suffered critical damage. You can either check the Kamino firing range for some boats or try to shoot down a patrolling helicopter. If you have an engineer in your team, he can try to repair it, as long as the pilot manages to land safely.
str_a3_mp_coop_m01_task1_text: Escape from Stratis by any means possible.%1%1Your best chances are the %3airfield%2 and %4Kamino firing range%2.
str_a3_mp_coop_m01_overview: Escape from Stratis by any means possible.
str_a3_mp_coop_m01_hint_1: WARNING: To be able to finish the mission, the group leader must be player-controlled.
str_a3_mp_coop_m01_execution_text: Attack observation posts to arm yourself properly.%1%1Try to stay together.%1%1Steal as many vehicles as you can.%1%1If your whole team is dead, the mission ends.%1%1It takes 30 seconds to respawn.
str_a3_mp_coop_m01_end6_text: With all boats and helicopters destroyed, you have no means to escape the island. And enemy reinforcements are surely on their way...
str_a3_mp_coop_m02_task5_text: Once you complete your primary task, head back to the boats and leave the area.
str_a3_mp_coop_m02_task4_text: Target Three's location is camp Rogain.
str_a3_mp_coop_m02_task3_text: Target Two's location is the comm installation South of camp Rogain.
str_a3_mp_coop_m02_task2_text: Target One's location is Kamino Firing Range.
str_a3_mp_coop_m02_task1_text: Elimiate three important officers currently garrisoned in eastern Stratis.
str_a3_mp_coop_m02_overview: Eliminate three officers in the area.
str_a3_mp_coop_m02_execution_text: Eliminate three officers in the area. Watch out for enemy patrols.
STR_A3_Showcase_EndGame_Showcase_Summary: Experience the End Game mode in a singleplayer environment. Secure and upload valuable schematics on Tanoa before the enemy is able to stop you.
str_a3_showcase_supports_task4_text: Bravo and Echo are awaiting your green light codes. They will neutralize the remaining garrison.
str_a3_showcase_supports_task3_text: Once clear, call in Close Air Support, Whisky-6.
str_a3_showcase_supports_task2_text: Neutralize the anti-air team patrolling the eastern perimeter prior to calling in CAS.
str_a3_showcase_supports_task1_text: Coordinate the attack on the airbase and neutralize hostile forces stationed there.
str_a3_showcase_supports_endloser_text: We incurred heavy losses in this operation. You've let us down, Sergeant. We're in a desperate position now.
str_a3_showcase_supports_end2_text: Although we've incurred some losses, we've neutralised the OPFOR garrison defending the airbase, and have regrouped our surviving forces in the south.
str_a3_showcase_supports_end1_text: Thanks to your effective coordination, we have significantly weakened the enemy presence on Stratis, while maintaining our strength and momentum. Outstanding work, Hawkeye.
str_a3_showcase_supports_diary_summary_t: Wield the power of Arma 3's improved Supports. Neutralize the anti-air defences and coordinate a strike on the enemy airbase.
str_a3_showcase_supports_diary_situation: We've drawn out most of the enemy forces from the %3airbase%2 and now have a unique opportunity to neutralize the remaining garrison. However, we're still thin on the ground - unable to effectively clear and secure the area against expected OPFOR counter-attacks.%1%1We have two ground teams in position and ready to storm the base: teams %4Bravo%2 (8-man infantry squad) and %5Echo%2 (armed Hunter + 2-man missile team). You also have a Blackfoot (callsign Whisky-6) and a mortar team with 32 HE rounds at your disposal, both stationed at %6Camp Maxwell%2. It's all we can spare; use them wisely.%1%1Be advised, the base is protected by man-portable AA defences; they'll tear our lightly-armoured gunship to pieces. This is an ideal target for your mortar team. Carefully coordinate your attack to result in minimal friendly casualties. We're still perilously out-manned on Stratis.
str_a3_showcase_supports_diary_signal_te: %2Hawkeye%1 - Forward observer, you%7%3Bravo%1 - Infantry squad%7%4Echo%1 - Motorized infantry team%7%5Whisky-6%1 - Blackfoot gunship%7%6Papa Bear%1 - HQ
STR_A3_Showcase_Supports_Showcase_Summar: Wield the power of Arma 3's improved Supports. Neutralize the anti-air defences and coordinate a strike on the enemy airbase.
str_a3_showcase_supports_diary_mission_t: From an %2overwatch point%1 above the airbase, coordinate a swift combined-arms assault, neutralize hostile forces, and fall back to %3Camp Maxwell%1.
str_a3_showcase_supports_diary_execution: %6 Get into position on overwatch and evaluate the situation on the %3airbase%2%1%7 If you decide to send in the gunship, first neutralize the %4AA patrol%2. This is an ideal target for your mortar team%1%8 Coordinate the attack: call in our squads via the Supports menu; defeat hostile forces garrisoned at the airbase%1%9 Fall back and regroup at %5Camp Maxwell%2
str_a3_showcase_supports_x05_aa_elimiate: Say again, Hawkeye, task executed with no mortar support? Over.
Copy that. We appreciate your confidence Sergeant, but be sure to support the assault properly. Mortars are still on standby. Over.
Papa Bear, Hawkeye, be advised, AA teams neutralised, over.
Affirmative, sir. I saw an opportunity. I took it.
str_a3_showcase_supports_x01_casaulties_: Hawkeye, what's the situation? We've lost contact with most of the teams, over.
Goddamnit, Sergeant, you had the upper hand here - this was not supposed to happen! Everyone, fall back to Gamma and await evac. Papa Bear out.
It's bad... we're getting our asses handed to us, sir. Please advise, over.
str_a3_showcase_supports_15_base_clear_b: Loud and clear, Hawkeye, good job. All teams, sweep the AO for casualties and RTB. Papa Bear out.
str_a3_showcase_supports_15_base_clear_h: Hawkeye to Papa Bear, mission complete. Enemy forces on the airbase neutralized. Do you read? Over.

str_a3_firing_drills_rules_rof_0: Do you understand the Course of Fire?
str_a3_firing_drills_cofgreen_rof_0: Here we are! Welcome to our fine sport shooting facility. I'll be your Range Officer for today. It's my job you get you oriented and keep everyone safe.
str_a3_firing_drills_cofgreen_rof_10: Most courses are composed of Check Points that you'll follow; others allow more 'freestyle' navigation.
str_a3_firing_drills_cofgreen_rof_11: Depending on the rules, you'll need to engage all targets before moving on, or, you can skip targets and accept a penalty.
str_a3_firing_drills_cofgreen_rof_2: For your first firing drill, we'll do a quick run-through the basics.
str_a3_firing_drills_cofgreen_rof_3: These drills are designed to hone your shooting and movement skills.
str_a3_firing_drills_cofgreen_rof_4: As a competitor, you're expected to effectively navigate Courses of Fire and deal with any obstacles.
str_a3_firing_drills_cofgreen_rof_5: Along the way, you'll scan for targets, engaging them quickly and accurately.
str_a3_firing_drills_cofgreen_rof_6: The goal is real simple: finish the drill in the best possible time.
str_a3_firing_drills_cofgreen_rof_7: Of course, really, we're just here to compete!
str_a3_firing_drills_cofgreen_rof_8: Ok, now, we're entering the Green Course of Fire.
str_a3_firing_drills_cofgreen_rof_9: Bring up and load your weapon. Make sure to observe strict weapon discipline and get to the start of the course.
str_a3_firing_drills_cofgreen_rof_12: Ok, time for some targets. We'll start with just one, for now.
str_a3_firing_drills_cofgreen_rof_13: This target appears later and does not stay up. Missing results in penalty time.
str_a3_firing_drills_cofgreen_rof_15: ... and multiple targets at once here.
str_a3_firing_drills_cofgreen_rof_16: Watch out for the no-shoot targets!
str_a3_firing_drills_cofgreen_rof_18: Your final time is affected by the penalties you've incurred and the bonuses you've won. Cutting corners isn't always faster!
str_a3_firing_drills_cofgreen_rof_19: In the second lane, the concept of using specific weapons is introduced. In this case, use your rifle, but always observe the Check Point briefing.
str_a3_firing_drills_cofgreen_rof_20: Courses sometimes introduce shooting boxes at Check Points. Engaging targets from these boxes nets the best results.
str_a3_firing_drills_cofgreen_rof_21: Check Points may also define a specific stance to use - like firing from prone or taking a knee. Be sure to keep an eye on the Check Point briefing when you study and memorize the course.
str_a3_firing_drills_cofgreen_rof_22: We'll be switching weapons again for this lane.
str_a3_firing_drills_cofgreen_rof_24: The key to improving your skills is repetition. Train, train and train some more.
str_a3_firing_drills_cofgreen_rof_25: Just like a race track, memorize the Course of Fire, find legal shortcuts, time your reloads and be observant.
str_a3_firing_drills_cofgreen_rof_26: Well, alright then, that just about wraps it up. I hope you found this useful. When you're ready, we can try Green again, or you can move on to other courses.

str_a3_firing_drills_diary_text1:
Welcome to %1!

Train or compete in this Firing Drill as often as you'd like and beat your best times!

Find more information about Firing Drills %2.
str_a3_firing_drills_diary_rec8_text: You may be asked to employ a specific stance at a Check Point. Doing this correctly can result in bonuses. Failure to do so may be penalized.
str_a3_firing_drills_diary_rec7_text: You may be urged to use a specific weapon type at a Check Point. Doing this will be rewarded with bonuses. Not doing this may incur penalties.
str_a3_firing_drills_diary_rec6_text:
There are various types of targets that appear at Check Points:
%1Targets can appear immediately or after a little while.
%1Targets can disappear after a timeout.
%1Targets can move along rails.
%1Targets can activate after hitting another target.
%1Sometimes only specifically colored targets should be hit.
%1Targets may require multiple hits.
%1Accuracy zones on targets can reduce your time when struck.
%1Optional bonus targets lower your time.
%1No-shoot targets must not be engaged!

Targets can sometimes be randomly positioned or randomly appearing.
str_a3_firing_drills_diary_rec5_text: Check Points can define specific shooting boxes. When present, it's always better to engage from within these marked boxes.
str_a3_firing_drills_diary_rec4_text:
When a COF uses Check Points, competitors move between them and usually engage all available targets before moving on.

Each Check Point may define special requirements such as the use of a specific weapon type or stance.

Keep an eye on the Check Point briefing and other indicators and memorize the COF well by training often.
str_a3_firing_drills_diary_rec3_text:
A competitor's raw time is the amount of time it takes to reach the final Check Point, or to clear all targets for some courses.

Time may be deducted when you are awarded bonuses, or added when you are penalized.

When competing for medals, you can beat the bronze, silver and gold times. Sometimes a special time is available.
str_a3_firing_drills_diary_rec2_text:
Firing Drills can be completed using one of two rule-sets: training and competitive.

%1Training: less strict and about familiarizing with the course. Medal times cannot be challenged while training.

%1Competitive: stricter rules and competitors are penalized when breaking rules. Medal times can be beaten here!
str_a3_firing_drills_diary_rec1_text:
Firing Drills are a fun shooting sport to train and compete in.

Competitors complete a Course of Fire (COF), usually consisting of a series of Check Points with targets to engage at each one.

They refine their skills in the areas of movement, environmental awareness, weapon handling, shooting, prioritization and creativity.
str_a3_firing_drills_clear_stats2: Removing Firing Drills statistics cannot be undone!
str_a3_firing_drills_diary_rec9_text:
%1Firing Drills are not meant to be aced in one attempt. Study the courses, find shortcuts and get creative.

%1Observe on-screen Check Point briefings, voice instructions and other indicators to know which stance and weapon to use.

%1Plan your reloads and weapon switches well! Doing this in a smart way can save you many seconds.

%1Don't always trust the most direct route. Sometimes a detour can be quicker if there are no obstacles in your path.

%1Consider what will cost you more time: missing a target and re-engaging it, or moving on and taking the penalty.

%1Think about your aiming path from target to target, as well as clever use of fire modes. Remember that some targets offer bonuses for accuracy.

%1Scan for bonus targets, but balance your search time against the gained bonuses. Check your map for clues.

%1Not all targets appear upon arriving at a Check Point. Remain vigilant until the all clear is given.

%1Consider your fatigue and how often you sprint. It all affects your continued performance and aiming.

We're now in a good position to strike a further blow and seize the encampment before they can effectively regroup. We'll execute a combined-arms assault and clear out enemy forces from the area.%1%1Close Air Support will be provided by Whiskey-Six, and motorized infantry, callsign Echo, will support the attack. However, be advised that enemy forces still have a foothold in the north and east. We should expect to encounter possible reinforcements from the %6Kamino area%2.

str_a3_boot_m05_overview: NATO peacekeepers returning to Kavala discover that the situation has gone from bad to worse.
str_a3_boot_m05_briefing_situation_text: Just under an hour ago, NATO troops were forced to engage members of the FIA in the vicinity of %1Kavirida%2. It has become clear that they were responsible for the attack on the convoy.%3Their motive is now apparent - the situation at %4the MoD%5 rapidly deteriorated, succeeded by the FIA conducting an all-out assault on %6Kavala%7. Details are still coming in, but we are certain that the FIA's actions are a direct consequence of these events. It appears to have convinced the FIA that the sit-down at %8the MoD%9 had not been conducted in good faith.%10The investigation is still ongoing.
str_a3_boot_m05_briefing_signal_text:
Alpha 1-2 - Your callsign.
Alpha 1-1 - Staff Sergeant Adams.
Bravo 2-3 - Inbound reinforcements.
Broadway - Colonel MacKinnon.
Phalanx - AAF Command.
str_a3_boot_m05_briefing_mission_text: Once %1the reinforcements%2 arrive, return to %3Kavala%4 and report in with Broadway.
str_a3_boot_m05_briefing_execution_text:
1. Await the reinforcements.
2. Report in with Broadway.
str_a3_boot_m05_epilogue_1: The following months would see a rapid deterioration in AAF-NATO relations.
str_a3_boot_m05_d10_ending_ada_1: Come on. Let's get out of here.
str_a3_boot_m05_d10_ending_lac_0: Can't believe MacKinnon just shut us down like that.
str_a3_boot_m05_d05_results_ada_0: Just the Chain of Command at its finest.
str_a3_boot_m05_d05_results_ada_1: Callsign 'Phalanx'. Colonel Akhanteros. You just bashed horns with the AAF's top brass.
str_a3_boot_m05_d05_results_lac_2: That's their top brass? Now I know why they're so fucked up.
str_a3_boot_m05_d01_hate_ada_0: Hearts and minds, Sergeant. Hearts and minds...
str_a3_boot_m05_d01_hate_lac_0: Just so you fucking know, I'm about to shoot something.
str_a3_boot_m05_45_aftermath_lac_2: Hey, asshole, I'm talking to you!
str_a3_boot_m05_45_aftermath_lac_3: Buddy, I'm warning you, you pick this fight and you'll lose.
str_a3_boot_m05_45_aftermath_bhq_3: Negative, 1-2, you are to stand down. That's an order. Confirm, over.
str_a3_boot_m05_45_aftermath_lac_4: What's the problem? Your men are abusing these prisoners.
str_a3_boot_m05_45_aftermath_ihq_0: Is there a problem here, Sergeant?
str_a3_boot_m05_45_aftermath_lac_5: The hell it is! Corporal, arrest them.
str_a3_boot_m05_45_aftermath_isa_0: This is none of your business, American.
str_a3_boot_m05_45_aftermath_ihq_1: What my men do is my concern, and mine alone, Sergeant.
str_a3_boot_m05_45_aftermath_lac_7: I've got Greenbacks abusing FIA prisoners at the MoD, sir. Please advise, over.
str_a3_boot_m05_45_aftermath_ihq_2: Don't you take another step. You are out of line, American.
str_a3_boot_m05_45_aftermath_ihq_3: It was a pleasure doing business with you, Sergeant.
str_a3_boot_m05_40_orders_ada_0: Go see what's going on. I'll be there in a sec.
str_a3_boot_m05_25_truck_ada_1: Martinez, McKendrick, stay behind. Keep an eye on things. The Sergeant and I will check out the MoD.
str_a3_boot_m05_20_fire_ada_1: Broadway, Alpha 1-1 Actual. What's the situation in Kavala? Over.
str_a3_boot_m05_20_fire_ada_2: Copy. Interrogative, what do you need us for? Over.
str_a3_boot_m05_20_fire_ada_3: Solid copy, sir. We'll keep you updated. 1-1 out.
str_a3_boot_m05_20_fire_bhq_1: Details are still coming in, but intel suggests the sitdown went haywire.
str_a3_boot_m05_20_fire_bhq_2: Phalanx is reporting that the FIA threw themselves at the cordon.
str_a3_boot_m05_20_fire_bhq_3: I want you to take control of the situation at the MoD.
str_a3_boot_m05_20_fire_bhq_4: We're getting conflicting reports left and right. I need someone on the ground. How copy?
str_a3_boot_m05_10_csat_bsb_0: Just marking their territory, as per usual.
str_a3_boot_m05_10_csat_bsb_2: Get yourselves back to Kavala. Shit's kicked off over there.
str_a3_boot_m05_05_situation_ada_0: Multiple KIA. AAF and FIA. The survivor didn't make it.
str_a3_boot_m05_epilogue_2: By Christmas of 2034, NATO's peacekeeping mandate would be limited to Stratis, a small island south of the Altis mainland.
str_a3_boot_m05_epilogue_3: With conflict brewing in the Pacific, the world - and NATO itself - slowly started to forget about the tiny island republic.
str_a3_boot_m04_overview: The AAF and the FIA agree to a dialogue in the former capital, Kavala.
str_a3_boot_m04_debriefing_boot_m05_2_de: The convoy was secured, but little remains. Although you broke the Rules of Engagement, it was clear that the FIA had hostile intentions. Let's keep your slip up to ourselves.
str_a3_boot_m04_debriefing_boot_m05_1_de: The convoy was secured, but little remains. NATO peacekeeping forces were forced to engage the FIA responsible for its demise.
str_a3_boot_m04_briefing_situation_text: Last week, an AAF patrol responded with lethal force to aggression from locals %1north of Kore%2, reportedly in self-defense. One casualty survived but later succumbed to their wounds, bringing the official death toll to 6.%3Peacekeeping forces on scene confirmed the reported timeline, but the justification for the patrol's use of force remains questionable.%4Following the incident, the government reached out to the FIA for a sit-down %5in Kavala%6, as a gesture of goodwill. As such, security has been ramped up, with peacekeeping forces watching over the proceedings.%7However, %8an AAF security convoy%9 en route from %10the AAC airfield%11 failed to pass %12an AAF checkpoint%13 east of %14Kavala%15 at its scheduled arrival time, nearly 20 minutes ago, raising fears that the situation is likely to escalate. It has failed to respond to hails from AAF Command.
str_a3_boot_m04_briefing_signal_text:
Alpha 1-2 - Your callsign.
Alpha 1-1 - Staff Sergeant Adams.
Broadway - Colonel MacKinnon.
Phalanx - AAF Command.
str_a3_boot_m04_briefing_mission_text: <marker name = 'BIS_adams'>Alpha 1-1</marker> and <marker name = 'BIS_lacey'>1-2</marker>, led by Staff Sergeant Adams, are to deploy to <marker name = 'BIS_lost'>the convoy's last known location</marker> and, if possible, obtain a visual on the convoy itself, before reporting back to Broadway.
str_a3_boot_m04_briefing_execution_text:
1. Move to the last known position.
2. Locate the convoy.
3. Report to Broadway.

str_a3_boot_m04_bis_locate_desc: Search %1the convoy's last known position%2 for any signs of the convoy itself.
str_a3_boot_m04_x10_status_treated_ada_0: We've got wounded at the convoy. One Greenback, unresponsive, possibly in shock. It doesn't look good, but 1-2 Actual's got him stabilized. Over.
str_a3_boot_m04_x01_ignored_roe_ada_0: What the fuck, Conway? Everyone, open up!
str_a3_boot_m04_d01_situation_ada_0: Who can blame him? He's the one that always has to do the cleaning up around here.
str_a3_boot_m04_d01_situation_ada_1: The AAF and FIA consenting to a sit-down within the country's Ministry of Defense.
str_a3_boot_m04_d01_situation_lac_0: MacKinnon didn't seem to be too happy.
str_a3_boot_m04_d01_situation_ada_2: I don't know who thought that was a good idea...
str_a3_boot_m04_85_all_clear_ada_2: Broadway, 1-1. Be advised, we've made contact with FIA forces at the convoy's location. All contacts neutralized. Over.
str_a3_boot_m04_85_all_clear_bhq_0: Copy, 1-1. Lock it down. Broadway out.
str_a3_boot_m04_70_move_up_ada_0: Move up! Stick to cover! Watch the trees!
str_a3_boot_m04_55_covering_ada_0: Please tell me you two have this.
str_a3_boot_m04_35_overwatch_ada_1: Understood. Maintain overwatch. We're moving up.
str_a3_boot_m04_35_overwatch_bsa_1: Convoy's been hit hard. No movement as far as I can tell.
str_a3_boot_m04_35_overwatch_bsa_2: But, to be honest, there are a lot of trees. Over.
str_a3_boot_m04_30_waiting_ada_0: Hold. Let's wait for the others.
str_a3_boot_m04_25_orders_ada_0: Martinez, McKendrick, take the hill on the right. Provide overwatch.
str_a3_boot_m04_15_roe_bhq_0: And, Staff Sergeant - in all likelihood - you're going to have FIA guerrillas waiting for you down there.
str_a3_boot_m04_15_roe_bhq_1: Stick to the ROE. Do not fire unless fired upon. However, that does not mean you are to roll over and take it. Confirm, over.
str_a3_boot_m04_125_perimeter_ada_1: I'm not in the mood for any more surprises!
str_a3_boot_m04_120_treated_lac_0: He's holding, but not for long. We need medical here now.
str_a3_boot_m04_115_medical_bhq_0: Copy. Relaying to Phalanx. Medical is inbound with reinforcements. Try to keep him stable until they arrive. Over.
str_a3_boot_m04_110_treating_ada_0: We've got wounded at the convoy. One Greenback, unresponsive, possibly in shock. It doesn't look good, but 1-2 Actual's taking care of him. Over.
str_a3_boot_m04_10_convoy_found_ada_1: Broadway, Alpha 1-1 Actual. We have a visual on the convoy. Grid 073-123. How copy? Over.
str_a3_boot_m04_10_convoy_found_bhq_0: 1-1 Actual, Broadway. Copy. Dispatching reinforcements. Secure the area and await their arrival.
str_a3_boot_m04_100_treat_ada_0: Sergeant, help him out. Take my kit if you need it.
str_a3_boot_m04_05_near_location_ada_0: Alright, we're coming up on the convoy's last known position.
str_a3_boot_m04_03_checkpoint_ada_1: It's coming up on 20 minutes since their convoy was supposed to pass through there.
str_a3_boot_m04_01_start_ada_0: Christ, did they put enough stairs in this thing?
str_a3_boot_m04_01_start_lac_0: Any word from the MoD sit-down, sir?
str_a3_boot_m04_01_start_bhq_2: Negative. Nothing from the AAF or the guerrillas.
str_a3_boot_m04_01_start_bhq_3: In fact, the whole thing's gone dark.
str_a3_boot_m04_01_start_bhq_5: Why do you think you boys are here?
str_a3_boot_m04_01_start_lac_1: Figure that missing Greenback convoy has something to do with it?
str_a3_boot_m04_01_start_bhq_8: Find us that convoy, Staff Sergeant.
str_a3_boot_m04_01_start_bhq_9: Good. And I'll try to un-fuck things here on this end.
str_a3_boot_m02_overview: NATO peacekeepers conduct joint training exercises with members of the AAF.
str_a3_boot_m02_briefing_situation_text: Peacekeeping efforts continue in The Republic of Altis and Stratis following the Civil War. Although some progress has been made, the newly-established government still faces serious obstacles, namely the inexperience of the Altis Armed Forces, or AAF for short.%1Officially, NATO Peacekeepers, primarily stationed on Stratis, have been seconded to Altis to cooperate and consult with the AAF. Unofficially, they have been assisting with training members of the AAF in order to ensure their ability to maintain security within the Republic itself.%2Recently, however, member states of CSAT have expressed interest in the Republic, further increasing already-heightened global tensions with NATO.
str_a3_boot_m02_bis_scope_desc: Take the RCO from %1the crate%2 and equip it on your rifle.
str_a3_boot_m02_bis_assemble_desc: Run to %1the target%2 and assemble it.
str_a3_boot_m02_x40_left_position_3_ada_: You're going to have a hard time if you don't fire from the shooting position, Sergeant.
str_a3_boot_m02_x35_left_position_2_ada_: Sergeant, please get back to the shooting position.
str_a3_boot_m02_x30_left_position_1_ada_: Back on the shooting position, Sergeant.
str_a3_boot_m02_x25_long_3_reprimand_ada: Sergeant, seriously, it's just in front of you. By the fence.
str_a3_boot_m02_x20_long_3_warning_ada_0: ... Once more, just for the sake of clarity: 100 meters, bearing 290.
str_a3_boot_m02_x15_long_2_reprimand_ada: Come on, Sergeant, it's right there. On top of the empty gas tank.
str_a3_boot_m02_x10_long_2_warning_ada_0: ... For the sake of those watching at home, the target is at 400 meters, bearing 307.
str_a3_boot_m02_x05_long_1_reprimand_ada: Conway, it's over there, in the ruined building. You're making me look bad.
str_a3_boot_m02_x01_long_1_warning_ada_0: ... That's 300 meters away from you, at bearing 330, Sergeant.
str_a3_boot_m02_d20_fatigue_ada_0: 'What is the Sergeant doing?', I hear you ask.
str_a3_boot_m02_d20_fatigue_ada_1: Well, in all honesty, I have no idea. Although, I think we can all agree, it's quite a sight to behold.
str_a3_boot_m02_d20_fatigue_ada_2: However, his completely spontaneous and totally unplanned marathon conveniently brings us to our next lesson: fatigue.
str_a3_boot_m02_d20_fatigue_ada_3: It can - and it will - be your worst nightmare in the field, should you fail to regulate it effectively.
str_a3_boot_m02_d20_fatigue_ada_4: Push yourself too hard, and you'll find yourself unable to hit shit - even when the situation requires otherwise.
str_a3_boot_m02_d20_fatigue_ada_5: And, hell - if that's not enough for you - you'll just grow to hate the sound of your own wheezing.
str_a3_boot_m02_d15_run_around_ada_0: While we're on the subject, you're going to find it much harder to control your breathing on the battlefield.
str_a3_boot_m02_d10_ballistics_and_beari: From now on, I will be giving directions to the Sergeant exclusively in compass bearings. So, please, pay attention.
I'll call out specific targets for the Sergeant to engage. It's up to him to pick them out and score a hit.
str_a3_boot_m02_d05_aaf_anger_ada_0: Y'know, I don't get annoyed easily-
str_a3_boot_m02_d05_aaf_anger_ada_1: - but this guy? This guy's a special kind of fuckwit.
str_a3_boot_m02_d01_hello_world_lac_0: Not bad. Not bad at all.
str_a3_boot_m02_d01_hello_world_ada_3: Shit. Looks like I missed one.
str_a3_boot_m02_d01_hello_world_ada_4: Tell you what: you go get it working. I'll get things set up here.
str_a3_boot_m02_95_started_composed_ada_: The Sergeant paced himself well as he ran around. As such, he's got it much easier when he engages targets.
str_a3_boot_m02_90_shot_composed_ada_0: You'll notice the Sergeant composed himself before he opened up.
str_a3_boot_m02_85_shot_fatigued_ada_0: See? Now the Sergeant has to battle himself as he fires.
str_a3_boot_m02_70_hold_breath_ada_0: Remember: control your breathing. Aim for clean, focused shots.
str_a3_boot_m02_50_take_scope_ada_0: Engaging targets at greater distances is a bit more complicated. Collimator sights - like the sergeant here is using - are not well suited to the task.
str_a3_boot_m02_50_take_scope_ada_1: Sergeant, go ahead and grab the RCO from the crate.
str_a3_boot_m02_45_suggest_prone_ada_0: Going prone offers the best stationary shooting posture, with the least recoil and smallest profile.
str_a3_boot_m02_45_suggest_prone_ada_1: However, be careful of grass and other obstacles obstructing your view.
str_a3_boot_m02_40_suggest_crouch_ada_0: Were he to take a knee, the effort he'd have to put in compensating for the recoil would be reduced.
str_a3_boot_m02_40_suggest_crouch_ada_1: So - whenever possible - try to crouch down before firing.
str_a3_boot_m02_35_suggest_stand_ada_0: If he'd remained standing, he'd've had a tougher time compensating for recoil. It's not impossible, but it's also not ideal.
str_a3_boot_m02_30_shot_prone_ada_0: Ah, I see the Sergeant went prone before engaging the targets. As such, he has the least amount of recoil to deal with, and maintains a lower profile.
str_a3_boot_m02_25_shot_crouch_ada_0: You'll notice that the Sergeant took a knee before firing, which creates a more stable firing position. Try to do this as much as possible.
str_a3_boot_m02_20_shot_stand_ada_0: As you can see, while the Sergeant remains standing upright, he has to work harder to compensate for the recoil.
str_a3_boot_m02_15_introduction_ada_1: I'm Staff Sergeant Adams, this is Sergeant Conway. We'll be your cabin crew for today.
str_a3_boot_m02_15_introduction_ada_2: Since I'm fairly confident we all know why we're here, I'll skip the usual brief.
str_a3_boot_m02_15_introduction_ada_3: So, over to you, Sergeant. When you're ready, put some rounds downrange.
str_a3_boot_m02_110_incident_isa_0: American, please, I need to speak with you. There has been an... Incident. Over.
str_a3_boot_m02_10_assembled_ada_1: Sorry, they're all we've got on hand.
str_a3_boot_m02_100_watch_yourself_ada_0: Again, you need to control your stamina. If you don't, you'll have a hard time hitting anything at all.
str_a3_boot_m02_05_annoying_ada_0: I'm sorry, I thought I told you to go bother someone else?

str_a3_mp_bootcamp_overview: Go through a series of bootcamp activities with friends.
str_a3_mp_bootcamp_debriefing_instructor: You have completed the Bootcamp by leading your recruits and showing them the basics of Arma. Congratulations.
str_a3_mp_bootcamp_briefing_recruit_recr:
Welcome to the Bootcamp,

NATO is in the process of providing us with their knowhow in the military field by training freshly arrived Recruits in order to make sure we, the local army, are able to keep security of our island intact.
str_a3_mp_bootcamp_briefing_recruit_obst: Within our Bootcamp, you can find two unique Obstacle Courses, one aimed at <marker name='BIS_obstacleCourse_infantry'>Infantry</marker> movement and another used for <marker name='BIS_obstacleCourse_vehicles'>Vehicle</marker> handling training.
str_a3_mp_bootcamp_briefing_recruit_firi: Within our Bootcamp, you can find three different Firing Ranges, the <marker name='BIS_firingRange_grenade'>Grenade Firing Range</marker>, <marker name='BIS_firingRange_weapon'>Weapons Firing Range</marker> and the <marker name='BIS_firingRange_vehicle'>Vehicle Firing Range</marker>.
str_a3_mp_bootcamp_briefing_instructor_t:
By the book,

You not only have the chance, but it is also advised to go through each researched, documented and iterated course of training.
These include the Infantry Stage and the Motorized Vehicle Course and can be accessed through the Zeus interface, within the CREATE section, Modules - Training - Bootcamp Stage and place it.

Infantry Stage:
- Guide your Recruits through the Infantry Course and show them the basics of Infantry movement, weapon handling and real world exercise, it is said that, after completing this course, a Recruit is able to behave like a soldier in the front line of a battlefield.

Motorized Vehicles Stage:
- Take your Recruits through the Motorized Vehicles Course and show them the basics of driving a vehicle through a rought terrain, using it's weapons and a real world exercise. There is a considerable amount of reports that after going through this course, a Recruit is able to participate in an operation where he will drive or shoot from a vehicle.
str_a3_mp_bootcamp_briefing_instructor_o:
Within our Bootcamp, you can find two unique Obstacle Courses, one aimed at Infantry movement and another used for Vehicle handling training.

You are expected to guide your Recruits through these courses in order to give them a sense of what moving, crawling through rough places and driving a vehicle actually means.

You are free to participate in a course, which is a good way how to show your Recruits how to do it.
str_a3_mp_bootcamp_briefing_instructor_m:
The way you want,

You are expected to share your skills with your Recruits in the way you see fit. You are not required to go through the Bootcamp Courses of Training (Bootcamp Module) and you can use the tools at your disposal to teach your Recruits what it means to be in a battlefield.
str_a3_mp_bootcamp_briefing_instructor_i:
Welcome to the Bootcamp,

You were asked to share your skills and expertise in the NATO effort to train the Altis local military, the AAF.
str_a3_mp_bootcamp_briefing_instructor_f:
Within our Bootcamp, you can find three different Firing Ranges, the Grenade Firing Range, Weapons Firing Range and the Vehicle Firing Range.

You are expected to guide your Recruits through these courses in order to give them a sense of what moving, crawling through rough places and driving a vehicle actually means.

You are free to participate in a firing range, which is a good way how to show your Recruits how to do it.

str_a3_boot_m03_x55_closed_map_3_ada_0: Sergeant, please, keep your map out.
str_a3_boot_m03_x50_closed_map_2_ada_0: Conway, stop messing around. Show us your map.
str_a3_boot_m03_x45_closed_map_1_ada_0: Come on, Sergeant. Keep your map out.
str_a3_boot_m03_x40_mark_location_again_: Figure you know where they are now, Sergeant?
str_a3_boot_m03_x35_mark_location_info_a: Are you guys around some buildings, or are you in the middle of nowhere?
So you have another road leading to you?
str_a3_boot_m03_x35_mark_location_info_i: We are in a small settlement, just off the main road.
Yes, a dirt track. It took us northeast from the main road itself.
str_a3_boot_m03_x20_mark_hill_wrong_1_ad: A hill with a chapel, Sergeant. Southwest of Syrta.
str_a3_boot_m03_x15_mark_town_wrong_2_ad: Conway. Syrta. Big letters. Mark it.
str_a3_boot_m03_x10_mark_town_wrong_1_ad: Syrta, Sergeant. 3 klicks to the northeast.
str_a3_boot_m03_x05_mark_start_wrong_2_a: Right there, Conway, for God's sake.
str_a3_boot_m03_d05_returned_ada_1: I let Broadway know what's going on. We've been ordered back to base.
str_a3_boot_m03_d05_returned_ada_2: I've told these idiots to clean up the mess. They'll handle the weapons.
str_a3_boot_m03_d05_returned_lac_2: I can't help but think the guerrillas won't take too kindly to this.
str_a3_boot_m03_d01_situation_ada_1: And these people? They attacked you?
str_a3_boot_m03_d01_situation_ada_3: Did you sweep the buildings? And what's the deal with that man over there?
str_a3_boot_m03_d01_situation_isa_0: We were on patrol. We were attacked.
str_a3_boot_m03_d01_situation_ada_4: You searched all of them? ... Including the ones down there?
str_a3_boot_m03_d01_situation_lac_2: You ever heard of excessive force?
str_a3_boot_m03_d01_situation_ada_5: And that man? Do you have medical support inbound?
str_a3_boot_m03_d01_situation_ada_6: Sergeant, search those buildings down there.
str_a3_boot_m03_d01_situation_ada_7: The rest of you, set up a perimeter.
str_a3_boot_m03_d01_situation_ada_8: And you, call for a goddamn medevac. Now.
str_a3_boot_m03_95_left_2_ada_1: Take the left, Conway. Around the town.
str_a3_boot_m03_90_gps_ada_0: Keep an eye on the GPS, Sergeant.
str_a3_boot_m03_80_get_in_ada_0: The rest of you? Load up!
str_a3_boot_m03_75_orders_ada_0: Okay. We're going to go find your friends.
str_a3_boot_m03_75_orders_ada_1: Keep yourselves busy while we're gone.
str_a3_boot_m03_70_en_route_ada_1: We're on our way. Stay put. Out.
str_a3_boot_m03_60_mark_location_ada_0: You'll notice the lines intersect. That, in a nutshell, is all we're looking for.
str_a3_boot_m03_60_mark_location_ada_1: It tells us that - if the information provided is accurate - they must be somewhere near there.
str_a3_boot_m03_60_mark_location_ada_2: However, the intersect won't always be exact. Use common sense to enhance your accuracy, or try to obtain further information.
str_a3_boot_m03_60_mark_location_ada_3: Over to you, Sergeant. Stick a marker on their position.
str_a3_boot_m03_55_hill_marked_ada_0: Alright. The bearing they gave us was 130.
str_a3_boot_m03_55_hill_marked_ada_1: However, that's from them to the chapel. We want to work out the bearing from the chapel to their position.
str_a3_boot_m03_55_hill_marked_ada_2: So, let's do a 180... That makes it 310 from the chapel itself.
str_a3_boot_m03_50_mark_hill_ada_0: That's probably somewhere southwest of Syrta itself.
str_a3_boot_m03_50_mark_hill_ada_1: Think you can locate it, Sergeant?
str_a3_boot_m03_49_more_info_ada_0: Can you guys give us any other landmarks to go on?
str_a3_boot_m03_49_more_info_isa_0: There´s a hill nearby. It has a small chapel on top of it. It´s at bearing... 130, from our position. Over.
str_a3_boot_m03_45_town_marked_ada_0: Now, let's draw a line going west from Syrta.
str_a3_boot_m03_40_mark_town_ada_0: Alright, Sergeant, stick a marker on Syrta. It should be about 3 klicks to the northeast.
str_a3_boot_m03_35_info_ada_1: We need some landmarks to go off, here. Do you have anything we can use? Did you spot anything recognizable en route to your location? Over.
str_a3_boot_m03_35_info_isa_1: Well... We know that we are west of Syrta. We drove through it.
str_a3_boot_m03_30_triangulate_ada_0: We're going to try and triangulate their position. However, before we get on to that...
str_a3_boot_m03_25_grids_ada_0: Before we begin, Sergeant - if you'd be so kind - stick a marker on our location. 066-159.
str_a3_boot_m03_25_grids_ada_1: For those just tuning in, six-figure grids are a crucial navigational tool.
str_a3_boot_m03_25_grids_ada_2: Coordinates are read from the bottom first, followed by the ones that run up the side.
str_a3_boot_m03_20_lesson_ada_1: Since your people are completely incapable of intelligent thought, it has fallen upon us to rescue them from certain doom.
str_a3_boot_m03_150_rtb_ada_0: Alright, everyone. Mount up. We're out of here.
str_a3_boot_m03_145_stash_found_isa_0: You see? They were a threat.
str_a3_boot_m03_145_stash_found_lac_0: Adams, I've got a weapon stash here. Small arms and explosives. Definitely guerrilla. Over.
str_a3_boot_m03_145_stash_found_lac_1: Yeah, and I'm sure they just attacked you for no reason.
str_a3_boot_m03_135_clear_2_lac_0: Small one's clear. Continuing the search.
str_a3_boot_m03_110_sitrep_ada_0: Keep driving. I'll check with MacKinnon.
str_a3_boot_m03_110_sitrep_ada_1: Broadway, Alpha 1-1 Actual. Was that what I think it was? Over.
str_a3_boot_m03_110_sitrep_ada_3: Yeah, we got it, Colonel. 1-1 out.
str_a3_boot_m03_110_sitrep_bhq_0: Confirmed, 1-1. Just a small tremor. No cause for concern. Over.
str_a3_boot_m03_110_sitrep_ihq_0: Phalanx to all units, we just experienced a light earthquake. Do not be alarmed. Return to your posts and resume your duties. Out.
str_a3_boot_m03_110_sitrep_bsa_0: Guess some Greenbacks must have shit themselves.
str_a3_boot_m03_10_gather_ada_1: Come on, don't be shy now - we're going to learn something useful.
str_a3_boot_m03_105_earthquake_bsa_1: For the record, I'm blaming CSAT.
str_a3_boot_m03_05_idiots_ada_0: It's always something with these people...
str_a3_boot_m03_01_start_ada_0: What do you mean 'incident'? Send us your grid. Over.
str_a3_boot_m03_01_start_isa_1: We do not have a map.
str_a3_boot_m03_50_location_marked_ada_0: Yup, that looks like it's them.
str_a3_boot_m03_45_hill_marked_ada_0: Okay, look where the lines intersect. They should be some place near there. Think you can figure out where?
str_a3_boot_m03_40_mark_hill_ada_0: Sounds like that's probably southwest from Syrta. Think you can locate?
str_a3_boot_m03_35_radio_ada_0: Can you identify any other landmarks? A hill, a road, anything? Over.
str_a3_boot_m03_35_radio_ada_1: Okay, that should help. Hold on.
str_a3_boot_m03_35_radio_isa_0: We have a hill southeast of us, bearing... 130. It has a small chapel on it. Over.
str_a3_boot_m03_30_more_info_ada_0: Well that's not overly helpful. Hold on.
str_a3_boot_m03_25_town_marked_ada_0: They said they're to the west, so let's see where that takes us...
str_a3_boot_m03_20_mark_town_ada_0: Now stick one on Syrta. It should be about 3 klicks northeast of us.
str_a3_boot_m03_15_mark_start_ada_0: Alright, stick a marker on our position. Grid 066 160.

str_a3_zone_restriction_a_warn_no_leader: Where the hell am I? I should check my map.
This doesn't look right at all. Where am I?
Wow, I must be way off course. Better check my map.
str_a3_zone_restriction_a_warn_leader_de: Corporal, you're heading into a minefield. Get back to the mission area.
Heads-up, soldier, you're approaching a minefield. Suggest you return to the AO, over.

str_a3_zone_restriction_a_warn_has_leade: Kerry, where the fuck are you going? Get back here!
Uh, Kerry, we're over here. The hell are you going?
STR_A3_CampaignOverview: Survive and adapt to unforgiving circumstances, and win victory over a more powerful enemy.
STR_A3_StageAOverview: Tensions rise as NATO peacekeeping forces begin to leave The Republic of Altis: a strategic fault-line between crumbling European influence and a powerful, resurgent East.
str_a3_cfgorbat.fsmbis_i_aaf_description: Post civil-war armed forces loyal to the new hard-line Altis government. Limited but growing in strength. Entrenched in a long-standing conflict with FIA guerrillas.
str_a3_cfgorbat.fsmbis_b_falcon_descript: The surviving remnants of TF Aegis, led by UKSF Captain Scott Miller.
str_a3_cfgorbat.fsmbis_b_falcon_d_descri: Miller's CTRG (Combat Technology Research Group) team. Operational remit unknown.
str_a3_cfgorbat.fsmbis_b_falcon_c_descri: A weakened squad composed of mainly non-combat and walking-wounded, usually tasked with providing support.
str_a3_cfgorbat.fsmbis_b_falcon_b_descri: Secondary squad, tasked with providing recon and backup to Alpha.
str_a3_cfgorbat.fsmbis_b_falcon_a_descri: Primary squad, comprised of mostly experienced soldiers, capable of a variety of mission profiles.
str_a3_cfgorbat.fsmbis_b_aegis_descripti: A US-led joint NATO-AAF peacekeeping force stationed on Stratis, with a strictly limited mandate and combat capacity.

str_a3_campaign_quote_23: 'Brave men are all vertebrates, they have their softness on the surface and their toughness in the middle.' - Lewis Carroll

str_a3_campaign_quote_16: 'We succeed only as we identify in life, or in war, or in anything else, a single overriding objective, and make all other considerations bend to that one objective.' - Dwight D. Eisenhower

STR_A3_Campaign_Intro_01: Although five years have passed since bloody civil war was brought to an end in the Republic of Altis and Stratis, the impact upon civilian infrastructure remains marked.
STR_A3_Campaign_Intro_02: Thousands of families remain displaced, refugees scattered across countries around the Mediterranean basin.
STR_A3_Campaign_Intro_03: However, with the US-led peacekeeping deployment coming to an end of its mandate, NATO forces are finalising their staged withdrawal from the region.
STR_A3_Campaign_Intro_04: As millions of dollars of military equipment and infrastructure is decommissioned, opinion is split as to the wisdom of the drawdown.
STR_A3_Campaign_Intro_05: In light of CSAT forces stepping up joint military exercises in the Pacific, the US is keen to re-orient its conventional forces, reinforcing battalions in the east.
STR_A3_Campaign_Intro_06: Yet, with the Mediterranean basin representing a strategic fault-line between crumbling European influence and a powerful, resurgent East, some argue that the withdrawal could not come at a worse time.
STR_A3_Campaign_Intro_07: The FIA are becoming increasingly desperate, as AAF forces begin to consolidate their position on Altis with the backing of Canton Protocol forces equipment and training.
STR_A3_Campaign_Intro_08: The fifth anniversary of the Jerusalem Ceasefire again was used as a platform to push the legitimacy of the government in Pygros, with the commander of Altis Armed Forces, Colonel Georgious Akhanteros, bullishly defending the legacy of his military coup.
STR_A3_Campaign_Intro_09: 'When Europe cast us out of their failed union of states, we rose from the ashes of a false society, a false economic norm.'
STR_A3_Campaign_Intro_10: 'We gave new hope to our unemployed. Without Berlin's noose around our neck! We stand for what was, is, and will forever be our own! Our land! Our people! One Nation. Altis!'
STR_A3_Campaign_Intro_11: 'Our CSAT partners recognise the new truth. The potential of our nation. We share with them and grow. They represent the new future. Our new future, our new truth.'
STR_A3_Campaign_Intro_12: In the UK, parliament was recalled for an urgent debate and vote over the possible redeployment of British peacekeeping forces on Stratis.
STR_A3_Campaign_Intro_13: 'Two decades of economic misery simply cannot be ignored. Britain is an island, not an empire. The answer is no longer 'send a gunboat' - it hasn't been the answer for the last fifty years!'
STR_A3_Campaign_Intro_14: Prime Minister Nicholas Ramsden said he would respect the defeat of his government's motion, which, effectively, ruled out the possibility of any extension to the NATO deployment in the former sovereign territory.
STR_A3_Campaign_Intro_15: Meanwhile, civil disorder spilled over into a third week of violent riots and mass protest across European capitals.
STR_A3_Campaign_Intro_16: Again, the streets of Paris and Rome were ablaze last night as military-enforced curfews passed ignored, and the number of deaths rose into the hundreds.
STR_A3_Campaign_Intro_17: 'CSAT wants to invest in Altis? Let them! The US can no longer be seen to prop up Europe's failed economic situation. This is their mess. We got our own problems - let's deal with those.'
STR_A3_EPA_Campaign_Intro_01: Although five years have passed since bloody civil war was brought to an end ...
STR_A3_EPA_Campaign_Intro_02: ... thousands of families remain displaced, refugees scattered across countries around the Mediterranean ...
STR_A3_EPA_Campaign_Intro_03: ... The FIA are becoming increasingly desperate ...
STR_A3_EPA_Campaign_Intro_04: ... with the US-led peacekeeping deployment coming to an end of its mandate ...
STR_A3_EPA_Campaign_Intro_05: As millions of dollars of military equipment is decommissioned, opinion is split as to the wisdom of the drawdown.
STR_A3_EPA_Campaign_Intro_06: In light of CSAT forces stepping up joint military exercises in the Pacific ...
STR_A3_EPA_Campaign_Intro_07: ... the US is keen to re-orient its conventional forces.
STR_A3_EPA_Campaign_Intro_08: ... the Mediterranean basin representing a strategic fault-line between crumbling European influence ...
STR_A3_EPA_Campaign_Intro_09: ... the streets of Paris and Rome were ablaze last night ...
STR_A3_EPA_Campaign_Intro_10: ... some argue that the withdrawal could not come at a worse time.
STR_A3_EPA_Campaign_Intro_11: ... as AAF forces begin to consolidate their position with the backing of Canton Protocol forces equipment ...
