str_a3_a_m03_overview: The survivors launch a coordinated assault on Air Station Mike-26.
str_a3_a_m03_x15_too_close_alp_0: Dammit, they're too close for our mortar.
str_a3_a_m03_x10_no_ammo_alp_1: Alright, looks like we're going to have to do this the hard way.
str_a3_a_m03_x05_out_of_ammo_alp_0: Dammit, looks like you didn't get all of them.
str_a3_a_m03_x01_compromised_alp_0: What the fuck are you doing, Kerry?!
str_a3_a_m03_i05_lead_targets_alp_0: Make sure that you lead the moving targets.
str_a3_a_m03_i05_lead_targets_alp_1: Don't fire at where they are, but where they're going to be.
str_a3_a_m03_i05_lead_targets_alp_2: And remember, we're running low, don't waste the rounds all at once!
str_a3_a_m03_i01_designate_targets_alp_0: The way I see it, Kerry, you've got two options. Either you call out targets visually, or you read off the grid from your map.
str_a3_a_m03_i01_designate_targets_alp_1: Just remember to use both to adjust Charlie's fire as needed.
str_a3_a_m03_i01_designate_targets_alp_2: These are the only rounds we've got, so try not to waste them!
str_a3_a_m03_50_reinf_dead_alp_0: Alpha to Falcon, enemy reinforcements neutralized. Awaiting further orders, over.
str_a3_a_m03_50_reinf_dead_mil_0: Outstanding, Alpha, entrench your position for now.
str_a3_a_m03_50_reinf_dead_mil_1: Delta's en route. They'll take a look at setting up long-range comms.
str_a3_a_m03_50_reinf_dead_mil_2: All call-signs, good work. We'll regroup at Maxwell after Delta inspects the Air Station.
str_a3_a_m03_50b_reinf_dead_alp_0: Alpha to Falcon, enemy reinforcements neutralized. Awaiting further orders, over.
str_a3_a_m03_50b_reinf_dead_bra_0: Wait, what?! You can't just blow it up! What the fuck was all this for then?!
str_a3_a_m03_50b_reinf_dead_del_0: Bad news, sir. We've got nothing here - no way to establish a link to MEDCOM - all the equipment's fried.
str_a3_a_m03_50b_reinf_dead_mil_0: Fine work, Alpha, entrench your position for now.
str_a3_a_m03_50b_reinf_dead_del_1: At least we can rig it to blow. We're setting the charges now.
str_a3_a_m03_50b_reinf_dead_mil_2: Stand down, Bravo. That's an order. If we cant hold it, we raze it.
str_a3_a_m03_50b_reinf_dead_mil_3: Proceed, Delta. Burn it down. The rest of you, fall back to Maxwell. Falcon Out.
str_a3_a_m03_45_designate_alp_0: Kerry, there's another watch tower at the northern end of the facility.
str_a3_a_m03_45_designate_alp_1: Get up there and put our remaining rounds to good use, Charlie's standing by.
str_a3_a_m03_40_reinf_alp_0: Solid copy, Falcon. We'll be ready for them. Alpha out.
str_a3_a_m03_40_reinf_mil_0: Confirmed, Alpha. Delta reports two AAF motorized infantry squads inbound from Rogain. How copy?
str_a3_a_m03_40b_reinf_del_0: This is Delta, be advised, Greenbacks are definitely mobilizing!
str_a3_a_m03_40b_reinf_del_1: We counted at least two mech-infantry squads gearing up at Rogain.
str_a3_a_m03_40b_reinf_del_2: We're en route back to your position now, we'll try to open up a channel to MEDCOM.
str_a3_a_m03_40b_reinf_del_3: Just watch your fire - we're coming in from the north-east.
str_a3_a_m03_35_mike26_clear_alp_0: Falcon, this is Alpha. Be advised, we've secured Mike-26. Any word on AAF reinforcements? Over.
str_a3_a_m03_35_mike26_clear_mil_0: Excellent work, Alpha. This takes us one step closer to leaving this rock. Wait one.
str_a3_a_m03_30_attack_alp_0: Alpha to Bravo, engage when ready. Engage when ready. Do you copy?
str_a3_a_m03_30_attack_bra_0: We copy you, Alpha. Bravo's on the move. Out.
str_a3_a_m03_20_targets_alp_0: All right, Kerry, you're up - call out targets for Charlie.
str_a3_a_m03_20_targets_alp_1: Remember, the tower at Bravo's entry point - anything guarding the main entrance - has priority.
str_a3_a_m03_15_at_op_alp_0: All units, be advised, we've taken up a position on overwatch.
str_a3_a_m03_15_at_op_alp_1: Charlie, expect requests for fire missions shortly. Out.
str_a3_a_m03_01_start_alp_0: Alpha to Bravo, Charlie, what's your status? Over.
str_a3_a_m03_01_start_bra_0: This is Bravo. In position. Awaiting the order. Over.
str_a3_a_m03_01_start_cha_0: Charlie here, we're almost set up. ETA 2 mikes. Over.
str_a3_a_m03_debriefing_a_hub01_2_descri: In spite of you compromising the initial assault, you managed to seize Air Station Mike-26. However, Delta determined the facility to be unusable - it wasn't possible to establish contact with NATO MEDCOM. Refusing to let it fall back into enemy hands, Miller authorized its destruction. Let's hope it was worth it.
str_a3_a_m03_debriefing_a_hub01_1_descri: Air Station Mike-26 is secured and you successfully repelled the reinforcements. However, Delta determined the facility to be unusable - it wasn't possible to establish contact with NATO MEDCOM. Refusing to let it fall back into enemy hands, Miller authorized its destruction. Let's hope it was worth it.
str_a3_a_m03_briefing_situation_text: As I'm sure you're all well aware, comms are still down. Efforts to restore contact with NATO MEDCOM have, thus far, proven fruitless. The plain truth is, gentlemen, with the AAF regrouping, we must re-establish a link soon.%1Now, aside from %2the airbase%3, %4Mike-26%5 is probably the most hi-tech installation on Stratis. It's also one of the most strategically valuable positions on the island.%6It's a risk, but hitting the facility will deal a serious blow to the AAF, and - if anywhere holds an opportunity to re-open comms channels - it's there.%7This will be a coordinated effort. Charlie will set up %8a mortar%9. %10Alpha%11 will %12provide overwatch%13 and mark priority targets. We'll strike hard from distance and - together with %14Bravo%15 - move in quickly, holding the position against any potential counter-attack.
str_a3_a_m03_briefing_signal_text: %1Alpha%2 - Your squad.%3%4Bravo%5 - Supporting element.%6%7Charlie%8 - Mortar team.%9%10Falcon%11 - Camp Maxwell HQ.%12%13Delta%14 - Recon element.
str_a3_a_m03_briefing_mission_text: With the support of %1Charlie%2 and %3Bravo%4, assault and hold %5Air Station Mike-26%6.
str_a3_a_m03_briefing_execution_text:
1. Take up %1a position on overwatch%2 above %3Mike-26%4.
2. Designate the watch towers for %5Charlie's mortar team%6.
3. Clear the AAF from the vicinity of Mike-26.
4. Hold the facility against any potential counter-attack.
str_a3_a_m03_bis_towers_desc: Neutralize the 3 critical watch towers with the support of %1Charlie%2.
str_a3_a_m03_bis_reinf_desc: AAF reinforcements are inbound %1from the north%2; prevent them from re-capturing %3the facility%4.
str_a3_a_m03_bis_op_desc: Set up %1an overwatch position%2 overlooking %3Air Station Mike-26%4.
str_a3_a_m03_bis_mike26_desc: With the towers neutralised, assist %1Bravo%2 with the capture of %3Mike-26%4.
str_a3_a_m05_overview: An opportunity to neutralize an AAF commander presents itself.
str_a3_a_m05_debriefing_a_hub01_1_descri:
You managed to clear the town and successfully neutralized a high-ranking enemy officer. Unfortunately, it was not our intended target, Goblin.

While the loss of this commander won't go unnoticed among the AAF, it was not the decisive blow we were looking for. Instead, we may have just kicked the hornet's nest.
str_a3_a_m05_briefing_situation_text: Recon reports indicate that the AAF will make a push south in the next few hours. It appears they're keen to lock down the area around %1Girna%2.%3Intel suggests that the highest-ranking officer on Stratis will himself be in the area. Neutralizing him will deal a serious blow to our enemy. Decapitating their command structure may even signal an end to this whole situation.%4We simply cannot let this opportunity pass us by.%5Now, we've come up with a plan of action. My team has a submersible stashed %6just off the west coast%7. That's why we asked for volunteers - those with diving experience.%8One of my men will use it to lead a small team and insert %9just north of Girna%10. Meanwhile, %11Bravo%12 will circle around and take up %13a position to the south%14. Once both teams are in place, we close the trap.
str_a3_a_m05_briefing_signal_text: %1Swordfish%2 - Your squad.%3%4Bravo%5 - Supporting element.%6%7Falcon%8 - Camp Maxwell HQ.%9Charlie - Camp Maxwell defense.
str_a3_a_m05_briefing_mission_text: Insert at %1the bay%2 and take up %3a position%4 north of %5Girna%6. Coordinate with %7Bravo%8, clear the village of hostile forces and neutralize the High Value Target.
str_a3_a_m05_briefing_execution_text:
1. Use %1the SDV%2 to insert at %3the bay%4.
2. Move into %5position%6 above the town.
3. Clear %7Girna%8 of all hostile forces.
4. Neutralize and verify the HVT, codename: Goblin, located there.
str_a3_a_m05_bis_truck_desc: Get in the truck as a passenger.
str_a3_a_m05_bis_town_desc: Neutralize all enemy forces in %1the town%2. Let none escape.
str_a3_a_m05_bis_position_desc: After inserting, move to %1your team's position%2 overlooking %3Girna%4.
str_a3_a_m05_bis_insert_desc: Using %1the SDV%2, insert with your team on %3the beach%4 north of %5Girna%6.
str_a3_a_m05_bis_identify_desc: Locate and identify the body of our target.
str_a3_a_m05_bis_extract_desc: Enemy reinforcements are inbound. Retreat to %1Camp Maxwell%2.
str_a3_a_m05_x01_no_truck_del_0: Damn... had you cowboys not wasted it, we could have used that truck.
str_a3_a_m05_x01_no_truck_del_1: You guys head south on foot and loop around.
str_a3_a_m05_x01_no_truck_del_2: Falcon, the others are moving out on foot. I'm going to double back for the SDV.
str_a3_a_m05_x01_no_truck_del_3: Meet you back at Maxwell, over.
str_a3_a_m05_95_truck_del_0: There's a truck in the center of town! Everyone, load up!
str_a3_a_m05_95_truck_del_1: Falcon, be advised, the others are commandeering a truck. I'm going to double back for the SDV
str_a3_a_m05_95_truck_del_2: Meet you guys back at Maxwell, over.
str_a3_a_m05_90_retreat_del_0: Falcon, be advised, our intel was faulty. The target isn't here. Over.
str_a3_a_m05_90_retreat_del_1: It's definitely a high-ranking officer, sir, but it's not our target. Over.
str_a3_a_m05_90_retreat_mil_0: Say again, Swordfish? You're positive it's not him? Over.
str_a3_a_m05_90_retreat_mil_1: Shit... Understood, Swordfish. Get yourselves back here. Falcon out.
str_a3_a_m05_85_identified_ker_1: It's not him! It's an officer - pretty high-ranking - but it's not our guy!
str_a3_a_m05_75_identify_del_0: Kerry, find and verify the target.
str_a3_a_m05_70_town_clear_del_0: Falcon, this is Swordfish. Enemy forces in Girna neutralized. Over.
str_a3_a_m05_70_town_clear_del_1: Making a sweep now, sir. Over.
str_a3_a_m05_70_town_clear_mil_0: Copy that, Swordfish. Great job. Do you have a kill confirmation on our target? Over.
str_a3_a_m05_70_town_clear_mil_1: Be quick about it, Swordfish. Assume enemy forces at Tempest are mobilizing.
str_a3_a_m05_70_town_clear_mil_2: I'd estimate you have about 5 minutes until they're on top of you. Over.
str_a3_a_m05_67_move_in_del_0: Alright, move in. Sweep the village!
str_a3_a_m05_67_move_in_del_1: I'll hold my position here on overwatch.
str_a3_a_m05_55_ready_bra_0: Falcon, we've got a visual here. HVT in a courtyard in the center of town. Over.
str_a3_a_m05_55_ready_del_0: Swordfish to Falcon. In position. Over.
str_a3_a_m05_55_ready_mil_0: Copy that. Have you got eyes on the target? Over.
str_a3_a_m05_55_ready_mil_1: Understood. The ball's in your court now, Swordfish. Good luck. Out.
str_a3_a_m05_54_report_in_bravo_bra_0: Falcon, this is Bravo. We're in position. Awaiting your signal. Over.
str_a3_a_m05_54_report_in_bravo_del_0: Wilco, sir. We're en route. Swordfish out.
str_a3_a_m05_54_report_in_bravo_mil_2: Swordfish, looks like we're just waiting on you. Get moving, over.
str_a3_a_m05_53_move_del_1: Hold fire until we're ready to strike.
str_a3_a_m05_50_report_in_del_0: Falcon, this is Swordfish. Be advised, we've inserted north of Girna.
str_a3_a_m05_50_report_in_del_1: We encountered a Greenback patrol, but I doubt they were able to get a warning out. Moving into position now, over.
str_a3_a_m05_50_report_in_mil_0: Copy that, Swordfish. Move quickly. The guys in the town probably heard the shots.
str_a3_a_m05_40_enemies_spotted_del_0: Contact. Four guys, on the beach.
str_a3_a_m05_35_dont_touch_alpa_0: Yeah. Please don't touch any of them.
str_a3_a_m05_30_get_out_del_0: Okay, end of the line. Everyone out.
str_a3_a_m05_15_big_boat_del_1: We'll insert at the bay and move up to a vantage point above the village.
str_a3_a_m05_15_big_boat_del_2: Syncing with Bravo, we'll strike together and neutralize enemy forces.
str_a3_a_m05_10_doubt_del_2: It's need to know, Corporal. If you see what I mean.
str_a3_a_m05_10_doubt_ker_1: Why are we on this mission, exactly? Why didn't Miller just leave it to you guys?
str_a3_a_m05_10_treasure_alpa_0: See that wreck? I wonder if there's some buried treasure in there.
str_a3_a_m05_10_treasure_alpb_0: Nah, it's just a fishing trawler.
str_a3_a_out_105_contacts_del_0: Miller! To the left! Fastmovers inbound!
str_a3_a_out_overview: The survivors launch a last-ditch effort to drive the remaining AAF units into the sea.
str_a3_a_out_briefing_situation_text: I know things don't look good for us right now. We took a hit. We lost a number of good men.%1Now, nothing I've got to say will change that fact, but I do have new information. Late last night Delta managed to establish temporary long-range comms with NATO MEDCOM. %2Reinforcements%3 are inbound, gentlemen.%4We need to lay the groundwork for a full invasion. They need an established foothold, not %5a broken down base hidden in the woods%6. I say we attack now. We catch the AAF off-guard. We hold the ground we seize.%7I'll lead Delta behind enemy lines and take up %8an advanced position to the North of Agia Marina%9. %10Alpha%11 and %12Bravo%13 will lead the assault on %14the military range%15, while %16Charlie%17 hit %18Camp Rogain%19 and contain any counter-attack that might flank our main assault.%20Once the Range is secure, we'll converge on %21the town%22 and entrench our position. I'll go through the exact details of the plan with each individual squad leader. They'll bring the rest of their men up to speed.%23'With fearlessness and rage', gentlemen. Good luck.
str_a3_a_out_briefing_signal_text: %1Alpha%2 - Your team.%3%4Bravo%5 - Supporting squad.%6%7Charlie%8 - Tasked with assaulting %9Camp Rogain%10.%11%12Delta%13 - Tasked with flanking %14Agia Marina%15, Operational Lead.
str_a3_a_out_briefing_mission_text: Advance and secure a number of key locations. Clear %1the military range%2 before converging upon %3the town%4. Hold the ground.
str_a3_a_out_briefing_execution_text:
1. Seize %1the military range%2.
2. Advance and clear %3Agia Marina%4 of AAF forces.
3. Entrench your position and await %5inbound NATO reinforcements%6.
str_a3_a_out_bis_town_desc: Once %1the military range%2 has been secured, move on to %3the town%4 and clear it of all remaining AAF.
str_a3_a_out_bis_retreat_desc: Contact with Broadway has been lost and Miller has ordered a full retreat. Rendezvous with him and evacuate from the island.
str_a3_a_out_bis_range_desc: Clear %1the military range%2 with the help of %3Bravo%4.
str_a3_a_out_bis_guerrillas_desc: Follow Captain Miller and attempt to rendezvous with the guerrillas on Altis.
str_a3_a_out_bis_boats_desc: Get in the Speedboat as a passenger.
str_a3_a_out_x01_spotted_alp_0: What the fuck are you doing, Corporal Kerry?!
str_a3_a_out_95_situation_ker_1: Respectfully, sir, when the hell are you going to tell us what's going on?
str_a3_a_out_95_situation_mil_1: Saying 'respectfully', Corporal, and proceeding to be disrespectful somewhat defeats the purpose, don't you think?
str_a3_a_out_95_situation_mil_2: ... Look, I can't say exactly what happened. What I can say is what's happening right now.
str_a3_a_out_95_situation_mil_4: There's a local guerilla movement there - FIA - the same guys that got themselves killed for us back on Stratis.
str_a3_a_out_95_situation_mil_5: We'll make a quiet entrance and link up with them.
str_a3_a_out_80_boats_mil_1: Get the fuck into the boats!
str_a3_a_out_65_mortars_alp_1: Keep moving! They'll have a harder time getting a bead on you!
str_a3_a_out_60_to_rv_mil_0: They're non-responsive, Alpha. There's nothing we can do for them.
str_a3_a_out_60_to_rv_mil_1: Unless you'd like to end up the same way, I suggest you get your ass into gear!
str_a3_a_out_60_to_rv_mil_2: Double time, Alpha. We'll be waiting. Delta out.
str_a3_a_out_55_retreat_alp_0: Delta, this is Alpha! What the hell is going on?! Over!
str_a3_a_out_55_retreat_alp_1: Captain Miller! Do you read? Respond!
str_a3_a_out_55_retreat_mil_0: Alpha, Bravo, listen carefully. There's not much time. These guys mean business.
str_a3_a_out_55_retreat_mil_1: Disengage. Fall back from the town. Head north.
str_a3_a_out_55_retreat_mil_2: We'll RV at a small bay. Grid 032 068.
str_a3_a_out_45_under_attack_cha_0: All callsigns, this is Charlie! We're facing a huge counter-attack here! We're being engaged by multiple unknown contacts!
str_a3_a_out_45_under_attack_cha_1: Numerous aircraft and infantry firing on our positions! Charlie is under heavy assault, I say again -
str_a3_a_out_40_orders_alp_0: Alpha to Delta, a bunch of unidentified helos just buzzed the capital, heading east. Please advise, over.
str_a3_a_out_30_nato_inbound_alp_0: Fan-fucking-tastic, Delta! Any guess why? Over.
str_a3_a_out_30_nato_inbound_alp_1: Solid copy, Delta. We'll get it done. Alpha out.
str_a3_a_out_30_nato_inbound_mil_0: Splendid news, Alpha. We see AAF forces pulling back. Acknowledge, over.
str_a3_a_out_30_nato_inbound_mil_1: Uncertain. It could be that they're regrouping for a counter-offensive.
str_a3_a_out_30_nato_inbound_mil_2: Either way, now is the time to strike. Push forward, Alpha. Seize and hold.
str_a3_a_out_27_charlie_status_cha_0: We're dug in. Exchanging fire with multiple contacts in the vicinity of Rogain. Over.
str_a3_a_out_27_charlie_status_cha_1: Solid Copy, Delta. Not a chance in hell of that. Charlie out.
str_a3_a_out_27_charlie_status_mil_1: Roger. Keep the situation contained, Charlie. Don't get greedy, understood? Over.
str_a3_a_out_25_to_town_alp_0: Delta, this is Alpha. We've taken the mil-range. Ready to proceed to the town. How copy? Over.
str_a3_a_out_25_to_town_mil_1: All teams, we are go for main assault. Delta's advancing. Out.
str_a3_a_out_15_attack_alp_0: Alpha to Delta, we've linked up with Bravo. Beginning the main assault. Get ready. Over.
str_a3_a_out_100_insane_ker_2: We're walking straight into a hornet's nest!
str_a3_a_out_100_insane_mil_1: It's our best option - and there are only bad options.
str_a3_a_out_03_warning_alp_0: Alpha to Charlie, be advised, we've spotted enemy reinforcements heading in your direction. Over.
str_a3_a_out_03_warning_cha_0: Copy that, Alpha. Thanks for the heads-up. Out.
str_a3_a_out_01_start_alp_0: This is Alpha, en route to the RV. ETA: 60 seconds. Over.
str_a3_a_out_01_start_mil_0: Delta to all callsigns. We're in position. Send SITREP, over.
str_a3_a_out_01_start_cha_0: Charlie to Delta, we're on approach. Should have visual contact in a few seconds, over.
str_a3_a_out_01_start_mil_2: Alright, gentlemen, we've got one shot at this. Let's get it done. Out.
str_a3_a_m02_overview: Friendly forces are pinned down in Girna.
str_a3_a_m02_debriefing_a_hub01_2_descri:
It was risky but, thanks to you, Bravo are safe and an enemy mortar position is out of action.

While we're not yet in a position to hold the ground we took - and despite being forced to retreat - we managed to adapt to the situation on the ground and strike another blow against the AAF.
str_a3_a_m02_debriefing_a_hub01_1_descri:
It was risky but, thanks to you, Bravo are safe.

While we're not yet in a position to hold the ground we took - and despite being forced to retreat - we managed to adapt to the situation on the ground and strike another blow against the AAF.
str_a3_a_m02_briefing_situation_text: As you're probably aware, we've been scouting positions to our north, keeping a check on enemy movement.%1Unfortunately, Bravo ran into trouble, taking contact in %2a village%3 a little to the west of %4our position%5.%6They're pinned down and need our support.%7An advanced element has already set up %8a position nearby%9 to get eyes on the situation. AAF units have mobilized along the valley leading to the village. More support is no doubt en route.%10%11Alpha%12 will approach from the east. Use the high ground and forest to your advantage. Clear the village and get our boys out of there.
str_a3_a_m02_briefing_signal_text: %1Alpha%2 - Your squad.%3%4Bravo%5 - Friendly element in Girna.%6%7Falcon%8 - Camp Maxwell HQ.%9%10Charlie%11 - Supporting element.%12%13Delta%14 - Camp Maxwell defence.
str_a3_a_m02_briefing_mission_text: Support Bravo by eliminating AAF contacts in the vicinity of %1Girna%2.
str_a3_a_m02_briefing_execution_text:
1. Move along the ridgeline and get into position.
2. Secure %1Bravo's position%2.
3. Return to %3Camp Maxwell%4.
str_a3_a_m02_bis_village_desc: Assault and secure %1the village%2. Take care to avoid friendly fire. Bravo are holed up in %3this building%4.
str_a3_a_m02_bis_uav_desc: Equip both the backpack and UAV terminal, and deploy the Darter.
str_a3_a_m02_bis_spotters_desc: Mortars have opened fire on %1Girna%2. Locate and eliminate %3the spotters%4 before it's too late!
str_a3_a_m02_bis_rtb_desc: An AAF Buzzard has engaged %1Girna%2. Fall back to %3Camp Maxwell%4.
str_a3_a_m02_bis_pointman_desc: You lost contact with your man on point. Divert to %1his last known position%2.
str_a3_a_m02_bis_overwatch_desc: Bravo are pinned down in %1Girna%2. Take the high ground and use the forest to cover your approach.
str_a3_a_m02_bis_defend_desc: Your squad mate is down! Cover the medic as he tries to stabilize him.
str_a3_a_m02_x20_faster_charlie_cha_0: Keep moving! He's not done yet!
str_a3_a_m02_x01_bravo_dead_mil_0: Falcon to all squads, we've lost comms with Bravo. Presumed KIA. Fall back, ASAP. Out.
str_a3_a_m02_i05_uav_scouting_bra_0: Think of it as a micro-helicopter, Corporal. Pitch, bank, rudder, all that crap.
str_a3_a_m02_i05_uav_scouting_bra_1: The thing's got thermal. Use it to pick out the assholes from the trees.
str_a3_a_m02_i05_uav_scouting_bra_2: Once you've found them, pick them off yourself if you think you can. Otherwise, mark them for Charlie to fuck up.
str_a3_a_m02_i05_uav_scouting_bra_3: Just don't take too long! We haven't exactly got all day here!
str_a3_a_m02_i01_grenade_launcher_alp_0: Kerry, if you can take your 3GL to a vantage point, you might be able to rain down hell as we move up!
str_a3_a_m02_i01_grenade_launcher_alp_1: But be careful where you aim that thing, it ain't going to behave like a normal round! Try not to blow us up in the process!
str_a3_a_m02_95_designated_cha_0: Copy on your mark, Alpha! Engaging!
str_a3_a_m02_90_designate_bra_0: Just don't take all day, guys! We're kind of in a situation here! Out!
str_a3_a_m02_90_designate_cha_0: Alpha, Bravo, this is Charlie. We're on station, ready to assist.
str_a3_a_m02_90_designate_cha_1: If you can get those assholes painted, Alpha, we can fuck them up! Over!
str_a3_a_m02_75_spotters_bra_0: Alpha, we've got mortar fire incoming!
str_a3_a_m02_75_spotters_bra_1: They've gotta have eyes on our position...
str_a3_a_m02_75_spotters_bra_2: ... Alpha - listen up - our UAV operator took a hit earlier.
str_a3_a_m02_75_spotters_bra_3: If you can get to it, you can use the Darter to locate the spotters!
str_a3_a_m02_65_lazy_med_0: Entrench your positions'? That's easy for him to say.
str_a3_a_m02_65_lazy_med_1: Where the hell are the Brits, anyway? What the fuck is Delta doing?
str_a3_a_m02_60_town_clear_bra_0: Alright, Alpha... looks like we can move. Appreciate the assist!
str_a3_a_m02_60_town_clear_bra_1: Falcon, this is Bravo. Come in, over.
str_a3_a_m02_60_town_clear_bra_2: All clear here, sir. Thanks to Alpha, at least. Requesting further orders, over.
str_a3_a_m02_60_town_clear_mil_0: Receiving you, Bravo. Go ahead. Over.
str_a3_a_m02_60_town_clear_mil_1: Good to hear, Bravo. Fine work, Alpha.
str_a3_a_m02_60_town_clear_mil_2: Charlie's inbound with support for your wounded. Entrench your positions. Falcon out.
str_a3_a_m02_55_town_approach_bra_0: Bravo to Alpha! Bravo to Alpha! Good to see you, guys!
str_a3_a_m02_55_town_approach_bra_1: We're pinned down here! Two story house, center of the village! Watch your fire!
str_a3_a_m02_50_ridgelines_alp_0: Contacts on the ridgeline! Northwest! Focus your fire!
str_a3_a_m02_45_keep_moving_alp_0: Shit. Alright! You heard it, guys!
str_a3_a_m02_45_keep_moving_alp_1: Kerry, flank left! Take the high ground!
str_a3_a_m02_40_taking_casualties_alp_0: Falcon, we're a man short and Greenbacks have taken up a position in the valley! What are our orders?
str_a3_a_m02_40_taking_casualties_mil_0: Stay on mission, Alpha. Bravo still needs your support!
str_a3_a_m02_40_taking_casualties_mil_1: Avoid the valley. Maneuver around the threat. Clear the village. Falcon out.
str_a3_a_m02_35_no_hope_med_0: Falcon, come in. This is Alpha-4. Jackson's hit.
str_a3_a_m02_35_no_hope_med_1: Requesting support at our position, over!
str_a3_a_m02_35_no_hope_mil_0: Negative, Alpha-4. Delta is unavailable. We're stretched thin here. Falcon out.
str_a3_a_m02_30_concentrate_fire_alp_0: Concentrate your fire down the valley!
str_a3_a_m02_25_report_casualties_alp_0: Falcon, this is Alpha. We've taken casualties. Standby for update.
str_a3_a_m02_20_point_man_dead_alp_1: Doc, check on him! The rest of you, covering fire!
str_a3_a_m02_17_point_man_divert_alp_0: Change of plan - I can't raise Jackson.
str_a3_a_m02_17_point_man_divert_alp_1: We'll divert to his last known position. Get set for contact, gentlemen.
str_a3_a_m02_15_point_man_hit_alp_0: Jackson, did you copy my last? Fall back and regroup. Over
str_a3_a_m02_125_faster_bravo_bra_0: Keep moving! He's not done yet!
str_a3_a_m02_110_rtb_bra_0: Bravo to Falcon, we just got buzzed out here!
str_a3_a_m02_110_rtb_bra_1: You heard him, guys! Get the fuck out before he comes back!
str_a3_a_m02_110_rtb_mil_0: Copy, Bravo, we saw him! Get out of there!
str_a3_a_m02_10_lets_go_alp_0: Okay, Jackson reports contacts in the valley.
str_a3_a_m02_07_report2_alp_0: Alpha to Falcon, be advised, contacts spotted near the village. Do we engage? Over.
str_a3_a_m02_07_report2_mil_0: Negative, Alpha, seize the high ground. Stay on mission. Out.
str_a3_a_m02_05_report_alp_0: Acknowledged, Private, appreciate the heads up.
str_a3_a_m02_05_report_alp_1: We're just east of your position, en route to the staging point. Fall back and link up with us. Out.
str_a3_a_m02_05_report_poi_0: Sir, update, we've got enemy movement in the valley. At least one Greenback fireteam.
str_a3_a_m02_05_report_poi_1: Looks like they're outflanking Bravo's position in the village, over.
str_a3_a_m02_01_start_alp_0: Double-time, gentlemen - back into the forest.
str_a3_a_m02_01_start_alp_1: We'll track along the ridgeline and take up a position above the village.
str_a3_a_m04_x_00_casualties_ker_0: We're dropping like flies here, sir!
str_a3_a_m04_i_05_clearhouseshelp_alp_0: Toss some frags into the buildings, Kerry!
str_a3_a_m04_i_05_clearhouseshelp_alp_1: Just make sure you're clear of the blast radius - and don't go rushing in before they've gone off!
str_a3_a_m04_i_00_flank_alp_0: Listen up, Kerry: the others will move from the right.
str_a3_a_m04_i_00_flank_alp_1: Watch for the crossfire. We can't afford any friendly fire bullshit.
str_a3_a_m04_95_agioscephasresponse_mil_: All teams, do not return! I say again, do not return!
Find shelter. Keep your heads down. Wait until you hear from me! How copy?!
str_a3_a_m04_85_houses_alp_0: Kerry, sweep and clear the buildings.
str_a3_a_m04_80_lzconnorgroup_alp_0: Alright, you heard it. Let's take it to them!
str_a3_a_m04_80_lzconnorgroup_alp_1: Negative, Corporal. Miller wants us to make a stand.
str_a3_a_m04_80_lzconnorgroup_ker_0: Wait, we're not falling back to Maxwell, sir?
str_a3_a_m04_75_lzconnorpapabear_alp_0: Miller, Connor's secure but we're too late. They've butchered the resistance. Over.
str_a3_a_m04_75_lzconnorpapabear_alp_1: Hard to say who destroyed them, but they're sure as hell gone now. Over.
str_a3_a_m04_75_lzconnorpapabear_mil_0: What's the status of the supplies, Alpha?
str_a3_a_m04_75_lzconnorpapabear_mil_1: Goddammit! Alright, strike hard, Alpha. Make a point. Clear the area.
str_a3_a_m04_65_agiosioannisclear_mil_0: Good job. Proceed to LZ Connor, ASAP.
str_a3_a_m04_50_flanking_alp_0: Kerry, Doc, on me. We're flanking left.
str_a3_a_m04_50_flanking_alp_1: The rest of you, flank right! Regroup when it's clear. Understood?
str_a3_a_m04_45_objectives_alp_0: We'll do our best, Falcon. Out.
str_a3_a_m04_45_objectives_mil_0: Alpha, Connor's gone dark. Sounds like the AAF's moved in.
str_a3_a_m04_45_objectives_mil_1: They've probably hit the abandoned towns nearby, too.
str_a3_a_m04_45_objectives_mil_2: Kick those arseholes out of there. Secure those supplies. Over.
str_a3_a_m04_42_howdidtheyfindout_alp_0: I don't know, Kerry. Just keep moving.
str_a3_a_m04_42_howdidtheyfindout_ker_0: How the hell did they find out about the weapons?
str_a3_a_m04_35_connorunderattackpapabea: Falcon, this is Alpha, do you copy?!
It's Connor! Something blew the fuck up!
Way ahead of you! We're on it!
Alpha, what the fuck was that?!
Dammit, Alpha, get moving! We need those supplies!
str_a3_a_m04_30_nikosboardingvehicle_con: Shit. We need to go. Now. Move.
str_a3_a_m04_15_nearcontact_con_0: Took you long enough. We were just about to leave.
str_a3_a_m04_10_onthewaytomeeting_alp_0: Miller says he's a resistance contact of his - tied with a bigger cell on Altis.
str_a3_a_m04_10_onthewaytomeeting_alp_1: Yeah, I get the impression that it's somehow linked to his team being here, originally.
str_a3_a_m04_10_onthewaytomeeting_alp_2: The whole thing looks pretty fucking shady, to be honest.
str_a3_a_m04_10_onthewaytomeeting_alp_3: Fuck knows, Corporal. Delta and Charlie moved north. Coordinating the recon, I guess.
str_a3_a_m04_10_onthewaytomeeting_alp_4: But he's right: we do need the supplies if we want to keep on kicking Greenback ass.
str_a3_a_m04_10_onthewaytomeeting_ker_2: So - with respect, sir - where's Miller now?
str_a3_a_m04_10_onthewaytomeeting_alp_5: Now, stay sharp. Keep moving. We don't have all night.
str_a3_a_m04_105_visualonmaxwell_alp_0: I don't know yet, Kerry! Just keep moving!
str_a3_a_m04_100_maxwell_alp_0: Copy that, but, with respect, Miller, fuck that!
str_a3_a_m04_100_maxwell_alp_1: We're on our way back! Out!
str_a3_a_m04_05_neargroup_alp_1: Take the pack. There's a spare set of NVGs in it, too.
str_a3_a_m04_05_neargroup_alp_2: Alright, everybody set? Let's go meet Miller's contact.
str_a3_a_m04_00_sitrep_alp_1: Alright. Just get a move on.
str_a3_a_m04_00_sitrep_ker_0: Less than a minute out, sir. Over.
str_a3_campaign_a_m04_situation_descript: We've struck some fairly significant blows against the AAF. They've been weakened.%1%1We only have a small window of opportunity to exploit that fact, though, before they're reinforced. It's also become clear that we're running short on ammo and supplies. We're beginning to stretch ourselves thin.%1%1Fortunately, an opportunity has presented itself. We've managed to re-establish communication with a contact that has ties to the local guerillas. It's a small cell. Part of a larger network of resistance on the Altis mainland. They call themselves the F-I-A. 'Fee-ah'.%1%1In the wake of the AAF attack, our contact - goes by the name Nikos - set up an ammunition dump somewhere near %4LZ Connor%2. Now he's offering to, well, share it, in a manner of speaking. We've agreed to link up %5just south of here%2.%1%1Meet with him, secure some supplies, and RTB. Be on your guard and good luck.
str_a3_campaign_a_m04_regroup_descriptio: Regroup with the rest of %3Alpha%1, who are waiting just outside %2Camp Maxwell%1.
str_a3_campaign_a_m04_mission_descriptio: Link up with %5Nikos%2, secure the supplies located near %6LZ Connor%2, and return to %3Camp Maxwell%2.
str_a3_campaign_a_m04_meet_description: Meet up with Miller's contact, %2Nikos%1, to the south of %3Camp Maxwell%1.
str_a3_campaign_a_m04_maxwell_descriptio: Return with the supplies to %3Camp Maxwell%1.
str_a3_campaign_a_m04_houses_description: Sweep and clear the %2buildings%1 inside %3Agios Cephas%1.
str_a3_campaign_a_m04_execution_descript:
1. Rendezvous with %5Nikos%2.
2. Continue to %6LZ Connor%2.
3. Secure the promised supplies.
4. Deliver the supplies to %3Camp Maxwell%2.
str_a3_campaign_a_m04_debriefing_win2: Despite your intervention, LZ Connor was overrun. The supplies were destroyed and you suffered heavy casualties. Worse still, an unexpected attack has left Camp Maxwell decimated. It looks like we're fast out of options.
str_a3_campaign_a_m04_debriefing_win1: Despite your intervention, LZ Connor was overrun and the supplies were destroyed. Worse still, an unexpected attack has left Camp Maxwell decimated. It looks like we're fast out of options.
str_a3_campaign_a_m04_callsigns_descript: %4Alpha%2 - Your squad.%1%5Nikos%2 - Miller's contact in the FIA.%1%3Falcon%2 - Camp Maxwell HQ.%1%3Bravo%2 - Camp Maxwell defence.%1%6Charlie%2 - North-east sector recon.%1%7Delta%2 - North-west sector recon.
str_a3_campaign_a_m04_backpack_descripti: Take the backpack and equip your night vision goggles.
str_a3_campaign_a_m04_overview: Meet FIA soldiers and resupply at their depot.
str_a3_a_in_overview: Tensions grow as NATO peacekeepers prepare to leave the island of Stratis.
str_a3_a_in_x10_moveon_ico_0: When the angry looking gentleman with the gun tells you to drive on, Kerry, you drive on. Get a move on.
str_a3_a_in_x05_slowitdown_ico_0: Ease up a bit on the gas, Kerry.
str_a3_a_in_x05_slowitdown_ico_1: This thing stops like an oil tanker.
str_a3_a_in_x01_offroading_ico_0: Fuck, Kerry, what are you doing?!
str_a3_a_in_i10_driving_ico_0: Just so we're clear, Kerry, this thing isn't exactly a sports car.
str_a3_a_in_i10_driving_ico_1: It's going to be heavier; it's going to be less responsive.
str_a3_a_in_i10_driving_ico_2: Please don't flip us, and definitely don't run some poor SOB over. I, for one, am not interested in that paperwork.
str_a3_a_in_i05_fatigue_ico_0: Jesus fucking Christ, Kerry, you won't hit shit if you're fucking wheezing like that, ok?
str_a3_a_in_i05_fatigue_ico_1: Focus. Take a breather if you need it. Slow is smooth and smooth is fast.
str_a3_a_in_i05_fatigue_ico_2: Move carefully - cover to cover - conserve your energy.
str_a3_a_in_i01_first_aid_kit_ico_0: Kerry, you look like shit. Get those wounds looked at.
str_a3_a_in_i01_first_aid_kit_ico_1: If you have to, patch yourself up with your first aid kit.
str_a3_a_in_i01_first_aid_kit_ico_2: Better now than when the bullets are flying; better yet once you're in hard cover.
str_a3_a_in_97_tense_bra_0: Yes, Staff Sergeant! I'll put on my best smile, sir.
str_a3_a_in_97_tense_ico_0: No kidding. I better give Lacey the heads up.
str_a3_a_in_97_tense_ker_0: Jesus, the AAF seem really on edge, huh?
str_a3_a_in_97_tense_ico_1: Sergeant Lacey, be advised, Greenbacks are really waving their dicks around today.
str_a3_a_in_97_tense_ico_2: Be on your best behavior at the checkpoint, soldier, you got that?
str_a3_a_in_97_tense_ico_3: You know, I don't think they even know what they're looking for, Kerry.
str_a3_a_in_80_slow_down_ico_1: Slow it down, nice and easy.
str_a3_a_in_76_turn_ico_0: Take a left at the T-junction.
str_a3_a_in_76_turn_ico_1: And, Kerry, do try not to make roadkill of the local wildlife.
str_a3_a_in_76_turn_ico_2: The AAF already hate our guts - we need to at least keep the goat population on side, you copy that, soldier?
str_a3_a_in_76_turn_ker_0: Minimize collateral damage, sir. Hearts and minds, sir.
str_a3_a_in_75_road_ico_0: Alright, take the dirt road out of the camp.
str_a3_a_in_75_road_ico_1: Sergeant Lacey, grab the second truck. We're headed down to Kamino.
str_a3_a_in_73_great_service_ico_0: You know, Kerry, the service here sure is excellent, sometimes.
str_a3_a_in_70_fly_away_nov_0: Hold up a second there, Staff Sergeant, let us get out of your way.
str_a3_a_in_65_get_in_ico_1: You sure you can handle that?
str_a3_a_in_65_get_in_ker_0: Sounds like MacKinnon needs some heavy lifting done at Kamino. I'll drive.
str_a3_a_in_55_orders_ker_0: Corporal Ben Kerry, reporting for duty.
str_a3_a_in_55_orders_log_1: Okay, there's been slight change of plan.
str_a3_a_in_55_orders_log_2: Commander MacKinnon requires logistical support down at Kamino. He left just as you guys were coming in.
str_a3_a_in_55_orders_log_3: No, Corporal. Now, take the trucks over there. You should probably get a move on.
str_a3_a_in_50_report_ico_0: Kerry, go check in with the Lieutenant over there. He runs the show here at Rogain.
str_a3_a_in_50_report_ico_1: Lacey - I dunno - make yourself useful for a change. I've got to piss.
str_a3_a_in_40_landing_nov_0: Alright, guys, I'm going to turn us around before bringing us in.
str_a3_a_in_40_landed_nov_0: Thanks for flying. Please disembark in an orderly fashion.
str_a3_a_in_35_lock_down_bra_0: I thought the roads were closed?
str_a3_a_in_35_lock_down_bra_1: Why's there a truck leaving Rogain?
str_a3_a_in_35_lock_down_ico_1: Good question. No idea. Maybe something important.
str_a3_a_in_30_baldy_bra_0: Nice. At this rate, we might even get out of here in, oh, 20 years...
str_a3_a_in_30_baldy_bra_1: Yeah? Well they can respectfully go fuck themselves, sir.
str_a3_a_in_30_baldy_ico_0: I see LZ Baldy's packed up.
str_a3_a_in_30_baldy_bra_2: We didn't butcher half our own population and I sure as hell didn't ask to be on their pissant island.
str_a3_a_in_30_baldy_ico_1: Greenbacks wouldn't take a stand for that, Lacey. They've had a stick up their ass about Baldy for weeks now.
str_a3_a_in_30_baldy_ico_2: Well ain't that just half the problem.
str_a3_a_in_25_mike26_bra_1: Just us lucky few left doing the monkey work, huh?
str_a3_a_in_25_mike26_bra_2: I'd rather be the hell off this rock, sir.
str_a3_a_in_25_mike26_ico_0: Yeah. Most of the guys have shipped out already.
str_a3_a_in_25_mike26_ico_1: You'd rather be on a boat in the Pacific, Sergeant?
str_a3_a_in_230_in_forest_ico_0: We're alive but, Jesus, for how long?
str_a3_a_in_220_find_shelter_ico_0: We need to get out of the open. Now.
str_a3_a_in_220_find_shelter_ico_1: Rogain's down. Kamino's fucked ... it's only bad news back where we came from.
str_a3_a_in_220_find_shelter_ico_2: We've got to head south - there's a forest just over the hill.
str_a3_a_in_220_find_shelter_ico_3: If you've got any better ideas, feel free to share! Let's go!
str_a3_a_in_215_now_what_ico_0: Shit, I don't know - we're out of options!
str_a3_a_in_20_maxwell_bra_0: Hey, check out Maxwell - there's a helo - didn't we finish with that place already?
str_a3_a_in_20_maxwell_ico_1: Then again, command doesn't really seem to know or particularly care what's going on. Part of me can't really blame them.
str_a3_a_in_200_bomb_inbound_ico_0: Echo, fastmover vectoring on your position! Get out of there!
str_a3_a_in_190_fly_over_eva_0: Echo to all units, we just got buzzed by a fastmover. Expedite! Out.
str_a3_a_in_185_request_evac_eva_0: Echo to all units in the Rogain area. We're setting up an evac point at LZ Baldy. Over.
str_a3_a_in_185_request_evac_eva_1: Affirmative. We'll hold, but we can't stall forever. Over.
str_a3_a_in_185_request_evac_ico_0: Echo, this Staff Sargent Adams - we're en route! It's just the two of us, part of a detachment from Rogain. We're moving out from Point X-ray now. How copy?
str_a3_a_in_185_request_evac_ico_1: You're a Godsend, Echo! Don't worry, we'll be there! Out!
str_a3_a_in_175_bad_sign_ker_0: Well, that's not exactly a good sign.
str_a3_a_in_170_over_camp_ico_0: Let's hope X-ray's had better luck. Move it.
str_a3_a_in_165_aa_ico_0: Stay focused. Point X-ray's just over the hill.
str_a3_a_in_165_aa_ico_1: Our best bet is to RV with them and take it from there.
str_a3_a_in_165_aa_ker_0: Fuck! What do we do, sir?
str_a3_a_in_160_evac_bhq_1: Broadway to all NATO forces on Stratis: Code Foxtrot. Code Foxtrot.
str_a3_a_in_160_evac_log_0: Rogain to Broadway! We're under heavy assault! Send backup! Over!
str_a3_a_in_160_evac_bhq_2: AAF forces have overwhelmed the airfield and Air Station Mike-26. We're pulling back.
str_a3_a_in_15_roads_bra_0: What's the deal with the roads? Why the lockdown?
str_a3_a_in_15_roads_bra_1: You'd think the Greenbacks were actually competent or something.
str_a3_a_in_15_roads_ico_0: Someone forgot to tell the AAF commander we'd be decommissioning the airbase.
str_a3_a_in_15_roads_ico_1: He's throwing some kind of hissy fit over there right now. It's a mess.
str_a3_a_in_155_contacts_ico_0: Rogain, we've just had a run in with Greenback forces in the forest to your south. Over.
str_a3_a_in_155_contacts_ico_1: Camp Rogain, do you read? Over.
str_a3_a_in_150_safer_ico_0: Tell me about it! Let's just get back to Rogain.

str_a3_a_in_115_check_ico_0: Fuck, he's not breathing! What the hell happened?
str_a3_a_in_10_all_in_ico_0: All right, we're set. Let's go.

str_a3_a_in_briefing_situation_text: The decommissioning of NATO assets on Stratis is roughly halfway complete, but Commander MacKinnon wants to step up the pace of tearing down these bases.%1To that end, additional support is required across at %2Camp Rogain%3 and %4Kamino%5; however, an AAF lockdown is making the process all the more difficult. The Greenback brass are due to visit (more than likely to protest against our work, our flags, our very presence - the same old, same old).%6Most of the roads are closed. Those which are actually open have our friendly neighborhood watch closely monitoring them. At the moment, only specially authorized vehicles are currently permitted freedom of movement. Airspace is open, but it's heavily restricted.%7We'll have to assess the situation on-the-fly to determine what work we can actually get done. Bring a good book, though, it's nailed on that there'll be plenty of hanging around today.
str_a3_a_in_bis_truck_desc: Get in the truck as the driver.
str_a3_a_in_bis_shelter_desc: Echo is down and you're out of options. You need to get out of the open. Follow your CO and find shelter in the forest.
str_a3_a_in_bis_return_desc: NATO forces are under attack. Return to %1Camp Rogain%2 immediately.
str_a3_a_in_bis_report_desc: Report in with the camp's logistics officer.
str_a3_a_in_bis_range_desc: Drive the logistics truck to the %1Kamino Firing Range%2 and assist Commander MacKinnon.
str_a3_a_in_bis_evac_desc: AAF forces have turned their guns on NATO. %1The air base%2 has fallen, and with it, NATO command. Code Foxtrot has been issued, ordering all NATO forces to retreat. Stick with your commander and get to safety.
str_a3_a_in_bis_co_desc: Your CO is waiting for you at %1LZ Connor%2. Check in with him.
str_a3_a_in_bis_check_desc: Pass %1the security checkpoint%2 between %3Camp Rogain%4 and the %5Kamino Firing Range%6.
str_a3_a_in_bis_camp_desc: The roads are locked down. Get to %1Camp Rogain%2 by helicopter.
str_a3_a_in2_x25_survivors_dead_del_0: No. We heard gunfire earlier and they went dark... No sense waiting any longer.

str_a3_a_in2_x05_exploded_no_kit_bra_1: Have a look and see if you can get yourself patched up and make your way to us. Out.

str_a3_a_in2_i01_navigation_bra_2: Take a look at your map. Once again, we're at grid 043043, at the old outpost north of Mike-26.

str_a3_a_in2_85_check_in_bra_1: Understood, Falcon. See you soon. Out.

str_a3_a_in2_85_check_in_del_1: Copy. We're in position at the rendezvous, awaiting your arrival.
str_a3_a_in2_80_bad_idea_ker_0: I told you going through the forest was a bad idea!

str_a3_a_in2_60_plan_bra_0: Alright, guys, just so we're all on the same page.
str_a3_a_in2_60_plan_bra_1: We're going to push south to the rendezvous, link up with the Brits, and continue to Camp Maxwell.
str_a3_a_in2_55_regrouped_bra_0: Good to see you, Kerry. Let's move.
str_a3_a_in2_50_position_bra_0: We're over here, Kerry. You see the big white building?
str_a3_a_in2_50_position_bra_1: Not that one - the old one next to it.
str_a3_a_in2_50_position_ker_1: Old one next to it. Got it. Out.

str_a3_a_in2_45_copy_bra_2: We can't keep them waiting all day. We're leaving in 10. Hope to see you before then! Out.

str_a3_a_in2_40_contact_mil_0: This is Captain Scott Miller, Royal Navy. Come in, over.
str_a3_a_in2_40_contact_mil_1: Next time, avoid broadcasting over the whole net, soldier.
str_a3_a_in2_40_contact_mil_2: We're consolidating the remnants of our forces at Camp Maxwell. You're welcome to join us, if you want.
str_a3_a_in2_40_contact_mil_3: Not so fast. Altis Armed Forces have concentrated themselves around Mike-26 and the air base, meaning there's sea AAF units between you and us.
str_a3_a_in2_40_contact_mil_4: I'm dispatching a team to RV with you at 028037, just east of Camp Tempest. Our callsign is Falcon. Make your way there. Over.
str_a3_a_in2_35_exploded_fine_bra_0: Okay. Make your way to us and we'll go from there. Out.
str_a3_a_in2_35_exploded_fine_ker_0: Yeah - I mean, no - I'm fine.

str_a3_a_in2_30a_situation_bra_2: Wait, what happened? Where's Adams? Over.
str_a3_a_in2_30a_situation_bra_3: Fuck. Shit, Kerry, I'm sorry, but you've got to get out of there. If we heard it, you can bet the AAF did too. You copy?
str_a3_a_in2_30a_situation_ker_1: ... a landmine... I'm on my own.
str_a3_a_in2_20_trust_ico_0: I don't think we have much of a choice, Kerry.
str_a3_a_in2_20_trust_ker_0: You think we can make it there, sir?
str_a3_a_in2_15_rendezvous_bra_0: Solid copy, we'll be here. Just get a move on. Out.
str_a3_a_in2_15_rendezvous_ico_0: Understood, will rendezvous with you there. How copy? Over.
str_a3_a_in2_125_survivors_alive_bra_0: How many other guys have you helped this way?
str_a3_a_in2_125_survivors_alive_del_0: You're the only ones so far.
str_a3_a_in2_120_rv_del_0: Glad to see you made it in one piece. Let's go.
str_a3_a_in2_115_reveal_del_0: Alright, men, you can come out of hiding now.
str_a3_a_in2_110_near_rv_bra_0: Falcon, be advised, we're nearing your position. Try not to shoot us! Over.
str_a3_a_in2_10_survivors_bra_2: Sarge, thank Christ, we thought we were the only ones left.
str_a3_a_in2_10_survivors_ico_0: Staff Sergeant Adams here, I read you. Over.
str_a3_a_in2_10_survivors_bra_3: I managed to link up with a couple of guys from Point Zulu.
str_a3_a_in2_10_survivors_ico_1: Affirmative - Is that you, Lacey? Over.
str_a3_a_in2_10_survivors_bra_4: Uh... We're just north of Mike-26, at the old outpost. 043043. We've been here for, shit, at least an hour now. Over.
str_a3_a_in2_briefing_situation_text: Earlier this morning, Altis Armed Forces and NATO peacekeepers unexpectedly entered a state of sudden and bloody conflict. Exactly how this situation came about is not yet entirely clear.%1NATO Command issued 'Code Foxtrot': the complete and immediate withdrawal of all forces from Stratis. Those personnel remaining on the island can, for now, only try to survive long enough to regroup and reassess.
str_a3_a_in2_bis_survivors_desc: Move to %1the old military outpost%2 and meet up with Bravo.
str_a3_a_in2_bis_rv_desc: Meet Cpt. Miller's unit at %1the RV point%2.
str_a3_a_m01_overview: A NATO helicopter went down in a nearby forest.
str_a3_a_m01_01_start_alp_0: Alpha to Falcon, approaching crash site, over.
str_a3_a_m01_01_start_mil_0: Confirmed, Alpha. Make a sweep of the immediate area. Out.
str_a3_a_m01_x15_get_clear_casualties_me: Okay. Wait until we're all clear before detonating.

Plant your mines and take up a defensive position.

str_a3_a_m01_i01_mines_mil_1: When setting up your defense, focus upon the ridgeline just in front of your position.
str_a3_a_m01_i01_mines_mil_2: Just remember, don't only focus on one place. If one mine goes off, they're going to know to go around it. Out.
str_a3_a_m01_65_get_clear_alp_0: Okay. Wait until we're all clear before detonating.
str_a3_a_m01_50_plant_alp_0: Kerry, plant a charge on that wreck.
str_a3_a_m01_45_survivor_dead_del_2: Falcon, this is Delta. They've lost their pilot. Please advise, over.
str_a3_a_m01_45_survivor_dead_med_1: I've got no pulse here - he's gone.
str_a3_a_m01_45_survivor_dead_mil_0: Acknowledged, Delta, you did what you could. Fall back.
str_a3_a_m01_45_survivor_dead_mil_1: Alpha, continue on mission. Destroy the wreck and get back to Maxwell. Out.
str_a3_a_m01_40_on_station_del_0: Delta to Alpha, we're on the way. Sending our medic to your guy. Over.
str_a3_a_m01_40_on_station_med_0: Copy that - just hurry the fuck up - we're losing him.
str_a3_a_m01_35_spotted_alp_0: Here they come! Engage at will!
str_a3_a_m01_33_medevac_result_mil_0: All right, Alpha, the best we can do is divert an element from Delta.
str_a3_a_m01_33_medevac_result_mil_1: They can bring a stretcher. Sit tight. Out.
str_a3_a_m01_30_medevac_mil_0: Medevac? With respect, Alpha, it's not like we've got a helo on standby here.
str_a3_a_m01_25_inform_alp_0: Falcon, we've got a survivor at the crash site.
str_a3_a_m01_25_inform_alp_1: He's immobilized. We don't have the supplies to get him moving. Requesting medevac, over.
str_a3_a_m01_20_survivor_alp_1: Doc, take care of him. We'll take up defensive positions.
str_a3_a_m01_20_survivor_alp_2: Kerry, you've got the mines, set up a perimeter. Get a move on.
str_a3_a_m01_15_report_alp_0: Falcon, this is Alpha. Enemy forces occupying the crash site neutralized. Securing now, over.
str_a3_a_m01_15_report_mil_0: Copy that, Alpha. Be advised, Bravo reports enemy movement incoming from Girna.
str_a3_a_m01_15_report_mil_1: Get in and get out. Falcon out.
str_a3_a_m01_10_secure_alp_0: Okay. Looks like that was the last of them.
str_a3_a_m01_05_contact_alp_1: Find some cover and open fire!
str_a3_a_m01_debriefing_a_m01_3_subtitle: You detonated the charge too early!
str_a3_a_m01_debriefing_a_m01_2_subtitle: You failed to protect the pilot!
str_a3_a_m01_debriefing_a_m01_1_subtitle: You failed to protect the medic!
str_a3_a_m01_debriefing_a_hub01_2_descri:
Although unable to save the pilot - and despite being wasteful with your gear - you managed to successfully beat back an enemy patrol and destroy the wreckage. You need to plan more carefully in future, we're desperately short on supplies. At least for now, we've earned ourselves some breathing room.

However, the AAF will now be more alert to the remaining threat on their island. We'll have to act quickly before they entrench their positions.
str_a3_a_m01_debriefing_a_hub01_1_descri:
Although we failed to save the pilot's life, we managed to beat back an enemy patrol and destroy the wreckage. At least for now, we've earned ourselves some breathing room.

However, the AAF will now be more alert to the remaining threat on their island. We'll have to act quickly before they entrench their positions.
str_a3_a_m01_briefing_situation_text: We're still piecing together what happened this morning, but one thing's clear: Altis Armed Forces on Stratis are hostile.%1Right now, long-range comms are down, Commander MacKinnon is confirmed KIA and whatever equipment we may have had is either halfway-scrapped or fucked entirely.%2We need to organise. Rearm. Make a plan. Take back the initiative.%3We'll split up, Alpha through Delta. I've nominated four men to lead each squad. They've agreed to operate under my coordination.%4Now, our first priority is situational awareness. Half our force will move out on recon. Another squad will dig in %5here%6 and take stock of whatever equipment we've got at hand.%7That just leaves our most pressing concern. The AAF managed to bring down a Blackfoot. It crash-landed %8dangerously close to our position%9. There's a burning wreck and smoke-stack a mile high - that's no good.%10%11Alpha%12 will secure the crash site, make a sweep for survivors, and get rid of it.
str_a3_a_m01_briefing_signal_text: %1Alpha%2 - Your squad.%3%4Falcon%5 - Camp Maxwell HQ.%6%7Bravo%8 - North-west sector recon.%9%10Charlie%11 - North-east sector recon.%12%13Delta%14 - Camp Maxwell defense.
str_a3_a_m01_briefing_mission_text: Move to %1the crash site%2 and make a sweep for survivors. Once secure, rig the wreckage, destroy it, and return to %3Maxwell%4.
str_a3_a_m01_briefing_execution_text:
1. Move to %1the crash site%2.
2. Sweep for any survivors.
3. Destroy the wreckage.
4. Return to %3Camp Maxwell%4.
str_a3_a_m01_bis_scavenge_desc: Search the bodies for a demo charge.
str_a3_a_m01_bis_plant_desc: Plant your demolition charge on %1the Blackfoot wreckage%2.
str_a3_a_m01_bis_destroy_desc: Once all elements are clear of the blast radius, detonate your charge.
str_a3_a_m01_bis_defend_desc: Defend %1the crash site%2 while the medic tends to the surviving pilot.
str_a3_a_m01_bis_crashsite_desc: One of our helicopters went down during the initial assault. Investigate %1the crash site%2.
str_a3_a_hub_340_armory_intro_cha_0: Alright, so that's you all set, Kerry.
str_a3_a_hub_340_armory_intro_cha_1: It's the best kit we've got for the task at hand.
str_a3_a_hub_340_armory_intro_cha_2: If you want to adjust your loadout, feel free. Your stuff is in the crate over there.
str_a3_a_hub_330_briefing_player_late_al: Oh, nice of you to join us, Corporal.
Sorry, did you need a little more time, soldier?
Glad to see you finally made it, Kerry.
str_a3_a_hub_321_time_reminder_5min_alp_: You've got five minutes. Get a move on.
str_a3_a_hub_320_time_reminder_30min_alp: Soldier, you've got 30 minutes before you're needed back here.
Be advised, 30 minutes until the op.
Kerry, you've got 30 minutes. Don't be late. Out.
str_a3_a_hub_140_welcome_a_hub02_del_0: Fuck ... we didn't know if you'd make it back, Alpha.
str_a3_a_hub_140_welcome_a_hub02_del_2: AAF hit us hard last night ... It's good to see you in one piece.
str_a3_a_hub_140_welcome_a_hub02_del_3: We took some casualties. Gillespie. Stephenson. Couple others I didn't really know.
str_a3_a_hub_140_welcome_a_hub02_del_4: Most of the rest of us are basically walking wounded.
str_a3_a_hub_140_welcome_a_hub02_del_5: Anyway, the AAF pulled back. For now at least. Fuck knows why.
str_a3_a_hub_140_welcome_a_hub02_del_6: As you can see ... things are pretty fucked up here.
str_a3_a_hub_140_welcome_a_hub02_del_7: So, we're moving out. Miller's called a meet. Get your shit together. Head over when you're ready.
str_a3_a_hub_140_welcome_a_hub02_del_8: And you, Corporal Kerry, you seem to developed the habit of staying alive.
str_a3_a_hub_140_welcome_a_hub02_del_9: You'll want to hold on to that.
str_a3_a_hub_120_welcome_a_hub01_del_1: For now, we're regrouping at Maxwell - whoever's left.
str_a3_a_hub_120_welcome_a_hub01_del_10: Get your shit together and report in when your set, Corporal.
str_a3_a_hub_120_welcome_a_hub01_del_11: We'll try to sort out exactly what the fuck is going on.
str_a3_a_hub_120_welcome_a_hub01_del_2: Just don't get too comfortable. You're one of the last groups we've been in contact with.
str_a3_a_hub_120_welcome_a_hub01_del_3: Captain Miller's coordinating things. Believe it or not, he's the ranking officer left on this fucking rock.
str_a3_a_hub_120_welcome_a_hub01_del_4: He's just over there ... setting up a temporary briefing area now.
str_a3_a_hub_120_welcome_a_hub01_del_5: We're pooling what little weapons and ammo we have just beside it.
str_a3_a_hub_120_welcome_a_hub01_del_6: It's not exactly an armory, but we need to take stock of whatever we've got left.
str_a3_a_hub_120_welcome_a_hub01_del_7: So, for now, we're divided up into four squads, Alpha through Delta.
str_a3_a_hub_120_welcome_a_hub01_del_8: I'm leading Delta - and your squad leader's just over there - Sergeant Conway's heading up Alpha, you guys must know each other.
str_a3_a_hub_120_welcome_a_hub01_del_9: Anyway, Miller's got the details. A helo went down in a forest nearby. He's putting together a plan.
str_a3_a_hub_104_skirmish_talk_lost_gear: Yeah, we had to leave a whole bunch of gear out the way.
I know, just - when we're so low on resources - seems like a damn waste.
Hey, man, no one blames you guys for that. Don't sweat it.
str_a3_a_hub_103_skirmish_talk_firefight: Apparently there was some firefight not far from our position.
That's the thing. Not one of ours. At least, not anyone accounted for.
str_a3_a_hub_102_skirmish_talk_timed_tra: There's talk about a small convoy en route to Girna.
No, a friendly one! Yes, idiot, a Greenback convoy.
Huh. Probably carrying some useful shit, too.
str_a3_a_hub_101_skirmish_talk_crashed_t: Yeah, Charlie reports that they spotted one of our trucks when they were on recon.
Said it looked pretty intact, but they had to pull back before they could investigate.
str_a3_a_hub_100_skirmish_talk_crashed_h: Apparently someone managed to get off a lucky shot on one of their choppers.
Yeah, hit the deck somewhere to up north.
Right.. wonder if the wreck's still intact.
str_a3_a_hub_093_ambient_special_03_alp_: C'mon, it's hardly like it's a surprise.
The economy's been in the tank for a decade - at least.
str_a3_a_hub_093_ambient_special_03_cha_: How did things get this fucked, anyway?
str_a3_a_hub_093_ambient_special_03_alp_: They got jobs. Growth. Influence. Fucking... China, man.
str_a3_a_hub_093_ambient_special_03_cha_: Yeah, but CSAT? How'd we ever let that happen, you know?
str_a3_a_hub_092_ambient_special_02_alp_: The Brits are broke, man. Everyone knows it.
They can't even afford to defend their pointless little islands any more.
str_a3_a_hub_092_ambient_special_02_cha_: If it's their goddamn problem, where the hell are they?
str_a3_a_hub_092_ambient_special_02_alp_: Why d'you think we're shipping out? We did our time. We kept our peace.
Now we get to go play with the big boys in the Pacific.
str_a3_a_hub_092_ambient_special_02_cha_: So why do we get stuck with them?
str_a3_a_hub_091_ambient_special_01_alpa: I thought we were supposed to be broke, though?
I mean... the military - we're staring down the barrel of a conflict in the Pacific - and we're junking our vehicles?
How's that meant to make any sense?
str_a3_a_hub_091_ambient_special_01_alpb: It probably costs more to ship this shit anywhere.
Plus - you gotta admit - it's kinda dated, too. At this point, it's worth more as scrap.
And we're sure as hell not about to hand it over to the Greenbacks.
str_a3_a_hub_090_ambient_special_00_alpa: What, we're on that for the whole week?
...I literally cannot wait to get off this fucking rock.
str_a3_a_hub_090_ambient_special_00_alpb: Just the same shit as yesterday, man. Vehicle tear-down.
Yup. At least until the contractors get here, we're the junkyard dogs.
str_a3_a_hub_080_ambient_talk_10_alpa_0: I dunno... I just hope Captain Miller knows what the hell he's doing.
str_a3_a_hub_080_ambient_talk_10_alpa_1: Yeah, and that's what worries me.
str_a3_a_hub_080_ambient_talk_10_alpb_0: We don't really have much other choice right now.
str_a3_a_hub_079_ambient_talk_09_alpa_0: An end goal's one thing - just not getting killed right now is fine by me.
str_a3_a_hub_079_ambient_talk_09_alpb_0: But what's the end goal, you know?
str_a3_a_hub_079_ambient_talk_09_alpb_1: Sure, man, but - without full NATO support - just feels like we're just pissing into the wind.
str_a3_a_hub_078_ambient_talk_08_alpa_0: You know this whole place used to be British?
str_a3_a_hub_078_ambient_talk_08_alpb_0: Like a colony or some shit?
str_a3_a_hub_078_ambient_talk_08_alpb_2: Of course we'd be cleaning up their mess now.
str_a3_a_hub_077_ambient_talk_07_alpa_0: Greenbacks were getting cocky for a while, though.
str_a3_a_hub_077_ambient_talk_07_alpa_1: Us pulling out, CSAT at their back, Europe, fucking... nowhere.
str_a3_a_hub_077_ambient_talk_07_alpa_2: True. Sometimes all you need is one loose trigger for a flashpoint, though...
str_a3_a_hub_077_ambient_talk_07_alpb_0: Yeah, they've been a giant pain in the ass for months, man, but...
str_a3_a_hub_077_ambient_talk_07_alpb_1: Well, you know, there's a difference between that and war.
str_a3_a_hub_077_ambient_talk_07_alpb_2: Yeah. Maybe this whole thing's one big misunderstanding.
str_a3_a_hub_076_ambient_talk_06_alpb_0: Jesus... We were just here to break down some vehicles... Tear down some bases.
str_a3_a_hub_076_ambient_talk_06_alpb_1: When I heard I wasn't gonna be drafted back out to the Pacific, I couldn't believe my luck.
str_a3_a_hub_076_ambient_talk_06_alpb_2: Dunno what the hell I must have done to end up here now. Fucking Karma, man.
str_a3_a_hub_075_ambient_talk_05_alpa_1: Well, everything's so lethal. So 'on target'. You know?
str_a3_a_hub_075_ambient_talk_05_alpb_0: Maybe we should have seen it coming, you know?
str_a3_a_hub_075_ambient_talk_05_alpa_2: Makes me wonder how much longer we can actually hold out.
str_a3_a_hub_075_ambient_talk_05_alpb_1: Fucking... Greenbacks, man, butchering half their own population during the conflict?
str_a3_a_hub_075_ambient_talk_05_alpb_2: Civil war's one thing - that was just - I dunno.
str_a3_a_hub_074_ambient_talk_04_alpb_0: I'm going to feel a lot better once we actually get comms with command back online.
str_a3_a_hub_074_ambient_talk_04_alpb_1: Who knows what's going on out there, you know?
str_a3_a_hub_074_ambient_talk_04_alpb_2: I mean, it could be World War 3 for all we know...
str_a3_a_hub_073_ambient_talk_03_alpa_0: And who the hell is this Miller guy anyway?
str_a3_a_hub_073_ambient_talk_03_alpa_1: Yeah, I mean sure, 'CTRG'. Whatever the fuck that means.
str_a3_a_hub_073_ambient_talk_03_alpa_2: For all I know, he's the royal fucking janitor.
str_a3_a_hub_073_ambient_talk_03_alpb_0: I dunno. Special Forces. SBS or some shit, man.
str_a3_a_hub_073_ambient_talk_03_alpa_3: And it's like... who died and made him king?
str_a3_a_hub_073_ambient_talk_03_alpa_4: Sure, you're right. It's just that accent, you know? Gets right up my nose.
str_a3_a_hub_073_ambient_talk_03_alpb_2: And - to be fair to the guy - he's kept us alive this far.
str_a3_a_hub_073_ambient_talk_03_alpb_3: I hear that, man, I hear that...
str_a3_a_hub_072_ambient_talk_02_alpa_0: Who fired first? Shit... gotta be Greenback.
str_a3_a_hub_072_ambient_talk_02_alpa_1: I mean, they were twitchy. Something to do with MacKinnon.
str_a3_a_hub_072_ambient_talk_02_alpa_2: You know, yeah, you used to hearing about that green-on-blue shit, but, Christ... not for a good decade, at least.
str_a3_a_hub_072_ambient_talk_02_alpa_3: I just can't see what the fuck they were thinking.
str_a3_a_hub_071_ambient_talk_01_alpa_0: Well, I heard it all kicked off up at Kamino.
str_a3_a_hub_071_ambient_talk_01_alpa_1: Yeah - comms were fucked, though - could barely make out the messages.
str_a3_a_hub_071_ambient_talk_01_alpb_1: Right, I heard that. It was a mess. Fuckin' Greenbacks, man...
str_a3_a_hub_070_ambient_talk_00_alpa_0: Christ. Where the hell are our reinforcements?
str_a3_a_hub_070_ambient_talk_00_alpb_0: Your guess is as good as mine, man...
str_a3_a_hub_055_a_out_briefing_mil_0: I know things don't look good for us right now. We took a hit. We lost a number of good men.
str_a3_a_hub_055_a_out_briefing_mil_1: Now, nothing I've got to say will change that fact, but I do have new information.
str_a3_a_hub_055_a_out_briefing_mil_2: Late last night Delta managed to establish temporary long-range contact with NATO MEDCOM.
str_a3_a_hub_055_a_out_briefing_mil_4: We need to lay the groundwork for a full invasion. They need an established foothold, not a broken down base hidden in the woods.
str_a3_a_hub_055_a_out_briefing_mil_5: I say we attack now. We catch the AAF off-guard. We hold the ground we seize.
str_a3_a_hub_055_a_out_briefing_mil_6: I'll lead Delta behind enemy lines and take up an advanced position to the North of Agia Marina.
str_a3_a_hub_055_a_out_briefing_mil_7: Alpha and Bravo will lead the main assault on the military range, while Charlie hit Camp Rogain and contain any counter-attack that might flank our main assault.
str_a3_a_hub_055_a_out_briefing_mil_8: Once the range is secure, we'll converge on the town and entrench our position.
str_a3_a_hub_055_a_out_briefing_mil_9: I'll go through the exact details of the plan with each individual squad leader. They'll bring the rest of their men up to speed.
str_a3_a_hub_050_a_m05_briefing_mil_1: Recon reports indicate that the AAF will make a push south in the next few hours. It appears they're keen to lock down the area around Girna.
str_a3_a_hub_050_a_m05_briefing_mil_2: Intel suggests that the highest-ranking officer on Stratis will himself be in the area. Neutralising him will deal a serious blow to our enemy.
str_a3_a_hub_050_a_m05_briefing_mil_3: Decapitating their command structure may even signal an end to this whole situation.
str_a3_a_hub_050_a_m05_briefing_mil_4: We simply cannot let this opportunity pass us by, gentlemen.
str_a3_a_hub_050_a_m05_briefing_mil_5: Now, we've come up with a plan of action. My team has a submersible stashed just off the west coast.
str_a3_a_hub_050_a_m05_briefing_mil_6: That's why we asked for volunteers - those with diving experience.
str_a3_a_hub_050_a_m05_briefing_mil_7: One of my men, Lieutenant James here, will use it to lead a small team and insert just north of Girna.
str_a3_a_hub_050_a_m05_briefing_mil_8: Meanwhile, Bravo will circle around and take up a position to the south. Once both teams are in place, we close the trap.
str_a3_a_hub_050_a_m05_briefing_mil_9: Alright, let's set this in motion. Dismissed.
str_a3_a_hub_045_a_m04_briefing_mil_0: We've struck some fairly significant blows against the AAF. They've been weakened.
str_a3_a_hub_045_a_m04_briefing_mil_1: We only have a small window of opportunity to exploit that fact, though, before they're reinforced.
str_a3_a_hub_045_a_m04_briefing_mil_2: It's also become clear that we're running short on ammo and supplies. We've got the momentum, but we risk stretching ourselves thin, gentlemen.
str_a3_a_hub_045_a_m04_briefing_mil_3: Fortunately, an opportunity has presented itself. We've managed to re-establish communication with a contact that has ties to the local guerrillas.
str_a3_a_hub_045_a_m04_briefing_mil_4: It's a small cell. Part of a larger network of resistance on the Altis mainland. They call themselves the F-I-A. 'Fee-ah'.
str_a3_a_hub_045_a_m04_briefing_mil_5: In the wake of the AAF attack, our contact - goes by the name 'Nikos' - set up an ammunition dump somewhere near LZ Connor.
str_a3_a_hub_045_a_m04_briefing_mil_6: He's offering to, well, share it, in a manner of speaking.
str_a3_a_hub_045_a_m04_briefing_mil_7: Now, we've agreed to link up just south of here.
str_a3_a_hub_045_a_m04_briefing_mil_8: Meet with him, secure some supplies, and RTB. Be on your guard and good luck.
str_a3_a_hub_040_a_m03_briefing_mil_0: As I'm sure you're all well aware, comms are still down.
str_a3_a_hub_040_a_m03_briefing_mil_1: Efforts to restore contact with NATO MEDCOM have, thus far, proven fruitless.
str_a3_a_hub_040_a_m03_briefing_mil_10: The rest of you, get set. Dismissed.
str_a3_a_hub_040_a_m03_briefing_mil_2: The plain truth is, gentlemen - with the AAF regrouping - we must re-establish a link soon.
str_a3_a_hub_040_a_m03_briefing_mil_3: Now, aside from the airbase, Mike-26 is probably the most hi-tech installation on Stratis.
str_a3_a_hub_040_a_m03_briefing_mil_4: It's also one of the most strategically valuable positions on the island.
str_a3_a_hub_040_a_m03_briefing_mil_5: It's a risk, but hitting the facility will deal a serious blow to the AAF, and - if anywhere holds an opportunity to re-open com channels - it's there.
str_a3_a_hub_040_a_m03_briefing_mil_6: This will be a coordinated effort.
str_a3_a_hub_040_a_m03_briefing_mil_7: Charlie will set up a mortar. Alpha will provide overwatch and mark priority targets.
str_a3_a_hub_040_a_m03_briefing_mil_8: We'll strike hard from distance and - together with Bravo - move in quickly, holding the position against any potential counter-attack.
str_a3_a_hub_040_a_m03_briefing_mil_9: Ok, squad leaders, form on me. I'll share some extra details.
str_a3_a_hub_035_a_m02_briefing_mil_0: As you're probably aware, we've been scouting positions to our north, keeping tabs on enemy movement.
str_a3_a_hub_035_a_m02_briefing_mil_1: Unfortunately, Bravo ran into trouble, taking contact in a village a little to the west of our position.
str_a3_a_hub_035_a_m02_briefing_mil_2: They're pinned down and need our support, gentlemen.
str_a3_a_hub_035_a_m02_briefing_mil_3: Now, an advanced element has already set up a position nearby to get eyes on the situation.
str_a3_a_hub_035_a_m02_briefing_mil_4: AAF units have mobilized along the valley leading to the village. More support is no doubt en route.
str_a3_a_hub_035_a_m02_briefing_mil_5: Alpha will approach from the east. Use the high ground and forest cover to your advantage.
str_a3_a_hub_035_a_m02_briefing_mil_6: Clear the village and get our boys out of there.
str_a3_a_hub_030_a_m01_briefing_mil_0: We're still piecing together what happened this morning, but one thing's clear: Altis Armed Forces on Stratis are hostile.
str_a3_a_hub_030_a_m01_briefing_mil_1: Right now, long-range comms are down, Commander MacKinnon is confirmed KIA, and whatever equipment we may have had is either halfway-scrapped or wrecked entirely.
str_a3_a_hub_030_a_m01_briefing_mil_2: We need to organise. Rearm. Make a plan. Take back the initiative.
str_a3_a_hub_030_a_m01_briefing_mil_3: We'll split up. I've nominated three men - Conway, Lacey and Mitchell - to each lead a squad, Alpha through Charlie.
str_a3_a_hub_030_a_m01_briefing_mil_4: My own team will operate as Delta under the command of Lt. James.
str_a3_a_hub_030_a_m01_briefing_mil_5: Now, our first priority is situational awareness. Half our force will move out on recon.
str_a3_a_hub_030_a_m01_briefing_mil_6: Another squad will dig in here and take stock of whatever equipment we've got at hand.
str_a3_a_hub_030_a_m01_briefing_mil_7: That just leaves our most pressing concern.
str_a3_a_hub_030_a_m01_briefing_mil_8: The AAF managed to bring down a Blackfoot. It crash-landed dangerously close to our position. There's a burning wreck and smoke-stack a mile high - that's no good.
str_a3_a_hub_030_a_m01_briefing_mil_9: Alpha will secure the crash site, make a sweep for survivors, and get rid of it. Questions?
str_a3_a_hub_025_a_out_intro_bra_0: Kerry, it's good to see you're still in one piece.
str_a3_a_hub_025_a_out_intro_bra_1: Miller wants to speak to us. Sounds serious. You coming?
str_a3_a_hub_020_a_m05_intro_del_0: Kerry, you went through diver training, didn't you.
str_a3_a_hub_020_a_m05_intro_del_1: Miller's got an op for us - are you up to it?
str_a3_a_hub_015_a_m04_intro_alp_0: Seems like Miller's set up some sort of supply operation tonight.
str_a3_a_hub_010_a_m03_intro_bra_0: Shit, looks like we're going to hit Mike-26, Kerry.
str_a3_a_hub_010_a_m03_intro_bra_1: Miller's going to brief us now. You ready?
str_a3_a_hub_005_a_m02_intro_cha_0: Hey, Kerry, did you hear? Bravo ran into some trouble.
str_a3_a_hub_005_a_m02_intro_cha_1: Sergeant Lacey's pinned down in some village. You ready to go?
str_a3_a_hub_000_a_m01_intro_alp_0: Kerry, good to see you, man, this shit's a mess...
str_a3_a_hub_000_a_m01_intro_alp_1: Anyway, this 'Captain Miller' wants to speak to us.
str_a3_a_hub_000_a_m01_intro_alp_2: C'mon, let's find out what's going on. You coming?

STR_A3_POI_Abandoned_Battlefield_04_Task: There was an intense fire-fight on the east coast earlier today. Search the area carefully and see what can be found.
STR_A3_POI_Abandoned_Battlefield_05_Task: Charlie saw an abandoned Hunter while they were retreating back to Camp Maxwell. Search the area, find it, and try to retrieve any useful equipment which may be left there.
STR_A3_POI_Abandoned_Battlefield_06_Task: We didn't have time to search Air Station Mike-26 properly after we secured it. Since it's now out of action, the Greenbacks will probably just abandon the place, which gives us an opportunity to salvage any equipment left behind.
STR_A3_POI_Crashed_Heli_03_Task_desc: Although we suffered heavy losses during the AAF's surprise assault, we at least managed to strike a blow of our own - one Greenback Mohawk was brought down and crashed somewhere north of Camp Maxwell. Investigating the crash site might provide some useful information or supplies.
STR_A3_Campaign_Full_Overview:
FULL GAME REQUIRED

We hope you've enjoyed the first episode of 'The East Wind'!

This version of the game does not include the second and third campaign episodes. Purchase the full game to continue playing (after purchasing you'll need to shut down the game and update it first).

ADAPT & WIN

Adapt: Cut off from the outside world, surviving NATO forces make their way to the Altis mainland seeking the assistance of local guerrilla forces.

Win: The Republic of Altis and Stratis sits at the center of an escalating global conflict. As the world stands on the brink of all-out war, NATO forces join the fray.
