STR_A3_b_hub_task_assemble_desc: Choose your equipment and link up with the rest of your team at the assembly point.
str_a3_b_hub_082_b_hub_ambient_talk_sfa_: Well, you know as much as I do.
But it's more than these poor bastards.
str_a3_b_hub_082_b_hub_ambient_talk_sfb_: Hah. You know that's not a lot, mate.
str_a3_b_hub_081_b_hub_ambient_talk_sfa_: Miller can't let it go, either. The man's possessed by it.
And, between you and me... Ah, forget it.
str_a3_b_hub_080_b_hub_ambient_talk_sfa_: We know it likely to be east of the main airport.
No kidding, but we do know that CSAT operates its own airfield in the south.
And we don't have eyes on that. Not yet. We've tried.
str_a3_b_hub_080_b_hub_ambient_talk_sfb_: Yeah. It's the only place that makes sense. The north west is a fortress.
str_a3_b_hub_079_b_hub_ambient_talk_sfa_: Yeah. They don't take that long to construct.
str_a3_b_hub_079_b_hub_ambient_talk_sfb_: I thought so. When did the construction start?
No - I just - I thought it was longer in general.
str_a3_b_hub_078_b_hub_ambient_talk_sfa_: Aye, but you gotta remember, that's why they were here in the first place.
Well, yes, but, c'mon, their actual intention was clear to anyone with half a brain.
I mean, you don't need that many people to train a small army.
Not even one as shite as the Greenbacks.
str_a3_b_hub_077_b_hub_ambient_talk_sfa_: Jimbo's got an idea but, well, you know Jimbo.
str_a3_b_hub_077_b_hub_ambient_talk_sfb_: Heh. Actually, I don't think I do.
str_a3_b_hub_076_b_hub_ambient_talk_sfa_: CSAT are still bringing in reinforcements. More each day now.
It was a lot simpler when you could count the number of their officers on your hands.
str_a3_b_hub_076_b_hub_ambient_talk_sfb_: Shit. They must be three times the force we first encountered.
str_a3_b_hub_076_b_hub_ambient_talk_sfa_: Aye, that's what I'm worried about.
str_a3_b_hub_076_b_hub_ambient_talk_sfb_: Well, one things for sure, it can't carry on like this indefinitely.
str_a3_b_hub_075_b_hub_ambient_talk_sfa_: Good. Just pay attention to the execution. A lot of moving parts, you know?
Well, CSAT's got it locked down tight. It's the only way.
str_a3_b_hub_075_b_hub_ambient_talk_sfb_: Uh, yeah. Jimbo talked to us this morning, why?
I mean, those areas are off limits even to the Greenbacks these days.
No argument here. I get it.
str_a3_b_hub_074_b_hub_ambient_talk_sfa_: But, c'mon, the food is shit.
Aye, like a fucking fungus, maybe.
str_a3_b_hub_074_b_hub_ambient_talk_sfb_: I don't know that about, mate. It's, er - you know - it's grown on me.
str_a3_b_hub_073_b_hub_ambient_talk_sfa_: Heh. Yeah, I know. Uh, it's 3 months. 3 months yesterday, actually.
Yeah, but the situation changed, didn't it.
str_a3_b_hub_073_b_hub_ambient_talk_sfb_: I mean - I think lost track of how long we've been out here, y'know?
str_a3_b_hub_073_b_hub_ambient_talk_sfa_: You just have to adapt to that.
str_a3_b_hub_073_b_hub_ambient_talk_sfb_: Christ. And to think, it was supposed to be done by the summer.
str_a3_b_hub_072_b_hub_ambient_talk_sfa_: That's because he wasn't. The intended target was different.
str_a3_b_hub_072_b_hub_ambient_talk_sfb_: Stavrou didn't sound too impressed, though.
str_a3_b_hub_071_b_hub_ambient_talk_sfa_: No, we were operating east of Oreakastro.
It was a no-go. Other priorities.
str_a3_b_hub_071_b_hub_ambient_talk_sfb_: Oh. But, I thought Miller moved you up north?
str_a3_b_hub_319_poi_weapon_smugglers_02: Alright, that looks like the last of them.
str_a3_b_hub_317_poi_uav_01_player_ker_0: This should help keep us a little safer.
str_a3_b_hub_316_poi_special_forces_01_p: Shit. Those guys weren't fucking around.
str_a3_b_hub_313_poi_mysterious_cache_01: Damn, this might help us out.
str_a3_b_hub_311_poi_immobile_armor_01_p: One less for us to have to worry about.
str_a3_b_hub_310_poi_First_Aid_02_player: Right. We should be able to put this to good use.
str_a3_b_hub_309_poi_first_aid_01_player: Okay. This should be enough for now.
str_a3_b_hub_305_poi_checkpoint_03_playe: That should free up our supply network a bit.
str_a3_b_hub_304_poi_checkpoint_02_playe: I hope they get the message now.
str_a3_b_hub_302_poi_abandoned_battlefie: Well, that APC's not going anywhere.
str_a3_b_hub_301_poi_abandoned_battlefie: Christ. Must have been some firefight.
str_a3_b_hub_300_poi_abandoned_battlefie: Damn, a whole platoon could get lost in this forest...
str_a3_b_hub_214_poi_pilots_01_gua_0: You won't believe what I've just heard.
str_a3_b_hub_214_poi_pilots_01_gua_1: We received a message from someone sympathetic to our cause.
str_a3_b_hub_214_poi_pilots_01_gua_2: He said that pilots from AAF's 2nd Helicopter Squadron set up a small 'HQ' in an abandoned coastal resort, just south of Kavala.
str_a3_b_hub_214_poi_pilots_01_gua_3: If we manage to eliminate them, AAF air power will take a serious blow.
str_a3_b_hub_214_poi_pilots_01_gua_4: Yes, of course, they are not so stupid as to go there alone. They will have protection.
str_a3_b_hub_214_poi_pilots_01_gua_5: This type of thing requires a delicate touch. Go in quietly - do the job - disappear before they know what's happened.
str_a3_b_hub_403_welcome_b_hub03_nik_0: American, come - please - walk with me now.
str_a3_b_hub_403_welcome_b_hub03_nik_1: My name is Nikos Panagopoulos and, from what I hear, I owe you a debt of gratitude.
str_a3_b_hub_403_welcome_b_hub03_nik_3: I will let Commander Stavrou share the details but, let me say, it is good news.
str_a3_b_hub_403_welcome_b_hub03_nik_4: I am - we together are - determined to change the status quo.
str_a3_b_hub_403_welcome_b_hub03_nik_5: Ever since our legitimate government was overthrown, we have waited for such a day.
str_a3_b_hub_403_welcome_b_hub03_nik_6: Thanks in part to you and, of course, our British friends over all these years, we are much closer to being able to do that.
str_a3_b_hub_403_welcome_b_hub03_nik_8: Now, come, Stavrou will debrief everyone soon.
str_a3_b_hub_402_welcome_b_hub02_sta_0: Ah, good, I am glad to see that you made it here.
str_a3_b_hub_402_welcome_b_hub02_sta_1: Moving our camp at this time was - ah - a rather unexpected task.
str_a3_b_hub_402_welcome_b_hub02_sta_2: I can not say how long we will find ourselves here, but we must be ready to move again.
str_a3_b_hub_402_welcome_b_hub02_sta_3: Our enemy is increasing the pressure upon us.
str_a3_b_hub_402_welcome_b_hub02_sta_4: We must now pick our moves with great caution.
str_a3_b_hub_402_welcome_b_hub02_sta_5: They grow stronger, but slower. We must adapt to this new threat.
str_a3_b_hub_401_welcome_b_hub01_ker_1: Wait, he's Stavrou? That explains a lot.
str_a3_b_hub_401_welcome_b_hub01_ker_2: Oh, uh, don't mention it, Captain.
str_a3_b_hub_401_welcome_b_hub01_mil_1: So, that's Stavrou over there, I believe you two have met.
str_a3_b_hub_401_welcome_b_hub01_mil_3: He's holding a debrief now. After what happened to them in Kavala, I can hardly blame him.
str_a3_b_hub_401_welcome_b_hub01_mil_4: They're expecting us - let's not keep them waiting.
str_a3_b_hub_401_welcome_b_hub01_mil_5: And, Kerry... Thanks for your help earlier.
str_a3_b_hub_219_poi_weapon_smugglers_02: Jesus. Just look at what we have left - so few weapons, such little ammunition!
I hope he'll talk. We need every single weapon, every single bullet...
Yeah, I know. But we're making gains - little by little.
Just yesterday, Yannis' group captured a well-known weapon dealer on the southern coast while on long-range patrol.
He's no small fish - part of a large international gang. They had access to almost everything.
They definitely have a cache here on Altis. Stavrou's interrogating him now, but the bastard's not saying anything.
str_a3_b_hub_218_poi_weapon_smugglers_01: You know, my cousin was in the police before the civil war - I remember he was investigating local weapon smugglers.
It was no big deal, but... could be something.
Apparently they were set up somewhere out in the wilderness west of Syrta, but the conflict escalated before they were able to catch them.
str_a3_b_hub_217_poi_uav_01_gua_0: Shit, really? That's funny, though, I heard Andreas saying he picked up some strange radio signal from the southern woods.
str_a3_b_hub_217_poi_uav_01_gub_0: Stavrou needs us to camouflage our camps more. He thinks CSAT will deploy drones to find us and bomb the hell out of us.
str_a3_b_hub_217_poi_uav_01_gub_1: You should tell Stavrou. Who knows if the bastards aren't watching us right now.
str_a3_b_hub_216_poi_special_forces_01_g: I overheard Stavrou speaking with Miller. CSAT have sent in their recon forces to use special 'COIN tactics' against us.
Perhaps, but now we face a whole new level of risk.
We've already lost contact with two scouting teams near Syrta.
Well, that's no surprise. The AAF have not exactly been successful in finding our hideouts.
str_a3_b_hub_215_poi_sniper_01_gua_0: Yeah, I - it was an ambush.
str_a3_b_hub_215_poi_sniper_01_gua_1: His team was hit by a sniper - near the large factory close by Kore.
str_a3_b_hub_215_poi_sniper_01_gub_0: Shit, man... I'm sorry to hear about Nikolo - what happened?
str_a3_b_hub_215_poi_sniper_01_gua_2: Before we got the chance to put together a team, his radio went silent.
str_a3_b_hub_215_poi_sniper_01_gub_1: Goddamn snipers. Don't worry. We'll make them pay for this.
str_a3_b_hub_213_poi_mysterious_cache_01: As if it wasn't bad enough standing alone against AAF, now these CSAT dogs bring their army, their armor, their gunships!
What can we possibly do against that?
Look, I don't know - we have to be smart. Take advantage of our opportunities.
Like, for example, I heard talk of some AAF soldiers wanting to defect.
Some guy here mentioned a weapons cache they set up somewhere - serious equipment - AA launchers and shit.
It's supposed to be in some abandoned warehouse or something in the bay east of Polliako
Whether it's true or not, I can't say. But, surely, it's worth a look.
str_a3_b_hub_212_poi_immobile_armor_02_g: You know, I could get used to lady luck being at our side.
A local just told us about an immobilized CSAT APC.
He doesn't know exactly what happened - broken transmission, fucked up engine - whatever.
As would we all, brother - what happened?
Not quite. It may be much simpler to kill its crew.
After all, if there's no one operate it, it's just useless heap of metal.
Interesting. You think we might use this opportunity to strike it?
str_a3_b_hub_211_poi_immobile_armor_01_g: Yeah, it was another well worked ambush.
It was a Gorgon. The explosion didn't kill the crew, but the IFV is a write off.
Well, the wreck is still there for now - on the crossroad between Syrta and Kore.
Good to hear. So, who was unlucky today?
Good news, indeed. Those things are lethal - a pity I didn't get to see that.
str_a3_b_hub_210_poi_first_aid_02_gua_0: Shit. We've got a couple of guys in really bad shape.
str_a3_b_hub_210_poi_first_aid_02_gub_0: We're still low on medical kits?
str_a3_b_hub_210_poi_first_aid_02_gub_1: You know, there's a veterinary clinic in Fotia. I lived nearby it.
str_a3_b_hub_210_poi_first_aid_02_gub_2: If it hasn't been destroyed or looted - I dunno - maybe there's something we can salvage?
str_a3_b_hub_209_poi_first_aid_01_gua_0: You got a spare medical pack?
str_a3_b_hub_209_poi_first_aid_01_gua_1: Damn. We're really running low - and it's not like we can just walk into the Kavala hospital and ask for help.
str_a3_b_hub_209_poi_first_aid_01_gua_2: Hm. There is but the village was abandoned long time ago.
str_a3_b_hub_209_poi_first_aid_01_gub_0: Uh, not spare, really, just my own.
str_a3_b_hub_209_poi_first_aid_01_gua_3: I'm afraid there might be nothing left by now...
str_a3_b_hub_209_poi_first_aid_01_gub_1: No, but... isn't there a small clinic in Oreokastro?
str_a3_b_hub_208_poi_crashed_plane_01_gu: Did you hear what Kostas reported?
They were watching a Buzzard - on patrol, as usual - but suddenly it started burning and went down.
They don't know if the pilot ejected, but it could be worth investigating before the AAF get a chance to respond.
str_a3_b_hub_207_poi_crashed_helicopter_: You know, even the mighty Kajman has its weak spot...
Exactly. Some lucky bastard managed to hit an engine with .50 cal.
It went down in some forest.
No... somebody managed to bring one down?
str_a3_b_hub_206_poi_crashed_helicopter_: Did you hear? One of our guys managed to sabotage an AAF helicopter.
They sent it on a mission few hours ago - after some time, they lost contact with it.
No shit. I wonder if they made it down or...
str_a3_b_hub_205_poi_checkpoint_03_gua_0: It seems these bastards won't rest until they control all the roads on our island.
str_a3_b_hub_205_poi_checkpoint_03_gua_2: This time, CSAT brought in their troops to guard it.
str_a3_b_hub_205_poi_checkpoint_03_gua_3: There's enough of them, but they placed the checkpoint right between two forests...
str_a3_b_hub_204_poi_checkpoint_02_gua_0: Tell me about it. A day behind enemy lines on patrol does this to a man.
str_a3_b_hub_204_poi_checkpoint_02_gua_1: We did. The AAF are building another checkpoint. It seems we have less and less freedom by the day.
str_a3_b_hub_204_poi_checkpoint_02_gub_0: My friend, no offense, but you look like hell.
str_a3_b_hub_204_poi_checkpoint_02_gua_2: I agree, brother but - right now - I can barely walk, let alone fight. Another day.
str_a3_b_hub_204_poi_checkpoint_02_gub_1: True. Did you at least see some activity?
str_a3_b_hub_204_poi_checkpoint_02_gub_2: Shit. We should get some men together. We should demonstrate just how unwelcome they truly are.
str_a3_b_hub_203_poi_checkpoint_01_gua_0: The AAF do not learn quickly.
str_a3_b_hub_203_poi_checkpoint_01_gua_1: Well, one of our contacts gave us a tip.
str_a3_b_hub_203_poi_checkpoint_01_gua_2: They were to build a new checkpoint - part of this new offensive - near the northern coast.
str_a3_b_hub_203_poi_checkpoint_01_gua_3: They first dispatched smaller team to prepare the ground for the others.
str_a3_b_hub_203_poi_checkpoint_01_gub_2: It is. Although, I cannot say if it is CSAT pushing them harder, or their own bloody arrogance.
str_a3_b_hub_202_poi_abandonedbattlefiel: Oh, shit. I feel totally ruined.
Let me tell you, it's no easy work hauling RPGs across mountains.
A CSAT mechanized group searching the village there.
Oh, yeah, your team was sent out to scout the western coast - did you find something?
They've really stepped up their operations - but guess who took out their APC?
str_a3_b_hub_201_poi_abandonedbattlefiel: Hey, are you okay, brother? What happened?
We've lost some men - an ambush on an AAF squad near the great dump.
We killed them all but - Stavrou - he was afraid of CSAT reinforcements. Ordered us to retreat.
We didn't even have time to take care of our fallen...
str_a3_b_hub_200_poi_abandonedbattlefiel: Ah, I see. A pity in times like these.
Ah, as last time. Dense fog. Little visibility.
Yes, a recon team. In the large forest by the coast.
I think we managed to get them all, but - the fog - it got so thick.
It took an hour just to regroup and find our way back - we simply did not have the chance to grab any equipment.
STR_A3_b_hub_task_debriefing_desc: Stavrou has organized a debriefing. Meet with the rest of the guerrillas at his position.
STR_A3_b_hub_task_patrol_desc: Leave the camp at your discretion to start scouting the surrounding area.
STR_A3_b_hub_task_patroltohub_desc: Finish up by returning to the camp.
STR_A3_b_hub_task_rearm_desc: Pick your loadout.%1%1Be aware, when you've finished a mission briefing, your weapons and equipment may be adjusted to best fit the mission profile.
STR_A3_b_hub_task_reportin_desc: Report in with one of the guerilla fighters preparing to go on an operation.
str_a3_b_hub_017_b_out2_briefing_sta_0: Brothers, join me in welcoming Nikos home!
str_a3_b_hub_017_b_out2_briefing_sta_1: With him back at our side, the return of a legitimate government is a little closer.
str_a3_b_hub_017_b_out2_briefing_sta_10: We will draw the bulk of the AAF from the defence of the main airport, leaving NATO with CSAT.
str_a3_b_hub_017_b_out2_briefing_sta_11: This is where the tides turn, brothers. We are stronger than ever before.
str_a3_b_hub_017_b_out2_briefing_sta_2: While it is unfortunate that our British friends could not be here themselves to celebrate this victory, there are more pressing matters at hand.
str_a3_b_hub_017_b_out2_briefing_sta_4: Although we’re still trying to verify his intel, we now believe that NATO is ready to launch an invasion.
str_a3_b_hub_017_b_out2_briefing_sta_5: Miller and his team have already moved north.
str_a3_b_hub_017_b_out2_briefing_sta_6: Their objective is to watch enemy movement and, if possible, establish contact with NATO command.
str_a3_b_hub_017_b_out2_briefing_sta_7: So, while we do not know any specifics, only one target makes sense: the main airport, which operates under joint CSAT-AAF control.
str_a3_b_hub_017_b_out2_briefing_sta_8: We’ll watch the situation carefully, and prepare to make our own strike when the moment comes.
str_a3_b_hub_017_b_out2_briefing_sta_9: Our target will be the AAC airfield to the south, operated entirely by the AAF.
str_a3_b_hub_017_b_out2_briefing_sta_12: An end to our struggle is finally within our grasp. Let us not waste it.
str_a3_b_hub_016_b_m06_briefing_sta_1: The recent attack on Kavala hit us hard.
str_a3_b_hub_016_b_m06_briefing_sta_2: We lost valuable equipment and munitions - many months of supplies.
str_a3_b_hub_016_b_m06_briefing_sta_3: And - to make matters worse – with Nikos still missing in action, we've lost a key link in our supply network.
str_a3_b_hub_016_b_m06_briefing_sta_4: We're not desperate - not yet, at least - but the situation is only going to get worse from here.
str_a3_b_hub_016_b_m06_briefing_sta_5: We must act now. We must strengthen our hand while we still can. Our British friend here has offered us a solution.
str_a3_b_hub_016_b_m06_briefing_sta_6: Part of Miller's team has been scouting enemy movement to the south.
str_a3_b_hub_016_b_m06_briefing_sta_7: There's a weekly supply run between Agios Dionysios and a CSAT outpost in Fotia.
str_a3_b_hub_016_b_m06_briefing_sta_8: His team will move in, ambush the convoy, and deliver the supply truck to one of our teams.
str_a3_b_hub_016_b_m06_briefing_sta_9: So - unless there are any objections - I say we do this.
str_a3_b_hub_015_b_m05_briefing_sta_0: Alright, I'll get straight to the point.
str_a3_b_hub_015_b_m05_briefing_sta_1: A sympathetic AAF officer has approached us looking for a way out.
str_a3_b_hub_015_b_m05_briefing_sta_2: He's been uncomfortable for many months, but the recent CSAT offensive - the bloody attack on Kavala, the ongoing crackdown - has proven to be the last straw.
str_a3_b_hub_015_b_m05_briefing_sta_3: Now he and a few trusted comrades are ready to defect.
str_a3_b_hub_015_b_m05_briefing_sta_4: As part of the deal - and before our enemy learns what's going on - we'll use his position of authority to strike a blow against the very CSAT forces that decimated Kavala.
str_a3_b_hub_015_b_m05_briefing_sta_5: We've arranged to link up with this officer - codename Orestes - along with some of his men at an abandoned farm to the north.
str_a3_b_hub_015_b_m05_briefing_sta_6: We'll then use his security clearance to set the trap.
str_a3_b_hub_015_b_m05_briefing_sta_7: This is both a great risk and a great opportunity. Let us not waste it.
str_a3_b_hub_013_b_m03_briefing_sta_1: So, as you know, AAF and CSAT forces have stepped up their operations against us.
str_a3_b_hub_013_b_m03_briefing_sta_2: It looks like a significant, coordinated and ongoing effort.
str_a3_b_hub_013_b_m03_briefing_sta_3: Now we need to be more mobile - able to move at a moment's notice. To do that, we need fuel for our vehicles.
str_a3_b_hub_013_b_m03_briefing_sta_4: However, as part of the recent offensive, several of our civilian supply trucks have been seized.
str_a3_b_hub_013_b_m03_briefing_sta_5: Many of them - including one of our fuel trucks - are being held at a small industrial complex to the south of the Kavala highway, the main road from the airport to the old capital.
str_a3_b_hub_013_b_m03_briefing_sta_6: We're asking Corporal Kerry here to lead a small team south of the road and raid that complex.
str_a3_b_hub_013_b_m03_briefing_sta_7: We'll stash the vehicle in a safe house nearby - and wait - until it's safe to move again.
str_a3_b_hub_012_b_m02_briefing_sta_0: Ok, quiet now; I have some important news to share with you all.
str_a3_b_hub_012_b_m02_briefing_sta_1: Since his defection, Orestes has further briefed us on what he knows about the situation.
str_a3_b_hub_012_b_m02_briefing_sta_2: Based on this information, we believe that one of our own - Nikos - is being held by the AAF on Stratis.
str_a3_b_hub_012_b_m02_briefing_sta_3: I don’t need to tell you how important he is to our cause, brothers.
str_a3_b_hub_012_b_m02_briefing_sta_4: Not only is he the lynchpin of our supply network, he’s the one man that truly unifies our cause.
str_a3_b_hub_012_b_m02_briefing_sta_5: We plan to set him free.
str_a3_b_hub_012_b_m02_briefing_sta_6: However, time is of the essence. Orestes believes that they will move Nikos deep into CSAT territory.
str_a3_b_hub_012_b_m02_briefing_sta_7: It’s imperative we get to him before he’s taken beyond our reach.
str_a3_b_hub_012_b_m02_briefing_sta_8: Right now, our British friend is putting together a plan to extract him and is finding the boats we will need to get to and from Stratis. We deeply appreciate this assistance.
str_a3_b_hub_012_b_m02_briefing_sta_9: For now, we’ll wait for Miller’s signal and move to his position when the time is right.
str_a3_b_hub_011_b_m01_briefing_sta_0: I’ve got some news, so listen carefully.
str_a3_b_hub_011_b_m01_briefing_sta_1: It begins to look more and more like the offensive against us is part of a bigger strategy.
str_a3_b_hub_011_b_m01_briefing_sta_2: Our enemy is pushing back into territory they abandoned long ago, setting up a forward operating base to the north west of Frini.
str_a3_b_hub_011_b_m01_briefing_sta_3: Yes, this is bad news for us, but, if we play our hand well, it’s also a rare opportunity.
str_a3_b_hub_011_b_m01_briefing_sta_4: CSAT forces are driving this offensive too quickly, over-stretching both themselves and the AAF.
str_a3_b_hub_011_b_m01_briefing_sta_5: If we can hit this position right now, I think we have a chance to catch them off-guard.
str_a3_b_hub_011_b_m01_briefing_sta_6: The base is still under construction, with supplies arriving by the hour.
str_a3_b_hub_011_b_m01_briefing_sta_7: I say we strike quickly, seize whatever weapons and ammo we can, and fall back.
str_a3_b_hub_011_b_m01_briefing_sta_8: We need to send a message to our enemy: they cannot expand with such impunity, and we cannot expect to last much longer if we let them do so.
str_a3_b_hub_010_b_hub_briefing_sta_0: Welcome, everyone, it is good to see you all here.
str_a3_b_hub_010_b_hub_briefing_sta_1: So, for the sake of our new friends, my name is Kostas Stavrou.
str_a3_b_hub_010_b_hub_briefing_sta_10: The last we heard, Pyrgos blamed NATO for supporting a terrorist attack on Stratis. Their CSAT partners have stood behind them.
str_a3_b_hub_010_b_hub_briefing_sta_11: The global situation has become critical and, in these troubled times, it is good to see a familiar face.
str_a3_b_hub_010_b_hub_briefing_sta_2: Together with my brothers here today, we form one cell of the FIA.
str_a3_b_hub_010_b_hub_briefing_sta_3: We reject the false regime in our nation. We fight to restore our freedom.
str_a3_b_hub_010_b_hub_briefing_sta_4: The situation, as it stands, is complex.
str_a3_b_hub_010_b_hub_briefing_sta_5: For many months now, CSAT forces have been a blight upon our homeland.
str_a3_b_hub_010_b_hub_briefing_sta_6: They have trained and supported the AAF – the right hand of the government in Pyrgos.
str_a3_b_hub_010_b_hub_briefing_sta_7: Yet now they have militarised. They have moved into our towns and villages.
str_a3_b_hub_010_b_hub_briefing_sta_8: They have brought bloodshed to our homes.
str_a3_b_hub_010_b_hub_briefing_sta_9: Communication with the outside world has become increasingly difficult.
str_a3_b_hub_010_b_hub_briefing_sta_12: I would like to welcome back our British friend here, and his men.
str_a3_b_hub_010_b_hub_briefing_sta_13: So, welcome, Scott. May the future bring good fortune, with you at our side.
str_a3_b_hub_007_b_out_intro_gua_0: Kerry, great job bringing Nikos home - it's a real game changer.
str_a3_b_hub_007_b_out_intro_gua_1: Stavrou wants to debrief us now. You ready?
str_a3_b_hub_006_b_m06_intro_jam_0: Alright, Kerry. Glad to see you made it.
str_a3_b_hub_006_b_m06_intro_jam_1: Anyway, Miller's put together a plan with Stavrou. You coming?
str_a3_b_hub_005_b_m05_intro_gub_0: Big news: we've got word of an enemy officer who's ready to switch sides.
str_a3_b_hub_005_b_m05_intro_gub_1: Want to go find out what's going on?
str_a3_b_hub_003_b_m03_intro_gua_0: Hey, we've just got some informaton about a vehicle depot - just south of the Kavala highway.
str_a3_b_hub_003_b_m03_intro_gua_1: Sounds like some of our vehicles are held there - Stavrou wants to talk. Come on, you in?
str_a3_b_hub_002_b_m02_intro_gub_0: You know that officer you helped out? He's given us some more intel.
str_a3_b_hub_002_b_m02_intro_gub_1: Sounds important - Stavrou's putting a briefing together. You ready to go?
str_a3_b_hub_001_b_m01_intro_gua_0: Kerry, did you hear? There's been some AAF activity quite close by.
str_a3_b_hub_001_b_m01_intro_gua_1: Stavrou wants to talk to us about it. Are you ready?
str_a3_campaign_b_in_task_radio_descript: Take the comms equipment from the body.
str_a3_campaign_b_in_task_help_descripti: You've washed up alone on foreign shores. Find help.
str_a3_b_in_x20_head_down_jam_0: Kerry, mate, keep your head down. We can't afford to get spotted up here.
str_a3_b_in_x15_mines_jam_0: Kerry, for fucks sake, watch out for the mines!
str_a3_b_in_x15_mines_jam_1: I told you, we set up a defensive perimeter on our six.
str_a3_b_in_x15_mines_jam_2: Approach from the south - I don't need your stupidity giving away our position.
str_a3_b_in_x10_no_radio_meeting_ech_0: Hey, kid, I've got a spare shirt and vest here. It's going to get cold after dark.
str_a3_b_in_x10_no_radio_meeting_jam_0: What the fuck? Kerry, is that you?!
str_a3_b_in_x10_no_radio_meeting_jam_1: Well, fuck me. You jammy cunt.
str_a3_b_in_x10_no_radio_meeting_jam_2: Alright then, Corporal, get your head down and make yourself comfortable.
str_a3_b_in_x10_no_radio_meeting_jam_3: We'll be here for a while yet.
str_a3_b_in_x05_has_map_kavala_jam_0: Oh, and keep clear of Kavala. It's getting fucked up.
str_a3_b_in_x01_has_map_rv_jam_1: Try to make your way to our position. We'll be here until dark, understood?
str_a3_b_in_i05_contact_jam_0: Both AAF and CSAT forces are operating in the area. Mopping up after some offensive against the guerrillas.
str_a3_b_in_i05_contact_jam_1: The situation's still pretty fucked up. Scattered pockets of resistance. You might use that to your advantage.
str_a3_b_in_i05_contact_ker_0: Lieutenant, I see infantry close by. What's the situation?
str_a3_b_in_i05_contact_jam_2: I'd suggest you avoid contact where possible but, if your back's against the wall, just pray it's an isolated patrol.
str_a3_b_in_i05_contact_jam_3: And, remember, CSAT is going to be better trained, better armed.
str_a3_b_in_i05_contact_jam_4: Be fucking careful. Don't get swarmed. Play the odds. Over.
str_a3_b_in_i05_contact_ker_1: Got it. Appreciate the intel. Out.
str_a3_b_in_i01_supplies_jam_1: ... I thought you Yanks couldn't get enough freedom?
str_a3_b_in_i01_supplies_ker_0: Lieutenant, do you read me? Over.
str_a3_b_in_i01_supplies_jam_2: Listen carefully. The FIA just took a massive beating.
str_a3_b_in_i01_supplies_ker_1: I could really use some help, I got nothing here. Over.
str_a3_b_in_i01_supplies_jam_3: There's still a lot of enemy activity in the area. Move carefully and keep your eyes open.
str_a3_b_in_i01_supplies_jam_4: Try searching the through the ruins; you might find something useful.
str_a3_b_in_i01_supplies_ker_3: Yeah, that's something, thanks. See you soon. Out.

str_a3_b_in_45_has_radio_meeting_jam_1: Get your head down and make yourself comfortable. We'll be here for a while yet.
str_a3_b_in_43_approach_from_south_jam_0: Kerry, watch it, we've placed defensive mines to our rear.
str_a3_b_in_43_approach_from_south_jam_1: Be sure to approach our position from the south. How copy?
str_a3_b_in_43_approach_from_south_ker_0: Understood, Lieutenant. Appreciate the head's up. Out.
str_a3_b_in_40_map_found_ker_0: Lieutenant, update, I managed to pick up a map.
str_a3_b_in_40_map_found_ker_1: Proceeding to your location now. 039-143, over.
str_a3_b_in_30_no_map_rv_jam_0: First off, get someplace where you've got a view of the city.
str_a3_b_in_30_no_map_rv_jam_1: If you look north, you'll see two hills - one with a radio mast.
str_a3_b_in_30_no_map_rv_jam_3: We're dug in on the other hillside. Just in case, our gridref is 039-143.
str_a3_b_in_30_no_map_rv_jam_4: Try to make your way to our position. We'll be here until dark. Understood?
str_a3_b_in_20_no_map_kavala_jam_0: Right. Listen carefully. It sounds like you're nearby the old capital, Kavala.
str_a3_b_in_20_no_map_kavala_jam_1: That's where the fighting is; we're just to the north of it, on overwatch.
str_a3_b_in_15_radio_contact_jam_0: What the fuck? Kerry, is that you?
str_a3_b_in_15_radio_contact_jam_1: What's your status? Where's Sergeant Hardy?
str_a3_b_in_15_radio_contact_ker_0: Hello, Lieutenant? I read you, it's Kerry here!
str_a3_b_in_15_radio_contact_jam_2: Shit ... Alright, can you pick out any landmarks? Any choppers or shelling?
str_a3_b_in_15_radio_contact_jam_3: You got a map at least?
str_a3_b_in_15_radio_contact_ker_3: He - Hardy didn't make it, I'm sorry - I found him washed up on the beach - I - I have absolutely no idea where I am.
str_a3_b_in_15_radio_contact_ker_4: Yeah, uh, both, I think ... Look, I'm on a beach - can't see shit from here.
str_a3_b_in_05_radio_babble_jam_2: I say again, do you read me? Over.
STR_A3_B_in_overview: Kerry faces the consequences of a botched withdrawal.
str_a3_campaign_b_m01_task_wait_descript: Wait for further orders from Commander Stavrou.
str_a3_campaign_b_m01_task_truckprotect_: Do what you can to protect our truck as it's loaded with supplies.
str_a3_campaign_b_m01_task_targets_descr: While remaining undetected, eliminate the guards in the watch towers.
str_a3_campaign_b_m01_task_retreat_descr: Friendlies have successfully evacuated from Kavala, retreat back to the forest.
str_a3_campaign_b_m01_task_outpostdefend: The enemy has launched a counter-offensive on the outpost. Make sure they do not succeed.
str_a3_campaign_b_m01_task_outpostattack: Assault and secure the AAF outpost near Frini.
str_a3_campaign_b_m01_task_mortarelimina: Eliminate the enemy mortar in the village of Frini.
str_a3_campaign_b_m01_task_friniretreat_: Fall back to the outpost by fleeing the incoming enemy air strike on Frini.
str_a3_campaign_b_m01_debriefing_win2: Despite being sucessfully assaulting the enemy outpost, the supply truck was damaged before it could return to our camp.
str_a3_campaign_b_m01_debriefing_win1: You successfully assaulted the enemy position and protected the truck. Given the circumstances, these supplies should prove to be invaluable.
str_a3_campaign_b_m01_debriefing_fail3: You failed to follow the orders assigned to you and you didn't attacked the outpost when required. That kind of behaviour will not be tolerated.
str_a3_campaign_b_m01_debriefing_fail2: You failed to go back to the outpost in time, weakening our defense and allowing our enemy to immobilize the supply truck.
str_a3_campaign_b_m01_debriefing_fail1: You failed to protect the supply truck.
str_a3_campaign_b_m01_briefing_situation: I’ve got some news, so listen carefully.%1%1It begins to look more and more like the offensive against us is part of a bigger strategy. Our enemy is pushing back into territory they abandoned long ago, setting up a forward operating base to the north west of Frini.%1%1Yes, this is bad news for us, but, if we play our hand well, it’s also a rare opportunity. CSAT forces are driving this offensive too quickly, over-stretching both themselves and the AAF. If we can hit this position right now, I think we have a chance to catch them off-guard.%1%1The base is still under construction, with supplies arriving by the hour. I say we strike quickly, seize whatever weapons and ammo we can, and fall back.%1%1We need to send a message to our enemy: they cannot expand with such impunity, and we cannot expect to last much longer if we let them do so.

STR_A3_B_m01_overview: The guerrillas plan a hit and run attack on an AAF outpost.
str_a3_campaign_b_m02_1_task_undetected_: Avoid enemy contact en route to Miller's position.
str_a3_campaign_b_m02_1_task_meet_descri: Meet the CTRG team at the beach and prepare to leave Altis.
str_a3_campaign_b_m02_1_briefing_situati: Ok, quiet now; I have some important news to share with you all.%1%1Since his defection, Orestes has further briefed us on what he knows about the situation. Based on this information, we believe that one of our own - Nikos - is being held by the AAF on Stratis.%1%1I don’t need to tell you how important he is to our cause, brothers. Not only is he the lynchpin of our supply network, he’s the one man that truly unifies our cause. We plan to set him free.%1%1However, time is of the essence. Orestes believes that they will move Nikos deep into CSAT territory. It’s imperative we get to him before he’s taken beyond our reach.%1%1Right now, our British friend is putting together a plan to extract him and is finding the boats we will need to get to and from Stratis. We deeply appreciate this assistance.%1%1For now, we’ll wait for Miller’s signal and move to his position when the time is right.
str_a3_campaign_b_m02_1_briefing_mission: CTRG are preparing %4the boats%2 that will take you to Stratis. Avoid detection and link up with them.
str_a3_campaign_b_m02_1_briefing_executi:
1. Inserted near %3Athanos%2
2. Stay undetected
3. RV with Miller at %4the beach%2
str_a3_b_m02_1_20_enddetected_mil_0: For goodness sake, Kerry, did you have to bring the whole army with you?
str_a3_b_m02_1_20_enddetected_mil_1: Quickly now, let's get to the boats.
str_a3_b_m02_1_15_end_mil_0: Oh, and there I was worried worried you wouldn't make it, Kerry.
str_a3_b_m02_1_15_end_mil_1: Come on then, lets get to the boats.
str_a3_b_m02_1_x15_detected_mil_0: This is Falcon, where are you?
str_a3_b_m02_1_x15_detected_mil_1: Look, we simply can't wait any longer - looks like you're staying. Out.
str_a3_b_m02_1_x10_detected_ker_0: Shit. Falcon, be advised, I've been spotted!
str_a3_b_m02_1_x10_detected_mil_0: ... Just don't lead them here - don't expose our boats - lose them first.
str_a3_b_m02_1_x05_millerinsatisfied_ker: Understood, Falcon. Appreciate the heads up. Out.
str_a3_b_m02_1_x05_millerinsatisfied_mil: This is Falcon, be advised, there's a CSAT team searching this village.
If we'd taken our chance to cut our enemy's head off - they might be a little less organized now.
Just be careful - don't blow this operation.
str_a3_b_m02_1_x00_insertionfar_gua_1: Sorry I can't take you any further, American, I'm running low on fuel - we still haven't managed to find any more.
str_a3_b_m02_1_i00_stayundetected_mil_0: Kerry, the enemy is not yet aware of your presence, or ours. It needs to stay that way.
str_a3_b_m02_1_i00_stayundetected_mil_1: Make sure not to run in the open, the area is mostly abandoned by the population.
str_a3_b_m02_1_i00_stayundetected_mil_2: So use the buildings, ridges and vegetation to stay hidden.
str_a3_b_m02_1_i00_stayundetected_mil_3: Yeah, right. Just make sure you don't compromise the operation, before we even start it. Out.

str_a3_b_m02_1_10_millersatisfied_mil_1: CSAT forces are scratching around like headless chickens for now. See you soon. Out.
