str_a3_b_m02_1_00_insertionnear_gua_1: Remember, we have reports of enemy movement in the area.
str_a3_b_m02_1_00_insertionnear_gua_2: Good luck on Stratis - bring our brother home.
STR_A3_B_m02_1_overview: Kerry joins a small team bound for Stratis.
str_a3_campaign_b_m02_2_task_meet_descri: Scuba dive to meet the extraction boat holding a position off the coast.
str_a3_campaign_b_m02_2_task_extraction_: Meet the extraction boat and leave Stratis.
str_a3_campaign_b_m02_2_task_equipment_d: Use the Scuba diving equipment that the extraction unit left for your team.
str_a3_campaign_b_m02_2_task_chaos_descr: Create as much chaos in your area of operation and force the enemy to divert assets south.
str_a3_campaign_b_m02_2_debriefing_win2: You successfully created enough chaos within your area of operation to force enemy units to divert south, enabling the CTRG team extract Nikos. However, you risked the entire operation by arriving late to the extraction point and were forced to swim to meet the extraction boat.
str_a3_campaign_b_m02_2_debriefing_win1: You successfully created enough chaos within your area of operation to force enemy units to divert south, enabling the CTRG team to extract Nikos.
str_a3_campaign_b_m02_2_debriefing_fail1: You were not able to create enough chaos on the enemy area of operation. Nikos couldn't be extracted. This operation is a complete failure.
str_a3_campaign_b_m02_2_briefing_situati: After discovering that %3Nikos%2 was being held in a AAF Stratis complex, %4Miller%2 has set up an operation to get him free from the AAF.%1%1The plan is for %4Miller's%2 team to rescue %3Nikos%2 personally, leaving us with the task of diverting the enemy attention from the complex where %3Nikos%2 is being held, in order for %4Miller%2 to go in and rescue %3Nikos%2 with the least problematic situations possible.%1%1Our window of operation should end in 45 minutes, at around 2025 hours is scheduled for Nikos to be transferred to the %5Airfield%2, we need to rescue him before this happens, otherwise, it will be impossible to get him back to safety.
str_a3_campaign_b_m02_2_briefing_signal_:
Omega - Your team
Gamma - Insertion/Extraction unit
%4Falcon%2 - Miller's team
%3Stawman%2 - Nikos
str_a3_campaign_b_m02_2_briefing_mission: Divert enemy attention by creating as much chaos you can in the %4south%2 to provide the CTRG team a window of opportunity in the %3north%2.
str_a3_campaign_b_m02_2_briefing_executi:
1. Create %3chaos%2 in order to divert the enemy attention from the %4North%2.
2. Meet the extraction unit.
3. Leave Stratis.
str_a3_b_m02_2_00_briefing_ker_0: No, I got it. Let's do this.
str_a3_b_m02_2_00_briefing_mil_0: Okay, listen up. This mission has two elements.
str_a3_b_m02_2_00_briefing_mil_1: A small force - led by me - will approach the location where Nikos - designated Strawman - is currently being held.
str_a3_b_m02_2_00_briefing_mil_2: Now, we've ruled out a direct assault - there's simply too much enemy activity in the area.
str_a3_b_m02_2_00_briefing_mil_3: That's where you come in, Kerry. Your team's objective is to draw enemy forces south.
str_a3_b_m02_2_00_briefing_mil_4: This should give us a fighting chance to get in, grab Nikos, and get out.
str_a3_b_m02_2_00_briefing_mil_5: We should have a window of 45 minutes before Nikos is moved, so keep that in mind.
str_a3_b_m02_2_x10_timeoutwarning_mil_0: Look, we don't have much more time here.
str_a3_b_m02_2_x10_timeoutwarning_mil_1: Do what you can to pull enemy forces south. Over.
str_a3_b_m02_2_x30_extractmeetingcomplet: Shit, man, I'm glad you made it. Now let's get the fuck out out of here.
str_a3_b_m02_2_x25_extractionfailure_gua: Shit. I cannot wait any longer - I need to move. Over.
I cannot hold this position any longer! Look, I'm leaving diving equipment behind. Over.
Get geared up and meet me away from the coast. I am sorry about this. Good luck. Out.
str_a3_b_m02_2_x25_extractionfailure_ker: Dammit, Gamma, don't leave us behind - we're on the way. Over.
str_a3_b_m02_2_x20_extractionwarning_gua: Come on, guys, you have to move it!
I have multiple contacts here - I won't be able to hold this position much longer. Over.
str_a3_b_m02_2_x15_timeoutfailure_mil_0: Kerry, you guys have really blown this - Strawman is being moved as we speak.
str_a3_b_m02_2_x15_timeoutfailure_mil_1: Prep to leave the island. Out.
str_a3_b_m02_2_x05_lighthouse_mil_0: Are you kidding me? You lads took down the lighthouse?
str_a3_b_m02_2_x05_lighthouse_mil_1: Fine work. That's certainly one way to get their attention.
str_a3_b_m02_2_x03_position3_ker_0: Okay, we'll approach from the east.
str_a3_b_m02_2_x02_position2_ker_0: We're taking the south west insertion point.
str_a3_b_m02_2_x01_position1_ker_0: We're taking the western approach. Let's go.
str_a3_b_m02_2_x00_selectiontimeout_mil_: Come on, Corporal Kerry, expedite! Move out now.
str_a3_b_m02_2_i10_instructordestroypoin: Kerry, bringing down bigger structures may be a good way to feign a bigger attack. Keep it in mind. Out.
str_a3_b_m02_2_i05_instructorcamps_mil_0: Try to hit and run. Make them think something big is going down in the south.
str_a3_b_m02_2_i05_instructorcamps_mil_1: Strike enemy camps and small bases quickly; just don't get pinned down. Out.
str_a3_b_m02_2_i00_instructorchaos_mil_0: Make sure to attack enemy camps and raid areas of enemy activity.
str_a3_b_m02_2_i00_instructorchaos_mil_1: Remember, try to confuse the enemy - create a mess so that they have to send more forces south. Out.
str_a3_b_m02_2_70_extractcomplete_gua_0: Hey! Over here! Let's get to the boat.
str_a3_b_m02_2_65_nikossecure_mil_0: All teams, Strawman is secure. Exfiltrating now.
str_a3_b_m02_2_65_nikossecure_mil_1: Sterling work, gentlemen. Now, let's get off of this rock.
str_a3_b_m02_2_60_extract_gua_0: This is Gamma, I'm in position, waiting for you guys. Out.
str_a3_b_m02_2_55_chaosthreshold_gua_0: Understood. Moving to the extraction point. Out.
str_a3_b_m02_2_55_chaosthreshold_ker_0: Copy that, Falcon. Gamma, we need extraction ASAP. Over.
str_a3_b_m02_2_55_chaosthreshold_mil_0: Alright, you lads have managed it, but watch yourselves, there's a small army headed your way.
str_a3_b_m02_2_55_chaosthreshold_mil_1: Get the hell out of there, we're moving on Strawman now. Over.
str_a3_b_m02_2_50_chaosthreequarters_mil: Update: Definite activity now, enemy movement increased.
Looks like they're briefing for something now. Not much longer.
str_a3_b_m02_2_45_chaostwoquarters_ker_0: Copy that, Falcon, thanks for the heads up. Out.
str_a3_b_m02_2_45_chaostwoquarters_mil_0: I don't know what your team just did, but it's working.
str_a3_b_m02_2_45_chaostwoquarters_mil_1: Just watch out, you have an armed vehicle inbound.
str_a3_b_m02_2_45_chaostwoquarters_mil_2: Keep up the pressure - we almost have our window here. Over.
str_a3_b_m02_2_40_chaosonequarter_mil_0: We've started to see some activity here at the camp. Maintain this pressure.
str_a3_b_m02_2_35_firstcontact_mil_0: Understood, but it's not yet enough - we see no reaction here at Tempest.
str_a3_b_m02_2_30_goloud_ker_0: Okay, remember we're here to create a distraction.
str_a3_b_m02_2_30_goloud_ker_1: We need to go loud, strike fast, and await confirmation.
str_a3_b_m02_2_30_goloud_ker_2: Falcon will only move on Strawman once it's clear.
str_a3_b_m02_2_25_reportarrival_ker_0: Falcon, we've just made our insertion; proceeding with the operation. Over.
str_a3_b_m02_2_25_reportarrival_mil_0: Copy that. Make some noise. Out.
str_a3_b_m02_2_15_quickbriefing2_mil_0: Update: we have a visual on Strawman. Verified sighting.
str_a3_b_m02_2_10_quickbriefing1_mil_1: Multiple contacts; vehicles and infantry. Wait one.
str_a3_b_m02_2_05_reportlanding_ker_0: Falcon, we've arrived at the coast. Over.
str_a3_b_m02_2_04_slowdownboat_ker_0: Ok, slow it down, we want to make a smooth landing without being detected.
str_a3_b_m02_2_03_position0_ker_0: We're taking the northwest route. Let's move.
str_a3_b_m02_2_02_selectlocation_mil_0: Kerry, this is where we split up.
str_a3_b_m02_2_02_selectlocation_mil_1: You're in charge of your team now. Pick a good insertion position and move in.
STR_A3_B_m02_2_overview: CTRG lead an operation to extract Nikos from Stratis.
str_a3_campaign_b_m03_task08_text: Get to the %2hideout%1 to finish the mission.
str_a3_campaign_b_m03_task07_text: With the cistern out of the picture, the only thing you can do to save this mission from total disaster is to try to eliminate the HVT on your own. Time to adapt.
str_a3_campaign_b_m03_task06_text: If you hand over the cistern to %2Miller's man%1, he will use it to eliminate the high value target approaching your AO in a convoy.
str_a3_campaign_b_m03_task05_text: Take the cistern to our hideout.
str_a3_campaign_b_m03_task04_text: Our cistern is empty. We need to take the risk of assaulting a heavier guarded target. CSAT are storing some fuel on the %1construction site%2 near Alikampos. Go there and steal a cistern that actually has some fuel in it.
str_a3_campaign_b_m03_task03_text: Retrieve our fuel truck, located in our former camp at the old %2industrial complex%1 south of Agios Dionysios.
str_a3_campaign_b_m03_task02_text: Link up with the rest of your team scattered in enemy territory - %3here%1 and %2here%1.
str_a3_campaign_b_m03_task01_text: In order to get to the AO, you'll have to cross the busy %2highway%1.
str_a3_campaign_b_m03_hint01: Get out of the truck if you want to hand it over to Miller's team.
str_a3_campaign_b_m03_debrief05_desc: The operation was a total disaster. You failed to deliver the fuel and the HVT got away.
str_a3_campaign_b_m03_debrief03_desc: You helped Miller eliminate his target. However, the FIA still remain very low on fuel.
str_a3_campaign_b_m03_debrief02_desc: You've decided that the FIA's need for the fuel were more important than Miller's.
str_a3_campaign_b_m03_debrief01_desc: FIA received the much needed fuel supplies. You've also eliminated a very important target all on your own. All in all, you did very well today.
str_a3_campaign_b_m03_brief_situation: AAF and CSAT forces have stepped up their operations against us. It looks like the start of a significant, coordinated and ongoing effort. We need to be more mobile, able to move at a moment's notice. For that, we need fuel for our vehicles.%1However, as part of the recent offensive, several of our civilian supply trucks have been siezed. Several of them - including one of our fuel trucks - are being held at a small %3industrial complex%2 south of the %4Kavala highway%2, the main road from the airport to the old capital.%1We're asking Corporal Kerry here to lead a small team south of the road and raid the %3complex%2. We'll stash the vehicle in a %5safehouse%2 nearby until it's safe to move it again.
str_a3_campaign_b_m03_brief_signal: %2Omega%1 - Your team.%3%4Sigma%1 - Additional team you can link up with.%3%5Gamma%1 - Additional team you can link up with.%3Slingshot - Command.
str_a3_campaign_b_m03_brief_mission: Locate our %3cistern%1 and safely deliver it to our %2hideout%1.
str_a3_campaign_b_m03_brief_execution: Move south of the Kavala Highway.%3%5Find the %8cistern%1.%3%6Take the cistern to the %2hideout%1.
str_a3_b_m03_x20_empty_handed_guc_0: Er, Kerry, where the hell is the cistern?
str_a3_b_m03_x20_empty_handed_ker_0: It's - uh - better if I explain face to face...
str_a3_b_m03_x15_miller_impressed_ker_2: We managed to take care of it on our own.
str_a3_b_m03_x15_miller_impressed_mil_0: Receiving you, Omega, what do you want?
str_a3_b_m03_x15_miller_impressed_ker_3: 'Opportunities like this sometimes require snap decisions'. Over.
str_a3_b_m03_x15_miller_impressed_mil_1: What on earth are you talking about, Omega?
str_a3_b_m03_x15_miller_impressed_mil_2: Good lord. You might just make a decent soldier after all. Well done. Falcon out.
str_a3_b_m03_x10_miller_grateful_mil_0: I hear you made the right choice; you won't regret it.
str_a3_b_m03_x10_miller_grateful_mil_1: And don't worry, I'll deal with any consequences. Falcon out.
str_a3_b_m03_x05_cistern_dead_ker_1: ... There's gotta be another way to stop that convoy.
str_a3_b_m03_x03_kappaout_guc_0: Omega, this is Kappa. We've done all we can - pulling back now. Over.
str_a3_b_m03_x03_kappaout_ker_0: Understood. Thanks for the assist. Out.
str_a3_b_m03_x01_cistern_dead_no_matter_: Slingshot, Omega here. The cistern, I - it's done for - I'm sorry ... What now, over?
Ah, typical American. Wait for new orders, Omega. Out.
str_a3_b_m03_i05_attacking_complex_2_sta: If you call in team Kappa, you will have fewer guards to worry about before you approach your objective.
Kappa's job is to hit and run - to give you a window of opportunity.
Get in and take the cistern. Don't stay there any longer than necessary - it's not up to you to seize that site.
Godspeed to you all. Slingshot out.
str_a3_b_m03_i01_attacking_complex_1_sta: Kerry, we don't have a lot of intel about the AAF garrison in the complex.
Team Gamma may have spotted some movement when they moved to their RV - I'd suggest asking them if you haven't already.
Anyway, I would avoid moving in from the north - they're probably watching the dirt road.
You could try sneaking in from the southwest or, perhaps, make a longer approach from the east.
The high ground there should give you a good overview of the place.
str_a3_b_m03_35_miller_angry_ker_1: Falcon, these people risked their asses to get that fuel today. I made a judgement call. Over.
str_a3_b_m03_35_miller_angry_mil_1: 'Judgement', Corporal? I hope you realise that we may not have a shot like this again.
str_a3_b_m03_35_miller_angry_mil_2: It's just so - forget it. I expected you see the bigger picture here.
str_a3_b_m03_35_miller_angry_mil_3: Just make sure that fuel is put to good use. Falcon out.
str_a3_b_m03_33_hvt_decision_ker_0: Goddamn Brits. Why am I the one making all the decisions these days?
str_a3_b_m03_32_hvt_intel_ker_0: Falcon - wait a second - what exactly's going on here?
str_a3_b_m03_32_hvt_intel_ker_1: My task is to just deliver the cistern to the hideout. Over.
str_a3_b_m03_32_hvt_intel_ker_2: Uh, I don't think I'm following you here.
str_a3_b_m03_32_hvt_intel_ker_3: I - wait - are you sure the locals signed off on this? Over.
str_a3_b_m03_32_hvt_intel_mil_1: That depends. How would you like to take down the highest ranking officer on this island?
str_a3_b_m03_32_hvt_intel_mil_2: Use your imagination for once. Two thousand litres of fuel? That's a pretty big fireball.
str_a3_b_m03_32_hvt_intel_mil_3: Now, our target's MRAP just left the airbase. An armoured convoy will be passing through your AO.
str_a3_b_m03_32_hvt_intel_mil_4: For reference, I'm sending you their route now. Over.
str_a3_b_m03_32_hvt_intel_mil_5: Look, neutralising this target is a game-changer. Opportunities like this sometimes require snap decisions.
str_a3_b_m03_32_hvt_intel_mil_6: It's up to you. One of my guys is en route to a small construction yard north of Alikampos.
str_a3_b_m03_32_hvt_intel_mil_7: You have 10 minutes. Deliver the truck; we'll take it from there. Falcon out.
str_a3_b_m03_30_hvt_wait_ker_0: Slingshot, this is Omega. We've finally got our hands on a full cistern. Heading home now. Out.
str_a3_b_m03_30_hvt_wait_mil_0: Kerry, Falcon here. Just hold on to that cistern for a bit.
str_a3_b_m03_30_hvt_wait_mil_1: I've got some new intel. Wait one.
str_a3_b_m03_25_team_2_attack_guc_0: We hear you. Got it confirmed by Slingshot. On our way. Kappa out.
str_a3_b_m03_25_team_2_attack_ker_0: Omega to Kappa, we'll need your help with the construction site. Move in, over.
str_a3_b_m03_23_approaching_complex_2_st: Slingshot to Omega, Kappa is in position in Alikampos. They wait for your signal.
Remember, your priority is that fuel truck. Slingshot out.
str_a3_b_m03_21_itson_sta_0: He's right, we must take that risk.
str_a3_b_m03_21_itson_sta_1: Okay, listen carefully. Team Kappa is in the woods to the east of our hideout.
str_a3_b_m03_21_itson_sta_2: They will take up a position in Alikampos, wait for your order and, if needed, join the assault the construction site.
str_a3_b_m03_21_itson_sta_3: Get it done with as little blood spilled as possible. Godspeed. Slingshot out.
str_a3_b_m03_20_plan_b_mil_0: Falcon to Slingshot, I've got decent intel on a CSAT fuel truck nearby Alikampos, over.
str_a3_b_m03_20_plan_b_mil_1: It was there an hour ago, parked up in the construction site. That's as sure as I can be.
str_a3_b_m03_20_plan_b_mil_2: I suggest moving in while you still have assets in the area. It's up to you. Falcon out.
str_a3_b_m03_20_plan_b_sta_0: Can you be sure, Falcon? Over.
str_a3_b_m03_15_cistern_empty_ker_1: Slingshot, update. The cistern's empty, I say again, no fuel left in the cistern, over.
str_a3_b_m03_15_cistern_empty_sta_0: Ah, Goddammit. This was always a risk.
str_a3_b_m03_15_cistern_empty_sta_1: Okay, wait for new orders, Kerry. Out.
str_a3_b_m03_08_approaching_complex_1_ke: Slingshot, be advised, we're closing in on the complex.
I'll report back once we've got the cistern. Out.
str_a3_b_m03_06_rendezvous_2_gua_0: Not much, but we were able to map out the last known position of guards in the main complex.
str_a3_b_m03_06_rendezvous_2_ker_0: Glad to see you made it here in one piece. Any new intel?
str_a3_b_m03_05_rendezvous_1_gub_0: Good to see you, Kerry. We have increased movement around the main road.
str_a3_b_m03_05_rendezvous_1_gub_1: Just give me a second - I can update their positions in your map.
str_a3_b_m03_05_rendezvous_1_ker_0: Morning, guys, any update on Greenback activity?
str_a3_b_m03_01_start_gua_0: This is Gamma, we have taken cover in a junk yard to the south of the highway.
str_a3_b_m03_01_start_gua_1: Trying to get a better view of the situation now, over.
str_a3_b_m03_01_start_ker_0: Slingshot, this is Omega, be advised, approaching the highway now. Over.
str_a3_b_m03_01_start_sta_0: Good news. Continue with the mission. I will check in with the recon teams.
str_a3_b_m03_01_start_sta_1: Gamma, Sigma, what is your status? Over.
str_a3_b_m03_01_start_gub_0: Sigma here, we are in position in the woods. All is quiet here.
str_a3_b_m03_01_start_sta_2: Understood. Omega is now in the area. Hold your positions. Slingshot out.
STR_A3_B_m03_overview: The FIA move in to retrieve a seized fuel truck.
str_a3_campaign_b_m05_task07_text: When you're done with your mission, regroup with Orestes at the %2meeting point%1 and bring him to our base.
str_a3_campaign_b_m05_task06_text: The enemy uses a %2farm%1 north-west of Katalakos as a repair depot for their damaged vehicles. If you eliminate the depot garrison along with the vehicle guarding it, Orestes will call in a fire mission to destroy all vehicles being repaired there.
str_a3_campaign_b_m05_task05_text: Orestes will request helicopter support in the area once you've eliminated the 5-man CSAT patrol on %2overwatch%1 near the wind turbines. When the chopper's in the area, mark the LZ with smoke, wait for it to land, and destroy it. Planted explosives are ideal. Make sure the pilot doesn't spot you!
str_a3_campaign_b_m05_task04_text: Pick one of the available opportunities for CSAT ambush. Eliminate the enemy presence in the selected area and let Orestes request a support run.
str_a3_campaign_b_m05_task03_text: Your contact was followed to the meet. Get rid of the pursuers before they realize what's happening.
str_a3_campaign_b_m05_task02_text: Wait for our AAF contact. He should arrive any minute now.
str_a3_campaign_b_m05_task01_text: Our contact is on his way to the %2rendezvous%1 and you're running late. Get there quickly and wait for him.
str_a3_campaign_b_m05_debrief03_desc: Orestes was killed by CSAT forces. Without him, this operation is futile.
str_a3_campaign_b_m05_debrief02_desc: You failed to destroy the helicopter.
str_a3_campaign_b_m05_debrief01_desc: Not only will this complicate future lines of communication between the AAF and CSAT, but we have managed to strike a significant blow against the very CSAT forces that decimated our brothers in Kavala.
str_a3_campaign_b_m05_brief_situation: A sympathetic AAF officer has approached us looking for a way out. He's been uncomfortable for many months, but the recent CSAT offensive - the bloody attack on Kavala, the ongoing crackdown - has proven to be the last straw.%1Now he and a few trusted comrades are ready to defect. As part of the deal - and before our enemy learns what's going on - we'll use his position of authority to strike a blow against the very CSAT forces that decimated Kavala.%1We've arranged to link up with this officer - codename Orestes - along with some of his men at an %3abandoned farm%2 to the north. We'll then use his security clearance to set the trap.
str_a3_campaign_b_m05_brief_mission: Meet our contact and exploit his position of authority to sabotage a CSAT element in the area.
str_a3_campaign_b_m05_brief_execution: %2Link up with the AAF officer%1%3Eliminate enemy presence in the area you've selected for sabotage%1%4Have the officer call in support%1%5Exfiltrate
str_a3_b_m05_15_sabotage_request_artille: Understood, Spartan-actual. We cannot allow them to raid our positions with such impunity.
Get to cover. We'll send heavy ordnance. Splash in 60 seconds. Griffin out.
Griffin, this is Spartan-Actual, we have multiple enemy contacts at the Oreokastro depot.
Looks like another raid on our position for weapons and vehicles - I don't think we can continue to hold them off.
We've pulled back to higher ground for now - requesting immediate fire support on the position. Danger-close. Over.
str_a3_b_m05_x10_chopper_getting_away_ke: Shit - I think he spotted us!
str_a3_b_m05_x05_meeting_late_ore_0: Oh, so nice of you people to finally arrive.
str_a3_b_m05_x05_meeting_late_ore_1: You know, it was a big risk neutralizing that patrol ourselves - I cannot say if we were discovered.
str_a3_b_m05_x05_meeting_late_ore_2: ... Anyway, I hope you'll find yourself more interested in the rest of this operation.
str_a3_b_m05_x05_meeting_late_ore_3: So, we can only afford to pull off one strike. CSAT get suspicious very, very quickly.
str_a3_b_m05_x05_meeting_late_ore_4: Let me know once you're in position. Go.
str_a3_b_m05_x01_orestes_alone_ore_0: This is Orestes, where the hell are you guys?!
str_a3_b_m05_x01_orestes_alone_ore_1: CSAT are on their way to our position now - we need urgent help!
str_a3_b_m05_i10_sabotage_headsup_helico: Corporal, this is Orestes. If you've decided to take down the helicopter, you should have some smokeshells and explosives at hand.
Do you have somewhere to rearm in the area? Maybe check your map.
After you've eliminated the patrol, report to me and I'll call it in.
When it gets near, deploy smoke to mark its LZ. Pick a reasonable spot so the pilot can land as close to it as possible.
You can then plant a satchel on the LZ or take it out with a rocket launcher. Orestes out.
str_a3_b_m05_i05_sabotage_headsup_artill: Kerry, this is Orestes. If you've decided to assault the depot, you might want to get some more men. I suppose you have more teams in the area, right?
After you've eliminated the garrison and the patrolling vehicle, report back and I'll call in the artillery. Out.
str_a3_b_m05_i01_sabotage_pick_ore_0: Okay, Kerry, assaulting the repair depot will put you and your men in more danger. You'll need to plan your attack carefully.
str_a3_b_m05_i01_sabotage_pick_ore_1: Luring in the chopper will require more stealth and finesse. If it spots you, it'll take defensive measures to protect the units in cargo.
str_a3_b_m05_i01_sabotage_pick_ore_2: Ultimately, the choice is yours. Orestes out.
str_a3_b_m05_25_suprise_falcon_jam_0: Just wanted to ensure our new friend makes it safely to the camp, that's all.
str_a3_b_m05_25_suprise_falcon_jam_1: We wouldn't want him to get lost on the way. Isn't that right, 'Orestes?'.
str_a3_b_m05_25_suprise_falcon_ker_0: L-lieutenant? What are you doing here?
str_a3_b_m05_25_suprise_falcon_ore_0: Just shut up and let's go. I told Miller, I have no business with you Brits.
str_a3_b_m05_20_good_job_ker_0: Slingshot, this is Omega. The operation was a success. Orestes stood by his word. Over.
str_a3_b_m05_20_good_job_ore_0: We have a common enemy, Commander Stavrou. Let us not make it personal. Out.
str_a3_b_m05_20_good_job_sta_0: Copy that, Corporal. Well done today, soldier.
str_a3_b_m05_20_good_job_sta_1: I am glad the Lieutenant came to see the true evil in our homeland.
str_a3_b_m05_20_good_job_sta_3: So, see you back at the camp, Omega, and keep your heads down.
str_a3_b_m05_20_good_job_sta_4: CSAT will not react kindly when they discover this deception. Slingshot out.
str_a3_b_m05_10_sabotage_request_helicop: Viper-Green, this is Griffin, we have a situation in the vicinity of Point Victor.
Griffin, this is Spartan-Actual, my unit has made contact near Point Victor!
We've secured the area but need urgent support - can you dispatch QRF to our position? Over.
Board Hydra and we'll brief you en route. Expedite.
Spartan-Actual, be advised, we're dispatching a chopper to your position, callsign Hydra.
Regroup and mark the LZ. Griffin out.
str_a3_b_m05_08_sabotage_request_ker_0: Orestes, we're in position. Call it in, over.
str_a3_b_m05_08_sabotage_request_ore_0: Affirmative, Kerry. I'll keep this channel open.
str_a3_b_m05_05_pursuers_eliminated_ore_: Good work, Kerry. Now, let's get this done.
CSAT are well trained - they get suspicious very, very quickly. We can only pull off one strike.
Let me know once you're in position. Good luck.
Oh, and one more thing, Corporal, one of my men has an AT launcher here.
If you would consider it to be helpful, you are welcome to it. Out.
str_a3_b_m05_03_contact_arrival_ker_0: Orestes? Corporal Kerry, I'm with the FIA.
str_a3_b_m05_03_contact_arrival_ker_1: It's okay, we can fall back to the forest - we'll be gone before they get here.
str_a3_b_m05_03_contact_arrival_ore_0: Yes - Stavrou told me to expect an American - but listen carefully, Corporal, I think we've been followed.
str_a3_b_m05_03_contact_arrival_ore_1: As we turned onto this road, we spotted a CSAT vehicle a little way behind us. They must not discover us!
str_a3_b_m05_03_contact_arrival_ore_2: Listen to me, we only have one shot at this. You must intercept them. They cannot find out we work together - not yet!
str_a3_b_m05_02_chitchat_gua_0: Have you noticed? Stavrou seems really keen to have this traitor at our side.
str_a3_b_m05_02_chitchat_gua_1: Perhaps - if we can trust him.
str_a3_b_m05_02_chitchat_ker_0: Yeah, I guess. Having a Greenback officer on hand must be an invaluable asset.
str_a3_b_m05_02_chitchat_ker_1: I - uh - no idea. Captain Miller hasn't once mentioned it since I last talked to him.
str_a3_b_m05_02_chitchat_ker_2: Though it's not like that means much.
str_a3_b_m05_01_start_ker_0: We're just south of the RV now - minutes away - don't worry. Over.
str_a3_b_m05_01_start_sta_0: Omega, what's your status? Are you going to make it there on time? Over.
str_a3_b_m05_01_start_sta_1: Good. Do not keep Orestes waiting - we can't afford to spook him now. Slingshot out.
STR_A3_B_m05_overview: An AAF officer looking to defect offers the guerrillas a chance for revenge.
str_a3_campaign_b_m06_task09_text: Fighting the enemy attack would be suicidal. Run to the hills and head for our %2base%1.
str_a3_campaign_b_m06_task08_text: The supply truck is immobile. Get to the %2hideout%1 and from there back to the base.
str_a3_campaign_b_m06_task06_text: Position your team however you see fit to ambush the convoy.%1For details, you can check your %2field manual%3.
str_a3_campaign_b_m06_task05_text: Order your team members to move to the position where you'll set up the ambush.%1For details, you can check your %2field manual%3.
str_a3_campaign_b_m06_task04_text: Order your team members to board the truck.%1For details, you can check your %2field manual%3.
str_a3_campaign_b_m06_task03_text: RV with Team Omega on their %2starting position%1.
str_a3_campaign_b_m06_task02_text: The supply truck is immobile. Your engineer can fix it up.%1For details, you can check your, %2field manual%3.
str_a3_campaign_b_m06_task01_text: Ambush the %2convoy%1 and steal the supply truck.
str_a3_campaign_b_m06_debrief02_desc: Your orders were to assume command of team Omega, not running around pointlessly.
str_a3_campaign_b_m06_debrief01_desc: Our hideout in the hills was discovered. We must now regroup our forces and reassess the situation.
str_a3_campaign_b_m06_brief_situation: The recent attack on Kavala hit us hard. We lost valuable equipment and munitions - many months of supplies. And - to make matters worse � with Nikos still missing in action, we've lost a key link in our supply network.%1We're not desperate - not yet, at least - but the situation is only going to get worse from here. We must act now. We must strengthen our hand while we still can. Our British friend here has offered us a solution.%1Part of Miller's team has been scouting enemy movement to the south. There's a weekly supply run between %3Agios Dionysios%2 and a CSAT outpost in %4Fotia%2. His team will move in, ambush the convoy, and deliver the supply truck to %5one of our teams%2.
str_a3_campaign_b_m06_brief_signal: %3Falcon%2 - Your team.%1%4Omega%2 - Guerrilla team on standby.%1%Slingshot - Command.
str_a3_campaign_b_m06_brief_mission: Attack the CSAT %2convoy%1 passing through your AO, steal the supply truck and take it to our %3hideout%1.
str_a3_campaign_b_m06_brief_execution: %5Intercept the enemy %3convoy%2 anywhere along its route.%1%6Steal the supply truck.%1%7Drive the truck to our %4hideout%2.
str_a3_b_m06_x01_truck_destroyed_ker_1: I'm not gonna hear the end of this one...
str_a3_b_m06_i01_ambush_mil_0: Alright Kerry, since we've thrown you in at the deep end, here's a crash course on convoy ambush.
str_a3_b_m06_i01_ambush_mil_1: Picking a good spot is crucial. It's vital that you and your men all have good cover or concealment, but ensure that you have a clear view of the target, too.
str_a3_b_m06_i01_ambush_mil_2: I'd recommend moving to higher ground and making your squad hit the dirt.
str_a3_b_m06_i01_ambush_mil_3: You should also consider ordering them to hold fire until the convoy gets close.
str_a3_b_m06_i01_ambush_mil_4: When placing the charges, keep in mind that you don't want the supply truck blown to bits along with the guards.
str_a3_b_m06_i01_ambush_mil_5: CSAT will probably call in reinforcements when you strike, so grab the truck and get out of there as fast as you can.
str_a3_b_m06_45_switchcamp_sta_0: Omega, are you still alive? Our camp here is under threat too - this offensive is a fucking extermination!
str_a3_b_m06_45_switchcamp_sta_1: We're falling back. The new RV is in an old factory not far from you, at grid 054-179. Godspeed!
str_a3_b_m06_40_blowjob_sta_0: Okay, listen carefully. If you can, blow the supply truck and fall back our camp! Go!
str_a3_b_m06_35_hideout_attacked_ker_1: Slingshot, come in! We've got CSAT forces inbound! Over.
str_a3_b_m06_35_hideout_attacked_sta_0: What?! How did they find our position? Hold there. Await orders.
str_a3_b_m06_30_hideout_reached_ker_0: Slingshot, this is Omega, update: we're at the hideout. Over.
str_a3_b_m06_30_hideout_reached_ker_1: Alright, then. They need to get a move on.
str_a3_b_m06_30_hideout_reached_sta_0: Understood. Wait for the spotters to regroup, then we'll start the debriefing. Out.
str_a3_b_m06_25_meeting_spotters_2_gub_0: See you in the camp, Kerry.
str_a3_b_m06_25_meeting_spotters_2_guc_0: See you in the camp, Kerry.
str_a3_b_m06_25_meeting_spotters_2_gud_0: See you in the camp, Kerry.
str_a3_b_m06_25_meeting_spotters_2_gue_0: See you in the camp, Kerry.
str_a3_b_m06_25_meeting_spotters_1_gub_0: Aren't you supposed to be preparing an ambush, Corporal? I'll let you know when I see the convoy.
str_a3_b_m06_25_meeting_spotters_1_guc_0: Aren't you supposed to be preparing an ambush, Corporal? I'll let you know when I see the convoy.
str_a3_b_m06_25_meeting_spotters_1_gud_0: Aren't you supposed to be preparing an ambush, Corporal? I'll let you know when I see the convoy.
str_a3_b_m06_25_meeting_spotters_1_gue_0: Aren't you supposed to be preparing an ambush, Corporal? I'll let you know when I see the convoy.
str_a3_b_m06_20_convoy_info_4_gue_0: Omega, The convoy's made it to the outpost - I hope you know what you're doing. Good luck.
str_a3_b_m06_20_convoy_info_3_gud_0: The convoy just reached the coast. Be ready.
str_a3_b_m06_20_convoy_info_2_guc_0: Hello, Omega? The convoy just arrived in Negades.
str_a3_b_m06_20_convoy_info_2_guc_1: I think I see troops in the rear of the second vehicle. See you back in the camp.
str_a3_b_m06_20_convoy_info_1_gub_0: I see the convoy. It just drove past Kore.
str_a3_b_m06_20_convoy_info_1_gub_1: One armed Ifrit in front ... another to the rear.
str_a3_b_m06_20_convoy_info_1_gub_2: Our target is the second vehicle. Okay, I'm out of here.
str_a3_b_m06_15_rendezvous_gua_0: Listen here. We follow you because commander Stavrou ordered us to, understood?
str_a3_b_m06_15_rendezvous_gua_1: I trust you know what you're doing and I suggest you keep it simple.
str_a3_b_m06_15_rendezvous_ker_1: That's fine by me. Let's get this done.
str_a3_b_m06_10_recommendation_guc_1: Are you sure, Commander? I'm just saying - Gekas knows the plan, too.
str_a3_b_m06_10_recommendation_sta_0: This is Slingshot, come in. Over.
str_a3_b_m06_10_recommendation_guc_2: Affirmative, Commander - we'll be at the RV.
str_a3_b_m06_10_recommendation_sta_1: Be advised, Corporal Kerry will lead this operation.
str_a3_b_m06_10_recommendation_sta_2: He will arrive shortly to assume command. Acknowledge, over.
str_a3_b_m06_10_recommendation_sta_3: Listen to me: I am certain.
str_a3_b_m06_10_recommendation_sta_4: We have increased CSAT activity near our camp - we simply cannot spare any further time or manpower.
str_a3_b_m06_10_recommendation_sta_5: The American is familiar with this mission - Falcon has vouched for his ability.
str_a3_b_m06_10_recommendation_sta_6: There is no room for further discussion, understood?
str_a3_b_m06_10_recommendation_sta_7: Good. Your group will operate as callsign Omega. Godspeed, brothers. Slingshot out.
str_a3_b_m06_06_plan_b_briefing_ker_0: Copy, Falcon, on my way to the RV, over.
str_a3_b_m06_06_plan_b_briefing_ker_1: What, are you serious? What makes you think the FIA will accept that?
str_a3_b_m06_06_plan_b_briefing_mil_0: This is Falcon, come in. Over.
str_a3_b_m06_06_plan_b_briefing_mil_1: Good. Now listen, I need you to step up and take command of this operation. Over.
str_a3_b_m06_06_plan_b_briefing_mil_2: There's no time for debate. The convoy's en route and you know the plan.
str_a3_b_m06_06_plan_b_briefing_mil_3: Look, I wouldn't task you with this unless I thought you could handle it. Commander Stavrou's on board with it, too.
str_a3_b_m06_06_plan_b_briefing_mil_4: We'll let them know you're inbound. Good luck. Falcon out.
str_a3_b_m06_03_plan_b_jam_0: Okay, slight change of plan. We're needed elsewhere.
str_a3_b_m06_03_plan_b_jam_1: Kerry, Miller wants you to link up with pocket of guerrillas and await new orders.
str_a3_b_m06_03_plan_b_jam_2: You ask a lot of questions, Corporal. Don't worry. Miller will be in touch soon. You'll know what to do.
str_a3_b_m06_03_plan_b_jam_3: We've got to go. I suggest you make your way to the new RV now. See you later.
str_a3_b_m06_03_plan_b_ker_0: But - with respect - what about the convoy? Are we still on for that?
str_a3_b_m06_02_wait_jam_3: Roger that, we'll be there. And Kerry? Over.
str_a3_b_m06_01_start_jam_1: 15 minutes till the convoy gets here. Let's move it.
STR_A3_B_m06_overview: CTRG prepare to ambush an enemy supply convoy.
STR_A3_B_out2_overview: On the eve of a NATO invasion, the guerrillas launch a diversionary assault against a small airfield.
str_a3_b_out2_briefing_situation_text: With Nikos back at our side, the return of a legitimate government is a little closer. While it is unfortunate that our British friends could not be here themselves to celebrate this victory, there are more pressing matters at hand.%1Nikos has brought new information. Although we're still trying to verify his intel, we now believe that NATO is ready to launch an invasion.%2Miller and his team have already moved north. Their objective is to watch enemy movement and, if possible, establish contact with NATO command.%3So, while we do not know any specifics, only one target makes sense: %4the main airport%5, which operates under joint CSAT-AAF control. We'll watch the situation carefully, and prepare to make our own strike when the moment comes.%6Our target will be %7the AAC airfield%8 to the south, operated entirely by the AAF. We will draw the bulk of the AAF from the defence of the main airport, leaving NATO with CSAT.
str_a3_b_out2_briefing_signal_text: %1Omega%2 - your team%3%4Sigma%5 - friendly reinforcements%6%7Slingshot%8 - HQ and main assault element
str_a3_b_out2_briefing_mission_text: As part of our assault on %1the airfield%2, we must neutralize %3a CSAT artillery position %4and assault %5the temporary command complex%6 established in Poliakko's town center.
str_a3_b_out2_briefing_execution_text:
1. Destroy %1the CSAT artillery position%2.
2. Neutralize all hostiles at %3the command complex%4 and seize any intel you find.
3. Await further orders from %5Slingshot%6.
str_a3_b_out2_bis_retreat_desc: %1Poliakko%2 is secure, but the area is too hot. Retreat to %3the airfield%4 and link up with %5Slingshot%6.
str_a3_b_out2_bis_crashsite_desc: A NATO Blackfoot went down nearby. With luck, its pilot may have survived. Secure %1the crash site%2 and establish communications with NATO.
str_a3_b_out2_bis_command_desc: AAF and CSAT forces have set up %1a temporary command post%2 in the center of the town. Eliminate all hostiles and seize any intel you find.
str_a3_b_out2_01_start_ker_0: Well, God damn - at last. Looks like that's our cue, then.
str_a3_b_out2_01_start_ker_1: Omega to Slingshot, I think it's safe to say the invasion's started. Over.
str_a3_b_out2_01_start_ker_2: Will do, Slingshot. Good luck. Over.
str_a3_b_out2_01_start_sta_1: So, let us set our own plan into motion.
str_a3_b_out2_01_start_sta_2: Moving on Therisa now. Be careful of any reinforcements coming our way.
str_a3_b_out2_01_start_sta_3: And to you, my friend. Godspeed. Slingshot out.
str_a3_b_out2_bis_arty_desc: CSAT forces have set up %1an artillery position%2 on the outskirts of Poliakko. Destroy it.
str_a3_b_out2_70_cease_fire_bhq_1: All units, cease fire on Objective Lima. I repeat, cease fire on Lima. Fall back to Point Echo.
str_a3_b_out2_70_cease_fire_lar_0: Crossroads, this is November, priority! Crossroads, priority!
str_a3_b_out2_70_cease_fire_lar_1: Cease fire on the airfield! We're firing on friendlies! Over!
str_a3_b_out2_70_cease_fire_bhq_2: November, stay put. Keep an eye on him. We're on our way. Out.
str_a3_b_out2_70_cease_fire_lar_2: Friendly forces operating at the airfield.
str_a3_b_out2_70_cease_fire_lar_3: I've got a US Soldier here at the crash site - Corporal Scott Miller - part of TF Aegis, sir.
str_a3_b_out2_i15_target_distinction_gub: Omega, beware of enemy contacts, but make sure you don't hit the NATO pilots!
We need them alive - you've got to put a stop to this attack!
str_a3_b_out2_i10_fast_transport_gub_0: Omega, you should hurry. There may be enemy units closing in on that crash site, too
str_a3_b_out2_i10_fast_transport_gub_1: If there's any way to get there sooner - I don't know, a truck in the town or something - I suggest you use it!
str_a3_b_out2_i05_ambush_sta_0: It sounds like you are dealing with CSAT special forces, Omega.
str_a3_b_out2_i05_ambush_sta_1: Avoid facing them directly, otherwise you will be in for a tough fight.
str_a3_b_out2_i05_ambush_sta_2: Hold back and let them come to you. Out.
str_a3_b_out2_i01_surprise_attack_sta_0: I Recommend you hold your fire until you are ready to strike, Omega. You will catch them off guard.
str_a3_b_out2_i01_surprise_attack_sta_1: Be sure you take advantage of it while you can. Just know that they won't be surprised forever. Out.
str_a3_b_out2_75_failed_invasion_bhq_1: Ah, I see. Well, at ease, Corporal.
str_a3_b_out2_75_failed_invasion_bhq_2: We had no idea guerrillas were so active here. Seems we were too late.
str_a3_b_out2_75_failed_invasion_ker_0: Uh, no sir, there was some miscommunication. Corporal Ben Kerry, TF Aegis. Reporting for duty, sir!
str_a3_b_out2_75_failed_invasion_bhq_4: The British? The Brits are no longer operating in this area.
str_a3_b_out2_75_failed_invasion_ker_1: What about Captain Miller, sir? He was supposed to establish comms with your main force.
str_a3_b_out2_75_failed_invasion_bhq_5: To my knowledge, they've been out since May. And, regardless, we had no record of a Scott Miller.
str_a3_b_out2_75_failed_invasion_ker_2: Captain Scott Miller. UKSF? Kinda ... talks like he's got a stick up his ass all the time?
str_a3_b_out2_75_failed_invasion_bhq_6: Look, we're out of time. Come with us, Corporal.
str_a3_b_out2_75_failed_invasion_bhq_7: You need to be debriefed, and we need everyone we can get our hands on.
str_a3_b_out2_65_stop_attack_ker_0: Corporal Ben Kerry, Task Force Aegis, but listen to me: your helos are firing on friendlies!
str_a3_b_out2_65_stop_attack_ker_1: Look, the FIA - the local resistance - they're assaulting that airfield, you're firing on friendly forces right now.
str_a3_b_out2_65_stop_attack_lar_0: Jesus Christ! Who the fuck are you guys?
str_a3_b_out2_65_stop_attack_ker_2: We're working alongside British Special Forces, Captain Scott Miller - just, please, get your command to suspend the attack on the airfield.
str_a3_b_out2_65_stop_attack_lar_1: Friendlies? Aegis? Holy fuck, no, we thought we'd lost you guys!
str_a3_b_out2_65_stop_attack_lar_2: Fuck. That's not our intel ... we just ... hold on - just wait a second.
str_a3_b_out2_60_engine_failure_gub_0: Omega, this is Sigma! Do you read us?
str_a3_b_out2_60_engine_failure_gub_1: No idea, helicopters followed by explosions - we've lost comms with Slingshot!
str_a3_b_out2_60_engine_failure_gub_2: But listen - we see a NATO helicopter going down - it's lost its tail rotor.
str_a3_b_out2_60_engine_failure_ker_0: Sigma? Thank god. What's the situation?
str_a3_b_out2_60_engine_failure_gub_3: It looks to be making an emergency landing somewhere near your grid.
str_a3_b_out2_60_engine_failure_ker_1: Fuck. Okay .. okay, thanks for the head's up.
str_a3_b_out2_60_engine_failure_ker_2: We'll approach the crash site - look for survivors - try to get a handle on this clusterfuck.
str_a3_b_out2_60_engine_failure_ker_3: Just sit tight for now, Sigma. We'll update you asap.
str_a3_b_out2_55_friendly_fire_sta_0: Omega, we are being engaged by NATO at the airfield! I repeat, NATO are-
str_a3_b_out2_55_friendly_fire_ker_3: Falcon, this is Omega! Miller! Do you read me?!
str_a3_b_out2_50_airfield_attack_ker_0: Slingshot, be advised, NATO air assets closing in on your position. Over.
str_a3_b_out2_40_town_held_ker_0: Alright, looks like that was the last of them.
str_a3_b_out2_40_town_held_ker_1: Slingshot, this is Omega. We've beaten back the enemy counterattack, but we've suffered some losses. Please advise, over.
str_a3_b_out2_40_town_held_ker_2: Copy that, en route. Any word from Miller yet? Over.
str_a3_b_out2_40_town_held_sta_0: Understood, Omega. That area is too hot. Better pull back to the airfield and link up with us. Over.
str_a3_b_out2_40_town_held_sta_1: Negative, Omega. We have been unable to raise him. We will keep trying. Slingshot out.
str_a3_b_out2_35_reinforcements_gua_0: Gamma to Omega, we are in position - ready to lend a hand. Over.
str_a3_b_out2_35_reinforcements_ker_0: Good to hear from you, Gamma. Alright, everyone, get ready. We're holding this town!
str_a3_b_out2_30_helicopter_ker_0: Where the hell did he come from?
str_a3_b_out2_25_lights_off_ker_1: Omega to Slingshot, be advised: we just had the whole town power down on us. Expecting company shortly. Any ETA on Gamma? Over.
str_a3_b_out2_25_lights_off_sta_0: Understood, Omega. Gamma are entering your AO now.
str_a3_b_out2_20_town_clear_ker_0: Wilco. Take care of yourselves out there, Slingshot. Out.
str_a3_b_out2_20_town_clear_sta_0: Received, Omega. Good news. We are proceeding with our assault on the airfield.
str_a3_b_out2_20_town_clear_sta_1: For now, dig in and wait for further orders. Over.
str_a3_b_out2_15_special_forces_ker_0: Shit ... Slingshot, these aren't CSAT regulars here. They're something else. Special forces, maybe. Over.
str_a3_b_out2_15_special_forces_sta_0: Copy that, Omega. Take great care. Slingshot out.
str_a3_b_out2_10_complex_cleared_ker_0: Omega to Slingshot, we've just taken the command complex.
str_a3_b_out2_10_complex_cleared_ker_1: There's a lot of intel just lying around here.
str_a3_b_out2_05_arty_destroyed_ker_0: Slingshot, be advised: we've neutralized the enemy artillery position.
STR_A3_B_hub01_overview: The remaining survivors join the guerrillas at a small camp near Bomos.
STR_A3_B_hub01_briefing: After a damaging enemy offensive, the remaining survivors join the guerrillas as they regroup at a small camp near Bomos.
STR_A3_B_in2_overview: The remaining survivors link up with the local guerrillas.
str_a3_b_in2_briefing_situation_text: Having linked up with %1Lt. James%2, the group waits for darkness to fall to rendezvous with %3the rest of the embedded special forces contingent%4, callsign Ice.%5The local guerilla cell, which intended to rendezvous with those from Stratis, is still under heavy assault in %6the city of Kavala%7, the former capital of Altis.%8CSAT forces are providing the bulk of the ground work, while the AAF have sealed off the town and the surrounding area.
str_a3_b_in2_bis_truck_desc: Get in the truck as the driver.
str_a3_b_in2_bis_rv_desc: Drive to %1the rendezvous with Miller%2, north of %3the factory complex%4.
str_a3_b_in2_bis_rescue_desc: Cpt. Miller is %1pinned down%2 by CSAT forces and requires assistance.
str_a3_b_in2_bis_plant_desc: %1The RV%2 was compromised. Divert and meet the FIA cell at %3the abandoned powerplant%4.
str_a3_b_in2_bis_newrv_desc: Miller was forced to relocate. Drive to %1the new rendezvous%2.
str_a3_b_in2_bis_falserv_desc: Link up with %1the rest of team Ice%2.
str_a3_b_in2_bis_check2_desc: Pass %1the CSAT checkpoint%2. Do not give yourself away.
str_a3_b_in2_x05_ready_ambushed_gua_0: I'm in position, but I see you've already met your CSAT friends!
str_a3_b_in2_x01_warnings_sta_0: American, what are you doing? Stick to the road!
str_a3_b_in2_x01_warnings_sta_1: Get back on the road, American!
str_a3_b_in2_i05_fog_mil_0: Use the fog to your advantage, Kerry.
str_a3_b_in2_i05_fog_mil_1: Most of the targets are trapped in it.
str_a3_b_in2_i05_fog_mil_2: Get above it and you should be able to even the odds.
str_a3_b_in2_i01_undercover_sta_0: Stay on the road, drive normally.
str_a3_b_in2_i01_undercover_sta_1: Slow down when we reach the checkpoint.
str_a3_b_in2_i01_undercover_sta_2: And please, try to avoid hitting anyone or anything. I like this truck.
str_a3_b_in2_95_drop_sta_0: Okay, this is your stop, brothers.
str_a3_b_in2_95_drop_sta_1: Good luck. I will see you back at the camp.
str_a3_b_in2_85_corruption_ker_0: So the AAF really are as corrupt as they say.
str_a3_b_in2_85_corruption_sta_0: Corrupt? Sure. But, with Orestes, the situation is different.
str_a3_b_in2_85_corruption_sta_1: Just drive. Such things do not concern you.
str_a3_b_in2_80_check_1_continue_sta_0: Well nothing, American. Drive on when the way is clear.
str_a3_b_in2_70_check_1_wait_ker_0: Does this usually take so long?
str_a3_b_in2_70_check_1_wait_ker_1: Great. First I'm stuck with spooks who can't say anything, now I'm stuck with farmers who won't.
str_a3_b_in2_65_check_1_ker_1: Great. What could possibly go wrong?
str_a3_b_in2_65_check_1_sta_1: The officer. We know him as 'Orestes'. He is... Sympathetic.
str_a3_b_in2_65_check_1_sta_2: You wait here. I will be back.
str_a3_b_in2_60_check_1_slow_ker_0: Checkpoint? You're going to get me killed here!
str_a3_b_in2_60_check_1_slow_sta_0: Slow down, we have our first checkpoint ahead.
str_a3_b_in2_60_check_1_slow_sta_1: Relax, American. We have our way.
str_a3_b_in2_55_straight_1_sta_0: Do not turn. We go straight on.
str_a3_b_in2_50_question_ker_0: Remind me again why I'm the one driving?
str_a3_b_in2_50_question_sta_0: You are the one they will shoot first.
str_a3_b_in2_45_follow_sta_0: Follow the road. Carefully. Do not act suspicious.
str_a3_b_in2_40_road_sta_0: Get on to the road. Drive us north.
str_a3_b_in2_36_getin_sta_0: Brothers, get in the truck! We go!
str_a3_b_in2_35_plan_jam_0: Alright, Slingshot, take him to Miller.
str_a3_b_in2_35_plan_jam_1: No time to explain, Kerry. Go with them.
str_a3_b_in2_35_plan_jam_2: I've got to go back for the others.
str_a3_b_in2_35_plan_ker_1: Whoa now, just wait a sec!
str_a3_b_in2_30_hurry_jam_0: Don't fucking move, Slingshot! You owe us!
str_a3_b_in2_30_hurry_sta_0: I am sorry, Falcon, we have to go - we have to go now!
str_a3_b_in2_25_wait_jam_0: We're close. Wait for us. Over.
str_a3_b_in2_25_wait_sta_0: That helicopter is not good news, Falcon. We must get away from here fast!
str_a3_b_in2_25_wait_sta_1: We cannot wait forever, Falcon! Out.
str_a3_b_in2_23_compromised_2_jam_0: We may have been compromised, Slingshot. I'm inbound from the southeast.
str_a3_b_in2_23_compromised_2_jam_1: I've got an American with me. Watch your fire.
str_a3_b_in2_23_compromised_2_sta_0: Slingshot to Falcon, we hear helicopters. What is going on? Over.
str_a3_b_in2_20_compromised_ker_0: How did they find us, Lieutenant?
str_a3_b_in2_200_explain_ker_0: Lieutenant James. He left me with the guerrillas some place south of here.
str_a3_b_in2_200_explain_ker_1: I think he had some sort of operation in that area?
str_a3_b_in2_200_explain_mil_0: Kerry, just how did you end up here?
str_a3_b_in2_200_explain_ker_2: Uh, some new guys. Brits, I guess.
str_a3_b_in2_200_explain_mil_1: Yes, of course. So you met with the rest of his team?
str_a3_b_in2_200_explain_mil_2: For now, Corporal, let's focus on getting to their camp - Commander Stavrou will explain the situation.
str_a3_b_in2_195_regrouped_mil_0: Come on. Let's get out of here, Kerry.
str_a3_b_in2_190_regroup_mil_0: Okay, form on me, Kerry. We've got to move.
str_a3_b_in2_185_slingshot_dead_mil_0: Slingshot, get over here with the truck.
str_a3_b_in2_185_slingshot_dead_mil_1: Shit. Slingshot, do you copy? Over.
str_a3_b_in2_185_slingshot_dead_sta_0: Goddammit, Falcon, our truck is wrecked - CSAT will be all over this area in no time.
str_a3_b_in2_185_slingshot_dead_sta_1: We must split up. Head north. Stick to the forests. Meet at our camp.
str_a3_b_in2_185_slingshot_dead_sta_2: And, Falcon, you people owe us for saving your life again today! Slingshot out.
str_a3_b_in2_170_sniper_gua_0: Slingshot, I am in position above you.
str_a3_b_in2_170_sniper_gua_1: Falcon - just south of you - I see four CSAT soldiers. Over.
str_a3_b_in2_170_sniper_mil_1: Ok, Kerry, there's at least four right on top of me as well. I'll open up once you move in.
str_a3_b_in2_170_sniper_mil_2: You up top? Fire on my lead. Understood?
str_a3_b_in2_167_truckstay_sta_0: I will stay with the truck, American. We must get away from here quickly.
str_a3_b_in2_15_heli_eca_0: Falcon, I don't think that helo's holding in a patrol pattern anymore!
str_a3_b_in2_15_heli_ech_0: Okay, take the Yank and get to the powerplant. We'll take this from here.
str_a3_b_in2_15_heli_jam_1: Roger that. See you at the objective.
str_a3_b_in2_150_surrounded_ker_0: Um, you know, there's only two of us - and you don't have a gun.
str_a3_b_in2_150_surrounded_mil_1: CSAT have compromised my position. Recommend you avoid a direct approach, over.
str_a3_b_in2_150_surrounded_sta_1: Understood, Falcon. We will be there shortly. Out.
str_a3_b_in2_150_surrounded_sta_2: Three. I have another man on his way.
str_a3_b_in2_145_aware_sta_0: I do not like the look of this. Not at all.
str_a3_b_in2_140_inform_ker_0: Yeah, I just spoke to Captain Miller.
str_a3_b_in2_140_inform_ker_1: I - yeah, long story - anyway, he wants you to know he's had to move the rendezvous.
str_a3_b_in2_140_inform_sta_0: Change of plan, American. We must divert left.
str_a3_b_in2_140_inform_ker_2: So, looks like we're going left anyway.
str_a3_b_in2_135_recon_ker_0: Miller? It's Kerry. Slingshot is, uh, occupied right now - I read you loud and clear, over.
str_a3_b_in2_135_recon_ker_1: Yeah, I can kinda see that. We're at the factory now - this place is crawling with them.
str_a3_b_in2_135_recon_mil_0: Falcon to Slingshot, come in, over.
str_a3_b_in2_135_recon_ker_2: Will do. Looks like we'll have to head that direction anyway.
str_a3_b_in2_135_recon_mil_1: Ah, I didn't think you made it, Corporal.
str_a3_b_in2_135_recon_mil_2: Anyway, I've had to change the rendezvous. CSAT moved in.
str_a3_b_in2_135_recon_mil_3: Indeed. The new RV is at 048-170.
str_a3_b_in2_135_recon_mil_4: That should be just northwest of where you are now. Make sure Slingshot knows. Over.
str_a3_b_in2_135_recon_mil_5: Copy. See you soon. It's good to hear from you, Kerry. Out.
str_a3_b_in2_125_check_2_ker_0: You know, I'm really starting to love this little arrangement we have here!
str_a3_b_in2_125_check_2_sta_0: No familiar faces here, I am afraid.
str_a3_b_in2_115_factory_sta_0: Huh... We were not expecting CSAT out here.
str_a3_b_in2_10_near_rv_ech_0: Ice-2, Ice-1. We're inbound from the west.
str_a3_b_in2_10_near_rv_ech_1: I've got Falcon-2 and a Yank with me. Watch your fire, over.
str_a3_b_in2_01_start_eca_0: Ice-1, Ice-2. We're in position at the RV, over.
str_a3_b_in2_01_start_ech_0: Roger that, en route. ETA 2 mikes. Out.
str_a3_b_in2_01_start_ech_1: Hey kid, there's an extra rifle in my pack if you need it.
str_a3_b_in2_01_start_ker_0: Oh, thank God, finally. I'm dying out here.
str_a3_b_in2_bis_check1_desc: Pass %1the AAF checkpoint%2 on the way to %3Negardes%4. Do not give yourself away.
STR_A3_B_hub02_overview: The guerrillas regroup at an abandoned industrial complex near Gori.
STR_A3_B_hub02_briefing: Under pressure from the coninued offensive, the guerrillas are forced to regroup at an abandoned industrial complex near Gori.
STR_A3_B_hub03_overview: The guerrillas reorganise their forces at a larger camp near Topolia.
STR_A3_B_hub03_briefing: With the return of Nikos, the guerrillas reorganise their growing forces at a larger camp near Topolia.
STR_A3_B_skirmishX_overview: Cpl. Kerry scouts the surrounding area.
STR_A3_B_skirmishX_briefing: Various pieces of intel indicate recent activity in the surrounding area, which may be worth investigating for additional supplies and information.
str_a3_campaign_quote_30: 'Adapt or perish, now as ever, is nature's inexorable imperative.' - H.G. Wells
str_a3_campaign_quote_31: 'Adaptability is the law which governs survival in war as in life.' - B.H. Liddell Hart
str_a3_campaign_quote_32: 'A leader is a man who can adapt principles to circumstances.' - General George S. Patton, Jr.
str_a3_campaign_quote_33: 'You can strike with the few and be many if you strike your adversary in his gaps.' - Sun Tzu
str_a3_campaign_quote_34: 'A fast moving environment can evolve more quickly than a complex plan can be adapted to it. By the time you have adapted, the target has changed.' - Carl von Clausewitz
str_a3_campaign_quote_35: 'It is not the strongest that survives; but the species [...] that is able best to adapt.' - Leon C. Megginson
str_a3_campaign_quote_36: 'Water shapes its course according to the nature of the ground over which it flows; the soldier works out his victory in relation to the foe whom he is facing.' - Sun Tzu
str_a3_campaign_quote_37: 'People used to think the large would eat the small; instead, it is the swift who are eating the slow.' - Curtis E. Sahaian
STR_A3_POI_Abandoned_Battlefield_01_Task: Our forces managed to eliminate an AAF patrol in a large forest, but were unable to collect any weapons or ammo from the fallen due to the dense fog. Try to find the battlefield and recover any valuable equipment you're able to find.
STR_A3_POI_Abandoned_Battlefield_02_Task: A small guerrilla group destroyed an AAF motorized patrol near the great dump, but - concerned about enemy reinforcements - Stavrou ordered them to pull back. Get to the area and try to retrieve any valuable equipment left behind.
STR_A3_POI_Abandoned_Battlefield_03_Task: One of ours long-range scouting teams destroyed a CSAT mechanized patrol; however, due to their own casualties, they were only able to return with a limited amount of useful equipment. Get there, search for anything you find valuable and return it to our camp.
STR_A3_POI_Checkpoint_01_Task_desc: The AAF are in the process of constructing another checkpoint but, so far, have only sent small group ahead to prepare the ground. This gives us a great opportunity to strike before it reaches its full strength.
STR_A3_POI_Checkpoint_02_Task_desc: Our scouts have discovered a new AAF checkpoint near the coast. Destroy it to enable our forces to travel along the coast with more freedom.
STR_A3_POI_Checkpoint_03_Task_desc: CSAT has established a new checkpoint along one of the main roads. Although well guarded, it's located between two forests, which gives us the a chance to approach quietly and destroy its' garrison.
STR_A3_POI_Crashed_Heli_01_Task_desc: One of our sympathizers has managed to sabotage an AAF helicopter. The control tower lost the contact with it in a remote area, some five kilometers west of the airfield. Try to find the wreck and verify this intel.
STR_A3_POI_Crashed_Heli_02_Task_desc: One of our comrades-in-arms hit a lucky shot through engine block of a CSAT gunship. It was last seen going down in forested area west of Abdera. Find and verify the wreckage.
STR_A3_POI_Crashed_Plane_01_Task_desc: One of our patrols spotted an AAF Buzzard losing altitude, with smoke pouring out of its engine. We don't know if the pilot managed to eject, so search the area and look for any evidence.
STR_A3_POI_First_Aid_01_Task_desc: We're running short on medical supplies. Go to the village of Oreokastro, get to the local clinic and try to retrieve any intact supplies, especially valuable medikits.
STR_A3_POI_First_Aid_02_Task_desc: Our forces have suffered unnecessary casualties because of our lack of medical supplies. Search the clinic in Fotia and try to retrieve any medical supplies. One or two medikits should suffice, as they contain the most needed materials.
STR_A3_POI_Immobilized_Armor_01_Task_des: An AAF IFV was heavily damaged by our mine. The crew managed to survived though and remain exposed, awaiting CSAR. Neutralizing them will prevent them returning to fight another day.
STR_A3_POI_Immobilized_Armor_02_Task_des: We received a report of an immobilized CSAT APC. Ambush the crew before they are able to fix it.
STR_A3_POI_Mysterious_Cache_01_Task_desc: Some disaffected AAF recruits that sought to join our cause established a well hidden weapons cache with very valuable equipment. Although we believe they have been betrayed and detained, we think the cache remains undiscovered on a small island south-east of Polliako, deep in enemy territory. If you think you can manage it, find the cache.
STR_A3_POI_Pilots_01_Task_desc: A sympathetic contact has uncovered information that pilots from the AAF's 2nd Helicopter Squadron have established new HQ in a resort south of Kavala. It's a dangerous move but, if you manage to neutralize them, it will be a painful blow to their air dominance.
STR_A3_POI_Sniper_01_Task_desc: We've lost some good men to a sniper hidden in an abandoned factory to the west of Kore. It would greatly improve our morale if this threat is neutralized.
STR_A3_POI_Special_Forces_01_Task_desc: CSAT has dispatched an elite COIN force to seek and destroy our positions. At the moment, we believe they are located in the Syrta area, where they recently decimated two of our scout teams.
STR_A3_POI_UAV_01_Task_desc: We picked up a strange signal in the southern forests a few hours ago; it's quite possible that CSAT has deployed UAVs to locate our camps. Search the area and find out if it's really an enemy drone or a false alarm.
STR_A3_POI_Weapon_Smugglers_01_Task_desc: We have intel about weapons smugglers active in the area west of Syrta before the conflict escalated. If their cache is still in that area, it will be worth visiting.
STR_A3_POI_Weapon_Smugglers_02_Task_desc: We have detained a known weapon dealer near the south coast. He's still refusing to reveal group's hideout. Try to search the southern coast. Locate the hideout and retrieve any valuable equipment.
str_a3_cfgorbat.fsmbis_o_brigade1: A combat brigade tasked with counter insurgency (COIN) operations in cooperation with their AAF partners.
str_a3_cfgorbat.fsmbis_o_4_t2: A company comprised mainly of instructors responsible for the training of local forces over the last 12 months.
str_a3_cfgorbat.fsmbis_b_i_fia0: A loosely organised band of anti-governmental fighters formed in the aftermath the 2026 Kavala coup d'etat.
str_a3_cfgorbat.fsmbis_b_i_ctrg2: Remaining UKSF operators tasked with classified operations within The Republic of Altis and Stratis.
str_a3_cfgorbat.fsmbis_b_i_12: One of the individual cells of the FIA, specifically focused on the northern-most regions of Altis.
STR_A3_StageCOverview:
The Republic of Altis and Stratis sits at the center of an escalating global conflict. As the world stands on the brink of all-out war, NATO forces join the fray.

Complete the previous episode to unlock the next.
str_a3_c_in1_23_broadcast_spe_0: Alpha-Green, we've got CASEVAC inbound. Pad Delta-2. Prep for casualties.
str_a3_c_in1_22_broadcast_spe_0: Sergeant Jones, please, deliver the signed form B-17 green to Lieutenant Barnes immediately.
str_a3_c_in1_22_broadcast_spe_1: Sergeant Jones, form B-17 green to Lieutenant Barnes immediately.
str_a3_c_in1_21_broadcast_spe_0: Team Victor, assemble in meeting room 3-1.
str_a3_c_in1_20_broadcast_spe_0: Corporal Kerry, report to Colonel Armstrong.
str_a3_c_in1_14_ambient_talk_04_abb_1: Those fucking cicadas on the other hand - they're driving me crazy.
str_a3_c_in1_13_ambient_talk_03_aba_0: Our whole deployment's on the back foot because of that radar.
str_a3_c_in1_13_ambient_talk_03_aba_1: You been up there yet? It's way beyond repair.
str_a3_c_in1_13_ambient_talk_03_abb_0: We need to get it online ASAP.
str_a3_c_in1_12_ambient_talk_02_aba_0: I heard it was a budget thing.
str_a3_c_in1_12_ambient_talk_02_abb_0: It's bullshit - we could've been here much sooner - our battalion was prep'd in a day.
str_a3_c_in1_11_ambient_talk_01_aba_0: Stratis was a cakewalk. I wonder what went wrong on Altis.
str_a3_c_in1_11_ambient_talk_01_aba_1: Yeah? I thought we were fighting Greenbacks?
str_a3_c_in1_11_ambient_talk_01_abb_0: The lieutenant said they ran into CSAT.
str_a3_c_in1_10_ambient_talk_00_aba_0: He's been hiding on Altis this whole time?
str_a3_c_in1_01_armory_arm_0: Alright, you should have everything you need.
str_a3_c_in1_01_armory_arm_1: If you want to adjust your loadout, take whatever you want - ammo and magazines are in the boxes to your right.
str_a3_c_in1_01_armory_arm_2: Once you're done, proceed to the assembly point outside.
str_a3_c_in1_00_briefing_bhq_0: Gentlemen, as you may have heard, our forces on Altis were unable to secure the airport.
str_a3_c_in1_00_briefing_bhq_10: Lucky for you, command doesn't feel likewise.
str_a3_c_in1_00_briefing_bhq_11: But make no mistake, you fuck up just once - you endanger any of my men - and you're gone.
str_a3_c_in1_00_briefing_bhq_2: As it turns out, there wasn't a chance in hell that we were ready for what awaited us.
str_a3_c_in1_00_briefing_bhq_3: CSAT got one over on us this time - and intel suggests they're ready to hit back at any moment.
str_a3_c_in1_00_briefing_bhq_4: Truth is, if we don't hold what we've taken over here, this whole operation is a wash.
str_a3_c_in1_00_briefing_bhq_5: So - with Stratis under our control - we're going to head back and dig in.
str_a3_c_in1_00_briefing_bhq_6: Now, keep in mind - in spite of Corporal Kerry's 'debrief' - we're not exactly sure what's happened here.
str_a3_c_in1_00_briefing_bhq_7: As such, keep an eye out for any suspicious activity.
str_a3_c_in1_00_briefing_bhq_8: Until MEDCOM says otherwise, 'Captain Miller' - along with his team - are not recognized as friendly.
str_a3_c_in1_00_briefing_bhq_9: And - while we're on the subject, Corporal - were it up to me, you'd be stuck here spit-shining latrines until a court-martial deemed you fit for duty.
STR_A3_C_in1_overview: Following a botched invasion on Altis, Kerry is taken back to NATO's re-established base on Stratis.
STR_A3_C_in1_briefingSituation:
Last night we launched a simultaneous attack on Stratis and Altis.

While we've been successful in capturing Stratis - re-establishing command over Stratis Air Base - NATO forces on Altis, in part due to CSAT involvement, have failed to secure the main airport.

Now, although we managed to regroup in the south, recon reports indicate our enemy is preparing a counterattack to drive us into the sea. Our forces here are readying to redeploy to the main island in support.

After his arrival to Stratis, Cpl. Kerry was quickly debriefed, describing the events of the AAF's surprise attack against our facilities. Although his information is somewhat inconsistent with NATO's own intel, his presence is requested by Col. Armstrong.
STR_A3_C_in1_debriefingAoALeft_long: You have disobeyed a direct order and are in breach of access permissions.
STR_A3_C_in1_debriefingAoALeft_short: You Have Left the Authorized Area
STR_A3_C_in1_notifLeaving_AoA1_desc: You are entering a restricted area!
STR_A3_C_in1_taskBIS_assemble_desc: Choose your equipment and link up with the rest of your team at the assembly point.
STR_A3_C_in1_taskBIS_reportIn_desc: Report to the officer for debriefing.
STR_A3_C_in1_taskBIS_goArmory_desc: Get to the armory and rearm for the next operation.
STR_A3_C_in2_overview: Although still under suspicion, Kerry returns to the NATO front-line on patrol duty.
str_a3_c_in2_debriefing_c_m01_1_descript: Although we suffered heavy losses, we held the line. CSAT have pulled back to the airfield for now, but we aren't going to take this lying down. With any luck, the politicians will be able to sort something out in time. Whatever happens, we are taking the airport. You've proven yourself to be a potentially useful liaison with the FIA, and an effective force in combat.
str_a3_c_in2_briefing_situation_text: Our forces on Altis were unable to secure %1the airport%2.%3As it turns out, there wasn't a chance in hell we were ready for what awaited us. CSAT got one over on us this time - and intel suggests they're going to hit back at any moment.%4Truth is, if we don't hold what we've taken over there, the whole op's a wash. So - with Stratis under our control - we're going to head back and dig in.%5Now, keep in mind - in spite of Corporal Kerry's 'debrief' - we don't know what exactly happened here. As such, keep an eye open for any suspicious activity. Until MEDCOM says otherwise, this 'Captain Miller', along with his team, are not recognized as friendly.
str_a3_c_in2_bis_regroup_desc: CSAT are making their move. Regroup with %1the rest of your team%2.
str_a3_c_in2_bis_patrol_desc: Patrol the south of %1Katalaki%2 until ordered otherwise.
str_a3_c_in2_bis_mech_desc: Your team is down. Rendezvous with Delta 3-1 and assist with the defense.
str_a3_c_in2_bis_fia_desc: The FIA are willing to assist NATO forces. Regroup with them %1here%2.
str_a3_c_in2_bis_defenses_desc: Coordinate with Delta 3-1 to retake %1the eastern defenses%2.
str_a3_c_in2_x15_support_apc_destroyed_b: Kerry, Delta 3-2 is unresponsive! Looks like we lost them! Out!
str_a3_c_in2_x10_squad_dead_bhq_0: All units, be advised, we've lost comms with Delta-3-1! Presumed KIA! Out!
str_a3_c_in2_x05_apc_destroyed_abb_0: Nomad, we've lost the Marshall! I say again, the Marshall is down!
str_a3_c_in2_x01_engaged_sf_mem_0: Kerry, I told you to disengage! You're not going to fuck this up for the rest of us!
str_a3_c_in2_i05_defenses_bhq_0: Kerry, did you get a chance to check the defenses?
str_a3_c_in2_i05_defenses_bhq_1: Copy! Don't forget to use them against the armor!
str_a3_c_in2_i05_defenses_bhq_2: I'm sure you'll find some supplies lying around out there, too! Hold the line! Out!
str_a3_c_in2_i05_defenses_ker_0: Yes, Sir. Everything seems mostly intact. Over.
str_a3_c_in2_i01_flanking_bhq_0: Kerry, avoid going through Neochori! You'll have less resistance if you flank north!
str_a3_c_in2_i01_flanking_bhq_1: Be careful, though! 2-2 are reporting contacts on all sides! Crossroads out!
str_a3_c_in2_95_defenses_secured_bhq_1: Nomad, priority message! Intel indicates enemy armor inbound from the airport!
str_a3_c_in2_95_defenses_secured_ker_0: Crossroads, Nomad here, defenses secured. Requesting reinforcements. Over.
str_a3_c_in2_95_defenses_secured_bhq_2: I need you to hold that position! We lose it, and we lose Neochori! How copy?
str_a3_c_in2_85_no_gunships_bhq_0: Nomad, be advised, we're holding our own here but the Blackfoots can't get off the ground!
str_a3_c_in2_85_no_gunships_bhq_1: Looks like you're going to be on your own for a bit longer! Over!
str_a3_c_in2_80_taking_command_abb_2: The rest of you, push through the west! We'll take the northern flank!
str_a3_c_in2_75_take_command_bhq_0: Kerry - I don't much like it - but I need you to step up!
str_a3_c_in2_75_take_command_bhq_1: We've lost the east! If we don't take it back, they'll punch straight through our lines!
str_a3_c_in2_75_take_command_bhq_2: Take the guerrillas and hit those defenses! Your new callsign is Nomad.
str_a3_c_in2_75_take_command_bhq_3: Delta-3-1, I want you to assist! How copy?
str_a3_c_in2_70_fia_abb_0: Kerry, we're going to form up on that tree line! Suggest you meet them there! Over!
str_a3_c_in2_70_fia_bhq_0: Kerry, I've got someone on the line. He says he'll only speak to you directly.
str_a3_c_in2_70_fia_bhq_2: Do as Delta says, Kerry! Over!
str_a3_c_in2_70_fia_nik_1: Listen, there's little time. Our brothers are engaging those gunships.
str_a3_c_in2_70_fia_nik_2: They're close to you. On my order, they'll assist you as needed. Over.
str_a3_c_in2_70_fia_ker_0: Nikos? Shit, man, it's good to hear from you!

str_a3_c_in2_70_fia_nik_3: Understood. They will meet you there, American. Out.

The %8military installation%2 overlooking the %6complex%2 was hit by our artillery at 0430 and UAVs did not confirm any remaining enemy presence.%1Stage Three: When the factory complex is clear, teams %5Echo%2 and %4Nomad%2 will join the main assault on the %3airport%2.

str_a3_campaign_c_m02_debriefing_win1: Having secured our eastern flank and supported a friendly squad, our forces were able to seize the capital and its surrounding fortifications. With enemy forces successfully cut in half - and the seat of political power under our control - it's a turning point in this conflict.
str_a3_campaign_c_m02_debriefing_fail2: You were unable to neutralize enemy armor before friendlies sustained heavy casualties.
str_a3_campaign_c_m02_debriefing_fail1: You did not follow your orders.
str_a3_campaign_c_m02_briefing_situation: With the help of the FIA, we were able to seize the main airport.%1%1We've been handed a major strategic advantage in this invasion, but we cannot give the AAF any time to breathe. Plus, with CSAT consolidating their forces in the north, we've managed to regroup and push deeper into enemy-controlled territory with little resistance.%1%1Now, we're poised to strike at Pyrgos: the capital city of Altis and their last true base of power. However, with one of the largest AAF bases nearby, it's a heavily fortified target. We'll launch a coordinated assault, securing both the base and the city.%1%1Cutting any remaining forces in two, we'll isolate our enemy in the north and south-west. Keep in mind: taking this objective will represent a significant blow to the Altis regime, and could help bring about a swift end to this conflict.

Make sure the enemy does not take Kalochori back.
Attack Kalochori and seize the area.
str_a3_campaign_c_out1_debriefing_win1: You were able to seize Kalochori and its surrounding area. With the main airport, the capital, and the north east now under our control, NATO forces are on the verge of neutralizing the AAF presence on Altis. With any luck, we can put a stop to this flashpoint before it escalates beyond control.
str_a3_campaign_c_out1_debriefing_fail1: You were unable to defend Kalochori from the enemy counter attack, forcing us to pull back. Losing the momentum will make this invasion difficult to complete.
str_a3_campaign_c_out1_briefing_situatio: Having taken control of the capital, Pyrgos, our offensive in the east continues.%1%1We need to kick on, using our momentum to seize the initiative. Now, although weakened, enemy forces still occupy important locations in the north and south east of Altis. So, before they have the chance to organize and fortify these positions, we need to strike on both fronts.%1%1In addition to a swift operation in the south, we'll launch a combined arms assault on Kalochori. Securing this town - alongside the solar power station - will put us in a strong position to push further into enemy-controlled territory. Time is of the essence here.%1%1For now, CSAT forces seem to be under orders not to interdict our operations; they've once again pulled back. Command is trying to work out what exactly's going on. We need to bring an end to this conflict before the global situation escalates beyond our control.

STR_A3_C_EA_overview: Six weeks after the flashpoint's resolution, Kerry is handed a special task.
STR_A3_C_EA_briefingMission: Await the arrival of an AAN reporter and deliver him to his interview with Nikos Panagopoulos.
STR_A3_C_EA_briefingSituation:
Six weeks have passed since the AAF's capitulation.

The FIA, under the leadership of Nikos Panagopoulos, have transitioned from a military opposition to a political body and, alongside our forces, are working hard to restore their homeland. Although it will take time for this country to recover from war, the new government has the confidence of the people of Altis.

However, NATO's invasion - albeit swift and, ultimately, successful - has stirred a new round of debates over the funding of military forces in this region. The conclusion was clear: there is no way NATO can maintain their position here while tensions in the pacific region rise. The decommissioning will continue and NATO will abandon this region.

STR_A3_Campaign_C_EB_Briefing_Situation_:
All hell's broken loose.
CSAT has made a massive counter-attack and the whole island is in flames. It feels like it's the beginning of a global war.

We thought that the whole conflict would be over in the next few hours - that the AAF would simply surrender - but, instead, it's escalated beyond control. I don't know exactly what that 'thing' I handed to Miller was, but CSAT certainly seems to value it highly.

I've got to get out of here.

STR_A3_Showcase_FixedWings_Briefing_Exec:
1. Equip yourself from a supply crate in the %6maintenance area%1
2. Get into %2your jet%1
3. Roll to the runway and take off
4. Destroy enemy supply vehicles heading from %3Molos%1 to %4Paros%1
6. Find and destroy two enemy %5self-propelled guns%1
7. Return %2back to the base%1

If you are low on fuel, out of ammo or need repairs, return to the airbase for %6maintenance%1 once the convoy is destroyed.
STR_A3_Showcase_FixedWings_Briefing_Inte: Enemy air defenses are now weakened, as our forces were able to destroy both enemy self-propelled AA systems in the area, though with heavy losses. STR_A3_Showcase_FixedWings_Briefing_Miss: Destroy the enemy %2supply convoy%1 heading to %3Paros%1 before they reach the city, then locate and destroy CSAT's %4self-propelled artillery%1.

Crossroads - Col. David Armstrong, Commander-in-chief
Guardian - Lieutenant Lewis, control tower
Avenger - your A-164 Wipeout.
STR_A3_Showcase_FixedWings_Briefing_Situ:
Our second attempt to establish a strong foothold on Altis was ultimately successful, yet the combined strength of AAF and CSAT forces still presents a significant threat. Recon reports indicate that our enemy is regrouping near the city of %2Paros%1.

According to intel provided by local guerrillas, the only thing delaying their counter-attack is a lack of fuel and ammunition, the result of a recent FIA attack on the AAF's main supply center.

However, CSAT will soon dispatch supply convoy from %3city of Molos%1 to their armored units. This convoy must be destroyed, otherwise their advanced main battle tanks will wreak havoc against our defensive positions.

Additionally, enemy self-propelled guns are hidden somewhere in the %4north of the peninsula%1. This artillery is inflicting heavy damage and must be found and destroyed.

If you find yourself in need of additional fuel or ammo, return to the airbase and roll to the %5maintenance point%1; however time is of the essence; do not miss our opportunity to destroy the supply convoy.
STR_A3_Showcase_FixedWings_Debriefing_Fa: Your hesitation and inexperience has enabled our enemy to maintain their advantage, presenting our forces with a significant setback.
You were unable to fulfill your main tasks, weakening our strategic position.
Despite your best efforts, your plane has been shot down. This battle is over for you.
STR_A3_Showcase_FixedWings_Debriefing_Wi: Your brave actions and excellent skills have greatly improved our tactical situation and prevented the enemy from launching a counter-attack. The initiative is now fully in our hands.
Your outstanding actions and great piloting skills have greatly improved our tactical situation and prevented our enemy from launching a counter-attack.
You prevented the enemy from launching a counter-attack and greatly improved our tactical situation, yet you missed an opportunity to strike even harder.

STR_A3_CampaignDescription:
CAMPAIGN INBOUND

The official campaign will be added in 3 Free DLC Episodes, available to everyone who owns Arma 3.

'Survive and adapt to unforgiving circumstances. Fight hard to win victory over a more powerful enemy.'

AVAILABLE FOR FREE

Each of the Campaign Episodes will be downloaded automatically via a Steam update once they become available.

For all the latest announcements on Arma 3's campaign and more, be sure to keep track of the in-game newsfeed, www.arma3.com, Facebook and Twitter!

str_a3_faction_opfor_10_o_air_exo_3: The Y-32 Xi'an comes in 2 primary configurations: infantry and vehicle transport, respectively.
str_a3_faction_opfor_10_o_air_exo_4: Both configurations of the Y-32 Xi'an are equipped with a 30mm cannon, Skyfire rockets, and Skalpel missiles.

str_a3_mp_coop_06_briefing_situation_tex:
OPFOR presence on the South West of Altis has been increasing in the last couple of weeks, they have established camps and bases bringing instability within the region.

Local guerrillas have requested help to push the OPFOR away from the bay and re-establish the docking of supply boats in the area.
str_a3_mp_coop_06_briefing_mission_text: Seize enemy strong points along the bay.
str_a3_mp_coop_06_briefing_execution_tex:
1. Seize Alpha
2. Seize Bravo
3. Seize Charlie
4. Seize Delta
5. Seize Echo
