STR_A3_Showcase_Drones_Showcase_Summary_: Utilize Arma 3's unmanned ground and aerial vehicles. Complete a daring operation behind enemy lines.
str_a3_showcase_drones_titlecard: SHOWCASE: DRONES - Armed UAVs & UGVs, Recon Quadrocopter, High Value Target
str_a3_showcase_drones_debriefing_win05_: Despite completing your objective, you abandoned the rest of your team, putting our exfil - and the operation at large - in danger. Command will be notified about this.
str_a3_showcase_drones_debriefing_win04_: Despite losing both autonomous vehicles, you managed to complete your mission and destroy the AA sites. However, Pegasus escaped. Let's hope the enemy forces are not able to rapidly reorganize their defensive network.
str_a3_showcase_drones_debriefing_win03_: Despite losing both autonomous vehicles, you managed to complete your mission. The enemy's defensive network is in disarray and their capacity to reorganize has been struck a decisive blow. Outstanding work, Fox.
str_a3_showcase_drones_debriefing_win02_: Pegasus escaped, but you still managed to destroy the AA sites. Let's hope the enemy forces are not able to rapidly reorganize their defensive network.
str_a3_showcase_drones_debriefing_win01_: You successfully destroyed the AA sites and neutralized Pegasus. The enemy's defensive network is in disarray and their capacity to reorganize has been struck a decisive blow. Outstanding work, Fox.
str_a3_showcase_drones_debriefing_fail03: You were unable to complete your mission after losing both of your drones. At least you live to fight another day.
str_a3_showcase_drones_debriefing_fail01: You could not complete your objective in the allotted time. This is a major setback, Fox. Command may have to re-evaluate the entire offensive based on this failure.
str_a3_showcase_drones_briefing_situatio: Recon has identified a fortified network of defenses that secure the southern approach to %1the island's main airport%2, coordinated by a regional commander, codenamed Pegasus. Ahead of our assault on Altis, our goal is to disrupt their defensive capability.%3To that end, four teams have been inserted into enemy territory via the coast, including your team, %4Fox%5, and an extraction element, %6Rook%7. Your task is to neutralize two anti-air launcher platforms in the vicinity of %8Neochori%9 before the main assault begins at 0450 hours. %10Jester%11 and %12Hammer%13 will synchronize their attacks with yours in an effort to catch the enemy off-guard.%14Intel indicates that Pegasus is likely to be in %15your AO%16 during the operation. Neutralizing him will disrupt their command structure and weaken their capacity to coordinate an effective defense. We will keep you updated on his position.
str_a3_showcase_drones_briefing_signal_t: Bishop - Operation lead.%1%2Fox%3 - Your team.%4%5Rook%6 - Extraction element.%7%8Jester%9 - Squad ambushing %10the naval base%11.%12%13Hammer%14 - Squad sabotaging %15the airfield%16.
str_a3_showcase_drones_briefing_mission_: Locate and destroy anti-aircraft positions in the vicinity of %1Neochori%2, withdraw to %3Rook's position%4, and exfil south. If the opportunity to neutralize Pegasus presents itself, take it.
str_a3_showcase_drones_briefing_executio:
1. Regroup with %1the rest of your team%2.
2. Destroy the AA sites in %3Neochori%4.
3. Withdraw to %5Rook's position%6 and exfil.
str_a3_showcase_drones_bis_tskrv_desc: Fall back to %1Rook%2's position and exfil south.
str_a3_showcase_drones_bis_tskregroup_de: Rendezvous with %1the rest of your team%2.
str_a3_showcase_drones_bis_tskcommander_: If possible, eliminate Pegasus, the enemy commander stationed in %2Neochori%1, before he leaves the AO.
str_a3_showcase_drones_bis_tskaa_desc: Locate and destroy both AA defense systems located in %2Neochori%1.
str_a3_showcase_gunships_titlecard: SHOWCASE: GUNSHIPS - Attack Helicopters, Countermeasures, Huge Terrain
STR_A3_Showcase_Gunships_Showcase_Summar: Learn how to operate gunships in Arma 3. Repel the enemy assault with your heavily armed attack helicopter.
str_a3_showcase_gunships_debriefing_win0: Despite failing to save Viper-Green, you successfully completed all remaining objectives, striking a serious blow against enemy forces.
You completed all objectives and rescued Viper-Green. Enemy forces were beaten back and are retreating to their initial positions. Excellent work today, Hydra.
str_a3_showcase_gunships_briefing_situat: Early this morning, enemy forces launched an all-out offensive against our southern positions. They managed to reach %1Panagia%2 before we were able to push them back to the island's capital, %3Pyrgos%4, and into the sea.%5However, our %6Pyrgos%7 forces report that the enemy has launched %8a swift counter-offensive%9 from %10their naval base%11. Friendly forces should be able to defend %12the city%13, but not for long. They need reinforcements as soon as possible.%14Our resources are stretched, but we need to hold the capital. Close Air Support will be a vital part of our defense.
str_a3_showcase_gunships_briefing_missio: Link up with your Mi-48 gunner at %1our southern airfield%2, proceed to %3Pyrgos%4 and beat back %5the enemy counter-offensive%6.
str_a3_showcase_gunships_briefing_execut:
1. Board %1your Mi-48 Kajman.%2
2. Fly to %3Pyrgos%4.

str_a3_showcase_arma_debriefing_win3: Despite suffering heavy losses, you completed objectives integral to the mission, supporting an ongoing offensive by providing assistance to our logistics convoy. The enemy has been forced onto the back foot and we're now in a strong position to further the attack.
str_a3_showcase_arma_debriefing_win2: You successfully supported our main offensive, but lost your engineering toolkit in the process. This oversight affected our supply chain, meaning that we were unable to sustain our momentum.
str_a3_showcase_arma_debriefing_win1: You successfully completed objectives integral to the mission and helped to sustain our ongoing offensive by providing assistance to our logistics convoy. The enemy has been forced onto the back foot and we're in a strong position to capitalize on their defeat.
str_a3_showcase_arma_debriefing_fail3: You seized the outpost and the enemy anti-tank defenses but after suffering heavy casualties you had to retreat when engaging the enemy road block.
str_a3_showcase_arma_debriefing_fail2: You seized the outpost, yet were unable to defeat the enemy anti-tank defenses. Without the support of our southern forces, the enemy was able to beat back our offensive. Regrouping with our forces at least gives you the chance to fight another day.
str_a3_showcase_arma_debriefing_fail1: Your team suffered heavy casualties and was ordered to stand down. Without seizing the enemy outpost, we were unable to execute the main assault, allowing the enemy to reinforce their position.
str_a3_showcase_arma_briefing_situation_:
Having seized Kavala - the largest settlement on the west coast - with surprisingly little resistance, our forces pushed north and were met with a heavily fortified position. At the same time, we have opened up a new front, with the goal of flanking the enemy and, ultimately, securing the entire west coast of the island.

An armored platoon, Nomad, has moved into position to the north west - securing a key power station - and is poised to strike against our primary objective, the main base. However, we must first secure a key outpost to the south, so as to remove the risk of our forces being outflanked.

Mechanized infantry, callsign Echo, will push north and deploy infantry squads, Alpha, your team, and Bravo, near the Outpost. Together, they'll execute a coordinated assault and, with armored support, immediately strike against the main base before the enemy can regroup and counterattack.

Once the Area of Operation is under our control, a logistics convoy, Kilo, will move up and establish a supply route in support of our forces in the north. It's vital that we maintain the momentum of our offensive.

Papa Bear - HQ
Alpha - Your team
Bravo - Infantry Squad
Echo - 2 IFVs
Nomad - Armored Platoon
Kilo - Logistics Convoy

str_a3_showcase_arma_briefing_execution_:
1. Move to the staging area and await the signal from HQ
2. Seize the fortified Outpost with the support of Echo and Bravo
3. Support Nomad's assault on the main Base

str_a3_showcase_tanks_diary_situation_te: Now that we've taken control of the %2main airport%1 and its %3military base%1, the enemy has pulled back and established a strong - borderline impenetrable - %4defensive line%1. Rather than risking any more casualties in a frontal assault, we've elected to open a new front on the %5eastern peninsula%1.%6%6Shortly before dawn, we deployed a small but powerful expeditionary force two klicks from the %7northernmost settlement on Altis%1. From this position, we're ideally placed to strike south, and disrupt their defensive line.%6%6An armored platoon, callsign Nomad, will spearhead the offensive. The plan is simple: regroup, head south, and neutralize anything that stands between you and your main objective, %7Molos%1. Charlie squad will move in to take care of any infantry you leave behind.

str_a3_tactics_ballistic0: When serving in artillery as a gunner, you can use the %3Artillery computer%4 to calculate the elevation/power as well as firing rounds.%1%2Open the action menu %11.%1%2Open the Artillery computer.%1%2Select a place on the map within the displayed radius.%1%2Select the type of ammunition and other parameters.%1%2Use the %3Fire%4 button to fire, when ready.
str_a3_tactics_annoucning0: At certain proximities observed enemies are automatically announced to your side. When you spot someone in the distance use %11 to announce the target to your side.
str_a3_vehicguided0: Guided missiles require a target lock before launch.%1<t></t>1. Mark a target - point at it and press %11 (or %12 for a next sensor target).%1<t></t>2. Split diamond %13 appears once target is in the seeker's field of regard.%1<t></t>3. Get the target inside missile's Launch Acceptability Region (LAR). This is indicated by a beeping sound and a converging diamond %14.%1<t></t>4. Keep it steady until there's a full diamond %15 and a high-pitch tone.%1<t></t>5. SHOOT!
str_a3_spectating_spectatorcamera0: %1%2Use %3[Space]%4 to switch between unit view and free camera.%1%2Use %3[Arrow left]%4, %3[Arrow right]%4 to scroll through watchable soldiers. The selected one is marked with an icon .%1%2Tap %3[M]%4 to open the map. %1%2Clicking %3[LMB]%4 anywhere on the map will move the free camera under the cursor position.%1%2Press %3[N]%4 to toggle night vision.
str_a3_spectating_spectatorcamera2: Use %3[Ctrl + F1–F10]%4 to save the currently selected soldier.%1Press %3[F1–F10]%4 to recall to a saved soldier.
str_a3_spectating_spectatorfreeview0: %1%2Move the camera with %3[W]%4, %3[A]%4, %3[S]%4, %3[D]%4, %3[Q]%4 and %3[Z]%4.%1%2Use mouse and Numpad numbers to look around.%1%2Tap %3[Num *]%4 to toggle between moving and looking around with the mouse.%1%2Press %3[Delete]%4 to toggle a floating mode.%1%2Use %3[F]%4 to focus the camera on a cursor target or a position.%1%2Press %3[L]%4 to hide the crosshair.%1%2Tap %3[Left Alt]%4 to move the camera to selected unit's position.

str_a3_spectating_spectatorinfo0: Spectator camera is a tool for watching the game whilst you cannot or do not want to play directly. It's often available after your death, when you wait for a respawn. It's also available on pre-defined playable slots for users who wish to observe a mission or even stream its progress.
str_a3_spectating_spectatorunitview0: Use %11, %12 or %13 to switch between camera views. This is consistent with other views in the game.
str_a3_medikit2: Unlike the First Aid Kit, only Medics can use a Medkit.
str_a3_medikit0: Medics are trained to use a %3Medkit%4, which can permanently heal any damage. When healing yourself as a Medic equipped with a Medkit:%1%2Open the action menu %11.%1%2Select %3Treat yourself%4.%1%2Confirm with %12.
str_a3_alpha_goals0: The Beta scales up from the Alpha version, which was designed to involve you more directly in the development of Arma 3™ on several levels. Compared to the Alpha, the Beta introduces the Combined Arms element, which is the nature of the Arma gameplay.%1As with the Alpha, the goal of the Beta remains to be an opportunity for early access to the game while it's still in development and to provide feedback to the team and affect the final game.%1Your objective is to locate performance, balancing and design issues. Together, as player and developer, we can ensure a more solid release of Arma 3.
str_a3_alpha_feedback0: We intend this to involve you more directly in the development process and give you the opportunity to affect the final game. Your feedback and bug reports are welcome and can help us to improve the game significantly.%1Please visit %3feedback.arma3.com%4 to learn how to submit feedback. To discuss the game and related topics, please visit %3forums.bistudio.com%4. Thank you kindly for your support!

str_a3_basiclean0: Lean to peak around corners and still have most of your body hidden behind cover.%1%2Lean left: %11.%1%2Lean right: %12.%1You can also lock the character into a leaning position by pressing %13 for left or %14 for right side.

str_a3_basiclook0: Free look enables you to move while keeping awareness of your surroundings.%1%2Hold %11 and move the mouse left and right to look around.%1%2Tap %12 to toggle between static and free look.
str_a3_basiclook2: Free look represents turning the head sideways and up or down. That's why you cannot look directly behind you. This works the same for vehicles – usually only a commander has a 360° view.
str_a3_basicmove0: Use basic controls %11, %12, %13, %14 to move around and explore the surroundings. Use the mouse to rotate and adjust the direction.
str_a3_basicspeed0: Press %11 to sprint away from danger or towards cover. Sprinting, however, decreases your aim precision and drains your stamina significantly faster than normal movement.
str_a3_basicspeed2: Sprint works in all stances, try using it while crouched %12 or prone %13.
str_a3_basicstances0: To decrease the enemy's chances of detecting and hitting you, use different stances:%1%2Crouch with %11.%1%2Go prone with %12.%1Crouching and going prone also stabilizes your aim. To stand, simply press the Crouch/Go Prone button again.
str_a3_basicstances2: When prone, you cannot use launchers.
str_a3_basicwalk0: Default movement speed is run.%1%2Press %12 to move more slowly and silently in a combat pace.%1%2Press %11 to walk.

str_a3_cfghints_quick0: As a commander, you have access to quick commands via the quick command menu %11. The menu is context sensitive – commands change according to objects you point at. str_a3_cfghints_quick2: When you open quick commands, the whole squad is selected by default.

str_a3_basicwalk2: Tactical pace is best for moving slowly while maintaining a steady aim.
str_a3_cfghints_teams0: Units can be organized into teams for a quick selection. str_a3_clothes0: You can change your uniform and bags in Inventory %11. Different items have different attributes. str_a3_combatpace0: Combat pace is a move stance with weapon raised permanently to the shoulder. It trades movement speed for situational awareness and faster reaction time. This is particularly useful in urban areas. Use %11 to toggle combat pace on and off.
str_a3_combatpace2: Combat pace and lowered weapon stance are two independent body poses. Try switching to combat pace %11, lowering your weapon %12 and raising it back %12. You will return to combat pace.
str_a3_commanding0: The vehicle commander issues orders to the driver and gunner. Commands are displayed in the message log for crew members to carry them out.%1%2Issue move commands by pressing move buttons %15, %16, %17, %18.%1%2Control acceleration with %19, %20.%1%2Issue fire commands by pointing at a target and pressing %21 (or %11 if you don't control any weapon yourself).
str_a3_commanding2: %2Switch the gunner's weapons with %12.%1%2The commander is able to acquire %3manual fire%4 - %13.%1%2This is best combined with the optics view %14.%1%Other important commands for the driver:%1%2%3[1-1-1]%4 Stay in formation. str_a3_containers0: Uniforms, vests and backpacks work as containers in your inventory. To exchange a container:%1%2Open Inventory %11.%1%2Point the cursor at the container with this equipment.%1%2Drag the replacement to the specific position.
str_a3_containers2: Each container has a limited capacity indicated by a load bar underneath its icon. It's possible that some items will not fit into one bag. So, go get a bigger one.
str_a3_alpha_content0: The Arma 3 Beta features the Island of 'Stratis', which hosts 20 km² of Mediterranean terrain. Playable content is considerably limited.%1%2<t></t>Stratis (20 km²)%1%2<t></t>4 Factions%1%2<t></t>20 Weapons%1%2<t></t>18 Vehicles%1%2<t></t>3 Multiplayer Scenarios%1%2<t></t>8 Singleplayer Showcases%1%2<t></t>4 Firing Drills%1%2<t></t>Multiple Weapon Attachments%1%2<t></t>Customizable Gear%1%2<t></t>Scenario Editor%1%2<t></t>Modding%1The Beta version is limited in comparison to the full version. We intend this to involve you more directly in the development process and give you the opportunity to affect the final game.
str_a3_countermeasures0: As a commander or a pilot, you are in control of a vehicle's countermeasures. Press %11 to launch countermeasures when you see an incoming missile or when a missile lock warning appears.
str_a3_death0: You are dead. There is nothing you can do besides restarting the mission from a save point or from the beginning. Better luck next time.
str_a3_death2: In multiplayer you will be able to see who killed you.
str_a3_designator0: Laser designator is used for aiming guided missiles, bombs and artillery.%1<t></t>1. Select %3Laser Designator%4 by pressing %16.%1<t></t>2. Use its optics by pressing %17.%1<t></t>3. Zoom using %12<t></t>, %13.%1<t></t>4. Switch view modes with %14.%1<t></t>5. And finally, press %15 to mark the target.
str_a3_designator2: Once marked, do not move or switch the laser beam off or the missiles will be unable to correct their trajectory and might miss the target.
str_a3_direction0: To better understand direction codes (bearings):%1%2Open your GPS %11 or compass %12.%1The direction matches the 360° system. North is marked as 000, East as 090 and so on. Coordinates are also visible on the map.
str_a3_direction2: Clock position is often used for a relative direction. Based on a 12-hour clock analogy, 12 o'clock means directly ahead, 3 o'clock means right and so on.
str_a3_directional0: %11 and %12 are directional explosives with a narrow arc of effect. They're especially useful in corridors and when defending enclosed areas. When placing them, face the direction in which you want the mine to explode.
str_a3_disarm0: To deactivate an explosive, you have to be an %3Explosives expert%4 or an %3Engineer%4, have a %3Toolkit%4 and know the location of the explosive.%1%2Crawl %11 to the explosive.%1%2Select %3Deactivate%4 from the action menu.%1WARNING: if you don't approach the explosive carefully in a prone position, it will detonate.
str_a3_disarm2: Deactivating a mine underwater doesn't require being in a prone position.
str_a3_doors0: Most doors can be opened.%1%2Point the cursor at a door until the icon appears.  %1%2Press %11. %1%2You can also %3open/close doors%4 through the action menu.
str_a3_dots0: Peripheral vision indicators represent units outside of your current view. These transparent dots change with the direction and distance of the units.
str_a3_dots2: On lower difficulties, dots will stick to their units anywhere on the screen, making it easier to distinguish between friends and foes.
str_a3_adjust0: Adjust your stance by pressing:%1%2%11, %12 for rise or crouch.%1%2%13, %14 for half-step sideways.%1This will help you to stay in cover more effectively or shoot over obstacles more easily. Adjust works in all stances.
str_a3_driving0: In ground vehicles%1%2%11 and %12 are used for acceleration.%1%2%13 and %14 are used for steering.%1%2You can also use %15 or %16 for a steady slow speed or fast forward acceleration.
str_a3_driving2: Third person view and free look might be particularly useful when driving.%1%2Switch to the third person camera with %17.%1%2Or use free look with %18.
str_a3_entering0: To enter a vehicle:%1%2Point the cursor at it until the icon appears.%1%2Use default action %11.%1Alternatively:%1%2Open the action menu %12.%1%2Select %3Enter%4.%1You will be given a seat associated with a role in the vehicle. For example enter as a driver to drive, enter as a gunner to shoot. Certain roles might not be available for some vehicles.
str_a3_entering2: Different roles in a vehicle have a different action icon indicating the default action . Use them to quickly determine the role you are taking by entering the vehicle.
str_a3_exit0: There are two ways to exit a vehicle (accessible also from the action menu).%1%2%11 or %3Get out%4 stands for a proper exit, when the vehicle is at a full stop and it's safe to get out. %1%2%12 or %3Eject%4 is an immediate, emergency exit from a moving or flying vehicle and can lead to injury or death.
str_a3_exit2: If your aircraft is not equipped with an ejection system, make sure you have grabbed your parachute!
str_a3_fak0: The First Aid Kit (FAK) is used to treat small wounds.%1%2Point the cursor at a wounded soldier.%1%2Open the action menu %11.%1%2Select %3treat%4.%1%2Confirm with %12 to use the FAK.%1You can even use it on yourself.
str_a3_fak2: FAK is depleted after a single use and is removed from your inventory.
str_a3_fastequip0: When in the inventory, %3RMB click%4 on any item will fast equip or fast un-equip it. %1%2Fast equipping anything from the ground will move it to its slot or one of your containers.%1%2Fast un-equipping anything from your slots or containers will move it to the ground or an opened ground container.
str_a3_fastravel0: Fast travel is a method of quickly getting through a safe area.%1%2Open the map %12.%1%2Select %3Fast travel%4 and choose a destination.%1Alternatively, use fast travel through the action menu:%1%2Open the action menu %11.%1%2Select a spot to %3travel%4 on the map.
str_a3_fatigue0: When your character starts to breathe heavily and is unable to aim steadily, sprint or even continue running, he is fatigued. Stop moving for a while and catch your breath.
str_a3_fatigue2: When fatigued, your inherent weapon sway becomes more pronounced, all actions take longer to complete, your movement is slower and the time you can hold your breath while aiming becomes increasingly limited. Carried load, moving stance and ascending high terrain gradients all significantly contribute to fatigue gain.
str_a3_firedamage0: Don't stay near fire or you will get burned. Fire damage is as dangerous as being hit by a bullet. Luckily, your armor protects you the same way.
str_a3_firedamage2: Vehicles can withstand a fire for a time before taking damage. This time increases with their armor.
str_a3_firemode0: Many weapons have several fire-modes such as semi-automatic and burst.%1%2Use %11 to switch between the fire-modes.%1While in a vehicle as a gunner, use the switch key %11 to switch between vehicle weapons.
str_a3_firing0: Weapons in vehicles work similarly to infantry weapons.%1%2Fire with %11.%1%2Zoom with %12, %18.%1%2Go to optics with %13.%1%2Switch weapons and fire-modes with %14 or %19,%20%,%21,%22.%1%2Reload different ammo via action menu %15.
str_a3_firing2: Some vehicles have sensors or guided weapons. To mark a target, point at it and press %16 or use %17 to cycle targets acquired by sensors.
str_a3_flares0: Flares of various colors are used for signaling. They can be launched from certain types of underslung grenade launcher.
str_a3_flashlight0: A flashlight can be very useful during night-time. Turn your gun-mounted flashlight on/off by pressing %11. Be careful, light can give away your position.
str_a3_gear0: %2Access your Inventory by pressing %11. %1%2Use %3drag and drop%4 to move items between slots and containers. %1%2Close the Inventory window by pressing %11 again.
str_a3_gear2: This hint also applies to searching vehicles, bags, corpses or just piles of items on the ground.
str_a3_gps0: Your GPS keeps track of the time, your location, direction and it even contains a detailed map of your surroundings.%1%2Activate the GPS %11 to gain instant awareness of your surroundings.
str_a3_gps2: This handy device is capable of displaying a map, compass and time in one place. Don't lose it.
str_a3_grenades0: Use grenades to quickly dispatch enemies behind cover.%1%2Throw a grenade by pressing %11.%1%2Cycle between grenade and chemlight types by pressing %12.%1The angle of the throw has a great influence on its distance.
str_a3_gui0: Weapon info (in the upper right corner) shows the name of the weapon, selected ammunition, remaining magazines, zeroing of the weapon and most importantly, the selected fire-mode. The more rectangles in fire-mode, the higher the fire rate.
str_a3_gui2: Weapon info reappears anytime the state of the weapon changes. So you can either fire a bullet or switch weapons or fire-mode to trigger it. Or press %11 to show it.
str_a3_handgun0: Handguns are secondary weapons, used in a close combat or for self-defense.%1%2Use %11 to quickly switch to the handgun.
str_a3_handgun2: You can also switch between weapons via the action menu %12.
str_a3_head0: There are specific slots for special items in your inventory. You can equip and use Binoculars %11, Night Vision Goggles %12 and others to improve your tactical awareness.
str_a3_head2: You can have only one head-mounted display equipped.
str_a3_hitdamage0: When you fall from certain heights, you suffer damage according to your gained momentum (speed and mass). The same applies to vehicles and also for being hit by them.
str_a3_hitdamage2: The damage caused by hits and falls is mitigated by armor. This is especially useful while being in vehicles as their armor counts towards protecting their crewmen.
str_a3_actionmenu0: The action menu is a context sensitive list of available actions. It changes depending on the object pointed at with the cursor. %3Icons%4 near the weapon cursor indicate a new default action. %1%2Execute the given action directly with %14.%1Other actions are listed in the action menu. %1%2Open the menu with %11 or %12.%1%2Select an action.%1%2Execute the selected action with %13.
str_a3_ieds0: Charges and IEDs can be detonated remotely or set with a timer. If you have an IED in your inventory, an item will appear in your action menu.%1%2Open the action menu %11.%1%2Place the IED on the ground using %3Put%4.%1%2Confirm with %12.%1%2Point at it with the cursor.%1%2Now you can set a timer in 40–second steps using the action menu.
str_a3_ieds2: You can detonate all your charges by selecting %3Touch off%4 from the action menu. Also, your side is aware of the positions of your charges to avoid friendly fire.
STR_A3_CfgHints_Waypoints2: The %3Move there%4 order is only available when a unit can reach the place.
str_a3_chemlights0: Chemlights of various colors are great for signaling during the night.%1%2Cycle between grenade and chemlight types by pressing %12.%1%2Throw a chemlight by pressing %11.%1The angle of the throw has a great influence on its distance.
str_a3_injury0: A few hits usually result in death, but for now you are just injured . Your condition affects your view, aim and speed, but it is treatable. Now, call for a medic: %1%2Press %11 to open fast commands.%1%2Report %3Injured%4.%1Alternative call procedure:%1%2Press %3[5]%4 for status reports.%1%2Press %3[4]%4 for %3Injured%4.
str_a3_launcher0:
Launchers give infantry a way to neutralize armored vehicles. %1%2Equip the launcher by pressing %11.%1%2You can press %12 to see through the launcher's optics.%1%2Point at the target.%1%2Shoot with %13.
For launchers armed with guided missiles, press %14 to lock the target and wait for the missile to lock before shooting.
str_a3_launcher2: In some presets, you can switch between weapons by opening the action menu %15 and selecting the weapon.
str_a3_looting0: To loot a dead body:%1%2Get close and point the cursor at the body.%1%2Press %11 to open the Inventory.%1%2%3Drag and drop%4 desired items into your inventory.%1%2Use %3double-click LMB%4 to open a bag/vest/uniform on the ground. It will open to a new tab.
str_a3_lowering0: Press %11 to lower your weapon. It will be raised again after clicking %12 or pressing %11 again.
str_a3_lowering2: A lowered weapon makes movement slower and less tiring.
str_a3_map0: The map is a powerful tool for navigation and commanding.%1%2Open it by pressing %11.%1%2Zoom in or out on the map with %3[mouse-wheel up and down]%4.%1%2Try hiding or showing map %3textures%4 or centering on your position. Buttons are located on the top toolbar.%1%2Close the map by pressing %12 or %3[Esc]%4.
str_a3_map2: Remember, you can only see the map if you have a GPS or Map in your Inventory.
str_a3_mines0: You don't need to be an explosives specialist to set mines. If you have a mine in your inventory, an item will appear in your action menu.%1%2Open the action menu %11.%1%2Go to a place you want mined.%1%2Select %3Put%4 mine.%1%2Confirm with %12.
str_a3_mines2: Anti-Tank mines will not be triggered by infantry as they are set for higher weights. Also, your side is aware of the position of your explosives to avoid friendly-fire.
str_a3_minesweep0: Having a mine detector in your inventory will automatically locate all explosives in a close range. Units can also spot mines depending on their training, so if you want to bet on luck, you can. When looking for a mine, move slowly and look around you. Note that mines are less likely to be spotted in bushes and grass.
str_a3_minesweep2: Known locations of mines are displayed on the map and are distributed among your fellow soldiers. They will keep away from such spots.
str_a3_multiplayer_chat0: To communicate with other players you can use one of the three types of communications: Text, Voice and Map Markers. The communication is only broadcasted to a selected channel. Channels are:%1%2Global – to all players%1%2Side – to your faction%1%2Command – to your faction commanders%1%2Group – to your command group%1%2Vehicle – to players in the same vehicle%1%2Direct – to players in a close distance%1Cycle channels with %11, %12.
STR_A3_Multiplayer_Markers0: A map marker is a visual aid placed on the map. To add a marker:%1%2Doubleclick %3[LMB]%4 anywhere on the map.%1%2Press %3[UP]%4, %3[DOWN]%4 to change the type of the marker.%1%2Hold %3[L. Shift]%4 and press %3[LEFT]%4 or %3[RIGHT]%4 to change the color of the marker.%1%2You can enter text while creating the marker.%1%2Confirm the marker placement with %3[Enter]%4.%1To delete a marker, point at it with the cursor and press %3[Delete]%4.
str_a3_multiplayer_teamswitch0: Team Switch enables you to switch between playable units.%1%2Open the Team Switch window %11.%1%2Select a unit to switch into.%1%2Press the %3Switch%4 button.
str_a3_multiplayer_teamswitch2: Press %12 to switch directly into the next unit.
str_a3_multiplayer_voice0: Built-in voice chat provides an option to quickly communicate with your fellow soldiers. If a microphone is connected, press and hold %11 to start broadcasting. Voice chat follows the same rules as text chat, so remember to switch channels by pressing %12, %13 to talk privately to your side.
STR_A3_Multiplayer_Markers2: This marker is visible to a selected chat channel (e.g. placing a map marker while in the Side channel ensures only other players on your side will see it). Use markers to point out enemy forces, plot routes, assign artillery targets and convey any other useful information required.
str_a3_muzzles0: Suppressors are used to reduce a weapon's sound and muzzle flash. To equip a suppressor:%1%2Open Inventory %11.%1%2%3Drag and drop%4 a suppressor to your weapon's suppressor slot. The slot will be marked.
str_a3_muzzles2: Equipping a suppressor reduces the power of fired bullets.
str_a3_normaldamage0: Damage from bullets and explosives is mitigated by armor. The more armor your uniform or vehicle has, the less damage is received. %1For increased protection, don't forget to equip a helmet and vest, as they add armor.
str_a3_normaldamage2: Damage also affects movement and aim. When shot in the leg, you will barely be able to walk. When shot in the arm, aiming will become harder.
str_a3_nv0: To use night vision, you need to have night vision optics mounted on a weapon, helmet or vehicle. %1%2Press %11 to cycle through available view modes.
str_a3_nv2: Use IR grenades and laser pointers to mark objects and locations when using night vision. They will remain unseen by the enemy but soldiers with night vision will be able to see them clearly.
str_a3_pointers0: Flashlight, Laser and IR Laser pointers can be attached to your rifle to provide accuracy, coordination and utility. Flashlights are especially useful during night missions.%1%2To activate the laser or flashlight, press %11.
str_a3_pointers2: To equip a pointer, open the inventory %12 and drag the pointer to your weapon's side slot. The proper slot will be highlighted.
str_a3_radar0: A Radar can detect and track targets beyond visual range and in adverse conditions. Radars can usually detect targets in the sky at longer distances than those in ground clutter. Some Radars may not be able to pick targets close to the ground at all unless those targets are moving fast enough.%1%2Press %11 to switch Radar on/off.%1Radar-guided missiles require the Radar to be switched on.
str_a3_rangefinder0: Use the rangefinder, hand-held or scope-integrated, to determine the distance to your target to engage it with better accuracy.%1%2Stadiametric RF - use reticle markings (mil-dots) to estimate the distance from the target.%1%2Digital (Laser) RF - Press %13 to measure the distance. %1Use %11 and %12 to adjust the weapon's zeroing accordingly.
STR_A3_Multiplayer_Text0: Text chat serves as one of the three forms of communicating with other players. It's displayed on the screen amongst the combat protocol.%1%2Open the text input with %11.%1%2Cycle the channels by pressing %3[UP]%4, %3[DOWN]%4.%1%2Send the message with %3[Enter]%4.
str_a3_rearm0: You can easily replenish your magazines without opening the inventory.%1%2Approach an ammo box or a vehicle, point your cursor at it and open the action menu with %11.%1%2Select %3Rearm %4. This will replenish your magazines up to your default loadout count.
str_a3_rearm2: When you are low on ammo, your commander will often issue a rearm order at an exact place.
str_a3_recoil0: Recoil is a backward momentum when a gun is fired. The stronger the gun cartridge, the bigger the kick. Recoil and the anticipation of it can negatively affect shooting precision. This applies even more while shooting in bursts or in full-automatic mode.%1To lower the effect recoil has on your accuracy, try moving the aim down between the consecutive shots. Increasing your stability also helps, crouch %11 or go prone %12.
str_a3_reload0: An empty magazine is indicated by the magazine icon in the center of the screen.%1%2Press %11 to reload anytime.%1Alternatively, use the default action %12 to reload your weapon when the icon is present.
str_a3_reload2: The Action menu also gives you a selection of all magazines possible to reload. This is useful when you need to use some utility ammo.
str_a3_rifles0: Rifles are primary weapons with great fire-power, magazine capacity, range and accuracy. Rifles can be fitted with various accessories such as pointers, suppressors or optics to customize them for specific situations.
str_a3_rifles2: Some rifles come in versions with underslung grenade launchers.
str_a3_scopes0: Scopes enhance weapon aiming. To equip a scope:%1%2Open your Inventory %11.%1%2%3Drag and drop%4 the scope into your rifle's scope slot.%1This is only possible if the weapon has an upper accessory slot.
str_a3_scopes2: Scopes are not usable together with a head-mounted display like NVG. But some scopes offer their own optics mode.%1%2Press %12 to switch available optics modes.
STR_A3_Multiplayer_Text2: When you are writing, other keyboard controls are disabled. Close the chat box by pressing %3[Esc]%4 quickly.
str_a3_seats0: While in a vehicle, you can change your seat and role:%1%2Open the action menu %11.%1%2Select a different position.%1Usually you can choose from driver, commander and gunner. When in a vehicle, remember to use the optics %12. They differ for each role and can provide a significant advantage.
str_a3_seats2: Some positions might not be available in certain vehicles. Switching is not available while in the air or in similar conditions.
str_a3_shoot0: Press %11 to fire your weapon. You can hold %12 to focus and zoom in a little more for more accurate aiming. Remember that going crouch or prone also stabilizes your aim. Going prone also slightly alters weapon recoil behavior.
str_a3_steppingover0: When passing a low obstacle, step over it with %11 to shorten your route.
str_a3_switch0: Switch between the primary and secondary weapon with %11. Switch to the handgun by using %12. Switch to the launcher (or other secondary weapon) by using %14.
str_a3_switch2: In some presets, you can switch between weapons by opening the action menu %13 and selecting the weapon.
str_a3_tacticalview0: When you are in command of a squad or vehicle, tap %11 to enable the Tactical view mode. In Tactical view, commanding options from the normal view remain available, but the view is changed to isometric to reveal more of the surroundings and provide better situational awareness. Switch to the Tactical view to better manage your squad in tight situations.
str_a3_tactics_ammotype0: Artillery operates with several different ammo types: %1%2HE shells – simple explosive ammo.%1%2Flares – used for signaling.%1%2Smoke shells – for signaling or screening.%1%2Guided – heat seeking shells.%1%2Laser Guided – precise, guided by laser designation.
str_a3_tactics_artillerycall0: Artillery is a precise strike effective against well defended or armored targets.%1<t></t>1. Point at the target.%1<t></t>2. Press %11 or %3[0]%4 to enter the command menu.%1<t></t>3. Select %3Communications%4 - %3[8]%4.%1<t></t>4. Select %3Artillery Strike%4.%1<t></t>5. Choose an artillery type.%1<t></t>6. Select a type of ammo.%1<t></t>7. Pick the number of rounds.%1Artillery support will then confirm the request and report the splash.
str_a3_tactics_artillerycall2: The procedure is the same for other types of support, just choose a different support in step 4.
str_a3_shoot2: %13 means focusing and holding your breath. This will help to reduce breathing impact over inherent weapon sway for a short while and give you an opportunity to hit your target more precisely. But it will also temporarily increase your breathing penalty after you release your breath deliberately or when your oxygen is depleted by itself. Remember that Fatigue has detrimental effect over your ability to effectively hold breath.
str_a3_slots0: The inventory has designated slots for specific items. %3Drag and drop%4 an item from your containers. Available slots for the item will be highlighted.
str_a3_smokes0: Smoke grenades are great for screening units and signaling.%1%2Cycle between grenade types by pressing %12.%1%2Throw a grenade by pressing %11.%1The angle of the throw has a great influence on its distance.
str_a3_take0: To pick up a single item from the ground:%1%2Move close to the item.%1%2Point the cursor at the item until the icon appears.%1%2Press %13 to take the item.%1Or you can choose to %3Take%4 the item through the action menu %11.
str_a3_take2: You can also move close to the item and open the Inventory %12. The item will be listed on the left side of the Gear window under the label %3Ground%4.
str_a3_takeoff0: %1%2Start the engine by pressing %11.%1%2Hold %11 to increase throttle and gain altitude.%1%2Hold %12 to decrease throttle and lose altitude.%1%2Maneuver the helicopter sideways with %13 and %14.%1%2Pull the nose down %15 to gain speed and up %16 to lose it.%1%2Use the rudder %17 and %18 to rotate left/right.%1%2Use the %3mouse%4 to control the helicopter smoothly.
str_a3_smokes2: Various smoke colors can be very useful when simultaneously marking more areas.
str_a3_sniper0: Sniper rifles are accurate and deadly at long ranges, provided that you can keep your aim steady. %1<t></t>1. Go prone with %11 to keep weapon sway minimal.%1<t></t>2. Press %12 to look through the scope to see the enemy.%1<t></t>3. Adjust the rifle's zeroing with %13/%14 to match the target's range.%1<t></t>4. Hold your breath with %15 to steady the aim.%1<t></t>5. Shoot by pressing %16 to kill.
str_a3_sniper2: Some scopes have range indication, which provides information for zeroing the weapon.
str_a3_tasks0: You have a new task. Tasks are mission objectives received from Command. To open mission tasks:%1%2Open the task list %11.%1Alternatively, you can access your tasks on the map.%1%2Open the map %12 and select %3Tasks%4.
str_a3_tasks2: Goals from the active task are marked on your screen. To select a different task as active:%1%2Open tasks %11.%1%2Click on the task.%1%2Then click on %3set as an active task%4.
str_a3_thirdperson0: Third person view can give you an increased tactical awareness of your surroundings.%1%2Press %11 to switch the camera between 1st person view and 3rd person view.
str_a3_thirdperson2: Try using %3Free look%4 – %12 to look around while moving in 3rd person view.
str_a3_ti0: Thermal Imaging can provide a valuable tactical advantage. If you have a TI sight or binoculars:%1%2Use %11 to cycle through available TI views.
str_a3_ti2: TI has two display modes to better distinguish an object from their background: %3White-hot%4 and %3Black-hot%4. Heat emitting objects are displayed in a selected color. The image has contrast at night.
str_a3_tracers0: Tracer rounds are used to mark enemy positions to other soldiers or check the bullet trajectory. Some magazines have tracer bullets loaded at the end. This way your teammates will know that you need to reload. Team leaders often have their magazines loaded only with tracers to mark the targets.
str_a3_ugl0: Underslung grenade launchers are great for engaging groups of enemies or enemies hidden behind cover. If your weapon has a grenade launcher: %1<t></t>1. Select it by cycling fire modes %11.%1<t></t>2. You can switch to sights by pressing %12.%1<t></t>3. Adjust zeroing to match the target range %14, %15.%1<t></t>4. Aim with the red dot on the sights.%1<t></t>5. Finally, fire with %13.
str_a3_ugl2: Grenade launchers are also capable of launching flares usable for signaling.
str_a3_underwater0: Shooting normal guns underwater is impossible. %11 is a special weapon designed to withstand higher pressure. If loaded with a dual purpose mag, it becomes an effective weapon for underwater combat at ranges of up to 40 meters.
STR_A3_radar2: An active Radar can reveal you to an enemy equipped with a passive Radar or RWR.
STR_A3_vehicunguided2: A small floating crosshair (CCIP) in the HUD will tell you where the rocket will land if it is fired at that exact moment.
STR_A3_TacticalView2: To use the Tactical view, 3rd Person view must be enabled in your difficulty settings.
str_a3_vehicleammo0: Some vehicles come with different ammunition types for varying uses. To change the ammunition type:%1%2Open the action menu %11.%1%2Select the option to %3reload%4 the desired ammunition type.
str_a3_vehiclegui0: In the top left corner is the vehicle info panel. It displays the name of the vehicle, damage indications , fuel bar and current speed, heading and altitude.
str_a3_vehiclegui2: Damage indicators are split between vehicle hull, instruments, tracks, wheel, engine or rotors. Damage is indicated by a color. Once the icon turns red, the corresponding part of the vehicle is no longer functional. If a gas tank is damaged, the vehicle might even explode.
str_a3_vehiclerearm0: Vehicles are rearmed and refueled anytime they happen to be in a vicinity of a fuel truck or repair truck.
str_a3_vehicunguided0: Unguided rockets are fired directly in front of the vehicle. As a pilot, you have to adjust vehicle position or angle to change the aim of unguided rockets.
str_a3_waterdamage0: When you are underwater without a rebreather for a longer time, your oxygen supply will start to run out. Tunnel vision indicates that you are lacking oxygen and start taking drowning damage. Go to the surface fast.
str_a3_waterdamage2: This damage is also inflicted in other situations where the oxygen level is limited, like in sealed rooms or while using gas weapons.
str_a3_waypoint0: Waypoints mark a location you are ordered to go to by your team-leader or a task. All waypoints and go-to orders will be shown by a marker on the screen. When moving in a formation, a formation marker will also be shown on the screen, but without any distance and description.
str_a3_waypoint2: Task related waypoints are shown on the map. The displaying of waypoints depends on chosen difficulty settings.
str_a3_zeroing0: Zeroing is the accurate setup of weapon sights. It tells you the range where the bullet will hit the center of the scope. Zeroing in meters is displayed in Weapon Info. %1%2Use %11 and %12 to adjust the weapon zeroing up and down.
str_a3_zeroing2: %2In close ranges under the zeroed range, it’s better to shoot slightly below the target.%1%2In ranges over the zeroed range, it's better to shoot slightly above the target.%1Some scopes come with crosshair aids for such situations.
str_a3_zooming0: Optics help you aim more precisely.%1%2Use %11 to switch to iron sights or optics.%1%2You can choose between alternative optic sights with the optics mode key %12.%1%2Use %11 to switch back to normal view.
str_a3_zooming2: While not using optics, you can focus by holding %13 to zoom in a little more for more accurate aiming. While looking through the optics, %14 and %15 zoom in/out. This also works in vehicles.
STR_A3_WeaponSway1: One of the vital abilities each soldier obtains is the ability to lay precise fire upon his enemies. Your weapon sway will increase when:%1%2You suffer an arm injury%1%2You're depleting your stamina through exhaustive movements or actions%1%1The heavier your loadout, and the longer you're exhausting yourself for, the faster you'll reach your limits.
STR_A3_WeaponSway2: To maintain decent accuracy, take short breaks to catch your breath and try to avoid exhausting yourself unless absolutely necessary. Manage the time you spend sprinting or climbing steep terrain.

str_a3_cfgvehicles_underwaterminerange_l: Moored naval mine is the most used naval mine. Deployed by ships and airplanes, it carries a large load of explosives and a variety of sensors to punish every ship or submarine that sails too close.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_underwaterminerangeab: Naval mines sitting on the bottom of the sea are used at depths of up to 200 meters. Deployed by ships and airplanes, a single mine carries a large load of explosives and a variety of sensors to punish every ship that sails too close.
str_a3_cfgmagazines_bouncingminerangemag:
Type: Anti-personnel bounding mine
Rounds: 1
Used on: Ground

The anti-personnel bounding mine is best suitable for open areas. It is usually burried just bellow the surface of the ground. When triggered, a charge launches the body of the mine one meter into the air. The explosion covers a close area with fragments, killing the whole group.
STR_A3_CFGVEHICLES_UNDERWATERMINEPDM_LIB: The PDM-7 is an amphibious mine used in shallow waters against light assault boats and amphibious vehicles. A fuse placed on the base serves to discourage handling of the armed mine.
str_a3_cfgmagazines_pipebomb_library0: An explosive satchel is a charge placeable on the ground. It can be set to detonate either by using the built-in timer or a remote detonator. They are stronger than an explosive charge, capable of destroying whole buildings, but easier to spot.
str_a3_cfgmagazines_classicminerangemaga: A classic pressure-activated anti-personnel mine is still widely used despite being prohibited by international conventions. When dug-in, they are very hard to detect without the help of a mine detector.
STR_A3_cfgMagazines_Mine_Library0: The design of anti-tank mines has not changed much during the last 50 years. An AT mine is the strongest ground mine manufactured today. They are triggered only by vehicles.
str_a3_cfgmagazines_classicminewiremagaz:
Type: Anti-personnel tripwire mine
Rounds: 1
Used on: Ground
Tripwire anti-personnel mines consist of a dug-in mine and a 5m wire.  They are very hard to spot, but carry a smaller explosive charge than more typical mines.
str_a3_cfgmagazines_democharge_library0: An explosive charge is placeable on the ground. It could be set to detonate either by the built-in timer or a remote detonator.
str_a3_cfgmagazines_directionalminerange:
Type: Anti-armor penetration mine
Rounds: 1
Used on: Ground

The M6 SLAM mine is a next generation Selectable Lightweight Attack Munition. They are very effective against light armored vehicles, penetrating 40 mm armor from up to eight meters. Unlike dug-in mines, SLAM is placed on the ground and is easier to spot.
str_a3_cfgmagazines_directionalmineremot:
Type: Anti-personnel fragmentation charge
Rounds: 1
Used on: Ground

A Claymore fragmentation charge is one of the deadliest anti-personnel charges available. On a timed or remote-triggered detonation, the Claymore sends deadly steel balls in a frontal direction. Effective kill radius is up to 50 meters. Unlike dug-in mines the Claymore is placed on the ground and is easier to spot.
str_a3_cfgmagazines_ied1: Improvised Explosive Devices of various kinds are usually used by irregular forces against regular army adversary. Made out of artillery shells, land mines or basically any explosive materials, remotely-detonated IEDs are capable of inflicting heavy casualties on unsuspecting patrols and convoys.

str_a3_cfgweapons_srifle_lrr_library0: M320 Long Range Rifle is a .408 caliber sniper rifle developed in the United States. The M320 LRR is a bolt-action rifle valued for its accuracy up to 2000 m.
str_a3_cfgweapons_srifle_gm6_library0: The Gepard GM6 Lynx is a semi-automatic anti-material rifle using Russian 12.7x108 mm ammo. Its purpose is to stop or disable targets such as light armored vehicles, light shelters and helicopters from 600–800 m range. Due to its weight and portability, it is good for parachute, airmobile and territorial troops. The barrel recoil technology brings the recoil of the GM6 below the recoil of other rifles in the same category. The weapon is highly accurate and effective up to a range of 1500 m.
str_a3_cfgweapons_rangefinder_library0: A rangefinder is a basic tool for spotting distances and targets. It has several active parts: one being the rangefinder itself on the right side where you can see the distance to the target. AZT displays the azimuth and the mode switches between the visible spectrum and night vision.
str_a3_cfgweapons_arifle_xmx_library0: The MX is a 6.5 mm assault rifle used as a standard-issue weapon for the BLUFOR army. It is lightweight, reliable, easily serviceable and compatible with a large number of accessories. Several variants of the MX rifle exist: MX 3GL is equipped with a 3GL grenade launcher. MXM is a designated marksman rifle for engaging targets from a larger distance compared to assault rifles. MX SW is a light support weapon providing light machinegun support. And finally MXC is a carbine version with shorter barrel, better suited for close quarters combat.
str_a3_cfgweapons_arifle_sdar_library0: Special Dual-medium Assault Rifle is a bullpup rifle specially designed to allow shooting both on land and under water. It uses standard 5.56x45 mm rounds or special supercavitating ammunition which is efficient when used under water. But still, when under water, its range drops rapidly from 35 meters in 10 m depth to 13 meters in 40 m depth.
str_a3_cfgweapons_arifle_katiba_f_librar: Katiba is a bullpup assault rifle of an Eastern origin and was developed in cooperation with China. It fires 6.5 mm caseless ammunition. Thanks to its construction, the rifle is really reliable and has a low recoil. Katiba is a standard issue weapon for OPFOR armies. Three versions of Katiba exist: standard, a shorter carbine and a GL version equipped with an underslung grenade launcher.
str_a3_cfgweapons_hgun_p07_library0: The P07 is a semi-automatic pistol with a frame, that combines metal and reinforced polymer. Following the success of Glock, polymer based pistols became known as perfect handguns for both military use and self-defense and are available in various calibers. P07 allows easy mounting of suppressors.
str_a3_cfgweapons_hgun_rook40_library0: Rook-40 is a double action, short recoil operated, locked breech pistol. Its steel construction makes it a bit retro, but compared to contemporary lightweight polymer pistols, it feels sturdier. It fires 9x21 mm ammunition and comes with tritium-filled night sights.
str_a3_cfgweapons_launch_law_library0: The RPG-42 Alamut is a lightweight, reloadable and recoilless anti-tank weapon fired from the shoulder. It's based on modern Russian rocket launchers and produced in the Middle East. The RPG-42 Rocket is best used against light-armored vehicles and defenses, though when used against a tank, it could damage its tracks.
str_a3_cfgweapons_launch_nlaw_library0: The PCML (Person-Carried Missile Launcher) is a portable, short range, fire-and-forget anti-tank guided missile system. The PCML is a soft-launch system, allowing it to be used from within an enclosed room.
str_a3_cfgweapons_lmg_mk200_library0: The Mk200 is a gas-operated light machine gun based on the Belgian LMG with ergonomical grips, reinforced lock and quick barrel removal system. It fires 6.5x39 mm (caseless) ammunition fed from a belt with a rate of 800 rounds per minute. The Mk200 provides the squad with the accurate and sustained fire-power required to suppress and destroy enemy targets.
str_a3_cfgweapons_arifle_trg21_gl_librar: The TRG-21 is a bullpup assault rifle used by the FIA. It features an ergonomical design that supports accurate fire in harsh conditions. TRG-21 is lightweight, ambidextrous, easily serviceable and compatible with a large number of accessories. TRG-21 EGLM is mounted with an enhanced grenade launching module. A carbine variant is labeled TRG-20. Compared to TRG-21, it features a short barrel better suited for close quarters combat situations.
STR_A3_CfgWeapons_srifle_ABR_Library0: The Mk18 Advanced Battle Rifle is a more compact and lightweight evolution of the Mk14 Battle Rifle. The ABR is an ergonomic rifle that can be accessorized and was designed for high accuracy. It's chambered for a 7.62x51 mm cartridge and is typically used in ranges from 600 - 800 m.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_mortar_01_base_librar: A classic 82 mm caliber mortar, equipped with a ballistic computer and easy to handle. It weighs only 21 kg and can fire various kinds of ammo: from HE (high explosive) to smokes, flares in support of infantry.

STR_A3_cfgvehicles_heli_light_02_lib: The PO-30 Orca is a transport and utility helicopter primarily developed for the Russian Air Force. The helicopter was intended to replace the Mi-8 and can be used for reconnaissance, transporting a full squad with combat gear and special operations. Armed variants of the PO-30 carry a Minigun and DAGR guided rockets.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_quadbike_base_f_libra: A quad bike is an all-terrain vehicle with low-pressure tires and handlebars for steering. The military uses quad bikes for reconnaissance and to access terrain difficult for heavier vehicles.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_b_heli_light_01_armor: A light single-engine helicopter used in special operations by the US Army since the Vietnam War. It now exists in several variants used by both military and civilian transport. The AH-9 Pawnee variant is a light helicopter with the ability to carry anti-ground fixed forward-firing weapons such as unguided rockets and machine guns to provide direct air-support for the special operations forces. The MH-9 Hummingbird is mostly used as a special forces troop transport with two outboard benches.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_rubber_duck_base_libr: An inflatable boat, often nicknamed 'Rubber Duck', is a lightweight boat constructed from tubes containing pressurized gas. Inflatables typically come in lengths between 2 to 7 meters. Due to their speed, weight and portability, inflatable boats are used in diverse roles such as lifeguard and rescue boats and even more often in the military as a landing craft.
STR_A3_CfgVehicles_mrap_02_Base_Library0: The Ifrit is a new Mine-Resistant Ambush Protected (MRAP) vehicle designed and manufactured in Russia. Its strengths lie in reliability in extreme weather conditions and crew protection, but its manufacturing costs are somewhat higher compared to other MRAPs. The Ifrit can be fitted with a RCWS turret and armed with a 12.7 mm heavy machine gun or a 40 mm grenade launcher.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_boat_armed_01_base_li: This V shaped boat with two powerful jet impellers excels in speed and maneuverability. It is used by both BLUFOR and OPFOR as a coastline guard boat and for special operations. The speedboat has a front-facing, remote controlled GMG turret. The OPFOR version is commonly equipped with a HMG in the rear, while BLUFOR speedboats are armed with a minigun.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_offroad_base_library0: The 4x4 pickup by Generic Motors is a perfect choice for farmers and hunters. The durable chassis and powerful engine have been designed to withstand anything from the cratered highways of Central Europe to the rugged terrain of the Mediterranean. The armed version is fitted either with a .50 caliber heavy machine gun or an anti-tank recoilless rifle. It provides the combination of mobility and firepower to many paramilitary and guerilla forces in local conflicts around the globe. Specialized versions, which sport a hard rear cover and rack-mounted communications equipment, are in use by law enforcement, national park rangers, and armed forces. These vehicles feature a large floodlight, loudspeakers, and long-range antennas.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_MRAP_01_base_library0:
The Hunter is a Mine-Resistant Ambush Protected (MRAP) vehicle manufactured by US arms factories to provide troops with enhanced protection. The armored hull can withstand light weapons and protects the crew against landmines and improvised explosive devices. Even though the heavy armor and powerful engine cause increased fuel consumption, it has been favored by frontline troops over the lighter vehicles for its easy maintenance and good protection level.
Armed version of the sturdy Hunter MRAP vehicle is fitted with a Remotely Controlled Weapons System turret. The turret is fitted with the universal 12.7 mm heavy machinegun or the multi-role 40 mm Grenade Machine Gun. The armed Hunters are used for troop transport in combat zones, as light reconnaissance vehicles or even in fire support role in COIN operations.

str_a3_cfgworlds_stratis_loadingtext9: There are only two settlements left on Stratis: the picturesque harbor town of Agia Marina and the small fishing village of Girna.
str_a3_cfgworlds_stratis_loadingtext8: Most roads on Stratis are just gravel trails which twist and turn into the mountains. Only 5% of roads have strengthened surface.
str_a3_cfgworlds_stratis_loadingtext7: According to legend, there is a hidden cave somewhere on the coast of Stratis, rumored to contain treasures hidden by the Arabian pirates.
str_a3_cfgworlds_stratis_loadingtext6: Part of the Agia Marina was rebuilt using simple residential houses after an earthquake damaged the town in the 1960s.
str_a3_cfgworlds_stratis_loadingtext5: In recent decades, Stratis slowly turned into a 'military island' after most of the civilian population moved to Altis.
str_a3_cfgworlds_stratis_loadingtext4: The coasts of Stratis are dangerous. Many shipwrecks can be found underwater near the coastline, including two large fishing trawlers Sofia and Apex Marshall.
str_a3_cfgworlds_stratis_loadingtext3: Stratis is of volcanic origin, with many rocks and crevices.
str_a3_cfgworlds_stratis_loadingtext14: Stratis Airfield was built on an area of artificially laid firm ground in the 1980s by the joint effort of British and US engineers.
str_a3_cfgworlds_stratis_loadingtext13: Kamino Firing Range uses remnants of the old Kamino village nearby as a target area.
str_a3_cfgworlds_stratis_loadingtext12: The Spartan, a monument in the southern part of Stratis, was built to honor the memory of Altian soldiers fighting alongside the Allies in the WW2's Operation Torch.
str_a3_cfgworlds_stratis_loadingtext11: Camp Rogain was named after the favorite pastime of NATO troops stationed in the area.
str_a3_cfgworlds_stratis_loadingtext10: Camp Maxwell was named after British surveyor Martin P. Maxwell, who laid plans for artificial ground for the Stratis Airfield.
str_a3_cfgworlds_stratis_loadingtext1: The area of Stratis is 19.3 square kilometers.

str_a3_firingdrills_timing2: Time may be deducted when you are awarded bonuses, or added when you are penalized.%1%1When competing for medals, you can beat the bronze, silver and gold times. Sometimes a special time is available.
str_a3_firingdrills_timing1: A competitor's raw time is the amount of time it takes to reach the final Check Point, or to clear all targets for some courses.
str_a3_firingdrills_targets2: %2Targets can appear immediately or after a little while.%1%2Targets can disappear after a short time.%1%2Targets can move along rails.%1%2Targets can activate after hitting another target.%1%2Sometimes only specifically colored targets should be hit.%1%2Targets may require multiple hits.%1%2Accuracy zones on targets can reduce your time when struck.%1%2Optional bonus targets lower your time.%1%2No-shoot targets must not be engaged!%1%1Targets can sometimes be randomly positioned or randomly appearing.

str_a3_firingdrills_stances1: You may be asked to employ a specific stance at a Check Point.
str_a3_firingdrills_shootingboxes1: Check Points can define specific shooting boxes. When present, it's always better to engage from within these marked boxes.
str_a3_firingdrills_checkpoints2: Each Check Point may define special requirements such as the use of a specific weapon type or stance.%1%1Keep an eye on the Check Point briefing and other indicators and memorize the CoF well by training often.

str_a3_cfghints_command_vehicles0: Order your men to get in a certain vehicle:%1%2Select your units with %3[F2-F10]%4.%1%2Press %3[4]%4 to bring up the list of nearby vehicles.%1%2Select a vehicle from the list.%1According to the vehicle type, you have the option to choose between specific positions like driver, gunner or commander.
str_a3_cfghints_command_stances0: You can adjust the direction your units are facing.%1%2Select the desired unit with %3[F2-F10]%4.%1%2Press %3[3]%4, %3[8]%4 and choose the azimuth.%1As standing units are easily seen and hit, you can order your men to kneel or go prone.%1%2Select your units with %3[F2-F10]%4.%1%2Press %3[7]%4 and choose the appropriate position.%1%2To watch for incoming enemy units on the horizon, press %3[3]%4, %3[7]%4 to %3Scan horizon%4.
str_a3_cfghints_command_formations0: As you move, you can see that your subordinates are following you in a certain formation. Try changing the default %3Wedge%4 formation to %3Line%4 or %3Column%4.%1%2Select all your units with %11.%1%2Press %3[8]%4 and choose a %3new formation%4.
str_a3_firingdrills_firingdrills1: Firing Drills are a fun shooting sport to train and compete in.%1%1Competitors complete a Course of Fire (CoF), usually consisting of a series of Check Points with targets to engage at each one.
str_a3_firingdrills_firingdrills2: They refine their skills in the areas of movement, environmental awareness, weapon handling, shooting, prioritization and creativity.
str_a3_firingdrills_rules1: Firing Drills can be completed using one of two rule-sets: training and competitive.
str_a3_firingdrills_rules2: %2Training: less strict and about familiarizing with the course. Medal times cannot be challenged while training.%1%1%2Competitive: stricter rules and competitors are penalized when breaking rules. Medal times can be beaten here!
str_a3_firingdrills_tips1: %2 Firing Drills are not meant to be aced in one attempt. Study the courses, find shortcuts and get creative.%1%1%2Observe on-screen Check Point briefings, voice instructions and other indicators to know which stance and weapon to use.%1%1%2Plan your reloads and weapon switches well! Doing this in a smart way can save you many seconds.
str_a3_firingdrills_tips2: %2Don't always trust the most direct route. Sometimes a detour can be quicker if there are no obstacles in your path.%1%1%2Consider what will cost you more time: missing a target and re-engaging it, or moving on and taking the penalty.%1%1%2Think about your aiming path from target to target, as well as clever use of fire modes. Remember that some targets offer bonuses for accuracy.%1%1%2Scan for bonus targets, but balance your search time against the gained bonuses. Check your map for clues.%1%1%2Not all targets appear upon arriving at a Check Point. Remain vigilant until the all clear is given.%1%1%2Consider your fatigue and how often you sprint. It all affects your continued performance and aiming.

str_a3_cfgweapons_lmg_zafir_f_library0: The Zafir 7.62 mm is a light machine gun mass-produced by China. It is said to be based on a copied Israeli design, which spawned a lengthy legal conflict that still remains unresolved. The Zafir is a gas-powered automatic firearm, that uses easily replaceable ammo boxes carrying up to 150 rounds. 7.62 mm caliber ammunition gives the Zafir an advantage over BLUFOR MX SW weapons when compared in power and range, but the weapon itself is heavier and less maneuverable.
str_a3_cfgweapons_smg_02_library0: The Sting is a 9x21 mm submachine gun. The weapon is designed to be used by security forces, vehicle crews and special forces. Due to its small size, accuracy, ambidextrous use and rate of fire, it became a popular SMG around the world.
STR_A3_CfgWeapons_hgun_ACPC2_Library0: The ACP-C2 is a custom version of the classic C-1911. A single-action self-loading pistol design remained and new materials allowed even better speed, precision and increased durability. The ACP-C2 is equipped with self-illuminating sights that provide a tactical advantage in low light conditions.
str_a3_cfgweapons_arifle_mk20_library0: The Mk20 is a gas-operated rotating bolt, selective-fire weapon, which was designed as a highly moddable weapon. Its design and front ejection system allows true ambidextrous use. Two other variants of Mk20 exist. The Mk20C comes with a shorter barrel suitable for close combat and the Mk20 ELGM comes with an enhanced grenade launching module.
STR_A3_cfgWeapons_launch_MPRL_short_Libr: The Titan Multi-Purpose Rocket Launcher is a shoulder system for launching guided rockets. This compact version trades increased portability for less powerful rockets and cannot launch anti-air missiles. It's adapted to be launched from closed quarters, has several modes of guidance and thanks to its advanced jet engine, it's capable of hitting even fast moving targets at short distances.
str_a3_cfgweapons_hgun_smg_01_library0: The Vermin SMG utilizes a downward pointed recoil force together with an inline design, moving barrel to line with the shooters shoulder and hand to reduce the amount of recoil as well as muzzle climb. This greatly enhances the weapon's accuracy.
str_a3_cfgweapons_launch_mprl_library0: The Titan Multi-Purpose Rocket Launcher is a shoulder system for launching guided rockets against aerial targets. It's adapted to be launched from closed quarters, has several modes of guidance and thanks to its advanced jet engine, it's capable of hitting even fast moving targets at short distances.
str_a3_heli_attack_01_lib: A two-seat attack helicopter armed with 20 mm Minigun, ASRAAM and DAGR missiles. Even though the construction dates back some time and the program faced cancelation in the first years of the 21st century, the project was finished successfully and the Blackfoot became the first attack helicopter with stealth technology applied even to the main rotor. The Blackfoot is extremely fast, agile and hard to detect even by contemporary sensors, but it's slowly becoming outdated.
str_a3_heli_transport_02_lib: A successor to the wide-spread Merlin helicopter, the CH-49 Mohawk is a primary transport used by the AAF. It can carry up to 16 soldiers plus crew. Besides the transport version, many other versions of the Mohawk exist, serving as evac, anti-submarine warfare or armed air support. Upgrades over its predecessor consist of more powerful engines and construction changes fully utilizing modern materials.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_truck_02_lib: The Zamak heavy truck is a 6x6 vehicle used for transport, repair, and utility roles. In addition, it can also carry a multiple rocket launcher. Fitted with a powerful V8 engine, these trucks are reliable even in harsh conditions.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_apc_tracked_01_base_l: While both IFV-6c Panther and IFV-6a Cheetah are based on the Israeli armored personnel carrier chassis, they serve different roles in combat. The Panther is an APC that boasts strong armor to achieve maximal protection for the transported crew. The standard Panther is armed with an RCWS HMG, 40 mm GMG and smoke grenades and it can take up to 8 soldiers in its cargo area. The Cheetah is a dedicated AA vehicle. The cargo space is taken up by ammunition storage and vehicle is armed with two 35 mm autocannons, four long range surface-to-air missiles and smoke grenades. The CRV (Combat Recovery Vehicle) variant of the IFV-6 also exists and is used by BLUFOR, designation CRV-6e Bobcat.
STR_A3_CfgVehicles_APC_Tracked_02_lib0: The infantry fighting vehicle BTR-K Kamysh and its anti-aircraft cousin ZSU-39 Tigris share the same vehicle platform. Developed by Russia with a pinch of undeniable inspiration from Israeli IFVs, they serve in the OPFOR army as a prime example of a leveling of the technology field with the West. The Kamysh is equipped with a CTWS turret fitted with a 30 mm cannon, coaxial machinegun and 2 guided AT missiles, making the vehicle significant in the infantry support role. The Tigris is fitted with a 35 mm autocannon and 4 Titan AA missiles.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_apc_wheeled_01_librar: APC (Armored Personnel Carrier) vehicles are used to deploy soldiers and to exfiltrate them away from a battlezone. The AMV-7 Marshall has a mounted 40 mm CTWS cannon and a coaxial M200 light machine gun. The vehicle is designed to sustain damage from mines and to quickly get to a designated position even in rough terrain or over water.
str_a3_CfgVehicles_apc_wheeled_02_librar: The MSE-3 Marid is an amphibious 6-wheeled APC used by the OPFOR army. It's an agile and maneuverable vehicle with a low silhouette and compact size. Its reliability and maintenance costs match the western APCs. It's fitted as standard with an RCWS turret with 40 mm GMG and 6.5 mm LMG and is able to carry up to 8 soldiers in the cargo space.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_truck_01_base_library: The Heavy Expanded Mobility Tactical Truck is an 8x8 diesel-powered off-road truck. It serves as a standard heavy transport vehicle for BLUFOR armies. There are several versions covering the basic transport functions: cargo, refuel, medical, repair, and ammo resupply.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_sdv_base_library0: The SDV is a manned submersible vehicle used to transport teams of divers over long distances under water. Its construction is based on the SEALs Delivery Vehicle from the early 21st century, but the engine and maneuverability have been increased rapidly. Divers drive the SDV while exposed to water and breathing from the vehicle's compressed air supply or using their own SCUBA gear. The SDV can take up to four passengers, but can be operated by just one person. It also contains a small compartment to store additional equipment.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_heli_attack_02_base_l: A multi-purpose successor to the Mi-24, the Mi-48 Kajman (BLUFOR designation "Hornet") is a large gunship and attack helicopter with troop transport capacity for 8 passengers. The front part of the helicopter is based on the Mi-28 attack helicopter, but the hull is modified for passenger transport. The Kajman has a coaxial rotor providing increased stability. It is armed with a 30mm three-barrel Minigun, unguided Skyfire rockets and guided Skalpel AT missiles.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_heli_transport_01_bas: The UH-80 Ghost Hawk is a BLUFOR medium-lift utility helicopter with stealth design. The Ghost Hawk was developed for special operations with a focus on deployment and extraction of troops undetected by enemy radar. Some pilots say the stealth design hindered the versatility of the helicopter compared to its predecessor, the UH-60. Nevertheless, the Ghost Hawk is now used as a primary transport helicopter in the BLUFOR army.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_mrap_03_base_library0:
The Strider is a medium all-terrain vehicle with amphibious capability and enhanced crew protection, designed for reconnaissance and troop transport roles. It has been adopted by most of the AAF as a replacement for older medium troop transports in the past decade. The unarmed version is fitted with an observation periscope package with thermal imaging and a laser marker.
The armed version of the basic troop transporter is equipped with a Remotely Controlled Weapons System turret fitted with the universal 12.7 mm heavy machinegun or the multi-role 40 mm Grenade Machine Gun. Armed versions share the observation periscope used for reconnaissance missions.
