STR_A3_CFGWeapons_Items_UAVTerminal_desc: Use this Terminal to connect to UAVs.
STR_A3_CfgVehicles_MBT_02_Arty_Library0: The 2S9 Sochor is a lightly armored self-propelled artillery piece used by the OPFOR army. It's based on the T-100 chassis and fires 155 mm projectiles. The T-100 chassis interior had to be heavily modified to allow support for the 155 mm cannon with auto-loader. Sochor is also equipped with a Remotely Controlled Weapon Systems turret fitted with 12.7 mm HMG and 40 mm GMG. The modification paid off and several Asian countries are now in the process of modernizing their heavy artillery division with the 2S9.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_mbt_01_cannon_base_f_: A licensed copy of an Israeli tank built in Central Europe. This tank is built for versatile use on the battlefield and maximal crew protection, which gained significant appreciation from western Europe armies in the 21st century. The M2A1 is armed with 120 mm cannon and a coaxial machinegun and can also be used as mobile artillery. This tank has proven itself in battle and thanks to heavy manufacture, it became the second most wide spread main battle tank of many countries in the world.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_b_apc_wheeled_01_medi: APC (Armored Personnel Carrier) vehicles are used to deploy soldiers and to exfiltrate them away from a battlezone. The vehicle is designed to sustain damage from mines and to quickly get to a designated position even in rough terrain.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_suv_base_library0: A full-size luxury crossover SUV, not particularly suitable for off-road but with good on-road performance. Its powerful engine and 4x4 contribute to the enjoyable rides in higher speeds.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_b_mbt_01_base_library: A licensed copy of an Israeli tank built in Central Europe. This tank is built for versatile use on the battlefield and maximal crew protection, which gained significant appreciation from western Europe armies in the 21st century. The M2A4 is armed with 120mm cannon and two machine-guns and can also be used as mobile artillery. This tank has proven itself in battle and thanks to heavy licensed manufacture, became the second most wide spread main battle tank of many countries in the world.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_apc_wheeled_03_wapc_l: The AFV-4 Gorgon is an amphibious 8x8 all-wheel-drive armored person carrier vehicle, used to carry soldiers to the battlefield and provide fire support. Its remote controlled CTWS turret is usually mounted with a 30 mm cannon, coaxial machinegun and 2 AT guided missiles. Crew consists of 11 soldiers including driver, gunner/commander.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_mbt_02_base_library0: A modernized version of the Russian T-95 MBT. The ongoing development of the new generation battle tank was restarted in 2016 thanks to revenues from the oil crisis. The new concept of battle tank is lower and lighter, with increased maneuverability. The T-100 Varsuk comes with a standard 125 mm cannon, 7.62 mm coaxial machine gun and a commander-controlled NSVT-M 12.7 mm HMG.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_van_01_base_library0: The civilian 4x4 truck is a highly customizable truck with off-road capabilities preferred by the civilian population. It builds on retro design, but utilizes a modern engine and electronics. Most common truck setups are boxed, cistern and pick-up set.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_b_mbt_01_mlrs_library: The Swedish Multiple Launch Rocket System is a replacement of the original U.S. MLRS platform. Built in 2021, it utilizes smaller rockets equipped with modern engines, resulting in longer range and better accuracy. The launch pod is mounted on a Slammer chassis and loads twelve 230 mm rockets.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_uav_02_base_armory0: The MQ-4A Greyhawk is a combat ready unmanned aerial vehicle. It's based on the proven U.S. design of MQ-9 with a turbo-propeller engine. It carries modernized tracking and tracing equipment and it has improved camouflage. OPFOR engineers and manufacturers were able to perfect construction, but their engines are less fuel effective. The OPFOR drone is labeled K40 Ababil-3. Both sides arm the drone with air-to-ground Scalpel missiles or laser guided bombs (CAS version).
str_a3_cfgvehicles_boat_civil_01_base_li: A luxury motorboat is an engine powered boat used by the Police and Altis' richest. Its speed and maneuverability is almost on a par with military speedboat.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_uav_01_base_library0: The Darter AR-2 is a miniature remote-controlled quadcopter equipped with laser designator. It is perfect for reconnaissance, surveillance and target designation. Darters are agile, silent and hard to detect. The ability to hover in one place and use the camera to observe a location is invaluable in setting ambushes. An OPFOR arms manufacturer was able to reverse-engineer the Darter's construction and now produces a similar vehicle. The OPFOR quadcopter is labeled as the Tayran AR-2.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_boat_civil_03_base_li: A bigger fishing boat is more expensive to maintain. When the golden age of Altis fishing ended, only a few owners were able to keep them. It has enough room for eight people.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_mbt_01_arty_base_Libr: Based on the licensed version of an Israeli tank chassis, The Scorcher M4 is a 155 mm self-propelled artillery at the end of its lifetime cycle. It has modules allowing indirect fire, advanced artillery computer and is able to fire guided cannon ammunition. The rear of the tank was changed from a passenger transport space to ammunition storage. Scorcher is also equipped with a Remotely Controlled Weapon Systems turret fitted with 12.7 mm HMG and 40 mm GMG.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_ugv_01_base_library0: The Stomper is a remote controlled unmanned ground combat vehicle designed for reconnaissance, surveillance and support. It's able to operate autonomously in large areas, while sending real-time data to the control center. Each wheel is powered by a separate electric engine, whose batteries are linked together to a diesel engine power unit. An armed variant of the Stomper is fitted with a RCWS turret carrying 40 mm cannon and 12.7 mm HMG. An OPFOR variant, designated Saif and Saif RCWS, is a cheaper and less reliable copy from the Asian region.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_car_base_library0: A four-seat hatchback car mass-produced in the Far East to satisfy increasing demand for family cars. Economical operation, enhanced safety and a roomy trunk made these cars widely popular in the whole of Europe. Also comes in a sporty version.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_c_boat_civil_04_libra: A fishing trawler is a vessel designed to operate fishing trawls. Fishing trawls are fishing nets that are dragged and pulled along the bottom of the sea or in midwater.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_o_plane_fighter_03_ca: The A-143 Buzzard is a single seat light multi-purpose combat aircraft able to carry a wide range of equipment and weaponry. A-143 Buzzard has seven weapon hardpoints, three under each wing and one under the fuselage. Close air support armament consists of 20 mm twin cannon, two Skalpel air-to-ground missiles, two laser guided GBU-12 bombs and two short range air-to-air missiles. Anti-air variant of Buzzard is fitted with 20 mm twin cannon, two short range air-to-air missiles and four long range air-to-air Zephyr missiles.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_plane_fighter_03_base: The A-143 Buzzard is a single seat light multi-purpose combat aircraft able to carry a wide range of equipment and weaponry. A-143 has seven weapon hardpoints, three under each wing and one under the fuselage. Standard armament consists of 20mm cannon, and a mixture of AA and AG rockets.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext9: The Airstrip of the Altis Aero Club was the first airfield on the island, built in 1916 by the British.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext8: Today's city of Kavala was founded by Venetian merchants on the ruins of a Phoenician city, and was the island's capital for several centuries.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext7: The population of Altis traces its origin to the Phoenician civilization of traders and explorers, but all of the rulers left traces in the populace in past centuries.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext6: The highest point of Altis is the peak of Thronos (350 m above sea level), with the ruins of a castle built by Arabian warlords in the middle ages.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext5: Pyrgos is an important port and the newly established capital of the Republic of Altis and Stratis.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext4: Total area of the Republic of Altis and Stratis is slightly smaller than twice the size of Washington, D.C.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext30: There are 49 settlements on Altis, including all towns and villages.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext3: Altis is a volcanic island with corrugated terrain and plentiful rocky areas.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext29: There is a myth that remnants of an ancient civilization lies underwater near the coast of Altis. It's possible that the shape of ancient Altis was reshaped by volcanic and tectonic activity.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext28: There are large pine forests north of Frini, covering the demand for wood for the whole archipelago.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext27: The mountain village of Oreokastro was abandoned during the civil war.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext26: The total coast length of Altis is over 200 km.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext25: The distance from Pyrgos to the north-easternmost Cap Strigla is almost 20 km.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext24: The driving distance from Pyrgos, the capital, to the ancient city of Kavala is 20 km.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext22: The Monument of Kalithea is commemorating one of the old legends pertaining to Altian history.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext21: The Agia Stemma mountain with a remarkable chapel on its top provides great views on the island, but it is extremely hard to access.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext20: The beaches of Thelos Bay and Chalkeia Bay are popular among surfers, providing the best waves in the central Mediterranean for the last few years of global climatic changes.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext2: The geographic coordinates of Altis are 35°9'5.12''N 16°39'37.60''E.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext19: Zaros is often called the 'Pine City' due to the pine groves surrounding it. The chapel overlooking the town is one of the nicest vantage points in the area.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext18: Strong winds and plenty of sun make Altis a perfect place for renewable energy sources: many wind and solar power plants have been built in the last decade, replacing two older oil-burning power plants.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext17: Many windmills are scattered across Altis, with the most notable ones in Zaros, Telos and Kore.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext16: The ruins of Pyrgos Castle can be found between the harbor and the closed complex of government offices.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext15: Most guides recommend a visit to several Antique ruins scattered over the island: the Old Kavala, the Amphitheater and Temple of Iraklia ruin over Pefkas Bay.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext14: There is a picturesque chapel on the rocky promontory over the sea in Agios Konstantinos, believed to be built on the much older remnants of an Antique temple.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext13: The mountain cave chapel of Agios Panagiotis north of Panochori is a popular place for local pilgrimages and festivities.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext12: Almyra, the biggest salt lake on Altis, serves as an auxiliary airstrip during summer, when the surface is dry and hard.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext11: There are 3 periodically flooded salt lakes in the east of Altis: Almyra, Limni and Ochrolimni.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext10: There is a desert north of village of Abdera, featuring a truly unique environment and popular sightseeing spot for adventurers.
str_a3_cfgworlds_altis_loadingtext1: Altis covers an area of 270.5 square kilometers.
str_a3_cfgweapons_smg_03_tr_base_library: The ADR-97 is a lightweight, highly maneuverable firearm with a high rate of fire, which stands out due to the 50-round magazine positioned on top of the weapon. The basic weapon comes with inbuilt collimator sights, but some variants can also be fitted with custom optics.

str_a3_wl_menu_fasttravel_info:
As long as you're on foot, you and your nearby (200 m) subordinates can instantly travel to the center of any currently controlled sector or outside a contested sector. In both cases, the sector has to be linked to your base. Note that scenario rules can override some of these settings.

If there are exclamation marks next to the destination marker, it means there are enemies nearby. The closer they are to the destination, the more exclamation marks will be shown (up to 3).

Using this feature will drain all of your stamina unless it's disabled in the scenario rules.

str_a3_wl_moddescription: %11%1Warlords is a fully modular and vastly scalable multiplayer mode where players participate in a %3Capture the Island%4 scenario through %3sector control%4. It offers both COOP and PVP gameplay, as well as a Singleplayer experience with AI teammates and opponents.%1%1BLUFOR and OPFOR are tasked with securing sectors guarded by the Independent faction. These sectors form a link between bases and generate Command Points which can then be used as currency to purchase additional troops, hardware, or other strategic advantages, such as fast travel. The first faction to capture the opposing side's starting base wins the match.

str_a3_c_rscdisplaywelcome_contact_parf: Arma 3 Contact delivers a varied range of assets, from brand-new premium content, to additional variants of existing gear, and reskinned equipment. The following premium and free additions are included in the expansion:
str_a3_c_rscdisplaywelcome_contact_pare_: use various tools, such as a mini UGV sampling laser and CBRN defense equipment, to study strange alien anomalies.
control the electromagnetic spectrum to locate, study, deceive, and ultimately defeat your enemies.
str_a3_c_rscdisplaywelcome_contact_pare: With Contact we wanted to not only make use of Arma 3's <t color='%1'>military gameplay</t>, but also explore <t color='%1'>non-combat mechanics</t>. Based on our research of first contact procedures, we ultimately arrived at two core features. We would like to point out that these features were developed primarily for the singleplayer campaign. They are often scripted, and not likely fully multiplayer compatible, hence they are available in the optional component only. Therefore, some gear may be purely <t color='%1'>cosmetic when used in the vanilla sandbox</t>, but is included so that it can still be used by content creators and their players.
str_a3_c_rscdisplaywelcome_contact_pard: Certainly one of the stars of the show is the lovingly created new <t color='%1'>Livonia sandbox terrain</t>. This huge 12x12 km terrain covers the Nadbór militarized region of a larger fictional Polish-speaking country. To populate the terrain, we've created an extensive set of new structures, props, and natural objects, complemented by objects from other Bohemia terrains. Operating in Livonia is the smaller yet capable Livonian Defense Force (LDF). But, being a NATO member state, other allied deployments in fitting woodland camouflage also occasionally visit the region. Moreover, Livonia is landlocked and shares one border with Russian territory, which prompts speculation of elite Spetsnaz operators infiltrating the country.
str_a3_c_rscdisplaywelcome_contact_parc2: Then there is an <t color='%1'>'optional'</t> part of Arma 3 Contact. This contains all the more unconventional content, such as <t color='%1'>ET</t> and the <t color='%1'>"First Contact" singleplayer campaign</t>. In order to access this content, you will need to own the expansion, and then launch the game with it optionally loaded. Do so by pressing the <t color='%1'>PLAY CONTACT</t> button in the game Launcher, or by enabling it in the DLC section and then pressing PLAY. Why separate the expansion in this way? From the start we wanted to make sure those who enjoy their authentic Arma 3 experience would not have this more sci-fi content forced into their sandbox. Additionally, the full Contact experience contains more unorthodox features, methods, technologies, and it also makes changes to core gameplay features that are not suitable for the full game.
str_a3_c_rscdisplaywelcome_contact_parc: The <t color='%1'>Arma 3 Contact expansion</t> consists of <t color='%1'>2 components</t>. There is a <t color='%1'>'default'</t> part, which is implemented in the same way as our official DLC released over the past years. This means the content is distributed to all players, and there are certain limitations if you do not yet own the expansion. That applies to the <t color='%1'>weapons</t>, <t color='%1'>vehicles</t>, <t color='%1'>character gear</t>, and similar conventional assets. Check them out without restrictions in Virtual Arsenal and Garage! There is also a new <t color='%1'>terrain</t>, for which you do need to own Contact to explore. And on top of that there's a dazzling array of sandbox additions free to all Arma 3 owners, such as a massive collection of props, 6 radio protocols, and more.
str_a3_c_rscdisplaywelcome_contact_parb: For many years our devs have enjoyed pondering the scale of the universe, and whether we Earthlings are really 'alone'. Just like many of you, we've grown up watching movies, reading books, and playing games about <t color='%1'>extraterrestrial life</t>. And for a long time we've wanted to apply this universal <t color='%1'>'what if' premise</t> to our authentic military sim-game. How would humanity react to intelligent visitors from outer space? How would our armed forces deal with such a historic event? And how would we uncover the motivations of these aliens? These were the conceptual questions we started to explore with a small team within Bohemia and reinforcements throughout production. We researched first contact protocols, approached consultants, experimented with our own tech, and ... here we are. We hope you find our interpretation of first contact as interesting as we found creating it. We want to believe!
str_a3_c_rscdisplaywelcome_contact_para: Whether you're a veteran player looking for a fresh experience, a seasoned mil-simmer wanting to deploy to a new locale, or you were drawn to Arma 3 for any other reason, we've crafted something new for you! In this <t color='%1'>military science fiction spin-off expansion</t> we've carefully designed a content pack to do something a bit more unexpected, while also enhancing the traditional Armaverse sandbox significantly. As always, we invite you to dive straight in, or let us take you through all that's on display. Welcome to <t color='%1'>Arma 3 Contact</t>!

STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_Enoch_desc: Explore a new temperate and partly abandoned summer environment ideally suited for combined arms warfare. The huge 12x12 km terrain covers the Nadbór militarized region of the larger Polish-speaking country. It is a landlocked member state of NATO, with one side bordering Russian territory. The woodland locale is covered by a big set of completely new structures, props, and natural objects, complemented by objects from other terrains.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Contact_CB_SpectrumDevi: Originally developed for the private security industry, the Spectrum Device is a small handheld transceiver with an electromagnetic spectrum analyzer. Its standard grip was designed to fit a range of directional antennas with varying frequency ranges. One common use case for these devices with security services is jamming drones. Fitted with other antennas however, they allow operators to receive and identify a myriad of signals, as well as to transmit them. An integrated screen lets users tune to desired frequency bands, but also analyze the strength and quality of signals. Several extra features have been added to the device's firmware after initial manufacturing and field feedback, including a compass and other useful navigation aids. Not originally incorporated into the grip, night use is sometimes facilitated by jerry-rigging a common flashlight to it.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_MiniUGV_desc: ED-1 is a commercial off-the-shelf series of robotic systems built upon a man-portable modular platform. The tracked mini UGV has convenient front and rear obstacle climbers that allow it to traverse relatively complex terrain. Standard lithium-ion batteries power the electric propulsion, and are placed to facilitate so-called 'hot swaps' in the field. Two primary uses in military remote operations are Explosive Ordnance Disposal and CBRN Defense. The former has an integrated mine detector and mounts a custom 12 gauge disruptor weapon on its swivel arm, intended to disable explosive devices. The latter is a literal driving laboratory, complete with a full suite of CBRN sensors, and a chemical compound sampling laser as well as telescopic biopsy probe on its arm.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_Tractor_desc: Found in farm barns across the globe, the common tractor is a reliable high torque engineering vehicle, used for towing trailers and many other agricultural tasks. This 2WD tractor with a diesel engine has proven itself reliable since the eighties. With solid maintenance and the occasional lick of fresh paint, this old workhorse has been in use by several generations of farmers to date.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_AK12_desc: Special Forces operators have applied both lush and arid camouflage spray paint to the existing AK-12 rifles, as well as several accessories and attachments.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_AKU12_desc: Another new addition to the AK-12 family is the AKU-12 for Special Forces and vehicle crews. It has a shortened barrel and special muzzle device. It too is available as plain black or with lush / arid spray paint applied.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_AvengerHelmet_: Tracing its design lineage to CSAT's advanced Protector / Defender / Assassin helmets, the Avenger helmet provides a more basic version of ballistic head protection. It is lightweight, durable, and favored by Special Forces. It retains the integrated flashlight camera, and has several small rails for extra accessories. A throat microphone and earpiece are used for communications. The Avenger helmet can be worn plain or with one of several camouflage covers.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_LDFAssaultRifl: Part of a sweeping effort to modernize the Livonian Defense Force's infantry capabilities, the Promet modular bullpup rifle became the LDF's main service rifle in late 2020. Its 6.5x39 mm caseless ammunition is the same caliber as NATO's 6.5 mm ammunition used in MX class weapons. The Promet is known for its unique detachable carry handle with integrated 2.5x magnified optics. Besides a marksman variant with extended barrel, it can also be fitted with a 40 mm underslung grenade launcher. Tactical teams can instead choose to mount an underbarrel 12 gauge shotgun module with quick-release cylinder for an extra close range punch. The rifle is manufactured in a range of color options.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_Blindfold_desc:
When prisoners need to quickly have their sight blocked, a basic piece of cloth wrapped around their heads will do the job just fine.

Note: this gear is primarily cosmetic; limited features are only available in the context of Contact's campaign and gameplay.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_RPK12_desc: The AK-12 family of weapons has been extended with the Light Machine Gun RPK-12 variant for autoriflemen. It features a longer barrel with integrated bipod and special muzzle brake, as well as modified stock for stability. High-capacity 75 round drum magazines can be loaded for prolonged fire. It is available as plain black or with lush / arid spray paint applied.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_HunterShotgun_: The Kozlice 12G is a trusty old shotgun still found in many parts of Eastern Europe. It is a low-tech yet powerful weapon typically used by hunters. Unlike some other double-barreled shotguns, the Kozlice employs an over/under design, placing the two 12 gauge barrels in vertical alignment. These can either be loaded with slug or buckshot shells. Certain criminal elements have been known to improvise sawed-off versions of the shotgun. These are easier to conceal and operate in confined spaces, but also have reduced range effectivity.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_HunterRifle_de: The existing Mk14 rifle has received a new civilian hunting version with classic walnut finish, single fire operation, and a smaller 10 round magazine.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_CBRNAPR_desc:
Full-face Air Purifying Respirators (APR) are a first line of defense against some forms of CBRN threats. They rely on manual breathing through special filters (one is typically plugged in to allow shouldering a weapon). Most designs also feature connectors for drinking canteens and communications equipment. APRs are available for both NATO and CSAT forces.

Note: this gear is primarily cosmetic; limited features are only available in the context of Contact's campaign and gameplay.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_LDF_desc: The Livonian Defense Force (LDF) is a new and relatively small military faction, ideally suited for their role of protecting the territory of Livonia. The bulk of its forces are infantry, motorized, and mechanized elements. The LDF has access to a very modest Air Force. Much of its equipment is available in distinctive woodland 'geometric' camouflage. The faction was built from a mix of new and existing assets, and is made complete by new character faces and Polish radio protocols.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_LDFUniform_des: These adjusted combat fatigues come in several variants, including an officer's uniform. They are set apart from fatigues in use elsewhere due their long jackets. Standard geometric woodland camouflage and the Livonian flag insignia are of course applied.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_CBRNCUR_desc:
The Combination Unit Respirator (CUR) is an advanced special backpack that contains a Powered Air Purifying Respiration (PAPR) and Self-Contained Breathing Apparatus (SCBA). Connected by hose to an APR, the former allows for easier breathing, while the latter creates an entirely closed circuit of breathable air. The CUR is fielded to Special Forces and tactical units who may encounter severe CBRN threats.

Note: this gear is primarily cosmetic; limited features are only available in the context of Contact's campaign and gameplay.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_LDFVest_desc: Brand-new plate carrier vests are at the disposal of LDF warfighters. They come in the geometric woodland camouflage and olive green plain variants. As has become standard, these vests were designed with modular quick-release options for pockets and pouches in mind. The heaviest version offers greater protection for sensitive parts of the body, such as the neck and groin.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_Spetsnaz_desc: Highly trained and versatile Russian Spetsnaz operators of the 223rd Special Purpose Detachment have been added. They make use of a mix of existing and new gear, but also receive new character faces and radio protocols. Much of their gear either has a taiga camouflage pattern applied or is plain green.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_OffroadCovered: Drive specialized versions of the classic 4x4 pickup with a hard rear cover and rack-mounted communications equipment (large floodlight, loudspeakers, and long-range antennas). LDF, Gendarmerie, and Forest Ranger liveries were added.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_CBRNObjects_de: Build authentic CBRN defense scenarios using a set of relevant props, like sealed transport packaging, a weather station, and more.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_LDFVehicles_de: In the LDF's motor pool you will mostly find vehicles also in use by other NATO partners, although covered in their own geometric woodland camouflage.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_LDFHelmet_desc: The LDF has access to brand-new advanced modular combat helmets. Besides basic uncovered / covered versions, there are two levels of enhanced protection provided by optional ear protectors and full chops. Standard accessory rails allow for mounting cameras, lights, and so on.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_CBRNSuit_desc:
As part of first contact protocols, CBRN over-garments are available to all NATO factions. They are made of highly advanced fabric layers with an activated carbon lining and omniphobic coating. A hood, gloves, and overboots are part of the outfit to create as much protection as possible, while still allowing limited tactical operations.

Note: this gear is primarily cosmetic; limited features are only available in the context of Contact's campaign and gameplay.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_NATOWoodland_d: Deployed to Livonia as part of a large training exercise with the LDF, NATO troops now have access to a modest range of gear in woodland MTP camouflage.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_ChemicalDetect:
By sampling nearby air, a chemical detector measures for common Chemical Warfare Agents. The rugged hand-held tool has a simple LCD display, and provides visual and audible alarms. It is sometimes mounted on vehicles.

Note: this gear is primarily cosmetic; limited features are only available in the context of Contact's campaign and gameplay.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_Civilians_desc: Various adjusted character gear pieces were added for civilian groups, such as international Astra scientists, local farmers, and looters.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_Contact_desc:
The "First Contact" singleplayer campaign and some of Contact's more experimental features and assets are only available when you launch the game with the optional DLC loaded. The easiest way of doing so is starting the Arma 3 Launcher and hitting PLAY CONTACT. For advanced configurations go to the DLC section, load Arma 3 Contact there, and press PLAY.

Note: while in this mode, several other changes are made to Arma 3, so it may not be compatible with the greater sandbox (official or user-generated).
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_DeconObjects_d: Construct decontamination lines for persons and vehicles using a big collection of objects, including a decon kit, an antidote kit, decon tents, showers, spill bunds, cleaning equipment, tarps, liquid hoses, and more.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_TrainingMuzzle:
Paired with force feedback vests worn under combat fatigues, the SIMCOM muzzle adapter allows soldiers to engage in realistic training simulations. This 6.5 mm model fits onto any NATO 6.5x39 mm muzzle, such as the MX rifle's. It allows the weapon to cycle while firing blank ammunition, but also has an integrated laser, which is used to register simulated hits on the feedback vests. As an extra safety feature, the adapter prevents an accidental live round to leave the barrel, although this does not replace safety discipline!

Note: this gear is primarily cosmetic; limited features are only available in the context of Contact's campaign and gameplay.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_EnochCP_desc: Explore the new terrain together in cooperative multiplayer by means of randomized infantry Combat Patrols.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_SCBA_desc:
The Self-Contained Breathing Apparatus (SCBA) is a padded carrier harness holding a clean air cylinder. It is connected by hose to a regulator facepiece.

Note: this gear is primarily cosmetic; limited features are only available in the context of Contact's campaign and gameplay.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_RegulatorFacep:
Regulator facepieces are used in combination with SCBA units. They provide clean air from a tank and create a closed system with a full face mask.

Note: this gear is primarily cosmetic; limited features are only available in the context of Contact's campaign and gameplay.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_TinFoilHat_des:
With all manner of electromagnetic radiation flying around these days, one can never be too sure a malicious party is not trying to control our minds. This advanced hat, made from multiple layers of carefully shaped aluminium foil, is a proven defensive measure against that form of attack.

Note: this gear is primarily cosmetic; limited features are only available in the context of Contact's campaign and gameplay.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_KipchakVest_de: In support of their mobility, Russian Spetsnaz often don the Kipchak lightweight chest rig. In addition to magazine and utility pouches, one variant sports a longer-range tactical radio. A cross-drawn chest holster is fastened to the rig for sidearms.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_EnochWarlords_: Battle it out in the competitive Warlords multiplayer mode using the new factions in their locale.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_RadioPack_desc: Electronic warfare and communications specialists can now be equipped with modular radio packs, which not only provide room for secure long-range comms gear, but also extra capacity for batteries and miscellaneous items. Radio packs are available in all faction camo patterns.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_GranitSuit_des: Russian Spetsnaz operating in Livonia commonly wear lightweight tactical suits that are almost fully rainproof. They are visually set apart by their two-tone paneled design, available in several color combinations.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_EnochZGM_desc: A new terrain means compatible multiplayer Zeus Game Master instances, all set up for the relevant fighting factions.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_EWObjects_desc: Add Electronic Warfare elements to your missions by placing various antennas, satellite dishes, and other such props.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_HEMTTCargo_des: Catering to a wider variety of cargo loads, the HEMTT heavy truck receives additional cargo and flatbed variants. The flatbed rack is also available as a separate prop.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_FieldObjects_d: Find everything you need to build convincing Forward Operating Bases, outposts and camps with a huge collections of rugged equipment, terminals, furniture, lamps, solar panels, power cables, cargo platforms, and a lot more - all suitable for multiple terrain types.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_MiscObjects_de: Embellish your compositions with several miscellaneous props, such as books, a newspaper, solar-powered camping tents, etc.
STR_A3_C_CfgMods_Enoch_CB_RadioProtocols: Primarily meant for the LDF and Russian Spetsnaz, you now have access to 3 Polish and 3 Russian full radio protocols for character identities.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText1: The geographic coordinates of Nadbór are 54°14'58.1"N 22°51'42.6"E.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText2: The early inhabitants of Livonia spoke a Balto-Slavic language but adopted Polish during the Middle Ages.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText3: The Nadbór Region became an army training area in the 1990s. Since 2035, it has grown extensively to accommodate biennial military exercises, held between NATO member states.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText4: The abandoned SIŁA Factory was once renowned for producing one of the world's finest sport and hunting rifles.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText5: The River Biela is personified as a benevolent spirit in Livonian mythology, often in the form of a white snake.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText6: The hills to the south of Nadbór appear in folklore as the seat of an ancient and unspeakable evil.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText7: A popular pub on Dambog Hill was demolished in the 1970s and replaced by a military observation tower.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText8: Livonia was part of the Soviet Union from 1940. It gained its independence in 1991, during the Singing Revolution.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText9: Despite being a Polish-speaking, landlocked country, Livonia is generally recognized as a Baltic state on account of its shared history, heritage, and culture.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText10: Livonia's megalithic sites are rarely considered genuine. All too often, they are dismissed as the work of the country's National Rebirth movement.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText11: Although the Nadbór Region is thought to have been inhabited since prehistoric times, no serious archaeological research has ever been conducted.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText12: The Biela River Valley is known locally as the "Valley of Blossoms", owing to its rich agricultural production.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText13: Forest management within the Nadbór training area is overseen by the Military Forests Directorate and enforced by armed Forest Rangers.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText14: The town of Nadbór is situated inside a much larger military exclusion zone. It is connected to the outside world by a road corridor, leading to nearby Gieraltów.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText15: Deer are not what they seem...
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText16: Occasionally, urban explorers are caught trespassing at the old Swarog radar station and SIŁA arms factory.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText17: Nadbór was excluded from the military training area, as it was originally the home for many workers at the SIŁA arms factory.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText18: The Nadbór Region is rumored to be the birthplace of traditional Livonian "jarzębnica" - oatmeal topped with bitter-sour rowanberry jam.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText19: The Wrzeszcz crossroads are strategically important, yet NATO exercises rarely encompass them.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText20: The town of Topolin saw fierce fighting between a Soviet penal battalion and retreating Wehrmacht troops on December 31, 1944.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText21: The last anti-Soviet partisans were allegedly hiding in the hills around Nadbór as late as 1965.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText22: The biggest deer ever hunted in Livonia was a 32-point stag, shot in the Muratyn forest district in 1864.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText23: The yellow of Livonia's flag suggests hope for the future and continuity with the past. The white represents peace and justice, while the blue signifies freedom and the distant Baltic Sea.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText24: The ruins near Bielawa mark the site of Branżów Castle, which opposed the Knights of the Teutonic Order until 1306.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText25: Jan of Branżów (c. 1213 - 1265) was known as the 'Bloody Baron' after his heroic feats during the Battle of Bajorki.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText26: Topolin is the district capital of the Upper Biela Valley Region.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText27: Before the outbreak of WW2, Livonian armed forces followed Poland's military doctrine and built a number of fortified defensive lines.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText28: The highly militarized Nadbór Region is part of Andrzejów, one of Livonia's three administrative divisions.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText29: The Livonian Romantic composer, Grzegorz Brzęczyszczykiewicz, wrote the famous "Livonian Suite" after visiting Polana in 1842.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText30: Livonia's emblem is the stag, symbolizing independence, indomitability, and instinctual readiness. The antlers - shed and regrown annually - reflect the nation's post-Soviet restoration and continual rebirth.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText31: There are 54 bunkers scattered across the Nadbór Region.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText32: The so-called "Andrzejów Gap" is south of Nadbór and runs through the heart of Livonia. It is of great strategic importance, linking NATO Baltic States to the rest of Europe.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText33: Fireflies or Lightning Bugs can be found all across Livonia. The females are famed for their yellowish-green, bioluminescent glow.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText34: According to official data, there are around 700 wolves in Livonia.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText35: Many mushrooms grow in the forests of Livonia. Some are edible, while others, such as the brown-capped Deadly Galerina, are highly poisonous.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText36: Livonia was founded in 1920 by Zbigniew Sokolski, a Polish mutineer general, sympathetic to refugees fleeing war and political turmoil in the northern Baltic States.
STR_A3_C_CfgWorlds_Enoch_LoadingText37: Livonia borders Lithuania, Belarus, Poland, and the Kaliningrad Region of Russia.
STR_A3_C_CfgHints_OptionalDLC_desc: For the first many years of <t %5>Arma 3</t>'s existence, we've adopted a <t %5>DLC strategy</t> that distributed all DLC data to all players, regardless of ownership. We refer to this as <t %5>default DLC</t> (Helicopters, Tanks, and Laws of War are examples).%1%1We have now entered a stage of Arma 3's tour of duty during which we want to try some more things on the platform, such as opening the doors to third-party Creator DLC. This officially published but externally developed DLC cannot be part of the main game data, since it's too large and / or often adjusts parts of the vanilla experience as a Total Conversion. We refer to this as <t %5>optional DLC</t>.%1%1Upon purchase, optional DLC automatically downloads. But you then <t %5>have to manually activate it in the game's Launcher</t> whenever you want to use it.
STR_A3_C_CfgHints_PremiumEnoch_desc: Enjoy various authentic additions to the Arma 3 sandbox courtesy of the Contact expansion.%1%11%1%2Livonia - a new temperate and partly abandoned summer environment ideally suited for combined arms warfare%1%2Humans - various small new and expanded human factions, including the Livonian Defense Force, woodland NATO forces, Russian Spetsnaz, CBRN specialists, looters, and scientists%1%2Mini UGV - a pair of man-portable robotic ground systems%1%2Tractor - your everyday farming vehicle%1%2Offroad Covered - additional hard cover and communications options for the 4x4 pickup%1%2HEMTT Cargo - extra transport capabilities for NATO's heavy truck%1%2Promet - a new assault rifle for the Livonian Defense Force, including an underbarrel shotgun option%1%2Kozlice - a simple double-barreled shotgun with sawed-off variant%1%2AK-12 - lush and arid spray paint camo variants for this weapon family and various accessories%1%2RPK-12 - a new Light Machine Gun member in the AK-12 family with drum magazine%1%2AKU-12 - another addition to the AK-12 family in the form of a light carbine variant%1%2Mk14 Classic - a civilian hunting rifle variant of the military-issue Mk14%1%2LDF Fatigues - combat fatigues worn by the Livonian Defense Force%1%2LDF Helmet - a collection of modular protective combat helmets worn by the Livonian Defense Force%1%2LDF Vest - brand-new load-bearing tactical vests equipped by the Livonian Defense Force%1%2Granit Suit - two-tone combat outfits for Russian Spetsnaz%1%2Avenger Helmet - tactical helmets for Russian Spetsnaz%1%2Kipchak Vest - load-bearing vests for Russian Spetsnaz%1%2SCBA - a Self-Contained Breathing Apparatus%1%2Regulator Facepiece - a full-face mask to connect to SCBAs%1%2CBRN Suit - sealed off over-garments to protect against Chemical Biological Radiological and Nuclear threats%1%2CUR - a tactical Powered-APR and SCBA Combination Unit Respirator%1%2APR - NATO and CSAT full-face Air Purifying Respirators to protect against CBRN contaminants%1%2Radio Pack - a long-range transceiver backpack for comms specialists%1%2Blindfold - a basic piece of cloth wrapped around a prisoner's head%1%2Tin Foil Hat - the preferred option for defense against mind control!%1%2Miscellaneous Objects - a massive set of new props to build scenarios with, ranging from CBRN, decontamination, Electronic Warfare, field outposts, and much more%1%2Livonia Multiplayer - instances of Zeus Game Master, Warlords and Combat Patrol set on the new terrain and using relevant factions%1%2Radio Protocols - all-new Polish and Russian voice sets%1%2Official Soundtrack - newly composed music tracks
STR_A3_C_CfgHints_OptionalDLC_tip: Compatibility is not guaranteed when launching the game with multiple optional DLC active at the same time.
str_a3_exp_m05_sp_signal:
%2Raider 1%1 - Lead element.
%2Raider 2%1 - Supporting team.
%3Keystone%1 - Group 14 Operative.

Watchtower - CTRG Headquarters.
Kingfish 1 - Boat Extraction.
Angel 1-3 - Supporting helicopter.
str_a3_exp_m05_sp_y25_boats_grm_0: Raider 1 to Watchtower. On boat leaving Balavu. Over.
str_a3_exp_m05_sp_y25_boats_wat_0: Knew you could handle it, Raider 1, outstanding.
str_a3_exp_m05_sp_y25_boats_wat_1: Angel 1-3's in the fold. No casualties. Standby, we're sourcing maritime escort from local CIVPOL. Out.
str_a3_exp_m05_sp_extract_description: Find one of the boats near %2Katkoula%1, %3Lalai%1 or %4insertion boats%1 and leave the island.
str_a3_exp_m05_sp_debriefing: Despite multiple problems with extraction, you were able to escape from the island in a boat.
str_a3_exp_m05_sp_y1_warning_knx_0: Weapons up, Raider 2. LZ's open and could be hot.
str_a3_exp_m05_sp_y19_splash_grm_0: Roger, Watchtower, we can improvise - out.
str_a3_exp_m05_sp_y19_splash_wat_1: Listen, we're going to see if we can un-fuck the situation for you.
str_a3_exp_m05_sp_y19_splash_wat_2: Satellite intel confirms there are multiple means of egress at Katkoula and Lalai.
str_a3_exp_m05_sp_y19_splash_wat_3: Rigid-hulled inflatables and motorboats. Considering your skillset, you shouldn't have trouble stealing one.
str_a3_exp_m05_sp_y19_splash_wat_4: Syndikat are active at both locations however, so exercise caution. Avoid contact.
str_a3_exp_m05_sp_y19_splash_wat_5: Don't forget your infil either, those landing craft are right where you left them.
str_a3_exp_m05_sp_y19_splash_wat_6: Additional EVAC options are off the table. I'm sorry, but we've got to call force closure.
str_a3_exp_m05_sp_y17_strike_rik_1: Better clear out, artillery's inbound - you're the new actual. Command's working on a gameplan; update in five.
str_a3_exp_m05_sp_y10_moveback_rik_0: Keystone and majority Raider elements RTB on Angel, minus figures three, I say again, we are minus figures three!
str_a3_exp_m05_sp_y10_moveback_rik_1: Requesting permission to put down and re-engage, how copy? Over.
str_a3_exp_m05_sp_y10_moveback_wat_1: Copy, Raider 1. Negative. Primary task has precedence. Allocate TACON - we'll send ordnance to on-call target. ETA one mike.
str_a3_exp_m04_sp_signal:
%1Raider 1%2 - Your team.
%3Raider 2%2 - Lead Element.
Watchtower - CTRG Headquarters.
str_a3_exp_m04_sp_mission:
You will be inserted at %1an LZ%2 north-west of the %3target area%2, to establish blocking position. %4Raider 2%2 will insert to the south and reach %5main objective%2.
Once you establish blocking position, Raider 2 will attemt to capture %6Warlock%2. Once he is in custody, you are to proceed to the %7primary exfil point%2 and await extraction together with Raider 2.
str_a3_exp_m04_sp_extract_description: Find Raider 2 north of Namavuka, at grid %1.
str_a3_exp_m04_sp_execution:
1. Establish %1Blocking Position%2
2. Wait for capture of %3Warlock%2.
3. Move to %4primary exfil.%2
str_a3_exp_m04_sp_capture_description: Establish blocking position to cut off enemy reinforcements.
str_a3_exp_m04_sp_pre05_blocking_knx_0: One, this is Raider 2. Touching down.
str_a3_exp_m04_sp_pre05_blocking_rik_0: Received - connecting feed now... okay, visual, 5 by 5, wait out.
str_a3_exp_m04_sp_pre02_spooked_grm_1: Damn it. They don't seem spooked...?
str_a3_exp_m04_sp_pre02_spooked_rik_1: No. Let's not give them the chance to call it in.
str_a3_exp_m04_sp_pre01_orders_grm_0: Riker. Stage's set, four targets, ready to fire.
str_a3_exp_m04_sp_43_attruck_knx_0: Riker, I cordially invite you to go fuck yourself.
str_a3_exp_m04_sp_41_r2found_grm_0: I got cutoff. Riker and the others - they're heading to the secondary exfil point
str_a3_exp_m04_sp_41_r2found_knx_0: Grimm, what the hell? You're on your own?
str_a3_exp_m04_sp_41_r2found_knx_1: Amateur hour's over then, huh? No problem - just, uh, you know - try and keep the pace, we ain't stoppin'.
str_a3_exp_m04_sp_39_report_3_grm_0: Raider 2, I'm approaching, watch your fire.

str_a3_showcase_vtol_tsk_taru_desc: Escort Dragonfly 7 from the %2airfield%1 to %3Lijnhaven%1. They will deliver reinforcements to our units defending the city.
str_a3_showcase_vtol_tsk_takeoff_desc: Take off from the airport using the designated runway or by increasing your vertical thrust.
str_a3_showcase_vtol_tsk_rtb_desc: RTB and roll to the %2entrance of your hangar%1.
str_a3_showcase_vtol_tsk_rescue_desc: Take the injured pilot to the %2first aid station%1 near Katkoula.
str_a3_showcase_vtol_tsk_pilots_desc:
Find Lion 5, a downed To-199 Neophron pilot. He should be %2somewhere in the vicinity of Vagalala%1. Look for a red smoke signal and land nearby.

Exercise caution, as the enemy will be searching for Lion 5 as well. Try to make the CSAR as fast as possible - we won't have anyone available to search for you, if you suffer a similar fate...
str_a3_showcase_vtol_tsk_pickup_desc: Collect Rhino 3 - a squad of paratroopers - from %2Bala Airfield%1. The long runway enables you to land horizontally.
str_a3_showcase_vtol_tsk_paradrop_desc:
Drop Rhino 3 over %2Tuvanaka Island%1. Remember, to accomplish the objective safely, you will need to fly at least 80 meters above ground and at a speed of 200 kilometers per hour.

NATO forces from the Tuvanaka base have probably retreated to the mainland after our preliminary strike. Be warned, however, this information is not currently verified.
str_a3_showcase_vtol_tsk_maintenance_des: Land at the airport and follow the %2maintenance%1 procedure to repair, refuel and rearm your VTOL.
str_a3_showcase_vtol_tsk_ifvs_desc:
NATO has the upper hand when it comes to armored combat vehicles - our Marids are no match for their AMV-7s and 40mm cannons. Locate and destroy at least two of them to improve the strategic situation on the ground and elevate the morale of our troops.

Locations:
%2Sugarcane factory%1 - one confirmed, another possible
%3Harcourt%1 - one damaged during an assault on the city
%4Georgetown%1 - one spotted near the harbor, but it might have relocated

Take great care when you deal with these IFVs - their FCS can easily track low and slow-flying aircraft.
str_a3_showcase_vtol_tsk_gunship_desc: Shoot down the enemy attack helicopter. Or else, attempt to lure it towards our own anti-air defences.
str_a3_showcase_vtol_tsk_getin_desc: Get in your %2Y-32 Xi'an VTOL%1 and join your gunner.
str_a3_showcase_vtol_situation:
Our units on Tanoa are in a fierce battle with NATO expeditionary forces. Although we have an advantage in the air, our opponent has committed a large number of superior ground vehicles, stalling our advance in places and forcing us to retreat in others.

If we cannot outmaneuver the enemy or reduce the threat of their armored assets, this whole operation could end in a stalemate. Needless to say, we can't let that happen.
str_a3_showcase_vtol_signal:
Shark 1 - your callsign
Swordfish - commanding officer, ATC
Rhino 3 - paratrooper squad
Dragonfly 6 - Mi-290 Taru support helicopter
Dragonfly 7 - Mi-290 Taru transport helicopter
str_a3_showcase_vtol_showcase_summary_te: VTOL aircraft, Overhauled radar functionality, New sensors and data link features
str_a3_showcase_vtol_missionoverview: Use your Y-32 Xi'an VTOL to support friendly troops against NATO forces on Tanoa.
str_a3_showcase_vtol_mission:
As a pilot of a Y-32 Xi'an VTOL, you'll be supporting our forces in battle.

Do not actively engage the enemy with troops on board - their transportation to the combat zone is priority. Once we have boots on the ground, you are free to attack targets of opportunity or provide close air support upon request.

Major NATO positions are marked on your map - avoid these areas, as they have solid AA protection. Although our adversary has no self-propelled anti-aircraft guns on Tanoa, they do have man-portable anti-air defense systems.

In case of damage or shortage of fuel, land back at the airport and resupply at the maintenance area.
str_a3_showcase_vtol_fail_02: Friendly units were KIA because of you...
str_a3_showcase_vtol_execution:
1. Get in your %2Y-32 Xi'an VTOL%1
2. Take off from the %3airport%1
3. Load Rhino 3 from %4Bala Airstrip%1
4. Drop Rhino 3 over %5Tuvanaka Island%1
5. Escort Dragonfly 7 with reinforcements from %3airport%1 to %6Lijnhaven%1
6. %7RTB%1 in case of no new orders
