str_a3_exp_m05_15_expositiontwo_rik_0: It's not the priority now. We'll sort out the details later.
str_a3_exp_m05_15_expositiontwo_sal_0: All these Chinese, Russian, Iranian weapons we keep finding - and who knows what else - someone's bringing them in.
str_a3_exp_m05_10_expositionone_grm_0: We had a run-in with them. I heard Mandarin. Is it CSAT?
str_a3_exp_m05_10_expositionone_mil_0: I'll bring you up to speed once we're clear.
str_a3_exp_m05_10_expositionone_sal_0: So, what's the story? Who took you hostage?
str_a3_exp_m05_10_expositionone_sal_1: CSAT definitely aren't meant to be here.
str_a3_exp_m05_05_onthemove_grm_0: Yeah, from Group 14. Hey, how you holding up, Captain?
str_a3_exp_m05_05_onthemove_grm_1: And Truck? How you doing back there?
str_a3_exp_m05_05_onthemove_rik_0: Salvo, shut it. Raider 2, move to exfil.
str_a3_exp_m05_05_onthemove_sal_1: So what, Truck, you're like a bullet magnet these days?
str_a3_exp_m05_05_onthemove_trk_1: Hit my plate. Put me on my ass - but no real injuries.
str_a3_exp_m05_00_movetobeach_com_0: I say again, waterborne asset inbound. Callsign Kingfish 1. All callsigns move to primary exfil.
str_a3_exp_m05_00_movetobeach_com_1: Understood. Be aware, Syndikat PAC's still observed in the area.
str_a3_exp_m05_00_movetobeach_rik_0: Roger. Raider 1 stays with Keystone, Raider 2 will move on point. Over.
str_a3_exp_m06_situation:
Captain Miller has revealed to us the existence of CSAT's clandestine operatives, codename 'Viper', and has confirmed their base of operations to be on %1Sosovu Island%2, a former Japanese stronghold last occupied during the Second World War.

Worryingly still, we have reason to believe that Viper are housing an Eastwind Device on the island capable of triggering a natural disaster.

Your mission is to locate the Device, secure it and any other intel you find, and assist with its extraction.
str_a3_exp_m06_signal:
%1Raider 1%2 - Lead element.
%3Raider 2%2 - Your team.
Watchtower - CTRG Headquarters.
Keystone - Captain Miller.
str_a3_exp_m06_rv_description: Miller has located %1Viper's base of operations%2. Meet him there.
str_a3_exp_m06_position5_description: Remove all hostiles from the vicinity of the eastern outpost, codename %1'Montana'%2.
str_a3_exp_m06_position4_description: Remove all hostiles from the vicinity of the north-western outpost, codename %1'Nebraska'%2.
str_a3_exp_m06_position3_description: Remove all hostiles from the vicinity of the western outpost, codename %1'Virginia'%2.
str_a3_exp_m06_position2_description: Remove all hostiles from the vicinity of the south-western outpost, codename %1'Washington'%2.
str_a3_exp_m06_position1_description: Remove all hostiles from the vicinity of the central outpost, codename %1'Texas'%2.
str_a3_exp_m06_patrol_description: Neutralize the remnants of the %1enemy patrol%2.
str_a3_exp_m06_overview: Acting on intel uncovered by Captain Miller, Group 15 are sent to a former WW2 outpost in search of Viper.
str_a3_exp_m06_mission:
%1You%2 will %3insert%2 on %4Sosovu Island%2 and, with the assistance of Captain Miller, remove all enemy forces from its shores before proceeding to locate Viper's base of operations. The objective is the safe extraction of the Eastwind Device.

%5Raider 1%2 will clear %6Yasa Island%2, concentrating on the %7enemy mortar%2 position. Once their objectives have been met, they will assist you with the capture of %4Sosovu Island%2.
str_a3_exp_m06_miller_description: Rendezvous with Captain Miller at his position.
str_a3_exp_m06_landing_description: Remove all hostile forces in the vicinity of the landing area on the northern coast.
str_a3_exp_m06_execution:
1. Capture %1Sosovu Island%2.
2. Locate Viper's base of operations.
3. Secure and extract the Eastwind Device.
str_a3_exp_m06_end1_description: Sosovu Island was captured and Viper's base of operations was discovered. However, the Eastwind Device has disappeared.
str_a3_exp_m06_drone_description: Move to the drone and investigate.
str_a3_exp_m06_cti_description: Eliminate all Syndikat forces on %1Sosovu Island%2.
str_a3_exp_m06_x20_drone_info_mil_0: What I was going to suggest was that you may be able to hack Viper's network using that drone.
str_a3_exp_m06_x20_drone_info_mil_1: If you happen across any more drones on your adventures, feel free to give it a shot.
str_a3_exp_m06_x20_drone_info_mil_2: You'll need a terminal to do so. Check their cargo bins, there may be one there.
str_a3_exp_m06_x10_skipping_drone_mil_0: Raider 2, I thought I told you to check the drone.
str_a3_exp_m06_x05_skipping_patrol_mil_0: Raider 2, we need to dust that patrol.
str_a3_exp_m06_x01_skipped_miller_mil_0: Gents, when I give you an order, I expect you to follow it.
str_a3_exp_m06_x01_skipped_miller_mil_1: 3 times Syndikat PAC's to the north. Sort them out.
str_a3_exp_m06_b30_greenlight_com_1: The operation has a green light. Go get this done, Scott.
str_a3_exp_m06_b30_greenlight_lia_0: Alright. We can deal with the operational specifics once we're connected.
str_a3_exp_m06_b25_onmission_com_0: Two teams are en route to Balavu province now. Time is of the essence.
str_a3_exp_m06_b25_onmission_com_1: The priority is finding the Eastwind Device and any intel related to it.
str_a3_exp_m06_b25_onmission_mil_0: Exactly. We need to hit them now before Viper can fold their operation.
str_a3_exp_m06_b25_onmission_mil_1: We'll run ashore, advance into the island, and flush Viper out of hiding.
str_a3_exp_m06_b23_viperblacksite_lia_0: And, what? Syndikat leadership just plays along with CSAT's 'earthquake weapon'?
str_a3_exp_m06_b23_viperblacksite_lia_1: I see. So, what's the situation now?
str_a3_exp_m06_b23_viperblacksite_mil_0: I can't say if Warlock knows who he's really dealing with, let alone that they may be responsible for the disaster. Frankly, it's not my concern.
str_a3_exp_m06_b23_viperblacksite_mil_1: Just before I was captured, I discovered the existence of a Viper black site. What I care about is getting some concrete intel.
str_a3_exp_m06_b20_projecteastwind_com_0: Project Eastwind. One sec, I'll bring it up.
str_a3_exp_m06_b20_projecteastwind_lia_0: 'Viper'? Where have I heard that before..?
str_a3_exp_m06_b20_projecteastwind_mil_0: The fact is, we have scant intel. The little we have is classified.
str_a3_exp_m06_b20_projecteastwind_mil_1: CTRG has been tracking a clandestine network of CSAT operatives. We know them as 'Viper'.
str_a3_exp_m06_b20_projecteastwind_mil_2: Group 14 got close in the Med, but the opportunity slipped away.
str_a3_exp_m06_b20_projecteastwind_mil_3: Bottom line: we believe Viper possess the means - a device - to trigger a natural disaster.
str_a3_exp_m06_b20_projecteastwind_mil_4: It's clear they're using Tanoan dissidents as cover.
str_a3_exp_m06_b15_csatagenda_com_0: Let's get to the meat of this, shall we?
str_a3_exp_m06_b15_csatagenda_lia_0: Hold on now, that makes no sense. It was a goddamn Tsunami, Captain.
str_a3_exp_m06_b15_csatagenda_mil_0: As we understand it, they aim to destabilise the region by proxy.
str_a3_exp_m06_b15_csatagenda_mil_1: In fact, it's my opinion that they're responsible for the Pacific disaster itself.
str_a3_exp_m06_b10_csatconnection_lia_0: Wait. You guys have been operating here before we brought you in to deal with our Syndikat problem?
str_a3_exp_m06_b10_csatconnection_mil_0: Over the past 4 weeks I've been on the ground and - in the last 4 days - focused on the Northern Division.
str_a3_exp_m06_b10_csatconnection_mil_1: Yes. Although the connection wasn't clear, at first.
str_a3_exp_m06_b10_csatconnection_mil_2: It's clear now that a covert CSAT presence has been giving Syndikat all sorts of hardware.
str_a3_exp_m06_b05_millerintro_com_0: Okay, we're on with CTRG 2 i/c, Captain, Scott Miller. Callsign: Keystone. Scott, you there?
str_a3_exp_m06_b05_millerintro_com_1: Scott, I'm here with our NATO SOF Liaison, Vince Broadale.
str_a3_exp_m06_b05_millerintro_com_2: Okay, Scott, bring Vince up to speed. Everything you know.
str_a3_exp_m06_b05_millerintro_lia_0: Good to hear from you, Captain.
str_a3_exp_m06_b01_briefingstart_com_0: Ready? We're on a timeline here.
str_a3_exp_m06_95_apex_mil_0: Good to see you, Raider 2. Looks like we've hit the jackpot.
str_a3_exp_m06_95_apex_mil_1: There's some key data here. Maps, schematics, documents, imagery.
str_a3_exp_m06_95_apex_mil_2: Highly classified CSAT material. It all points to some type of doctrine.
str_a3_exp_m06_95_apex_mil_3: But it seems we have bigger problems. The Eastwind Device was here. Now it's not.
str_a3_exp_m06_90_rendezvous_com_0: Roger, sending transport. The helicopter's turn-around is gonna be longer than expected. You may as well dig-in. Out to you.
str_a3_exp_m06_90_rendezvous_com_1: Raider 2, RV with Keystone and post security until transport arrives. Out.
str_a3_exp_m06_90_rendezvous_mil_1: Boss, I've located Viper's FOB. Grid 028-094. Roger my last, over.
str_a3_exp_m06_85_self_destruct_mil_1: They're detonating the drones. Get away from them, rapid!
str_a3_exp_m06_80_island_captured_com_0: Raider 2, Watchtower. All points of interest are clear. Great work.
str_a3_exp_m06_75_corpses_mil_0: Riker, looks like Syndikat caught up with Viper. It's a mess.
str_a3_exp_m06_70_drone_destroyed_mil_0: Looks like you lost a drone, Raider 2. Seems they're pretty fragile. Use them sparingly.
str_a3_exp_m06_65_terminal_reminder_mil_: You'll need a terminal to slave that drone.
str_a3_exp_m06_60_turret_spotted_mil_0: You're looking at CSAT's autonomous grenade turret. Hoofin piece of kit.
str_a3_exp_m06_60_turret_spotted_mil_1: It's extremely temperamental, but the 20mil will ruin anyone's day.
str_a3_exp_m06_55_ugv_spotted_mil_0: That's a 'Saif' UGV. Basically a remote weapon system.
str_a3_exp_m06_55_ugv_spotted_mil_1: While not invincible, it's accurate as hell, and sports a fifty and a 20 mil GL.
str_a3_exp_m06_50_terminal_spotted_mil_0: That station controls an aerial drone, Raider 2. You'll need a UAV terminal to hack it.
str_a3_exp_m06_45_reveal_com_1: A large Syndikat incursion force has run ashore north of Sosovu Island's main settlement. Several mounted and dismounted PAC's observed.
str_a3_exp_m06_45_reveal_com_2: Intel's of the same mind. We're running contingencies now.
str_a3_exp_m06_45_reveal_com_3: Even though Syndikat's sub-par, complacency kills. Stay sharp. Out.
str_a3_exp_m06_45_reveal_sal_0: I doubt Viper would invite a bunch of thugs to run around their FOB.
str_a3_exp_m06_45_reveal_grm_0: Sounds like Syndikat are pissed off.
str_a3_exp_m06_45_reveal_mil_0: It's possible Syndikat learned of Project Eastwind.
str_a3_exp_m06_40_drones_attack_mil_0: If you can get close, you should be able to slave control to your terminal.
str_a3_exp_m06_40_drones_attack_mil_1: Fuck. Looks like their guidance systems are offline. You'll have to pilot them manually.
str_a3_exp_m06_40_drones_attack_mil_2: As you crack that task, I'll recce the Viper black site. Have fun with your new toys.
str_a3_exp_m06_35_uav_first_mil_0: You should also be able to see what grid the other drones are in, too.
str_a3_exp_m06_30_uav_connected_mil_0: Aerial drone's all yours. Control authority transferred to your terminal.
str_a3_exp_m06_25_drones_revealed_mil_0: You should now see the locations of the remaining drones on the island.
str_a3_exp_m06_25_drones_revealed_mil_1: Looks like Viper's got one circling overhead, too. You'll need to access its control station if you want to use it.
str_a3_exp_m06_15_drone_connect_mil_1: Raider 2, that drone'll be connected to Viper's network. If you have a terminal, try to force your way in.
str_a3_exp_m06_15_drone_connect_mil_2: May even be one in its cargo bins.
str_a3_exp_m06_10_patrol_dead_mil_1: ... Raider 2, move in on that drone please.
str_a3_exp_m06_105_apexreport_com_0: Acknowledged, Keystone. Grab whatever intel you can - and get us some footage of that Viper camp.
str_a3_exp_m06_105_apexreport_mil_0: Watchtower, Keystone. Objective is now clear.
str_a3_exp_m06_105_apexreport_mil_1: We've located the Viper black site, but no sign of the Device. I say again, Eastwind Device is not here, over.
str_a3_exp_m06_05_surprised_rik_0: Raider 2, Raider 1, SITREP. We've got Syndikat PAC's on Yasa Island.
str_a3_exp_m06_05_surprised_rik_1: Looks like they're part of this mess, too. Keep your eyes open.
str_a3_exp_m06_03_patrol_mil_0: Sighting. We have 3 times PAC's, 11 o'clock, lightly armed. Oddly enough, they're Syndikat.
str_a3_exp_m03_tasks_tsk_destroy4_descri: Destroy the fourth stockpile of Syndikat supplies.
str_a3_exp_m03_tasks_tsk_destroy3_descri: Destroy the third stockpile of Syndikat supplies.
str_a3_exp_m03_tasks_tsk_destroy2_descri: Destroy the second stockpile of Syndikat supplies.
str_a3_exp_m03_tasks_tsk_destroy1_descri: Destroy the first stockpile of Syndikat supplies.
str_a3_exp_m03_tasks_tsk_chopper_descrip: Rendezvous with Angel 3-2 at the %2abandoned observatory%1.
str_a3_exp_m03_tasks_tsk3_description: Exfil from the vicinity of the lumberyard.
str_a3_exp_m03_tasks_tsk2_description: Locate and destroy all Syndikat supply stockpiles within the lumberyard.
str_a3_exp_m03_tasks_tsk1_description: Move to the %2Syndikat facility%1 while avoiding the %3enemy checkpoint%1.
str_a3_exp_m03_sitreptext_1: Central Tanoa, north-west of the Syndikat facility
str_a3_exp_m03_overview: Following Syndikat's unchecked aggression towards the citizens of Tanoa, Group 15 launch an operation to draw out their leadership.
str_a3_exp_m03_debriefing_2_description: You successfully destroyed all of Syndikat's supply stockpiles. This will definitely bring Warlock out of hiding.
str_a3_exp_m03_debriefing_1_description: You successfully destroyed most of Syndikat's supply stockpiles. Hopefully this will bring Warlock out of hiding.
str_a3_exp_m03_briefing_situation_3: With the assistance of Raider 1, you are to locate and destroy all Syndikat supply stockpiles within the vicinity of the lumberyard.
str_a3_exp_m03_briefing_situation_1: Blue Cap has informed us of a major %2Syndikat facility masked as a lumberyard%1 in central Tanoa. Recent satellite imagery suggests a large shipment of weapons and supplies has just come in, bound for the far reaches of Syndikat-controlled territory. The loss of these supplies would deal a major blow to Syndikat's operations and may just flush Warlock out into the open.
str_a3_exp_m03_briefing_signal_4: Angel 3-2 - V-44 X Blackfish on loan from the NATO Task Force.
str_a3_exp_m03_briefing_mission_2: Once all supply stockpiles have been destroyed, you are to rendezvous with Angel 3-2 at the %2abandoned observatory%1 atop the dormant volcano.
str_a3_exp_m03_briefing_mission_1: %2Raider 1%1 will provide overwatch from here, covering your approach. You are to infiltrate %3the facility%1, locate all supply stockpiles and rig them to blow. When ready, you are to %4exfil from the facility%1 and blow the charges.
str_a3_exp_m03_briefing_intel_4: - Fuel reserves, commonly found in barrels.
str_a3_exp_m03_briefing_intel_3: - Containers suspected of housing military weapons and equipment.
str_a3_exp_m03_briefing_intel_2: - Any container or object exhibiting military markings.
str_a3_exp_m03_briefing_intel_1: Valid Syndikat targets marked for demolition:
str_a3_exp_m03_briefing_execution_1: 1. Locate and destroy all Syndikat supply stockpiles.
str_a3_exp_m03_x03_late_arrival_pil_0: Raider 2, Angel 3-2, what the hell is taking so long? Get to the LZ, now!
str_a3_exp_m03_x02_slow_players_pil_0: Where are rest of you guys?
str_a3_exp_m03_x01_accident_com_0: For Christ's sake, Raider 2, who taught you to drive?
str_a3_exp_m03_x01_accident_com_1: On your feet, and hump it to the LZ. On the double!
str_a3_exp_m03_b25_situation_3_com_0: The compound's in this grid, here.
str_a3_exp_m03_b25_situation_3_com_1: Two teams will move in, blow any and all supplies they find, and fade back into the jungle.
str_a3_exp_m03_b25_situation_3_com_2: Yeah. The kind of operation that should force Warlock out into the open.
str_a3_exp_m03_b20_situation_2_com_0: No time for politics. As I said: this is time sensitive.
str_a3_exp_m03_b20_situation_2_com_1: My CTRG team is here now. We'll finish the job.
str_a3_exp_m03_b20_situation_2_lia_0: Wouldn't the NATO Task Force be better positioned to ...
str_a3_exp_m03_b20_situation_2_com_2: That being said, some heavy lifting on the logistics end would be more than welcome.
str_a3_exp_m03_b20_situation_2_com_3: You boys can take all the credit.
str_a3_exp_m03_b20_situation_2_lia_1: That can be arranged. Okay, lay it out for me.
str_a3_exp_m03_b20_situation_1_com_0: We've got intel about a storage compound in the heart of Syndikat-controlled territory.
str_a3_exp_m03_b20_situation_1_com_1: Unusual spike in activity. Seems like a shipment of weapons, fuel, etcetera, is moving in.
str_a3_exp_m03_b20_situation_1_com_2: Maybe, maybe not. Could just be a distribution hub.
str_a3_exp_m03_b20_situation_1_com_3: That's why we need to hit them now - before they can move this kit out to the adjacent islands.
str_a3_exp_m03_b15_weaponscache_com_0: Yeah. Unexpected. But we might be able to work it to our advantage.
str_a3_exp_m03_b15_weaponscache_com_1: These kinda weapons are not simple to get a hold of - they're valuable.
str_a3_exp_m03_b15_weaponscache_lia_0: The weapons your team uncovered. Advanced stuff. Military grade.
str_a3_exp_m03_b15_weaponscache_com_2: If we keep smashing all of Syndikat's toys, it'll provoke a response.
str_a3_exp_m03_b15_weaponscache_com_3: Exactly. We've not been able to get a LOCSTAT on him as of yet. Guy's a jmfsb.
str_a3_exp_m03_b15_weaponscache_lia_2: You want to draw Warlock out into the open.
str_a3_exp_m03_b01_altiswrapup_aan_0: Following the defeat of forces loyal to General Akhanteros, the provisional ceasefire has held firm.
str_a3_exp_m03_b01_altiswrapup_aan_1: With a new round of NATO-CSAT talks due imminently, strategic analysts point to encouraging signs of a lasting peace, with a shared peacekeeping deal on the table.
str_a3_exp_m03_60_lz_lia_0: Correct. The rest of Group 15 is en route. Standby.
str_a3_exp_m03_60_lz_lia_1: Raider 1, this is Northstar Actual. Send LOCSTAT, over.
str_a3_exp_m03_60_lz_pil_0: Welcome to LZ Vesuvius, boys! We've been waiting for you.
str_a3_exp_m03_60_lz_pil_1: Hey, hold up, weren't you supposed to arrive in an LSV?
str_a3_exp_m03_60_lz_pil_2: Northstar Actual, this is Angel 3-2. We picking up anyone else? Over.
str_a3_exp_m03_60_lz_lia_2: Roger that. We'll put aside some bacon and eggs for you, Angel 3-2. Out.
str_a3_exp_m03_60_lz_pil_3: Raider 1, Angel 3-2. Double in, boys. We don't much enjoy sitting around a combat zone.
str_a3_exp_m03_60_lz_rik_0: Raider 1, should be at the LZ in figures few.
str_a3_exp_m03_60_lz_pil_4: Once repairs are complete, we need to get in the air, rapid.
str_a3_exp_m03_60_lz_pil_5: Raider 2, all board. Everyone, belt up. Once Raider 1 finally shows up, we can go.
str_a3_exp_m03_60_lz_sal_0: Repairs? Is this guy for real?
str_a3_exp_m03_60_lz_pil_6: Now let's try to get back to the Task Force before all the breakfast is gone.
str_a3_exp_m03_58_debriefing_com_0: Raider callsigns, be advised, we're already seeing an increase in Syndikat comms.
str_a3_exp_m03_58_debriefing_com_1: If Warlock makes a move, we'll be all over it.
str_a3_exp_m03_58_debriefing_rik_0: Good. Sounds like we pissed em off.
str_a3_exp_m03_58_debriefing_sal_0: And done with this goddamn island.
str_a3_exp_m03_57_reach_observatory_grm_: The boss is liaising with the Task Force for the duration. Logistical support, mostly.
str_a3_exp_m03_57_reach_observatory_trk_: So, NATO's gonna be our chauffeur again?
str_a3_exp_m03_57_reach_observatory_rik_: Raider 2, see you at the RV.
str_a3_exp_m03_57_reach_observatory_sal_: That's one way of putting it.
str_a3_exp_m03_55_reach_observatory_com_: All Raider callsigns, mission update, RV at abandoned comms station.
We've got a Blackfish moving to extract.
Raider 2, we left a Prowler nearby during insertion. Saddle up, and move to the LZ.
Raider 1, quick time. Transport's leaving in figures few. Watchtower out.
str_a3_exp_m03_55_reach_observatory_sal_: Riker, c'mon. We really catching a ride in one of those death traps?
str_a3_exp_m03_50_support_team_leave_com: Raider 1, be advised, Raider 2 now leaving the area.
str_a3_exp_m03_40_reinforcements_2_com_0: Raider 2, SITREP, we're seeing a large QRF moving to your position.
str_a3_exp_m03_40_reinforcements_2_com_1: Quick time. We're not here for a prolonged contact.
str_a3_exp_m03_40_reinforcements_2_com_2: Complete your objective before that Syndikat force is on top of you. Watchtower out.
str_a3_exp_m03_35_reinforcements_1_com_0: All Raider callsigns, be advised, we see a Syndikat reaction force moving on your position.
str_a3_exp_m03_35_reinforcements_1_com_1: The QRF's coming in along the road from north and south. Don't get cut off, Raider 2.
str_a3_exp_m03_30_supportteamretreating_: Negative, Raider 1, withdraw to the exfil point.
Raider 2, you are to continue on task.
Watchtower, Raider 1 taking concentrated fire at the overwatch.
We're not doing much good from up here - my callsigns gonna press an attack, over.
str_a3_exp_m03_25_allsuppliesdestroyed_c: Nice one, Raider 2. That should be all of Warlock's kit dealt with now.
New mission: your callsign, complete, is to move to exfil.
str_a3_exp_m03_20_suppliesdestroyed_com_: Fine work, Raider callsigns. Three caches destroyed. That should put a dent in Syndikat operations.
Raider 2, search for more supplies, or move to exfil. Your call. Out.
str_a3_exp_m03_10_overwatch_com_0: Acknowledged. Raider 2, recce enemy positions. When you're happy, move in.
str_a3_exp_m03_10_overwatch_com_1: Search all buildings and shipping containers. Execute when ready. Out.
str_a3_exp_m03_10_overwatch_rik_0: Watchtower, SITREP, we have eyes on Raider 2, now on task.
str_a3_exp_m03_07_convoydepart_rik_0: Be advised, mounted convoy departing the complex.
str_a3_exp_m03_06_supportteamchatter_com: Roger that. Blue Cap's int points to at least three large deliveries.
Raider 2, search and destroy everything you find in the target facility. Watchtower, out.
str_a3_exp_m03_06_supportteamchatter_rik: Watchtower, SITREP, looks like Blue Cap's int was solid. Grimm's got eyes on.
str_a3_exp_m03_06_supportteamchatter_grm: Lot of movement here. Gang members moving in and out of structures. Getting busier. Over.
str_a3_exp_m03_05_supportteamoverwatch_c: Roger. Continue to observe, but do not engage. Raider 2, same orders.
If you raise hell now, it'll be that be much harder for Raider 1 to provide effective fire support. Out.
str_a3_exp_m03_05_supportteamoverwatch_r: Watchtower, this is Raider 1, that's my callsign complete in position.
We currently have eyes on a small convoy. At least a handful of mounted paramilitaries, over.
str_a3_exp_m03_01_start_com_1: Acknowledged. We're seeing a spike in Syndikat presence in the area. Out to you.
str_a3_exp_m03_01_start_com_2: Raider 2, be advised, you have a similar checkpoint to your front along the Main Supply Route.
str_a3_exp_m03_01_start_rik_0: Watchtower, Raider 1, that's my callsign moving to overwatch now.
str_a3_exp_m03_01_start_rik_1: Just avoided an enemy VCP on the southern approach, over.
str_a3_exp_m03_01_start_com_3: Suggest you avoid it en route to the supply depot. No need to make our presence known. Watchtower, out.
str_a3_exp_m02_tasks_bis_rv_description: Move through the jungle and %2rendezvous%1 with %3Raider 1%1.
str_a3_exp_m02_tasks_bis_investigate_des: Search the nearby %2footpath%1 for any signs of Syndikat forces.
str_a3_exp_m02_tasks_bis_exfil_descripti: Board the UH-80 Ghosthawk %2at the LZ%1 and exfil from the AO.
str_a3_exp_m02_tasks_bis_ambush_descript: Move to the %2ambush site%1 and ambush the convoy.
str_a3_exp_m02_sitreptext_1: Central Tanoa, east of the capital, Georgetown
str_a3_exp_m02_overview: Group 15 is deployed to ambush a Syndikat convoy en route to a Tanoan village.
str_a3_exp_m02_debriefing_description: The convoy was destroyed and Syndikat's anti-air weaponry was disposed of. We have to figure out how CSAT weapons are making their way into Syndikat hands.
str_a3_exp_m02_briefing_situation_2: Your job is to stop the Syndikat convoy from reaching its destination.
str_a3_exp_m02_briefing_situation_1: Our local informant, codename 'Blue Cap', has revealed that Syndikat intend to attack the town of Regina, one of the hardest-hit locations following the tsunami some months ago. With both the local populace and various NGOs in the vicinity, the likelihood of civilian casualties is extremely high. As such, local police have asked us to assist.
str_a3_exp_m02_briefing_mission_2: Once the convoy has been eliminated you are to radio for extraction.
str_a3_exp_m02_briefing_mission_1: You will rendezvous with Raider 1 %2here%1, north-west of the %3ambush site%1. From there, you will proceed to the ambush site and co-ordinate with Raider 1 to neutralize the incoming Syndikat convoy.
str_a3_exp_m02_b30_context_3_lia_0: We've been tracking 'Syndikat' for a while. Face value? Bunch of thugs. Guns, drugs. Very violent.
str_a3_exp_m02_b30_context_3_lia_1: But - given the current mess - they're expanding.
str_a3_exp_m02_b30_context_3_lia_2: Right. But there's more to it.
str_a3_exp_m02_b30_context_3_lia_3: Correct. Solomon Maru. One of the few living remnants of failed 'Red Tiger' coup.
str_a3_exp_m02_x20_ambush_backstop_grm_0: Convoy's hit the line. Blowing my charges, clear!
str_a3_exp_m02_x15_ambush_spatne_grm_0: Raider 2, you need to place your charges in advance of the bridge.
str_a3_exp_m02_x15_ambush_spatne_grm_1: Raider 2, my charge is the stop line. Hit them before it.
str_a3_exp_m02_x10_stalled_ambushed_rik_: Raider 2, we need you back at the ambush site.
str_a3_exp_m02_x05_stalled_preparing_rik: Get back to that ambush site, Raider 2.
str_a3_exp_m02_b50_situation_3_com_0: We've sent a team to the area. We're setting up an ambush.
str_a3_exp_m02_b50_situation_3_com_1: If he's there, we'll snatch him up.
str_a3_exp_m02_b50_situation_3_com_2: One squad's already in position. Another's a few minutes out.
str_a3_exp_m02_b50_situation_3_com_3: We can do one better than that. I'll set up a feed.
str_a3_exp_m02_b45_situation_2_com_0: So, 'Blue Cap' indicates a Syndikat gang are planning to hit a village, here.
str_a3_exp_m02_b45_situation_2_com_1: After the disaster, it was being used as a staging post for aid workers. Fuel, medicine, etcetera.
str_a3_exp_m02_b45_situation_2_com_2: There are still a handful of NGOs around. The local community embraced them.
str_a3_exp_m02_b45_situation_2_com_3: Syndikat are out to make a point. We're not clear if Warlock himself will make it.
str_a3_exp_m02_b45_situation_2_com_4: Brutal. Yeah. It'll be a bloodbath.
str_a3_exp_m02_b45_situation_2_lia_0: Hm. We've seen these gangs at work in the past, they're, um...
str_a3_exp_m02_b40_situation_1_com_0: Yeah - hold up a sec - let me bring that up.
str_a3_exp_m02_b40_situation_1_com_1: Alright, so your local source, uh...
str_a3_exp_m02_b40_situation_1_lia_0: That brings us to the current situation.
str_a3_exp_m02_b40_situation_1_com_2: Yeah, 'Blue Cap', we ran his intel. We've put assets in place.
str_a3_exp_m02_b35_context_4_com_0: So, we cut the head off the dragon.
str_a3_exp_m02_b35_context_4_com_1: Let the dogs rip each other apart.
str_a3_exp_m02_b35_context_4_lia_0: Syndikat are pretty big - but they're scattered.
str_a3_exp_m02_b35_context_4_lia_1: They operate in cells. Somehow Warlock holds it all together.
str_a3_exp_m02_b35_context_4_lia_2: That's our end game. Neutralise the leadership.
str_a3_exp_m02_b25_context_2_com_0: Besides our ISTAR remit, we've been running counter-cyber operations in the South China Sea.
str_a3_exp_m02_b25_context_2_com_1: Now, we've got assets in the field, so this Exercise - this disaster 'clean up' shit - it's a distraction for us.
str_a3_exp_m02_b25_context_2_lia_0: I get that. Look, it's political, strategic. The region's a mess - we're just here to help.
str_a3_exp_m02_b25_context_2_lia_1: That's where CTRG comes in. We need a ... special tool for the job.
str_a3_exp_m02_b20_context_1_com_0: So, as you know, CTRG's taking part in 'Exercise Safe Horizon'. Anti-piracy, security, etcetera.
str_a3_exp_m02_b20_context_1_com_1: But - as our NATO liaison - you should be aware of a few, uh, 'operational extras'.
str_a3_exp_m02_b20_context_1_lia_0: Heh. Well - as your NATO liaison - I'm all ears, commander.
str_a3_exp_m02_b05_tanoareport_cor_0: The Horizon Islands were one of the nations worst hit by the disaster; yet, it is a new threat that poses the real danger.
str_a3_exp_m02_b01_tanoasituation_aan_0: The aftermath of the South Pacific Disaster shows little sign of improvement, and the scale of the humanitarian crisis has been exacerbated by a marked rise in criminality.
str_a3_exp_m02_b01_tanoasituation_aan_1: AAN's Mark Cole is in the region with this special report.
str_a3_exp_m02_95_search_wreck_rik_0: Search and clear that wreckage, Raider 2.
str_a3_exp_m02_90_confirmed_enemy_rik_0: Watchtower, Raider 2's definitely got something. Standby.
str_a3_exp_m02_85_on_path_rik_0: That would be the path, Raider 2. Follow it down.
str_a3_exp_m02_84_newintel_com_0: Raider callsigns, we've received new int from our NATO liaze. Possible Anti-Air threat. Patching it through.
str_a3_exp_m02_84_newintel_com_1: Raider 1, your rotary exfil can not move to extract while the threat is still in the area.
str_a3_exp_m02_84_newintel_com_2: Find any and all Syndikat PACs in the area. Roger, over?
str_a3_exp_m02_84_newintel_lia_0: Raider 1, this is Northstar Actual, local police spotted a handful of heavily-armed paramilitaries in your area.
str_a3_exp_m02_84_newintel_lia_1: They were last seen moving along a footpath near the bridge at grid 072-095. Heading deeper into the jungle.
str_a3_exp_m02_84_newintel_rik_1: Grimm, fall back and link up with us. We're going back for the quads.
str_a3_exp_m02_84_newintel_rik_2: Raider 2, you're up. Deal with Syndikat so we can get the hell out of here.
str_a3_exp_m02_84_2_newintel_comment_grm: They are. Mostly. But there's a hardcore element, too.
Rebels. The ones who survived that failed coup a decade ago.
str_a3_exp_m02_84_2_newintel_comment_trk: What did Northstar mean, 'paramilitaries'? Aren't Syndikat just a bunch of untrained thugs?
str_a3_exp_m02_84_2_newintel_comment_rik: Raider 2, take it slow. Switch on. Watch your arcs. Out.
str_a3_exp_m02_83_waitone_grm_0: NATO. Our transport's handled by the Task Force.
str_a3_exp_m02_83_waitone_sal_0: We'll just sit here while they pull the paperwork outta their ass.
str_a3_exp_m02_80_convoy_destroyed_com_0: Roger, Raider 1. Interrogative, any sign of Warlock?
str_a3_exp_m02_80_convoy_destroyed_rik_1: Watchtower, SITREP, 2 times technicals and multiple PAC's engaged and destroyed, CASREP to be sent later.
str_a3_exp_m02_80_convoy_destroyed_rik_4: Watchtower, that's a negative on Warlock. No PID on enemy dead, either. Send extraction.
str_a3_exp_m02_65_convoy_spotted_rik_0: Raider 2, standby. We'll be waiting for your go.
str_a3_exp_m02_65_convoy_spotted_trk_0: Heads up, convoy sighted. Couple technicals, nothing fancy.
str_a3_exp_m02_65_convoy_spotted_rik_1: Grimm, get set to mop up anything Raider 2 might miss.
str_a3_exp_m02_60_charge_set_com_0: All Raider callsigns, SITREP, that convoy's stepping off now. Inbound to your position in figures few. Over.
str_a3_exp_m02_60_charge_set_grm_0: Charge in place. Climbing into my hidey-hole. Raider 2's getting set up now.
str_a3_exp_m02_60_charge_set_rik_2: Alright. We're good to go on our end.
str_a3_exp_m02_60_charge_set_rik_3: Raider 2, make sure you're out of sight before that convoy shows up. We'll keep you posted. Out.
str_a3_exp_m02_35_joke_1_sal_2: She put em on the mantlepiece to see if they would -
str_a3_exp_m02_30_plan_grm_0: Raider 2, I'm gonna plant a charge just ahead of the bridge. That's our stop line.
str_a3_exp_m02_30_plan_grm_1: Feel free to throw down your own stuff. Just keep it low profile, yeah? And hit the convoy before they reach the stop line.
str_a3_exp_m02_30_plan_grm_2: Remember: it's on your go. Riker, Truck and Salvo will box them in once you've set things off.
str_a3_exp_m02_25_briefing_com_0: Raider 1, Watchtower. No movement yet. We'll update when they roll out. Over.
str_a3_exp_m02_25_briefing_rik_1: Militia's set on killing civvies. We're gonna stop em.
str_a3_exp_m02_25_briefing_rik_2: If he's here, we'll snatch him.
str_a3_exp_m02_25_briefing_rik_3: Watchtower, Raider 1. Send SITREP on Syndikat convoy, over?
str_a3_exp_m02_25_briefing_rik_7: Take Raider 2 and post on the road. I'll move east with Truck and Salvo to cut their egress.
str_a3_exp_m02_25_briefing_rik_8: Raider 2, Truck was kind enough to lug those explosives up the hill just for you. Take what you need. Meet Grimm at the snap-ambush.
str_a3_exp_m02_25_briefing_rik_9: Remember, folks, there's a bridge over there. Leave it standing. Locals have it hard enough as it is - we're here to help, not hinder.
str_a3_exp_m02_20_no_touch_grm_0: Watch it. Riker's gonna be pissed if you scratch up his quad.
str_a3_exp_m02_20_no_touch_grm_1: Easy. The sergeant'll kick your ass for touching his quad.
str_a3_exp_m02_15_continue_grm_0: Rest of the guys are just up ahead, Raider 2.
str_a3_exp_m02_125_weapons_destroyed_com: Roger that, Northstar Actual, thanks for the assist.
Raider callsigns, fine work out there. RTB for debrief.
str_a3_exp_m02_125_weapons_destroyed_lia: All callsigns, be advised, target destroyed.
str_a3_exp_m02_115_uav_targeting_lia_0: Greyhawk on site. Going into loiter and hunt.
str_a3_exp_m02_110_helicopter_ready_lia_: This is Northstar Actual. Rotary asset on standby. Callsign Angel 3-1.
str_a3_exp_m02_10_watch_fire_rik_0: Check fire around the temple, Raider 2.
str_a3_exp_m02_107_chineseforeshadow_grm: It's documented on Raider 2's live-feed. We'll know more soon enough.
str_a3_exp_m02_107_chineseforeshadow_rik: Switch on. We need to move to the secondary exfil.
str_a3_exp_m02_107_chineseforeshadow_trk: See the markings on those crates? Looked Chinese to me.
str_a3_exp_m02_107_chineseforeshadow_sal: Hardly surprising. Black market's saturated with their shit.
str_a3_exp_m02_107_chineseforeshadow_trk: That stuff looked high quality, Salvo. Maybe even CSAT. And higher ain't exactly waiting around to nuke it from orbit.
str_a3_exp_m02_105_support_plan_com_0: Raider 1, move to secondary exfil. Extraction helo will pick you up there. Over.
str_a3_exp_m02_105_support_plan_rik_0: Got it, Watchtower, out to you.
str_a3_exp_m02_105_support_plan_rik_1: Raider 2, you heard it. Get your asses down the hill to the extraction. Out.
str_a3_exp_m02_100_weapons_found_com_0: Roger your last. Raider 2, we see your location. Diverting an armed drone to you. Move to ERV. Grid 077-092. Out.
str_a3_exp_m02_100_weapons_found_rik_0: Watchtower, Raider 1. Be advised, Raider 2 has destroyed that Syndikat group.
str_a3_exp_m02_100_weapons_found_rik_1: Their feed shows a large weapons cache, Watchtower. Awaiting further tasking. Over.
str_a3_exp_m02_05_convoy_update_com_0: Raider callsigns, be advised, we're seeing increased activity in Tanouka.
str_a3_exp_m02_05_convoy_update_com_1: We suspect the Syndikat convoy's gearing up to leave. Over.
str_a3_exp_m02_05_convoy_update_rik_0: Roger that, Watchtower, out to you.
str_a3_exp_m02_05_convoy_update_rik_1: Raider 2, get your ass moving, double.
str_a3_exp_m02_01_start_com_0: Raider 1, we're patched into your helmet-cam. Over.
str_a3_exp_m02_01_start_com_1: Understood. Raider 2, move up to the marked RV point. You're in Syndikat-controlled territory. Stay switched on. Out.
str_a3_exp_m02_01_start_rik_0: Roger, Watchtower. Glad to have you with us.
str_a3_exp_m02_01_start_rik_1: SITREP, we've secured the RV. Spotted some minor movement on our way up here. Waiting on Raider 2. Over.
str_a3_exp_m04_situation:
Following our assault on Syndikat's supply lines, Blue Cap informed us that Warlock has called a meeting of Syndikat leadership at a %1safehouse%2 near the village of %3Namuvaka%2. This presents us with an opportunity we can't afford to pass up.

The location is heavily guarded and lies within Syndikat territory, so expect a sizable enemy presence.

We have the element of surprise, so let's use it. If we're quick, we'll be able to catch them off guard.
str_a3_exp_m04_sitrep01: Western Tanoa, near the target area
str_a3_exp_m04_signal:
%1Raider 1%2 - Lead element.
%3Raider 2%2 - Your team.
Watchtower - CTRG Headquarters.
str_a3_exp_m04_overview: Recently acquired intel sends Group 15 on a mission to kill or capture Warlock.
str_a3_exp_m04_mission:
You will be inserted at %1an LZ%2 south of %3the target area%2. Raider 1 will insert %4to the north-west%2 and establish %5a blocking position%2 along the north-east road.

You are to move on %6the target building%2 and capture Warlock. Once he is in custody, you are to proceed to %7the primary exfil point%2 and await extraction.
str_a3_exp_m04_execution:
1. Clear the %1target area%2.
2. Capture %3Warlock%2.
3. Move to %4primary exfil%2.
str_a3_exp_m04_end1_description: Despite being lured into a trap, you managed to extract safely from the AO. Whoever these CSAT operatives are, it's likely we haven't seen the last of them
str_a3_exp_m04_f05_viper_syndikat_fre_0: I don't know what you're trying to tell me. We did everything you asked.
str_a3_exp_m04_f05_viper_syndikat_fre_1: What did you expect? That we could manage them alone?
str_a3_exp_m04_f05_viper_syndikat_fre_2: It was your men who failed!
str_a3_exp_m04_f05_viper_syndikat_vip_0: We gave you instructions. You failed to follow them.
str_a3_exp_m04_f05_viper_syndikat_vip_1: You do not want to die today. Lower your weapon.
str_a3_exp_m04_f01_viper_reveal_vip_1: Enemy agents in sight, Commander. Ready to engage.
str_a3_exp_m04_f01_viper_reveal_vip_2: Yes, sir. Both teams are surrounded.
str_a3_exp_m04_f01_viper_reveal_vip_3: Understood, Commander. They will not escape. Out.
str_a3_exp_m04_70_end_com_0: It was unrelated to the Task Force. Not your concern.
str_a3_exp_m04_70_end_lia_0: Hold it there. Play that back.
str_a3_exp_m04_70_end_lia_1: You haven't told me everything, have you?
str_a3_exp_m04_70_end_lia_2: Looks like you just made it my concern, Major.
str_a3_exp_m04_x05_spotted_rik_0: Watchtower, SITREP, Raider 2's in contact with the enemy now, out.
str_a3_exp_m04_x01_fire_rik_0: An open flame in a wooden house.
str_a3_exp_m04_b35_connect_com_0: We're talking about inner-circle leadership here. Ex-paramilitary types. They'll spook easy.
str_a3_exp_m04_b35_connect_com_1: A small strike team's got a better chance of getting the job done. We'll get in and out with our boats.
str_a3_exp_m04_b30_situation_4_com_0: The compound's here ... east of this remote village.
str_a3_exp_m04_b30_situation_4_com_1: We have assets en route to the area now. Their insertion should be ... here.
str_a3_exp_m04_b30_situation_4_com_2: This is a snatch and grab.
str_a3_exp_m04_b25_situation_3_com_0: Yeah. Many demand a response. They want to hit the multinationals.
str_a3_exp_m04_b25_situation_3_com_1: Sure, and the rest. Everyone's a target.
str_a3_exp_m04_b25_situation_3_lia_0: Warlock must have a lot on his plate.
str_a3_exp_m04_b25_situation_3_com_2: Not exactly, but intel points to a high-level meet.
str_a3_exp_m04_b25_situation_3_com_3: Looks like it. 'Blue Cap' provided a location.
str_a3_exp_m04_b20_situation_2_com_0: So, as you can see, traffic's increased massively.
str_a3_exp_m04_b20_situation_2_com_1: We've been filtering out any actionable intel, and got a few decent hits.
str_a3_exp_m04_b20_situation_2_com_2: Mostly confirmed our previous knowledge. Very dispersed structure.
str_a3_exp_m04_b20_situation_2_com_3: Lot of people expecting hardware deliveries. Lot of egos to smooth over now.
str_a3_exp_m04_b15_situation_1_com_0: Well, we definitely kicked the hornet's nest.
str_a3_exp_m04_b15_situation_1_com_1: Oh, sure. I guess we were just taken aback by how many of those little fuckers came crawling out.
str_a3_exp_m04_b10_interrupt_lia_0: Okay, let's get started. What's the latest?
str_a3_exp_m04_b05_tanoareport_2_cor_0: Terrorised by a criminal gang known colloquially as 'Syndikat', the Horizon Islands' under-equipped Gendarmerie have long been at breaking point.
str_a3_exp_m04_b05_tanoareport_2_cor_1: Driven by a hardened 'inner circle' of paramilitary rebels, Syndikat have seized upon the chaos to expand their separatist agenda with brute force.
str_a3_exp_m04_b01_tanoareport_cor_0: I've been based in Georgetown, Tanoa, for a number of days now. Although this remote province avoided the type of destruction seen elsewhere in the region, there has been an almost complete breakdown in the rule of law.
str_a3_exp_m04_60_status_grm_0: I think we'll find out soon enough.
str_a3_exp_m04_60_status_rik_0: Truck, how's the arm back there, buddy?
str_a3_exp_m04_60_status_sal_0: What the fuck just happened, anyway?
str_a3_exp_m04_60_status_trk_0: Hurts like a motherfucker. Packed it, strapped three FFD's on er. Bleeding's stopped.
str_a3_exp_m04_55_all_in_rik_0: That's everyone. Get us outta here, Grimm.
str_a3_exp_m04_45_mystery_com_1: Leave it, Sergeant. You'll have a full debrief once you return. Over?
str_a3_exp_m04_45_mystery_rik_0: Raider 2, be advised, we've commandeered a civilian truck for transport. PID your targetry.
str_a3_exp_m04_45_mystery_rik_2: What's going on, boss? I thought 14 went dark after Altis?
str_a3_exp_m04_40_flares_rik_0: They're popping flares, Raider 2. Be careful. Out.
str_a3_exp_m04_35_exfil_rik_0: Raider 2, move to grid 023-061. We'll RV at said grid. Out.
str_a3_exp_m04_30_feed_end_com_0: Raider 1, primary exfil compromised. Heavy enemy QRF moving into the area. Mounted and dismounted PAC's.
str_a3_exp_m04_30_feed_end_com_1: New tasking: your callsign complete, is to move to the secondary exfil. Over.
str_a3_exp_m04_30_feed_end_com_2: We have intel working on it now. Just focus on the task at hand. Out.
str_a3_exp_m04_30_feed_end_rik_2: Interrogative, can you confirm the origin of these broadcasts? Over.
str_a3_exp_m04_25_feed_explain_rik_0: Watchtower, is this who I think it is?
str_a3_exp_m04_20_feed_start_rik_0: There's no sign of Warlock. This whole situation -
str_a3_exp_m04_20_feed_start_rik_1: Wait. Looks like another hack, Watchtower. Send tasking, over.
str_a3_exp_m04_15_defeated_rik_1: Be advised, multiple enemy dead; 1 times friendly, type 3 casualty, walking wounded. Truck's on his feet now.
str_a3_exp_m04_15_defeated_rik_2: Further to my last, the enemy we engaged were not Syndikat. They look way higher up the food chain.
str_a3_exp_m04_15_defeated_rik_3: Definitely Chinese - maybe CSAT - but, their equipment is pretty advanced. Prototypes, maybe.
str_a3_exp_m04_10_attack_com_0: Raider 2, be advised, we've lost comms with Raider 1. Be careful, out.
str_a3_exp_m04_05_empty_com_0: We're seeing it, too, Raider 1. Confirm point of origin, over.
str_a3_exp_m04_05_empty_com_1: Raider 1, I say again, confirm point of origin. Raider 1, radio check, over? Raider 1, nothing heard, out.
str_a3_exp_m04_05_empty_rik_1: Watchtower, SITREP, our POC's been - the fuck?
str_a3_exp_m04_05_empty_rik_2: We being hacked here? Watchtower, someone's connecting to - wait, no, it's a burst transmission.
str_a3_exp_m04_01_blocking_com_0: Workable, wait. Just flicking on now.
str_a3_exp_m04_01_blocking_com_1: Roger. When you're happy, step off. Out.
str_a3_exp_m04_01_blocking_rik_1: That's me set up at the blocking position. Raider 2's ready to move in on Warlock now. Over.
str_a3_exp_m04_01_blocking_rik_2: Ball's in your court, Raider 2. Break a leg.
str_a3_exp_m07_taskreachdevicetext: Clear all hostile forces from the vicinity of the %1Eastwind Device%2 and await the arrival of Captain Miller.
str_a3_exp_m07_taskmillertext: Defend Captain Miller while he disarms the Eastwind Device.

str_a3_exp_m07_taskintel01text: Clear %1target location 'Lisbon'%2 of all hostile forces.

str_a3_exp_m07_situation:
Yesterday evening, Syndikat forces launched an offensive against Viper's presence on Tanoa, culminating in their theft of the Eastwind Device. Though we've been monitoring Syndikat movements extensively over the past 24 hours, observing a significant increase in their activity across the island, the whereabouts of the Device have remained unknown. Until now.

Earlier today, the %2Blue Pearl Industrial Port%1 was attacked and occupied by a large Syndikat force. Intel confirms the presence of both Warlock and the %4Eastwind Device%3 itself. The Device is being kept under heavy guard in the northern sector, and we believe Warlock has agreed to ransom it back to Viper. As a contingency, Warlock has armed the Device, with himself the sole holder of the disarm codes.

Regardless of Syndikat's and Viper's motives, it's clear that we must secure the Eastwind Device before the situation escalates.
str_a3_exp_m07_sitrep01: Blue Pearl Industrial Port, Northern Tanoa
str_a3_exp_m07_signal:
%2Raider 1%1 - Lead element.
%4Raider 2%3 - Your team.
Watchtower - CTRG Headquarters.
%6Keystone%5 - Captain Miller.
str_a3_exp_m07_missionoverview: Syndikat have occupied the Blue Pearl Industrial Port with the intent of ransoming the Eastwind Device. With enemies on all sides, Group 15 are deployed to end this once and for all.
str_a3_exp_m07_mission:
You will be inserted %4here%3, south of the Blue Pearl Industrial Port.

%6Captain Miller%5 will infiltrate the facility and disable its primary power supply. At the same time, %2Raider 1%1 will hit the main power thruway ensuring the facility's multiple electricity fail-safes do not kick in.

Under the cover of darkness, you are to make your way through the port, intercept Warlock, secure the disarm codes and take the Eastwind Device offline. %2Raider 1%1 and %6Captain Miller%5 will assist you once their primary objectives have been met.
str_a3_exp_m07_execution:
1. Locate and neutralize Warlock.
2. Secure the disarm codes for the Eastwind Device.
3. Secure and extract the Eastwind Device.
str_a3_exp_m07_end01: As a direct result of the extensive efforts of CTRG, CSAT's Apex Protocol was exposed to the world. With the fragile alliance now on the brink of collapse, the world is slowly returning to the status quo.
str_a3_exp_m07_xsyndikatcalm_translate_f: Hey, mec. T'as vu quelque chose?
C'est moi, ou il n'y a pas de nana sur cette foutu île?
Putain d'étrangers. Ils viennent et mettent leur nez partout, se mellent de notre business.
Le patron est pas content, vous avez encore merdé?
str_a3_exp_m07_xsyndikatalarm_translate_: Hey, hey, c'est quoi ce bordel?
Qu'est-ce qu'on fait? Qu'est-ce que le patron a dit?
Est-ce que tu t'fous d'ma gueule? Ces cons?
str_a3_exp_m07_x20_shakestrong_com_0: Yes. Intensity will ramp up until the mainshock event. All callsigns, expedite!
str_a3_exp_m07_x20_shakestrong_rik_0: Watchtower, are these quakes getting stronger?
str_a3_exp_m07_x15_shake_com_0: Roger your last. Int says foreshocks are part of its arming sequence.
str_a3_exp_m07_x15_shake_com_1: Time is vital. We must secure Eastwind now.
str_a3_exp_m07_x15_shake_rik_0: Watchtower, this is Raider 1. We just felt a tremor at our position - what's the latest at Blue Pearl?
str_a3_exp_m07_x10_getnearthedevice_com_: Raider 2, Priority tasking, move on the target. Secure Eastwind. Out.
str_a3_exp_m07_x05_devicedisarmed_mil_0: Raider 2, it's on you now. Move!
str_a3_exp_m07_x00_bossnothere_com_0: Warlock's not at that location. Raider 2, continue on tasking. Out.
str_a3_exp_m07_x00_bossnothere_com_1: No luck yet, Raider 2. Proceed to next objective. Out.
str_a3_exp_m07_o25_stinger_lia_0: Hey, before we move on to the brief. I can't help but notice just one thing here, gents.
str_a3_exp_m07_o25_stinger_lia_1: There's been no mention of this 'Eastwind' device. Zero.
str_a3_exp_m07_o25_stinger_mil_0: Oh, that. Yes. No, we saw no reason to complicate matters further.
str_a3_exp_m07_o17_apexsoundbite_questio: I weep for my countrymen. There can be no question. CSAT have engineered chaos and destruction on a massive scale.
By supplying dangerous criminals with military weapons, they have sought to murder the people of the Horizon Islands.
They are illegitimate. Their time has come to an end!
str_a3_exp_m07_o17b_apexsoundbite_questi: Je pleure pour mes compatriotes. Il n'y a pas de place pour le doute. Le CSAT a engrengé chaos et destruction à grande échelle.
En fournissant de l'équipement militaire, des armes de guerre à de dangereux criminels, c'est la population des îles Horizon qu'ils ont cherché à assassiner.
Ils sont illegitimes. Leur heure est arrivée!
str_a3_exp_m07_o16_apexsoundbite_voiceso: This should be golden. Turn it up.
He asks a lot of questions.
str_a3_exp_m07_o15_apexsoundbite_emergen: CSAT member states are due to convene for an emergency session in the coming days, exposing fault-lines within the alliance itself, and calling into question a decade of CSAT's soft power expansionism across Eurasia, Africa, and the Pacific region.
str_a3_exp_m07_o13_apexsoundbite_lies_po: The evidence has little basis in reality.
Even so, the actions of a few individuals must not reflect upon the progress made by the whole.
str_a3_exp_m07_o13b_apexsoundbite_lies_t: The evidence has little basis in reality.
Even so, the actions of a few individuals must not reflect upon the progress made by the whole.
str_a3_exp_m07_o10_apexsoundbite_justice: NATO sources have moved quickly to condemn the, quote, 'illegal, immoral, and indefensible act of war'.
With a UN Security Council Resolution set to mandate peacekeeping operations in the South China Sea, NATO forces remain on a heightened state of alert.
str_a3_exp_m07_o05_apexsoundbite_summit_: Evidence of a deliberate, sustained, high-level effort to incite death and chaos, has brought into question the continued viability of the Canton Protocol Strategic Alliance itself.
Leaders from across the world have united in a call for action, seeking to bring those responsible to justice swiftly.
str_a3_exp_m07_o01_apexsoundbite_revelat: Barely two months on from the Pacific Disaster, new revelations have shocked the international community.
Documents seen by AAN investigative journalists - the so-called 'Apex Protocol Papers' - have exposed a global network of illegal CSAT operations.
str_a3_exp_m07_b30_silentstrike_com_0: Blue Pearl's power grid is here.
str_a3_exp_m07_b30_silentstrike_com_1: We'll cut the power, and hit them hard. Maximum aggression.
str_a3_exp_m07_b30_silentstrike_com_2: Speed is paramount. We'll sort out Warlock, grab the key and secure the device.
str_a3_exp_m07_b30_silentstrike_mil_0: Once our presence is known, Warlock will get twitchy. No saying what he'll do.
str_a3_exp_m07_b30_silentstrike_lia_1: Understood. NATO assets will be on standby.
str_a3_exp_m07_b25_warlockplan_com_0: Maybe. Our presence isn't exactly the best kept secret, either.
str_a3_exp_m07_b25_warlockplan_mil_0: An hour ago we intercepted comms between Syndikat and Viper.
str_a3_exp_m07_b25_warlockplan_lia_1: You'll have full NATO support at your disposal.
str_a3_exp_m07_b25_warlockplan_mil_1: More like desperate. Viper are willing to strike a deal. Weapons and cash.
str_a3_exp_m07_b25_warlockplan_mil_2: The hand-over will happen at the Blue Pearl. We're moving now.
str_a3_exp_m07_b25_warlockplan_lia_2: So, Warlock's got a contingency. Expecting a Viper double-cross?
str_a3_exp_m07_b25_warlockplan_mil_3: There's a snag. SIGINT suggests the device has been armed.
str_a3_exp_m07_b25_warlockplan_mil_4: We'll hit them now. Warlock carries the disarm key on his person. We can't give them any time to react.
str_a3_exp_m07_b20_uptospeed_com_0: It's a bit more... prosaic than that. Hold on, our teams have already diverted. I'll patch them in.
str_a3_exp_m07_b20_uptospeed_com_1: Keystone, Watchtower. Let's bring Vince up to speed, over.
str_a3_exp_m07_b20_uptospeed_lia_1: What does that mean, 'pay for it'? He'll use this 'Eastwind' device?
str_a3_exp_m07_b15_warlockdeal_war_0: Fucking ghosts. Think you can disappear?
str_a3_exp_m07_b15_warlockdeal_war_1: This is our home. Our home!
str_a3_exp_m07_b15_warlockdeal_war_2: One step too far. The jungle is a dangerous place.
str_a3_exp_m07_b15_warlockdeal_war_3: We'll take your toy. And you will pay for it, all of it!
str_a3_exp_m07_b15b_warlockdeal_translat: Putain de fantômes. Vous pensez que vous pouvez disparaître?
Un pas de trop. La jungle est un endroit dangereux.
Nous allons prendre votre jouet. Et vous allez payer pour ça. Pour tout ça.
str_a3_exp_m07_b10_badnews_com_0: Far from it. We also recovered part of a Viper transmission. Take a look.
str_a3_exp_m07_b10_badnews_com_1: As suspected, they were folding their operation.
str_a3_exp_m07_b05_basilexposition_com_0: We've been analysing the int recovered. It points to what we suspected.
str_a3_exp_m07_b05_basilexposition_com_1: Using embedded operatives, CSAT destabilise small, strategically valuable nation states.
str_a3_exp_m07_b05_basilexposition_com_2: This strategy - the so-called 'Apex Protocol' - it's a pretext for CSAT diplomats, special advisors - even peacekeeping forces - to deploy.
str_a3_exp_m07_b05_basilexposition_com_3: Correct. Grooming a network of pro-CSAT governments.
str_a3_exp_m07_b01_sosovusecured_com_0: Hours ago, we secured a CSAT black site on Sosovu Island.
str_a3_exp_m07_b01_sosovusecured_com_1: Thanks in part to a surprise Syndikat attack, we retrieved a significant tranche of intel.
str_a3_exp_m07_b01_sosovusecured_com_2: We'll get to the bad news in just a second.
str_a3_exp_m07_b01_sosovusecured_lia_0: Stroke of luck. Do we know what happened yet?
str_a3_exp_m07_97_viperunitsdown_com_0: Negative Raider 1. All callsigns, brilliant work. Eastwind Device secure. ENDEX.
str_a3_exp_m07_97_viperunitsdown_rik_0: Watchtower, SITREP, most Viper callsigns engaged and destroyed. 1 or 2 are running, can we pursue?
str_a3_exp_m07_96_bothkeysentered_com_1: Roger, diverting additional support. All callsigns, post security on Eastwind. Keystone, Raider 2, hold that position.
str_a3_exp_m07_96_bothkeysentered_fal_0: This is Falcon, we've got eyes on. They're ghosting between the containers. Looks like Viper's last play.
str_a3_exp_m07_96_bothkeysentered_rik_0: Watchtower, Raider 1. We see a small QRF moving towards Keystone.
str_a3_exp_m07_95_devicedisarmed_mil_0: Roger, got it. My disarm key's done.
str_a3_exp_m07_95_devicedisarmed_mil_1: Raider 2, send one of your lads to Eastwind with that second key.
str_a3_exp_m07_90_watchyourfire_fal_0: Raider 1, this is Falcon, we see you. We're on the deck. Set up on our right flank. We'll move towards Keystone.
str_a3_exp_m07_90_watchyourfire_mil_0: Raider 2, be advised, friendlies coming in. Check fire.
str_a3_exp_m07_90_watchyourfire_mil_1: Heard a rumour you have a violent allergy to bullets. Thought I'd treat you. Out.
str_a3_exp_m07_85_supportteamarrives_com: Roger, Raider 1. RV with Falcon and move to target.
str_a3_exp_m07_85_supportteamarrives_rik: This is Raider 1, That's my callsign back in, eyes on Blue Pearl. Awaiting further tasking. Over.
str_a3_exp_m07_80_protectmiller_com_0: You heard it. Raider 2, hold the area. Keystone will initiate the disarm sequence.
str_a3_exp_m07_80_protectmiller_mil_0: C'mon, lads, give us some support!
str_a3_exp_m07_75_disarmdevice_com_0: Keystone, Raider 2 is in position at location. What's your LOCSTAT?
str_a3_exp_m07_75_disarmdevice_com_1: Roger. Falcon, get boots on the ground.
str_a3_exp_m07_75_disarmdevice_com_2: Raider 2, hold position at the Device and post security. Out.
str_a3_exp_m07_75_disarmdevice_mil_0: Figures few, Watchtower. I'll need help. Viper's everywhere.
str_a3_exp_m07_75_disarmdevice_fal_0: Roger your last. Moving in now.
str_a3_exp_m07_70_airsupport_com_0: Roger, Falcon. Good to hear from you boys. Guns free, fire at will.
str_a3_exp_m07_70_airsupport_com_1: All callsigns. Be advised, Falcon is now on task.
str_a3_exp_m07_70_airsupport_fal_0: Watchtower, this is Falcon. We're on task. Ready to light em up. Over.
str_a3_exp_m07_70_airsupport_fal_1: You're lucky they pay me pop-star wages to save your arse, Keystone.
str_a3_exp_m07_70_airsupport_mil_0: Nice to have you with us, Falcon. Join the party, feel free to shoot something.
str_a3_exp_m07_65_syndikatmovement_com_0: All callsigns, be advised, Syndikat has reinforced the primary target. Out.
str_a3_exp_m07_65_syndikatmovement_com_1: Negative. We can't risk damaging the Eastwind device.
str_a3_exp_m07_65_syndikatmovement_com_2: Falcon is moving to your location now. They should provide ample overwatch. Watchtower out.
str_a3_exp_m07_65_syndikatmovement_rik_0: Watchtower, Raider 1. Any artillery support available? Over.
str_a3_exp_m07_63_millerteam_mil_0: Raider callsigns, be advised, my team is moving in on the target location.
str_a3_exp_m07_63_millerteam_mil_1: I say again, that's me on task, callsign Falcon will provide support. Keystone out.
str_a3_exp_m07_63_millerteam_rik_0: Say again your last, Keystone? Over.
str_a3_exp_m07_60_supportteam_com_0: Confirmed. Raider 1, RV with Keystone and Raider 2 at the port. Assist with the final push, out.
str_a3_exp_m07_60_supportteam_mil_0: Raider 1, this is Keystone. Confirmed. No lights observed.
str_a3_exp_m07_60_supportteam_rik_0: Watchtower, backup generator destroyed. Confirm, Over?
str_a3_exp_m07_55_viperreveal_com_0: Keystone, SITREP, confirmed several Viper dead at the meeting location.
str_a3_exp_m07_55_viperreveal_com_1: Looks like Raider 2 intervened before they could complete their deal.
str_a3_exp_m07_55_viperreveal_mil_0: Thanks for the heads up, Watchtower, out to you.
str_a3_exp_m07_55_viperreveal_mil_1: There'll be more of them out there, Raider 2. Switch on. Watch your arcs. Out.
str_a3_exp_m07_50_supportteamstatus_rik_: Watchtower, Raider 1. Charges set, out to you. Grimm, Salvo, on me, now.
str_a3_exp_m07_45_movetodevice_com_0: All callsigns, SITREP, both keys retrieved. Move to secure the device.
str_a3_exp_m07_45_movetodevice_mil_0: Raider 2, Keystone, be advised, I'm already moving. The target is buzzing with Syndikat.
str_a3_exp_m07_40_bossdead_mil_0: Watchtower, Keystone. Task complete. I have the second key. Now moving on Eastwind. Over.
str_a3_exp_m07_35_themeeting_com_0: All callsigns, SITREP, Raider 2 is in contact.
str_a3_exp_m07_35_themeeting_com_1: Deal with Warlock and retrieve that key, now. Out.
str_a3_exp_m07_30_millermovestocodes_com: Roger. Let me know when the second key is in your possession.
Roger that. You need to destroy those generators now. Out.
str_a3_exp_m07_30_millermovestocodes_rik: That's my callsign moving into position now.
str_a3_exp_m07_25_millersecondarycodes_m: Watchtower, SITREP, that's me on task, almost at second key's last position.
str_a3_exp_m07_20_secondarycodes_com_0: All callsigns, important message, SITREP, new int received. We may have a problem.
str_a3_exp_m07_20_secondarycodes_com_1: From what we understand, Warlock's given a secondary disarm key to one of his lieutenants.
str_a3_exp_m07_20_secondarycodes_com_2: To clarify: we need both keys to deactivate Eastwind.
str_a3_exp_m07_20_secondarycodes_com_3: Raider 2, continue on tasking, out to you. Keystone, new mission: retrieve the second key.
str_a3_exp_m07_15_viperforeshadow_com_0: Unknown. No change as of yet, but that hand-over could wrap at any time.
str_a3_exp_m07_11_backpoweronline_mil_0: Watchtower, looks like a backup generator kicked up.
str_a3_exp_m07_11_backpoweronline_com_2: Roger your last, out to you. Raider 2, stay on task. You know how critical timings are here.
str_a3_exp_m07_11_backpoweronline_rik_0: Raider 1, one of our charges failed to blow.
str_a3_exp_m07_11_backpoweronline_rik_1: We need to reset. Give us a few minutes.
str_a3_exp_m07_110_outro_com_0: Roger, Keystone. All callsigns, move to exfil!
str_a3_exp_m07_110_outro_mil_0: Alright. Payload secure. Falcon, continue on task.
str_a3_exp_m07_110_outro_mil_1: Watchtower, this is Keystone. We're figures few to ENDEX.
str_a3_exp_m07_10_findboss_com_0: All callsigns, power's out at Blue Pearl.
str_a3_exp_m07_10_findboss_com_1: Raider 2, taskings, find Warlock and retrieve that key. Watchtower, out.
str_a3_exp_m07_107_proceedtoextract_com_: All callsigns, this is Watchtower. Fine work, gentlemen.
Raider callsigns, extraction helo on standby. Let's get you outta there.
str_a3_exp_m07_107_proceedtoextract_mil_: Alright, Raiders, cheers for the help.
Falcon and I will take it from here.
str_a3_exp_m07_105_ctrg_fal_0: We know how you love the attention.
str_a3_exp_m07_105_ctrg_mil_0: Glad to see you finally made it.
str_a3_exp_m07_100_extractionontheway_co: Extraction helo en route to your position. Sit tight, out.
str_a3_exp_m07_05_mark_com_0: Keystone, Raider 1, blow your charges, now.

Keystone is held somewhere inside the enemy's island stronghold in southern Tanoa.

Time is of the essence. Locate, secure and extract Keystone.

str_a3_exp_m01_missionoverview: The sun rises over the Horizon Islands.
str_a3_exp_m01_mission:
Insertion will be via rubber assault boats.

%2Raider 1%1 will insert west of the %3target location%1. %4Raider 2%1, your team, will be inserted to the north-west.

From there, you are to sweep and clear all target locations with the assistance of Raider 1. Extraction will be made available upon the successful acquisition of Keystone.
str_a3_exp_m01_x00_orders_rik_0: Raider 2, don't follow us. Move East-South-East to the target location.
str_a3_exp_m01_x00_orders_rik_1: We're circling back around to link up with Truck and Salvo. Continue planned.
str_a3_exp_m01_p40_already_clear_rik_0: That must've been the thugs you ran into up there. Shame about his man.
str_a3_exp_m01_p36_towerintel_rik_0: Watchtower, be advised, we've just got int on enemies at the radio mast.
str_a3_exp_m01_p35_rescued_pol_1: They took one of us to the tower. There are more of them there.
str_a3_exp_m01_p20_not_clear_pol_0: Look out, there are more of them!
str_a3_exp_m01_p16_noshoottarget_rik_0: Check fire. We've got a local cop here.
str_a3_exp_m01_65_support_searched_rik_0: Negative eyes on Keystone at our current position, Raider 2. Moving to you.
str_a3_exp_m01_60_qrf_com_0: Raider callsigns, be advised, 2 times enemy technicals moving on Toronto. Approaching from the radio mast.
str_a3_exp_m01_51_planagain_com_0: Solid copy. Raider 2, execute when ready.
str_a3_exp_m01_51_planagain_rik_0: Watchtower, Raider 1. Be advised, in position at Toronto.
str_a3_exp_m01_51_planagain_rik_1: Ready to move on Raider 2's lead.

str_a3_exp_m01_50_plan_rik_1: Your route in's blocked by trees. Recommend you move out to a flank for a better view.
str_a3_exp_m01_50_plan_rik_2: You take the building on your side, we'll take the one on ours. We'll fire on your lead.
str_a3_exp_m01_45_second_rik_1: Watchtower, SITREP, no sign of Keystone at New York. Over.
str_a3_exp_m01_40_paras_grm_0: Must be something important if they're here.
str_a3_exp_m01_37_civpop_com_0: Raider callsigns, be advised, CIVPOP in the area. Get Positive IDs on your targets. Acknowledge my last, over.
str_a3_exp_m01_37_civpop_rik_1: Raider 2, watch out for mounted civvies. We need PIDs.
str_a3_exp_m01_35_continue_com_0: Roger. Raider 2, move on New York. Out.
str_a3_exp_m01_35_continue_rik_0: Watchtower, be advised, London is clear. Negative eyes on Keystone.
str_a3_exp_m01_30_weapons_grm_0: Enough ordnance to cause some major damage.
str_a3_exp_m01_25_search_rik_0: Move in on the building. Go!

str_a3_exp_m01_20_quiet_rik_0: Keep it ninja, Raider 2. Use your NODs if you need them.
str_a3_exp_m01_15_orders_rik_0: Alright, target area looks good. London should be a cakewalk.
str_a3_exp_m01_15_orders_rik_1: It's just beyond this outcrop of rocks. Grimm and I'll double back and RV with the others. Move.
str_a3_exp_m01_10_spotted_rik_0: Roger, Watchtower. Looks like they're back in. Raider 1 out.
str_a3_exp_m01_05_online_com_0: All Raider callsigns, check systems now.
str_a3_exp_m01_01_start_com_0: Understood. Raider 2, standby. Running transponder diag.
str_a3_exp_m01_01_start_rik_0: Watchtower, I'm having a hard time reading Raider 2's tracker. Over.

str_a3_showcase_endgame_situation:
Intel has learned of a CSAT defector trying to sell schematics belonging to an unknown CSAT super-weapon. His last known location was somewhere on Tanoa, where he was quickly captured by the local criminal faction, Syndikat.

We need to learn the purpose of this CSAT weapon. You are to secure the schematics at all costs before this opportunity gets away from us. Be aware, however, that CSAT aren't going to let them go without a fight. Stay alert.

Angel 3-1 - UH-80 Ghosthawk.
Watchtower - CTRG Headquarters.
str_a3_showcase_endgame_mission: You are to move to the AO, neutralize all Syndikat forces, secure the schematics and upload them to our secure servers. Be on the look out for any CSAT and Syndikat presence in and around the AO.

2. Await reinforcements.
3. Locate and secure the schematics.
4. Upload the schematics to our secure servers.

STR_A3_CoopCampaignOverview: Take on the role of a NATO CTRG special operator in the 1-4 player "Apex Protocol" co-op campaign. It consists of highly replayable missions, featuring a drop-in / drop-out multiplayer structure, and the difficulty scales up or down based on the number of players.
str_a3_radio_dialogues_070_am_radio_broa: The Tanoa Sugar Company reopened its main refinery yesterday after a group of armed men stormed the building and rigged the machinery with explosives.
It was the second time the site has been targeted by criminals, holding production quotas to ransom, and is now under police protection.
str_a3_radio_dialogues_069_am_radio_broa: A military convoy was stopped on the Regina-Lifou coast road yesterday by an improvised explosive device.
A CSAT officer told reporters no-one was killed and said anti-government insurgents were clearly responsible for the attack.
str_a3_radio_dialogues_068_am_radio_broa: Two men have been killed in a violent confrontation with gendarmes in Lami after stealing supplies from an International Development and Aid Project depot.
A short chase ended with the pair barricading themselves in Le Toucan Hotel. Fortunately, according to police sources, no bystanders were hurt during the incident.
str_a3_radio_dialogues_067_am_radio_broa: A man was injured yesterday in an explosion at the Lifou Diesel Power Plant.
The Tanoa Energy Company has stated that the accident was caused by a defective motor and ruled out external factors or operator error.
str_a3_radio_dialogues_066_am_radio_broa: Workers from the International Development and Aid Project have established a new emergency centre on Wednesday in the town of Regina.
A volunteer from the organization explained that the camp would be distributing anti-malarial medication seven days a week - and offering supplies to those in need.
str_a3_radio_dialogues_065_am_radio_broa: Tanoa Accommodation, a hotel company with properties across the archipelago, faces legal action after an aggressive marketing campaign.
Reams of leaflets, advertising budget rooms to rent, were dropped en masse from drones over popular tourist areas last weekend, contravening national litter laws.
Owner, Arnaud Leroux, said he was deeply sorry for the stunt and thanked those involved in the clean-up effort.
str_a3_radio_dialogues_064_am_radio_broa: A former dock worker at Blue Pearl Industrial Port received a generous cash reward two days ago after leading gendarmes to a large weapon stash in the jungle.
Jean-Paul Delacroix from Georgetown discovered the hidden stockpile after hearing gunshots several nights before, when walking on a nearby trail.
CSAT counter insurgency operatives removed the weapons and congratulated Mr. Delacroix on his vigilance.
str_a3_radio_dialogues_063_am_radio_broa: Former president of the Horizon Islands, Benjamin Hope, has condemned government decisions regarding CSAT's militarization of Tanoa.
Speaking at a fundraising event for Nouveaux Horizons, he condemned both foreign intervention and militant groups affiliated with L'Ensemble for exploiting the nation's current malaria crisis.
La Roche agreed to Canton Protocol demands for combined counter insurgency operations with local gendarmes last week, sparking violent protests in Georgetown, Tanouka, and Ouméré.
str_a3_radio_dialogues_062_am_radio_broa: A driver has been arrested after failing to stop at a checkpoint outside of Georgetown.
Several shots were fired during the incident.
Xu Haifeng, supreme commander of CSAT forces operating in the Pacific region, issued a statement from La Roche and reminded civilians to avoid any actions that might be interpreted as aggressive.
str_a3_radio_dialogues_061_am_radio_broa: In Saint Julien today, a young man was killed, and another seriously wounded by CSAT soldiers.
According to one eyewitness, the pair approached a military vehicle and were fired upon after ignoring repeated warnings, given in both French and English.
A government spokesman in Georgetown refused to comment until the identity of both men is established.
He added that all Tanoans should listen attentively to military personnel and law enforcement officers and to approach only if given explicit permission to do so.
str_a3_radio_dialogues_060_am_radio_broa: Temporary military checkpoints are now in place along several major roads, so please; drive carefully and allow for the extra journey time.
str_a3_radio_dialogues_059_am_radio_broa: A 31 year-old pilot from Tanouka has gone missing after taking off in a light aircraft from the Saint-George Airstrip near Lijnhaven.
The disappearance coincides with mixed reports of a plane coming down near Tuvanaka.
str_a3_radio_dialogues_058_am_radio_broa: Two strategic radar buildings, protected by CSAT soldiers, have been destroyed in a series of audacious raids.
L'Ensemble, widely believed to be behind the attacks, denied involvement and instead proclaimed ordinary Tanoans were taking up arms in a spontaneous fight against neo-colonial oppressors.
str_a3_radio_dialogues_057_am_radio_broa: CSAT soldiers stationed at a fuel depot, east of Laikoro, were reportedly attacked some hours ago by a lone gunman.
Details are unclear, but two large silos have been destroyed and a high number of military personnel killed. Many more are believed injured.
How the man responsible achieved such destruction is unknown, but authorities speculate he may have had extensive training.
More on that story when we know more.
str_a3_radio_dialogues_056_am_radio_broa: CSAT soldiers stationed at a fuel depot, east of Laikoro, were reportedly attacked some hours ago by anti-government insurgents.
Details are unclear, but two large silos have been destroyed and a high number of military personnel killed. Many more are believed injured.
More on that story when we know more.
str_a3_radio_dialogues_055_am_radio_broa: CSAT soldiers stationed at a fuel depot, east of Laikoro, were reportedly attacked some hours ago by anti-government insurgents.
Details are unclear, but reports suggest the raid was unsuccessful. A high number of combatants are believed to have been killed in the fighting.
More on that story when we know more.
str_a3_radio_dialogues_054_am_radio_broa: Vagalala was rocked by an explosion recently, when a house on the north side of the town was destroyed.
An eyewitness, Lou Wesir, owner of the independent Wesir Book Centre, said the residence was under investigation by police when the blast occurred.
Authorities have yet to comment on the event.
str_a3_radio_dialogues_053_am_radio_broa: A suspect in the death of Nouveaux Horizons leader, Jean-Guy Devereux, has disappeared from police custody after a bloody gunfight near Vagalala.
Oringo Madaki, a 39 year-old mechanic, is believed to have escaped detention after anti-government insurgents staged a rescue.
Several gendarmes were killed in the engagement.
str_a3_radio_dialogues_052_am_radio_broa: A suspect in the death of Jean-Guy Devereux, a political leader in the pro-CSAT Nouveaux Horizons party, has died in police custody.
Oringo Madaki, a 39 year-old mechanic from Vagalala, was found dead in a mangrove swamp near Kotomo.
The director general of the gendarmerie, Roch Robineau, told press in Georgetown a full investigation will ensue, but insisted Mr. Madaki had escaped detention.
str_a3_radio_dialogues_051_am_radio_broa: A man was arrested yesterday in connection with the death of Nouveaux Horizons leader, Jean-Guy Devereux.
39 year-old Oringo Madaki was detained by gendarmes after the dismembered body of Mr. Devereux was discovered at Croconeel's Ranch last week.
He is currently being held under witness protection, at a secure location.
A house in Vagalala was also raided.
str_a3_radio_dialogues_050_am_radio_broa: Port-Boisé on the Lijn islands was placed under quarantine earlier today owing to a new outbreak of Atrox strain malaria.
Access to the village and the surrounding area is prohibited and medical martial law is in effect.
As with other affected zones, anyone concerned about local residents should call Le Service de Santé de Tanoa on 555-455.
str_a3_radio_dialogues_049_am_radio_broa: Another deadly malaria outbreak has occurred in Port-Boisé, just one kilometre from the popular tourist resort of Lijnhaven.
Authorities have said it is the super-strain epidemic and are advising non-residents to stay away.
CSAT medical personnel are working with emergency services to assess the severity of the situation.
str_a3_radio_dialogues_048_am_radio_broa: Recent reports of Atrox strain malaria in a village north of the Tanoa Sugar Company have been confirmed.
A quarantine has now been declared in Galili and its cocoa bean plantation.
Friends and families of residents are encouraged to contact Le Service de Santé de Tanoa on 555-455.
str_a3_radio_dialogues_047_am_radio_broa: Incidents of malaria have been reported in the small village of Galili.
Early reports indicate that it may be another outbreak of the Atrox super-strain.
Emergency services are working with CSAT health officials to control the situation.
str_a3_radio_dialogues_046_am_radio_broa: A medical quarantine has been issued in Savaka after a deadly outbreak of Atrox strain malaria.
Anyone worried about residents should call Le Service de Santé de Tanoa on 555-455.
str_a3_radio_dialogues_045_am_radio_broa: A malaria outbreak has hit the village of Savaka in Balavu province.
According to health officials it is linked to the super-strain epidemic.
Authorities are urging members of the public to stay clear until more information becomes available.
str_a3_radio_dialogues_044_am_radio_broa: Following the recent malaria super-strain outbreak in Luganville, a strict quarantine is now in force.
Access into the town is strictly prohibited.
Those concerned for residents, friends, and family members should contact Le Service de Santé de Tanoa on 555-455.
str_a3_radio_dialogues_043_am_radio_broa: A malaria outbreak has been reported in the seaside town of Luganville.
Authorities believe it is linked to the super-strain epidemic and are advising all locals to avoid the area completely.
Blue Pearl workers, stay off the east coast road.
CSAT medical units are working with emergency services to contain the situation.

str_a3_oldman_ambient_dialogues_029_am_l: He works nights, at the Tanoa Sugar Company.
He's out having a cigarette, when a small plane flies over.
And it lands on a field. No runway. No nothing.
Next thing he knows, gendarmes have arrived and everybody's shooting at each other...
And this plane, it takes-off again!
Turns out the pilot was flying guns for L'Ensemble.
I mean, you gotta admit, these guys have got some courage, eh?
str_a3_oldman_ambient_dialogues_028_am_f: There was a major firefight over on Tuvanaka.
CSAT are locking down every island.
It's total chaos. I don't know what happened, but, it's big!
str_a3_oldman_ambient_dialogues_027_am_r: Somebody took out CSAT's radar sites! Too bad the guérilleros don't have an air force. They could drive those bâtards into the sea...
str_a3_oldman_ambient_dialogues_026_am_v: Y'know - the one that got blown up?
La gendarmerie seized it, but it belonged to some guy they arrested.
Seems L'Ensemble were worried about him talking.
Anyway, there's not much left of it now. And no witnesses either.
str_a3_oldman_ambient_dialogues_025_am_n: It's not that great, n'ais pas?

str_a3_oldman_ambient_dialogues_024_am_i: I shit you not, I left him for like a couple of minutes, came back with an RDT and...
