I'm at the shanties in Ouméré.
Follow the dirt road by the harbor. Last house on the left.
str_a3_t_sq_t_plane_questdefines.inct_sq: Acquire an airport access pass. This can be taken from L’Ensemble’s contact, who owns a <marker name = '%2'>nightclub in Lifou</marker>. Otherwise, it can be obtained by bribing <marker name = '%1'>airport security</marker>.
Collect the airplane at <marker name = '%1'>Aéroport de Tanoa</marker> and take it to <marker name = '%2'>Bala airstrip</marker>.
str_a3_anim_opening.sqf2: NATO have reneged on their commitments. A malaria epidemic spreads...
str_a3_anim_opening.sqf3: And a newly elected government calls for humanitarian support - from CSAT.
str_a3_t_sqc_r_lucas_questdefines.inct_s: Get Lucas to a <marker name = '%1'>secure location</marker>.
str_a3_anim_opening.sqf4: First they sent their doctors. Then, they sent their soldiers.
str_a3_anim_opening.sqf5: The criminal organization, known as Syndikat, has become 'politique'...
str_a3_t_sqc_r_lucas_questdefines.inct_s: Arthur's son, Lucas, has been captured by CSAT. Try to locate his whereabouts and get him to a safe place.
str_a3_anim_opening.sqf6: After a power struggle and 3 years of gang warfare, a legitimate insurgency has been born.
str_a3_anim_opening.sqf7: And now, it threatens to tear the beautiful South Pacific archipelago apart.
str_a3_t_sqc_f_vaccine_questdefines.inct: It seems CSAT have some sort of counteragent for this super-strain of malaria. Its location however, remains a mystery. Do your best to get hold of it.
str_a3_anim_opening.sqf8: But not everybody's abandoned the old ways.
str_a3_anim_opening.sqf9: Some still remember what it means to have fidelity, and honor.
str_a3_t_sqc_f_vaccine_questdefines.inct: Take the sample of CSAT's counteragent to Dr. Drábek.
str_a3_description.extcampaign1: NATO has abandoned the Horizon Islands to CSAT and a deadly super-strain of malaria. But not everyone is giving up the fight...
str_a3_t_sqc_f_truck_questdefines.inct_s: Search for a truck or other large vehicle and take it to Dr. Drábek in the <marker name = '%1'>jungle</marker>. He and his patients are in danger and need to relocate...
str_a3_description.extcampaign_missions_: A former French Légionnaire and his CTRG handler monitor suspicious CSAT activity in the town of Ouméré.
str_a3_t_sqc_f_research_questdefines.inc: Recover Howard the archaeologist's <marker name = '%1'>documents</marker> and sell them on the black market.
str_a3_missions_cfgquestsparents.inccsat: Keystone has been monitoring suspicious CSAT activity in <marker name = '%1'>Ouméré</marker>. Go to the now abandoned camp and search for evidence. It's possible the unit stationed there was connected in some way to the malaria outbreak in <marker name = '%2'>Luganville</marker>.
str_a3_t_sqc_f_medicine_questdefines.inc: Dr. Drábek needs medicine. Bring any anti-malarial drugs you can find to his <marker name = '%1'>camp in the jungle</marker>. The clock is ticking...
str_a3_missions_cfgquestsparents.incdest: Disrupting CSAT's radar coverage on Tanoa by removing both their primary and auxiliary radar sites could open the possibility of an airstrike. Keystone, however, cannot provide any kind of air support…
str_a3_t_sqc_f_medicine_questdefines.inc: Once you have found anti-malarial medicine, get it to <marker name = '%1'>Dr. Drábek</marker>. He'll need a couple of boxes worth, at least.
str_a3_missions_cfgquestsparents.incdisa: Recent intel reveals CSAT's lab on Tuvanaka is protected by a series of autonomous weapons. If they could be shut down somehow, it would be open to attack.
str_a3_t_sq9_g_money_questdefines.inct_s: Appropriate the dirty money belonging to the corrupt <marker name = '%1'>gendarme</marker>.
str_a3_missions_cfgquestsparents.incfaci: Retrieve the photos of the military island from the plane on the bottom of the ocean.
str_a3_missions_cfgquestsparents.incgets: Cooperate with former Syndikat criminals and local insurgents, united by L'Ensemble, to oppose CSAT's operations on Tanoa.
str_a3_t_sq99_f_finale_questdefines.inct: Do as Samjo says and get out of Georgetown.
Rendezvous with Keystone on the <marker name = '%1'>island of Sainte-Marie</marker>.
str_a3_missions_cfgquestsparents.inchelp: Dr. Drábek is doing what he can to care for civilians infected with the super-strain malaria in Luganville. He has asked for your assistance.
str_a3_t_sq99_f_finale_questdefines.inct: It's time to get as far away from the Tanoan archipelago as possible...
str_a3_missions_cfgquestsparents.incmain: A mysterious and deadly malaria epidemic is spreading across Tanoa. And it seems that CSAT are somehow responsible. Do what you can to prevent an escalation of this crisis.
str_a3_t_sq99_f_finale_questdefines.inct: Go to L'Ensemble's dead-drop in Tanoa's capital city, Georgetown. Leave the counteragent sample in the back of a blue van, behind the meat market, opposite the cathedral.
str_a3_missions_cfgquestsparents.incopen: Arthur, an old friend of yours, has a 'problem'. Do what you can to help.
str_a3_t_sq8_gen_station_questdefines.in: A vehicle has been prepared for you and rigged with explosives. Collect it from L’Ensemble’s <marker name = '%1'>garage</marker>.
str_a3_missions_cfgquestsparents.incsave: CSAT counter insurgency operators discovered an explosive charge in a shed outside Arthur's house. They arrested his son, Lucas, and took him away. Rescue him!
str_a3_t_sq8_gen_station_questdefines.in: Detonate explosives outside an office block belonging to the gendarmerie in <marker name = '%1'>Katkoula</marker>.
str_a3_missions_cfgquests_syndikat.incsu: %3 insurgents are assaulting an <marker name = '%1'>enemy base</marker> at %2. Help them so L'Ensemble will assist you in the future.
str_a3_t_sq7_t_planevip_questdefines.inc: Set down on the <marker name = '%1'>open fields</marker> near the Tanoa Sugar Company, so L'Ensemble guerrillas can load your aircraft with some special cargo.
Fly the plane to <marker name = '%1'>Bala Airstrip</marker> and land with its illicit cargo.
str_a3_t_sq6_f_nvgs_questdefines.inct_sq: There's been a change of plan. Get to the new staging area in <marker name = '%1'>Koumac</marker>.
Insurgents sympathetic to L'Ensemble are almost ready for the operation against CSAT. It will begin from <marker name = '%1'>Cerebu</marker>, at 20:00.

L'Ensemble are getting ready for a major offensive. As it's planned to be a night-time attack, they require night vision goggles. Get hold of at least 5 devices and take them to the designated insurgent <marker name = '%3'>stash</marker> before the %4. The optics themselves can be captured from isolated CSAT patrols or poorly defended checkpoints. The <marker name = '%2'>gendarme depot</marker> suggested by Samjo may also be a good target.
Join the <marker name = '%2'>anti-government insurgents</marker> in their boat, ferry them across Yanukka Bay, and disembark at the <marker name = '%1'>insertion point</marker> on the opposite shore.
str_a3_t_islandfacility_questdefines.inc: Take down CSAT's biogenetic weapons lab, located on the heavily defended <marker name = '%1'>island of Tuvanaka</marker>.
str_a3_t_sq6_f_nvgs_questdefines.inct_sq: Sabotage one of the two silos in CSAT's <marker name = '%1'>fuel depot</marker> using an explosive charge.
str_a3_t_sq0_g_pistol_questdefines.inct_: A charge has been hidden in a <marker name = '%1'>shed</marker>, next to Arthur's house. Take it away and keep it safe.
str_a3_t_sq4_d_aaradar_questdefines.inct: Disable CSAT's main radar site on <marker name = '%1'>Mont Tanoa</marker>.
str_a3_t_sq0_k_traitor_questdefines.inct: Blow up the <marker name = '%1'>house</marker> that the gendarmerie have seized in Vagalala. Explosives can be found at the <marker name = '%3'>Red Spring Mine</marker> or the evidence room of the nearby <marker name = '%4'>police station</marker>.
str_a3_t_sq4_d_aaradar_questdefines.inct: Knock out the <marker name = '%1'>auxiliary radar station</marker> belonging to CSAT.
str_a3_t_sq0_k_traitor_questdefines.inct: Take the captive's ID card to his <marker name = '%1'>friend</marker>. He should be at his garage between 12:00 and 20:00. Alternatively, drop it at <marker name = '%2'>L'Ensemble's cache</marker>.
str_a3_t_sq3_f_autonomousturrets_questde: To reboot CSAT's network and install Keystone's virus, restart the uninterruptible power supply. It should be somewhere near the computers.
str_a3_t_sq0_k_traitor_questdefines.inct: It appears Samjo's comrade has been taken to a nearby cocoa farm. Kill his captors and help him escape.
str_a3_t_sq3_f_autonomousturrets_questde: Keystone has prepared a program which will disable CSAT's autonomous weapons once uploaded to their network. Meet with him <marker name = '%1'>in the jungle</marker> and collect the flash drive with the virus.
str_a3_t_sq0_k_traitor_questdefines.inct: Release Samjo's man from the <marker name = '%2'>police station</marker> in Vagalala, if he's still there...
str_a3_t_sq3_f_autonomousturrets_questde: Network Structure Plans are required to neutralize CSAT's autonomous weapon systems. Secure this intel and return it to your handler, <marker name = '%1'>Keystone</marker>.
str_a3_t_sq0_l_locations_questdefines.in: Rest up on your sofa. Keystone will contact you again at 6:30.
Sensitive information has been sent to you. Go <marker name = '%1'>home</marker> and access your laptop.
str_a3_t_sq3_f_autonomousturrets_questde: Prevent CSAT from interrupting the virus upload.
str_a3_t_sq2_f_photos_questdefines.inct_: Go to the <marker name = '%1'>location</marker> where Keystone's reconnaissance plane was last seen and dive beneath the waves. Search for the wreckage and recover the intel on CSAT's weapons lab.
str_a3_t_sq0_l_locations_questdefines.in: Talk with your handler, Keystone, at your rendezvous point <marker name = '%1'>in the jungle</marker>. He should be there from %2.
str_a3_t_sq2_f_photos_questdefines.inct_: Find a rebreather for deep sea diving, either by <marker name = '%2'>buying one</marker> or stealing one from the maritime gendarme station in the <marker name = '%1'>village of Lösi</marker>.
str_a3_t_sq0_l_locations_questdefines.in: Dr. Drábek has organized a meeting with an important figure in Tanoa's insurgency, at a warehouse <marker name = '%1'>in the big banana plantation</marker> near Ouméré. Go there, talk to him, and earn his trust.
str_a3_t_sq1_f_evidence_questdefines.inc: Go to <marker name = '%3'>Ouméré</marker> and collect evidence for Keystone by taking photographs of anything interesting.
str_a3_t_sq0_l_locations_questdefines.in: Keystone has organized a meeting with an important figure in Tanoa's insurgency, at a warehouse <marker name = '%1'>in the big banana plantation</marker> near Ouméré. Go there, talk to him, and earn his trust.
str_a3_t_sq10_l_massacre_questdefines.in: Investigate the fate of the man washed up on the shore, based on his journal notes...
str_a3_t_sq0_t_arthur_questdefines.inct_: Go to Arthur in the <marker name = '%1'>shanties</marker>, on the east side of Ouméré.
Accompany Arthur to his <marker name = '%1'>home</marker>, just outside Luganville.
str_a3_sq6.fsmfsm_states_set_delay_wait_: The attack on CSAT's <marker name = '%1'>fuel depot</marker> will begin in 5 minutes. Find a good position and wait.
str_a3_sq1.fsmfsm_states_update_task_0: Take the documents back to <marker name = '%1'>Keystone</marker>.
str_a3_sq3.fsmfsm_states_update_task0: Infiltrate a CSAT base, restart the power supply, and upload Keystone's virus on a computer. To do so without raising the alarm, you will need to steal an access card from an enemy officer.
str_a3_sq1.fsmfsm_states_update_task_add: Follow-up on the intel you found in Ouméré and look for another lead in <marker name = '%1'>Harcourt</marker>.
str_a3_sq3.fsmfsm_states_info_to_miller_: Take the documents you recovered to <marker name = '%1'>Keystone</marker>.
str_a3_sq2.fsmfsm_states_miller_responds: Destroy CSAT's <marker name = '%1'>weapons lab</marker> on the militarized island of Tuvanaka.
str_a3_om_taskupdate_syndikatfighter: It seems as though Samjo's man has been relocated to a police safe house at a <marker name = '%1'>cocoa farm</marker>, just outside Vagalala.
str_a3_om_container_guns_Boss_sms: You wanting guns, Képi blanc? I know place. Orange ship container in Blue Pearl. Next to IDAP one. Only one like it in the port. But you no have easy time of it. Big time guarded.
str_a3_om_taskupdate_lucas: Arthur's son, Lucas, is being interrogated by CSAT counter insurgency operatives. It's likely he's being held at the <marker name = '%1'>harbor</marker>, near Leqa.
str_a3_om_container_guns_Miller_sms: I forgot to mention. I heard it on good authority there's a shipping container in Blue Pearl Industrial Port - full of guns. It belongs to Syndikat. Apparently, it's bright orange and near one labeled IDAP. Just - be warned - that place is well-guarded. Be careful if you want to check it out.
str_a3_om_intel_vagalalalaptopmoney_text: I noticed some information on a laptop in Vagalala's police station. Looks like they got a bad apple in their midst - an officer on the take. Apparently, corruption is so rife in this precinct he's writing emails about his illicit money in the office...
str_a3_om_intel_syndikatfighter_text: The captive that Samjo wanted rescued has been taken by the police to a safe house at a cocoa farm <marker name = '%1'>near Vagalala</marker>.
str_a3_om_intel_syndikatcamp_text: An encampment in the <marker name = '%1'>jungle</marker>, used by the insurgents.
str_a3_om_intel_planofattack_text: L'Ensemble's guerrillas have sketched some plans on a whiteboard. Looks like an amphibious assault on a CSAT fuel depot. One team's crossing the Yanukka Straits in a boat. Another has taken up an overwatch position. I guess the idea is both teams will assault the depot and the first one to the silos will set an explosive charge. Simple hit and run. Once the target's destroyed, it's every man for himself. Least. that's what it looks like.
str_a3_om_intel_aadefensecentral_text: A formidable battery of <marker name = '%1'>S-750 Rhea surface to air missile launchers</marker>.
str_a3_om_intel_oumerebase_text: Some <marker name = '%1'>CSAT soldiers</marker> took over the playing field and community centre in Ouméré this morning. Looks like they've setup a mobile hospital - which doesn't make a lot of sense. The worst of the malaria outbreak's over on the Îles de Lijn.
str_a3_om_intel_aadefenseharbour_text: A formidable battery of <marker name = '%1'>S-750 Rhea surface to air missile launchers</marker>.
str_a3_om_intel_aadefensenorth_text: A formidable battery of <marker name = '%1'>S-750 Rhea surface to air missile launchers</marker>.
str_a3_om_intel_minefields_text: All minefields around research facility were discovered and marked in your map.
str_a3_om_intel_aadefensesm_description: A formidable battery of <marker name = '%1'>S-750 Rhea surface to air missile launchers</marker>.
str_a3_om_intel_minefield94_text: A minefield placed by CSAT engineers. It's marked on the map, <marker name = '%1'>here</marker>.
str_a3_om_intel_aadefensesouth_text: A formidable battery of <marker name = '%1'>S-750 Rhea surface to air missile launchers</marker>.
str_a3_om_intel_minefield69_text: A minefield placed by CSAT engineers. It's marked on the map, <marker name = '%1'>here</marker>.
str_a3_om_intel_aadefensesystem_text: The island of Tuvanaka is protected by several surface to air missile sites. To function, they require radar coverage.
str_a3_om_intel_minefield44_text: A minefield placed by CSAT engineers. It's marked on the map, <marker name = '%1'>here</marker>.
str_a3_om_intel_aadefensewest_text: A formidable battery of <marker name = '%1'>S-750 Rhea surface to air missile launchers</marker>.
str_a3_om_intel_minefield129_text: A minefield placed by CSAT engineers. It's marked on the map, <marker name = '%1'>here</marker>.
str_a3_om_intel_minefield122_text: A minefield placed by CSAT engineers. It's marked on the map, <marker name = '%1'>here</marker>.
str_a3_om_intel_aaoutpost_text: A static <marker name = '%1'>anti-aircraft launcher</marker> on an elevated position.
str_a3_om_intel_minefield111_text: A minefield placed by CSAT engineers. It's marked on the map, <marker name = '%1'>here</marker>.
str_a3_om_intel_aaradars_text: There are two radars, linked to CSAT's AA missile defenses. One is the conspicuous radome on Mont Tanoa. The other will be a mobile back-up.
str_a3_om_intel_minefield110_text: A minefield placed by CSAT engineers. It's marked on the map, <marker name = '%1'>here</marker>.
str_a3_om_intel_abandonedbase_text: An encampment in <marker name = '%1'>Ouméré</marker>, recently deserted by CSAT's secretive medical units.
str_a3_om_intel_millersorders_text: Surprisingly, there was some physical intel on my handler, Keystone: '[...] knock out CSAT's biogenetic weapon's lab and acquire the counteragent. Exploit the situation; use local agents if you have to. Everyone's expendable - including you, Miller'.
str_a3_om_intel_armoredbaseairport_text: A CSAT <marker name = '%1'>base</marker> with armored vehicles, east of Tuvanaka Airbase.
str_a3_om_intel_armoredbaseqrf_text: CSAT reinforcements are located <marker name = '%1'>here</marker>, including an APC.
str_a3_om_intel_millershideout_text: A <marker name = '%1'>rendezvous point</marker> in the jungle, selected by the CTRG operative named 'Keystone'.
str_a3_om_intel_armoredbase_text: A <marker name = '%1'>military site</marker> with a number of armored vehicles.
str_a3_om_intel_millershideoutsm_descrip: Current location of the CTRG operative, Keystone.
str_a3_om_intel_autonomousturrets_text: CSAT's <marker name = '%1'>biogenetic weapon's lab</marker> is guarded by state of the art remote turrets. Keystone's team may be able to disable them, if Network Structure Plans can be acquired...
str_a3_om_intel_millersanalysis_text: Photographic evidence of CSAT personnel, handling containers of the deadly 'Atrox' strain malaria.
str_a3_om_intel_autonomousturret_text: CSAT's <marker name = '%1'>biogenetic weapon's lab</marker> is guarded by state of the art remote turrets. Keystone's team may be able to disable them, if Network Structure Plans can be acquired...
str_a3_om_intel_militaryisland_text: The northwestern island of Tuvanaka is held by CSAT. Their biogentic weapon's lab must be located somewhere there.
str_a3_om_intel_backupaaradarsmdescripti: A mobile radar, used by CSAT to monitor aerial threats.
str_a3_om_intel_mainaaradar_text: The radome providing all of CSAT's SAM sites with target data is located at <marker name = '%1'>Comms Alpha</marker> on Mont Tanoa. There ought to be an auxiliary mobile radar somewhere nearby.
str_a3_om_intel_backupaaradar_text: A <marker name = '%1'>mobile radar</marker>, used by CSAT to monitor aerial threats.
str_a3_om_intel_mainaaradarsmdescription: The radome providing all of CSAT's SAM sites with target data is located at <marker name = '%1'>Comms Bravo</marker> on Mont Tanoa. There ought to be an auxiliary mobile radar somewhere nearby.
str_a3_om_intel_basesawmillsmdescription: A small CSAT <marker name = '%1'>camp for logistics</marker> in a former sawmill.
str_a3_om_intel_lumberyardstorage_temp_t: Authorities have temporarily stored weapons and equipment in the vicinity of a <marker name = '%1'>lumberyard</marker>.
str_a3_om_intel_basesawmill_text: A small CSAT <marker name = '%1'>camp for logistics</marker> in a former sawmill.
str_a3_om_intel_lugprisoner_text: It appears CSAT are holding an insurgent prisoner. He has been moved to a secure location at the <marker name = '%1'>ferry station</marker> north of Leqa.
str_a3_om_intel_borderzoneminefield_text: There is a large minefield between two CSAT checkpoints, <marker name = '%1'>here</marker> and <marker name = '%2'>here</marker>.
str_a3_om_intel_luganvillebase_text: A <marker name = '%1'>military base</marker>, near Luganville. It is garrisoned by CSAT soldiers.
str_a3_om_intel_checkpointgeorgetownsout: CSAT are searching vehicles at a <marker name = '%1'>checkpoint</marker> on the south side of Georgetown.
str_a3_om_intel_junglehideout_text: A temporary <marker name = '%1'>camp</marker> for villagers suffering from the malaria outbreak.
str_a3_om_intel_checkpointlami_text: A military <marker name = '%1'>checkpoint</marker> with CSAT soldiers in the town of Lami.
str_a3_om_intel_checkpointlifou_text: CSAT have set up a <marker name = '%1'>checkpoint</marker> on the road, west of Lifou.
str_a3_om_intel_junglehideoutsmdescripti: A temporary <marker name = '%1'>camp</marker> for villagers suffering from the malaria outbreak.
str_a3_om_intel_checkpointluganville_tex: There is a <marker name = '%1'>military checkpoint</marker> on the road, just to the west of Luganville.
str_a3_om_intel_infectedluganville_text: A luxury <marker name = '%1'>villa</marker> has been affected by the malaria. The house has been closed off by CSAT soldiers.
str_a3_om_intel_checkpointssoutheast_tex: A few new checkpoints have been put up by CSAT in the south east. Two are on the main coast road, <marker name = '%1'>here</marker> and <marker name = '%2'>here</marker>. There is also another <marker name = '%3'>here</marker>, on the highway connecting Vagalala and Ouméré.
str_a3_om_intel_graveyardstash_text: There is a sum of money hidden in this graveyard.
str_a3_om_intel_checkpointssouthwest_tex: Military checkpoints have been raised on various roads across the southwestern side of Tanoa. There is one covering the <marker name = '%1'>south road</marker> from Georgetown, one on the route <marker name = '%2'>between Lobaka and Lifou</marker>, and one more <marker name = '%3'>between Lifou and Lami</marker>.
str_a3_om_intel_disco_text: Lifou's go-to venue for entertainment. It's open every night.
str_a3_om_intel_civildeadbody_text: There was a suicide note on a body I found washed up on the beach. It would appear he shot himself. How he ended up in the sea though, is anybody's guess. There were some ramblings about a vendetta - violence, killing; whatever happened, it didn't happen far from where I found this note. I'm no forensic pathologist but it doesn't look like the corpse was adrift for long...
str_a3_om_intel_ctrgstmarie_text: I found a note on Keystone, concerning an RV point. It's on Sainte-Marie. One of his team has the counteragent for the malaria super-strain in his backpack.
str_a3_om_intel_csatweaponcache_text: A large stockpile of weapons has been uncovered and is now being guarded by CSAT. It's <marker name = '%1'>location</marker> is on the map.
str_a3_om_intel_VIPLobaka_Text: Law enforcement officers are questioning an insurgent who is providing information on L'Ensemble and their activities in <marker name = '%1'>Lobaka</marker>.
STR_A3_OM_FastTravelAvailable: Fast Travel is available, allowing for instant movement between points.
str_a3_missions_f_oldman_cfghints_oldman: Your geo-finder app can be switched on and off using your phone. Make sure you have it active when searching!
STR_A3_moduleDepot_Hint: You are transferring all equipment stored in the vehicle to L'Ensemble.\n\nThis action is non-reversible
str_a3_missions_f_oldman_cfghints_oldman: Explore Tanoa! Find as many hostels as you can to jump freely from place to place.
Even if your reputation is very low, you can always win back your standing.
Unless you are actively seeking combat, it is usually best to keep a low profile and avoid interactions with authorities.
str_a3_om_uitools.sqf28: Some individuals may last longer than others. Their current status is as follows:
str_a3_om_uitools.sqf26: die in a matter of hours!
str_a3_missions_f_oldman_cfghints_oldman: CSAT soldiers and local law enforcement are liable to respond with deadly force if you ignore warnings or are caught trespassing inside certain zones.
str_a3_om_uitools.sqf24: people infected with the malaria super-strain will
str_a3_om_fn_om_modulecheckpoint_handles: Relax and avoid raising any suspicion...
str_a3_om_uitools.sqf22: Once the doctor's medical supplies have been depleted, people infected with the malaria super-strain will
str_a3_missions_f_oldman_cfghints_oldman: Tanoa Accommodation has many rooms to let with affordable prices. Look out for leaflets listing places to stay.
str_a3_om_uitools.sqf19: Dr. Drábek has run out of medication!
str_a3_systems_commondescription.inccfgo: Former soldier in the French Foreign Legion.
CTRG operative, conducting clandestine operations on Tanoa.
str_a3_missions_f_oldman_cfghints_oldman: By sleeping you can heal your wounds. Be aware that some events in the world are time limited!
str_a3_systems_commondescription.inccfgo: Archaeologist, who lives and works near Luganville.
A local resident and retired bacteriologist, contracted by IDAP.
str_a3_missions_f_oldman_cfghints_oldman: A good reputation with Syndikats might lower the prices.

Maximum time for how long you can wait is set to 12 hours. You can't wait if enemies are nearby or you are moving in a vehicle. Sleeping bags take up a lot of space. To get a new sleeping bag,  find a stash or buy one from the black market.
str_a3_systems_commondescription.inccfgo: Call this number to detonate vehicles rigged with explosives.
str_a3_missions_f_oldman_cfghints_oldman: Waiting for nightfall can be advantageous in some situations, if you have the right equipment.
Remember, sleeping bags take up a lot of space. To get a sleeping bag, you can search for them in weapon stashes, or buy one off the black market.
str_a3_systems_commondescription.inccfgo: Former Syndikat boss and rumored accomplice of Solomon Maru. Now the muscle behind Tanoa's revolutionary political movement, L'Ensemble.
An old friend, living on the outskirts of Luganville. He has a son, Lucas.
str_a3_modules_bis_modulemanhunt_moduled: Handles signs of the player's activity (portrait - broadcasts, etc.). It cannot be used without first adding the Old Man Init. module.
str_a3_modules_moduleomactionqueue_f_mod: Action Queue can be used for the sequential execution of actions (scripts, dialogues) in a non-specified time.
str_a3_modules_moduleomawareness_f_modul: Player's awareness regarding his relationship to the enemy via ambient radio chatter. This module cannot be used without first adding the Old Man Init. module.
str_a3_modules_moduleomdepot_f_moduledes: Player is able to unload/sell equipment inside of the sector area. Synchronize a container so it can be used to store items from inventory. This module cannot be used without first adding the Old Man Init. module.

str_a3_missions_f_oldman_cfghints_oldman: Old Man Update
STR_A3_Missions_F_Oldman_cfgHints_Oldman: Arma 3 Apex: Old Man is an experimental singleplayer open world scenario set on the beautiful Tanoan archipelago. It is a free addition to the Apex expansion and the Armaverse.%1%1%2Sandbox Gameplay%1%2Exploration%1%2Multiple Quests%1%2Safehouses%1%2Hidden Caches%1%2Fast Travel%1%2Time Skipping%1%2Faction Reputation%1%1More about Old Man
str_a3_missions_f_oldman_cfghints_oldman: Weapon Stashes
Supporting the revolution by making regular drops at weapon stashes will improve even the worst of relations.

You can help insurgents on Tanoa by bringing weapons and equipment to <t %5>weapon stashes</t>, marked on your map. Not only will you receive money for any items you supply, your <t %5>reputation</t> will improve too, giving you further advantages.
Bombmaker
It is possible to have multiple vehicles equipped with explosives. However, one phone call will trigger them all!

Tanoa's insurgents include several <t %5>bombmakers</t>. These individuals can <t %5>rig vehicles</t> with high explosives - for a price. Once you complete a certain task or your <t %5>relation</t> with local guerrillas increases, their workshops will appear on your map.%1%2To fit a vehicle with a bomb, take your delivery vehicle to one of the special garages.%1%2Approach the <t %5>bombmaker</t>.%1%2Select and confirm which vehicle you wish to arm.%1%2You will receive an SMS confirmation when the work is done and your vehicle is ready to collect.%1%2To detonate the explosives, <t %5>call the phone number</t> given to you by the bombmaker.
Hidden Caches

<t %5>Hidden caches</t> containing weapons and equipment can be located by using the geo-finder app on your phone (%11). The frequency of the beeps increases depending on your <t %5>direction</t> and your <t %5>proximity</t> to the cache.
Fast Travel

You can move quickly across long distances using <t %5>Fast Travel</t>. This can be triggered from <t %5>safehouses, hotels</t>, or if your relations with L'Ensemble are good, <t %5>insurgent camps</t>. You will receive a notification if the option is available.%1%2To transition to a new location, open your map with %11.%1%2Choose the place you want to go to; valid sites are visualized in-game with <t %5>markers</t>.%1%2Select the time you wish to arrive, by clicking on the <t %5>minute hand of the watch</t> with %12 and rotating it.%1%2There will always be a <t %5>minimum travel time</t>, corresponding to the distance covered.
STR_A3_Missions_F_Oldman_cfgHints_Oldman: To stay in touch with useful contacts and coordinate activites with Tanoa's insurgency, you can use your <t %5>phone</t>. To access it, simply press %11. It is useful for:%1%2Checking your personal finances%1%2Managing your tasks%1%2Browsing collected intel%1%2Reading recent messages and conversations%1%2Setting an alarm%1%2And coordinating attacks against the enemy
str_a3_missions_f_oldman_cfghints_oldman: Reputation

You can increase your <t %5>reputation</t> with insurgents on Tanoa by completing missions, sharing loot, and joining groups in small, impromptu engagements. Elevated status means <t %5>cheaper weapons and equipment</t> on the black market, as well as more <t %5>accommodation</t> options with <t %5>better prices</t>. Conversely, failing missions and attacking insurgents can result in a lack of local support, making strategic objectives harder to complete. The reputation scale starts at <t %5>0</t>, can increase to <t %5>+3</t> or be reduced to <t %5>-3</t>.
Relations

In ordinary circumstances, you will not be a target for military personnel or law enforcement. But <t %5>relations</t> can change. Certain actions will provoke confrontation:%1%2Not stopping at checkpoints.%1%2Taking weapons through checkpoints.%1%2Visibly carrying weapons.%1%2Wearing military uniforms or equipment, including guerrilla apparel and accoutrement.%1%2Trespassing in <t %5>restricted areas.</t>%1%2Harassing military personnel or law enforcement officers by getting too close.%1%2Disobeying orders given by armed individuals.
Restricted Areas

As a civilian, there are <t %5>restricted areas</t> you are not allowed to enter:%1%2Military bases.%1%2Airports (without access pass).%1%2Police stations.%1%2Quarantined towns and villages.%1%2Insurgent camps (depending on < t%5>reputation</t>).%1%2Some factories and harbors.
Sleeping Bags
You cannot make use of your sleeping bag if you are close to enemy units or are actively moving in a vehicle.

To save hard-won progress, you can unfurl a <t %5>sleeping bag</t> by pressing %11 and rest. This will create a saved game. Sleeping bags can be found all over Tanoa, or purchased with weapons and other equipment on the <t %5>black market</t>. Be aware, these items only allow <t %5>one save</t> and are cumbersome to carry, occupying a great deal of space in your inventory.
Threat Level
Sleeping in safe houses and other accommodation will remove your threat level.

CSAT soldiers and gendarmes will ignore you unless they become <t %5>suspicious</t>. If your <t %5>threat level</t> is high enough, combat will occur and you will be hunted by authorities. However, it will decrease again if you can hide or escape your pursuers.
STR_A3_Missions_F_Oldman_CfgHints_Oldman: By sleeping you can save your progress, lower your threat and heal your wounds. To sleep you have to find a bed, sofa or unfolded sleeping bag. You have your own at home. You can also rent a bed in a hostel or, if your reputation with Syndikat is high enough, you can sleep in their camps.
str_a3_missions_f_oldman_cfghints_oldman: Accommodation
If you need to <t %5>sleep</t> to regain your strength, < t%5>skip time</t>, or lower your <t %5>threat level</t>, there are a number of safe-houses and hotels. However, not all are free.
Waiting

Press %11 and rotate the watch hands to <t %5>move forwards in time</t>. The maximum number of hours you can skip is 12. If you have a sleeping bag item in your inventory, you have the option of exchanging it for a saved game.
Skipping Time

In some situations, you may wish to <t %5>skip time</t> and progress events. You can do this if no enemies are nearby.%1%2Use the 'sit down' key by pressing %11.%1%2Click on the <t %5>minute hand of the watch</t> with %12 and drag it around to the time you wish to skip to. You may shift time by a maximum of 12 hours.%1%2Then select <t %5>OK</t>.
Sleeping

Old men need their rest. <t %5>Sleeping</t> can save your progress, heal injuries, and remove any threat level you have received. It will also enable you to <t %5>skip time</t>.%1%2Approach a <t %5>bed (or sofa)</t> and hold %11.%1%2Click on the <t %5>minute hand of the watch</t> with %12 and drag it around to the time you wish to skip to. You may shift time by a maximum of 12 hours.%1%2If you have a <t %5>sleeping bag</t> in your inventory, you will have the option of saving your game. Such items are good for <t %5>one use</t> only. %1%2Select <t %5>OK</t>.

str_a3_cfgvehicles_uav_04_base_f_library: The KH-3A Fenghuang is an unmanned aerial drone based on a Chinese design. The UAV adopts the unusual canard layout and is propelled by a pusher engine. This multipurpose drone is equipped with modern tracking and tracing systems, countermeasures and also carries four air-to-ground laser guided missiles.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_scooter_transport_01_: Personal watercraft (PWC) of the sit-down type. This small-hulled craft driven by a jet-propulsion system offers seats for 3 people and is easy to mount or dismount on the water thanks to the open stern construction. The powerful engine and great maneuverability makes this craft truly fun to ride. And of course it is a small and useful water transport vehicle for military use as well.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_uav_03_base_f_library: This autonomous/remotely controlled helicopter drone is mainly used as close air support and thanks to the unmanned construction can be deployed in the most dangerous zones. The Falcon is equipped with a laser designator and can therefore handle surveillance, reconnaissance and target designation tasks. Its greatest strength, however, lies in armament. It carries two rocket pods, each with 12 unguided rockets and six Scalpel air-to-ground missiles. The MQ-12 Falcon can also use countermeasures for self-defense.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_vtol_01_armed_base_f_: Developed as a 21st century replacement for aging C-130 based gunships and transport aircraft. Its third-generation tilt-rotor VTOL (Vertical Take-Off and Landing) technology allows this long endurance aircraft to conveniently utilize a wide range of airfields and runways which greatly improves the military logistics. It also provides unparalleled maneuverability in its heavily armed gunship variant which has the unique ability to perform either pylon turns or merely hover in place during the ground attack. The huge internal storage allows for transportation of vehicles up to the size and weight of the AMV-7 Marshall APC in the vehicle transport variant or up to 32 fully armed soldiers with supplies in the infantry transport variant. The storage space of the gunship variant is fully occupied by automated weapon stations and carried ammunition.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_vtol_02_infantry_base: By far the largest CSAT joint development project to date was long troubled by the conflicting requirements of the participating armies who demanded an aircraft with VTOL capabilities. The planned budget was vastly exceeded several times and development was years behind schedule. The program eventually became one of the most expensive in military procurement history and despite a great deal of information remains classified and is often compared to the older F-35 program. The final solution was based upon the most promising prototype designed in Xi'an which was able to meet most of the requirements with satisfactory results. High running and maintenance costs remains a huge issue that plagues the reputation of the otherwise extremely progressive aircraft with many unique features and top-notch bleeding-edge technologies.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_offroad_02_base_f_lib: The MB 4WD is a modern four-wheel drive off-road vehicle with a distinctive construction, which could be tracked up to World War II. The vehicle was produced in the US and exists in a number of different editions. A light machine gun or anti-tank recoilless rifle can be mounted on top of the roll cage. Paramilitary groups often use such variants as lightweight weapon carriers. Thanks to the powerful engine, durable chassis and great maneuverability, this vehicle can handle all levels of difficult terrains from dry deserts to humid jungles or artic wastelands.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_lsv_02_base_f_library: An agile (maximum speed 160 km/h) light protected vehicle for up to 7 soldiers – depending on the configuration. The Qilin provides safe and fast operating speeds with superior levels of mobility and maneuverability. It is highly adaptable to severe, rugged and restrictive terrains while providing off-road, cross-country mobility under all types of weather conditions. The vehicle was produced in China with Russian cooperation, so some minor influence from Ifrit MRAP can be seen in the Qilin design. The Qilin is a highly customizable platform which can be fitted according to the mission. CSAT Pacific forces primarily use the unarmed variant and the armed variants fitted with either a 6.5 mm minigun or a Vorona missile launcher.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_plane_civil_01_base_f: Caesar BTT is a single-engine, fixed-gear, low-wing general aviation aircraft built from composite materials. The Caesar BTT is one of the fastest fixed-gear, single-engined piston aircraft, reaching a speed of 235 knots (435 km/h) true air speed at 25,000 feet (7,600 m). It is used by civilians and smaller shipping companies all around the world.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_lsv_01_base_f_library: The Prowler is a light strike vehicle (LSV) which means it is agile and lightly armored. It uses speed, maneuverability and off-road mobility to avoid major threats. Another benefit is that the Prowler is light enough to be transported by medium helicopters such as UH-80 Ghost Hawk. This is in contrast to the heavy MRAP vehicles which are harder to transport to the battlefield. The Prowler can be configured in several different ways. Armed variants are equipped with a .338 SPMG medium machine gun, mounted on the front passenger side, while the turret can sport a .50 cal heavy machine gun or Titan missile launcher. With this arsenal, the Prowler is ideal for quick hit and run missions. The unarmed variant is stripped of all guns, but the back part of the vehicle is open and there are reserve seats for two additional soldiers.
str_a3_cfgvehicles_boat_transport_02_bas: The rigid-hulled inflatable boat, (RHIB) is a light-weight but high-performance and high-capacity boat constructed with a solid, shaped hull and flexible tubes at the gunwale. The boat can fit 7 passengers and a driver. RHIB can be used for multiple tasks. It can be a simple transport boat with some countries deploying them for coast guarding. This is in contrast to criminals on Tanoa who uses RHIBs as a fast and small smuggling boat.

str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_exp_pard_footer: Even at its apex, there is a long and bright future ahead for Arma 3. We are all supported by an army of modders, entertained by hordes of streamers, serviced by battalions of server admins and motivated by legions of players. Hope you enjoy your time together!
str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_exp_pard: We've worked on the <t color='%1'>#RoadToApex</t> for a long time, releasing improvements in various large updates. Many usability improvements, new features and other forms of support have <t color='%1'>freely enhanced the platform</t> for every player out there. Let's reflect on the highlights:

str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_exp_parc: Undoubtedly the star of the show is our new <t color='%1'>100 km² South Pacific archipelago</t>: <t color='%1'>Tanoa</t>. Book your passage today to this lush tropical destination, sometimes described as a "green hell", with Arma 3 Apex.

str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_exp_parb: Much like our previous DLC releases, this expansion features a <t color='%1'>premium content pack</t> and is supported by a <t color='%1'>free platform update</t>. Having purchased Arma 3 Apex, you gain unrestricted access to <t color='%1'>a new terrain packed with new objects, 10 new vehicles, 13 new weapons, a new campaign and more</t>. You will also be supporting the continued development of the Arma 3 platform. On behalf of our team and every player out there, we would like to thank you for this! Those who have not quite yet made the call to enlist, can try out the premium vehicles, weapons and character gear in the Virtual Arsenal. So, what exactly has been added in the Arma 3 Apex?
str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_exp_para: The time has come to deploy on a tour of duty to a brand new warzone with the release of <t color='%1'>Arma 3 Apex</t>. We are proud to present a major milestone for the game and the platform it is built upon. Representing the pinnacle of over 15 years of development, we hope you will enjoy one of the most meaningful gaming experiences on a PC!

str_a3_cfgmods_apex_suppressorsound: Sound suppressor used with late Chinese weapons such as Type-115. Its purpose is to stay relatively cold even after prolonged fire giving operative advantage when the enemy is using Thermal Imaging technology.

This content is exclusive to Arma 3 Apex expansion.
Press Left Shift + P to open the store page for more information.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_overview: Be deployed to the 100 km² South Pacific island archipelago Tanoa, with 13 new weapons and 10 new vehicles, a co-op campaign, and more, in the Arma 3 Apex expansion.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_opticserco: The open reflex ERCO sight is the ideal sighting solution for rifles and carbines and is designed with standard rail mounts in mind. Features medium range optics and a close range collimator to achieve maximal effectivity in combat as an operator. Recommended for all CTRG and NATO forces.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_loading: Arma 3 Apex brings you the brand new 100 km² South Pacific island of Tanoa, a co-op campaign and new weapons and vehicles such as the VTOL aircraft or LSV.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_itemprevnotiftext: This content is part of the non-owned Apex expansion. Please purchase it to use it.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_helmetviper: Next generation combined helmet developed in China for special military operatives. Shields physical heat and renders the soldier invisible to Thermal Imaging if used with compatible uniform. This helmet combines a protective function with the functionality other soldiers seek via additional equipment, such as night vision.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_helmetskate: Universal size protection helmet with a chin strap providing necessary protection to the wearer.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_helmetctrgtropic: New generation protective headgear designed originally for the U.S. Army by an external company. It is a modular helmet system designed to give soldier an edge in combat making him stealthy for Thermal Imaging technology when combined with the TI shielding uniform. Mainly used by special forces.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_helmetbalaclava: Balaclava made of next generation materials blocking heat radiation, giving the wearer an advantage while enemy is using Thermal Imaging technology.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_feature_weaponswitch: Fast and precise deployment and quick reactions are crucial for successful combat missions. Switch when on the move between your primary weapon and sidearm or other weapon types and interact with a streamlined action menu.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_feature_visualupgrad: Overhauled environment lighting, water shader & reflection technologies, fog improvements, better ground parallax effects and other graphical tweaks give the game an impressive face-lift.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_feature_vehicleinveh: Deploy into the Area of Operations by ferrying vehicles inside larger vehicles. Command AI or cooperate with friends to gain an edge with rapidly deployed Light Strike Vehicles or other suitable vehicles.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_feature_units: Use our official web service to support finding, creating and managing community groups. Together with others, experience the game at its finest regardless of your preferred playstyle.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_feature_tasks: The visual representation of scenario objectives - your 'tasks' - has been improved. You will find a more discernible style and new icons, a possibility to show multiple tasks in 3D, enriched 2D map interaction and Shared Objectives in modes such as End Game.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_feature_targeting: Utilize new targeting tools to better execute your attack. You will find enhanced commanding visualizations, more crew communication, weapon systems & indicators and virtual targeting pods at your disposal.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_feature_tanoa_terrai: Walk, swim, drive, fly, and sail your way across the brand new South Pacific island terrain.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_feature_stamina: A better communicated version of the mechanics governing your ability to sprint, its relationship with your loadout and the impact of sustained movement upon combat effectiveness.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_feature_squadcomm: Coordinate your movement and actions with your squad. Use the Squad Radar, Line Drawing, improved Voice-Over-Network communications and other improvements to play as a cohesive unit.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_feature_spectator: Watch as battles unfold with the new Spectator Cam in End Game multiplayer and other official and unofficial multiplayer scenarios.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_feature_revive: Care for your downed teammates in End Game multiplayer and other modes. We have improved and optimized this rewarding team-play feature.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_feature_respawn: Depending on the scenario, pick the best-suited respawn location, change your role & load-out, use the Spectator Mode and more from the new Respawn Screen.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_feature_quickplay: Use the new Quick Play interface to conveniently jump into the "Apex Protocol" co-op campaign, End Game multiplayer, or other multiplayer modes.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_feature_limping: You will encounter a more immersive representation of injured character legs in the game. This will also let you determine whether someone is walking slowly or actually injured.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_feature_launcher: Major upgrades to the game's official Launcher include an integrated Server Browser with advanced filters and enhanced mod handling.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_feature_groups: Form your group on-the-fly, name it as you wish, promote or kick out your teammates and share the same tasks in the multiplayer modes that support it.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_feature_fonts: We hope you are reading this more comfortably in the game's new font!
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_feature_equipment: Increased hitpoint precision and tweaked hit reactions for characters add to more immersive and intense infantry combat.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_feature_eden: Creating your own scenarios has never been this simple and fun. Edit in 3D, use custom layers and compositions, change load-outs, filter assets, undo & redo changes and so much more.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_feature_difficulty: An overhaul of the difficulty settings has resulted in consolidated presets, explanatory texts & images, and enhanced control over game challenge for players, scenario designers and server administrators.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_feature_controls: Play using a new default "Arma 3 Apex" preset that applies industry-standard control paradigms, such as switching weapons via the number keys. Or stick to the setup you are used to via the "Arma 3" preset.
str_a3_cfgmods_apex_feature_audio: A new audio engine with greater configuration options, distance-based samples for weapons & explosions, and positional ambient sounds add a stronger sense of immersion, situational awareness and fidelity to the soundscape.

str_a3_cfgmods_apex_clothesviperharness: A special military backpack with the aim to accommodate the ergonomics of a soldier. str_a3_cfgweapons_nvgogglesb_grn_f_libra: ENVG-II - Mark 2 Enhanced Night Vision Goggles are all-in-one goggles used by members of CTRG forces consisting of TI white-hot and NV. They are relatively light and compatible with NATO gear.
str_a3_cfgweapons_o_nvgoggles_ghex_f_lib: Next generation CSAT night vision combat googles. They are compatible with common CSAT helmets. They use multiple lenses for greater reliability and their power source can last a long time.
str_a3_cfgweapons_hgun_pistol_01_f_libra: The PM is an Ukrainian semi-automatic pistol. It is based on a Soviet Union's standard military and police side arm designed by Nikolay Fyodorovich Makarov. It has been produced since 1970s and has been used ever since in Ukraine, Yugoslavia, and places where black market reached from those countries. It uses 9x21 mm caliber instead of the original 9x19 mm. The actual bullet is 9.22 mm in diameter, since caliber in Russia is measured between the grooves and not the lands of the rifling. Being shorter and wider, the 9 mm cartridge is incompatible with pistols chambered for 9x21 mm cartridges and vice-versa.
str_a3_cfgweapons_arifle_spar_03_base_f_: The SPAR-17 designated marksman rifle is in many ways similar to the SPAR-16. The main difference is the chambering to 7.62 mm which also means a longer, thicker barrel and more weight. Thanks to the more powerful ammunition, the SPAR-17 is most suitable for ranges from 600 to 800 meters. The rifle offers a single and full auto mode and is, like the SPAR-16, compatible with a large number of accessories.
str_a3_cfgweapons_arifle_spar_01_base_f_: The SPAR-16 is a standard issue assault rifle of CTRG units in Pacific, chambered for 5.56 mm ammunition. The gun is a reliable rifle compatible with a large number of accessories. Multiple variants of this rifle exist, each suitable for a different role. The SPAR-16 GL is equipped with an underslung grenade launcher, the SPAR-16S with its thicker barrel and drum magazine works as a light support weapon.
str_a3_cfgweapons_arifle_ctar_base_f_lib: A bullpup style assault rifle used by CSAT Pacific forces. It works as a common platform for different weapon types: a standard rifle, GL variant with attached grenade launcher and a light support version with a longer barrel and drum magazine. The CAR-95 uses polymer materials in its construction and fires 5.8x42 mm small-caliber, high-velocity bullets.
str_a3_cfgweapons_arifle_aks_base_f_libr: The AKS-74U was created as an answer for the Soviet need for a fully automatic carbine. The gun is basically a shortened AK-74, which enabled significant production savings. Like the AK-74, this variant is also chambered in 5.45x39 mm, but its compact dimensions make it intended for special forces, vehicle crews, police patrols, etc. However, the lower muzzle velocity makes the AKS-74U effective up to only around 400 meters.
str_a3_cfgweapons_arifle_akm_base_f_libr: The AKM gas operated assault rifle with a rotating bolt is a modernized version of the old AK-47. Despite the later introduction of the AK-74, it has remained in use in many countries all over the world with more than 10 million units built. Its improvements over the AK-47 made mass manufacturing simpler, but also decreased the weight and increased accuracy of the weapon. At the same time, the gun's exceptional wear and corrosion resistance has been preserved.
str_a3_cfgweapons_arifle_arx_base_f_libr: The Type 115 is a modern multi weapon. It consists of two separate weapons combined into a single unit: a lower semi auto rifle chambered to fire 0.50 caseless rounds and upper automatic/ semi auto rifle chambered in caseless 6.5mm. The gun can be modified by attachments to fulfill various roles in battle. Its versatility turns every soldier into an universal threat against both infantry and armored targets.
str_a3_cfgweapons_arifle_ak12_base_f_lib: The AK-12 is a modern assault rifle designed to replace the legendary AK-74 as general issue for the Russian Army. The weapon introduces many improvements over its predecessors: better recoil control, versions suitable for various ammunition, compatibility with several underslung grenade launchers, accessory rails, or better ergonomics. This particular version is chambered in 7.62x39 mm, so it trades a bit of accuracy for a bigger punch and better penetration. Also part of this family is the RPK-12 for autoriflemen. It features a longer barrel with integrated bipod and special muzzle brake, as well as a modified stock for stability. High-capacity drum magazines can be loaded for prolonged fire. The AKU-12 on the other hand has a shortened barrel and special muzzle device for use by Special Forces and vehicle crews. SF operators sometimes spray paint these weapons in camouflage colors.
str_a3_cfgweapons_muzzle_snds_65_ti_ghex: Stealth Sound Suppressor (6.5 mm, Green Hex)
str_a3_cfgweapons_muzzle_snds_58_wdm_f0: Stealth Sound Suppressor (5.8 mm, Green Hex)
str_a3_cfgweapons_dmr_07_base_f_library0: Designated marksman rifle of an Eastern origin. It is a gas operated, semiautomatic rifle of a bullpup construction. The housing is made from polymer. The rifle is chambered in 6.5 mm and therefore is most suited to ranges from 500 to 700 meters. The CMR-76 is missing both the sides and the bottom rails but is by default equipped with a bipod.
str_a3_cfgweapons_launch_rpg7_f_library0: The RPG-7 is a portable, reusable, unguided, shoulder-launched, anti-tank, rocket-propelled grenade launcher. The ruggedness, simplicity, low cost and effectiveness of the RPG-7 has made it the most widely used anti-armor weapon in the world. Currently, around 40 countries use the weapon and it is manufactured in several variants by nine countries. It is popular with irregular and guerrilla forces. The RPG has been used in almost all conflicts across all continents since the mid-1960s, from the Vietnam War to the early recent conflicts in the Pacific area.
str_a3_cfgweapons_lmg_03_base_f_library0: The light infantry machine gun 85 is an iteration of a special purpose weapon. Combining a high fire-rate and relatively easy maintenance with high reliability, it was adopted by several armies around the world. It features standard accessory rails and 200-round box 5.56x45 mm magazines. Its weight is 7.1 kilograms which is less than its predecessors.
str_a3_cfgweapons_smg_05_base_f_library0: A lightweight, air-cooled, selective fire, delayed blowback operated submachine gun with a roller-delayed bolt. The compact size, accuracy and high rate of fire of the Protector are highly regarded and the gun is used in many variants by numerous military, law enforcement, intelligence and security organizations all around the world.

STR_A3_CFGWORLDS_TANOA_LOADINGTEXT1: The mining and heavy ship industry have already devastated many areas of the Tanoan paradise archipelago.
STR_A3_CFGWORLDS_TANOA_LOADINGTEXT2: During the hottest summers, there are many occurrences of native men missing in the jungle.
STR_A3_CFGWORLDS_TANOA_LOADINGTEXT3: Local tribes claim that huge reptilian creatures can be encountered at the foot of the volcano.
STR_A3_CFGWORLDS_TANOA_LOADINGTEXT4: The native people have turned many parts of the wild jungle into fertile fields and plantations.
STR_A3_CFGWORLDS_TANOA_LOADINGTEXT5: Around the Tanoa archipelago, the native people worship a god of fertility and festivity called Darkon.
STR_A3_CFGWORLDS_TANOA_LOADINGTEXT6: The name of the archipelago comes from the Fijian word tanoa which means a bowl (the main island resembles a large bowl).

str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_oldman_pard: The gameplay of Old Man is all about <t color='%1'>freedom</t>. You are working towards a main objective, but how you get there is up to you and your choices. You may wish to explore Tanoa for hours on end, or rather work steadily towards your goal. You may want to keep a low profile and avoid combat, or go in guns blazing. Multiple <t color='%1'>parallel quests</t> can be available to you, and you can choose by what means you achieve them within the Arma 3 sandbox. The most straightforward way is not always the best in the long-term. Actions have consequences. Experiment and find your own way. Given the huge size of the world, we did also introduce various convenience mechanics. Let's take a look at those and several other features:
str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_oldman_parc_foo: More about Arma 3 Apex: Old Man
str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_oldman_parc: The "Old Man" scenario is a <t color='%1'>free bonus addition</t> for all players who own the Arma 3 Apex expansion (due to it being set on Tanoa). It takes place in the shared <t color='%1'>Armaverse</t> setting of the other vanilla campaigns, such as "The East Wind" and "Apex Protocol". You assume the role of a retired Legionnaire who lives on Tanoa. When a mysterious super-strain of malaria triggers a new humanitarian crisis on the islands, and local authorities fail to resolve the situation, you are given intel about a possible plot behind it all. Together with a former military contact, you set out to uncover the truth. As you travel across the vast Pacific paradise – by land, sea, and even air – you will find secret locations, shelters, and form relationships with people aligned with a range of factions. How you get to the bottom of the situation is entirely up to you!
str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_oldman_parb_foo: More on the Arma 3 Dev Hub
str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_oldman_parb: Old Man for us has been an experiment in open world gameplay design. Developed by a small and passionate team, faced by significant technical challenges, it might have its rough edges. At the same time it should provide hours of fun gameplay with lots of freedom to explore a beautiful terrain. There are systems to handle parallel quests, to populate chunks of the world, and much more. Many of you have provided us with useful feedback during the scenario's beta test on Steam Workshop, which was introduced under the Bohemia Incubator label. Thanks! Besides taking these experiences to our future projects, we hope to reflect on our lessons learned in a future blog, so stay tuned for that.
str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_oldman_para: Get ready to once more explore the Tanoan archipelago and its 'green hell' of tropical jungles. Arma 3 Apex: Old Man is an open world singleplayer scenario now available to all players who have their boarding pass for Tanoa handy (main menu > PLAY > SCENARIOS > Old Man). The update also delivers various fun platform goodies, so keep on reading for the details, or jump in and experience what's new for yourself. Safe travels!
STR_A3_OM_Screen01_description:
Tanoa has plenty of hostels and hotels. These places can be used for:

REST
Any injuries you've received will heal after a few hours of sleep.
SKIPPING TIME
You can shift time by up to 12 hours.

All accommodation costs money.
STR_A3_OM_Screen02_description:
Some hostels and hotels have connections with Tanoa's insurgents and are run by individuals sympathetic to their cause. Such places are only available if your reputation with L'Ensemble is good. They can be used for:

REST
Any injuries you've received will heal after a few hours of sleep.
SKIPPING TIME
You can shift time by up to 12 hours.

All accommodation costs money. However, the rates of establishments run by L'Ensemble will vary, depending on your relation with them.
STR_A3_OM_Screen03_description:
There are many weapon stashes on Tanoa, belonging to insurgents. These are designated by an icon featuring a cog. If you choose to deposit weapons or equipment at these locations, you can earn extra money.
The sale price depends on your reputation with L'Ensemble.

By supporting 'La Revolution', insurgents can be leveled up.
You can check their rating from the menu on your phone.
STR_A3_OM_Screen04_description:
The violent insurgency on Tanoa, loosely led by L'Ensemble, has a life of its own. But you can play a part, assigning tasks to a small guerrilla team. Their size and availability depends on your reputation.
 • If your reputation is too low, you cannot send such groups on missions.
• If, on the other hand, your reputation is good, you can recruit insurgents at any of their camps.
• If your reputation is very good, you can assign missions using your phone.
You can check what options are available to you from the menu on your phone.

str_a3_showcase_jets_debriefing_fail01_d: You were unable to respond to enemy air threats in time. NATO ground units met with heavy casualties. The advance has been halted.
str_a3_showcase_jets_briefing_situation_:
After the AAF surrender, NATO continue to clean up remnants of CSAT forces to the northeast. Progress has been halted after CSAT brought in fast-air assets to interdict our ground assault.

Air superiority is vital for victory. USS Freedom has been deployed to Altis. As an F/A-181 fighter pilot, your task is to secure the %4airspace%1 to allow ground assets to continue their attack.
str_a3_showcase_jets_briefing_signal_tex:
Hornet - Your squadron
Eagle - Friendly squadron
Freeway - USS Freedom
str_a3_showcase_jets_briefing_mission_te: CSAT jets have been spotted over Altis. Patrol the %4airspace%1 and eliminate hostile air assets.
str_a3_showcase_jets_briefing_execution_:
1. Gear up, board your fighter jet and take off from %2USS Freedom%1.
2. Patrol the %4airspace%1 and eliminate enemy air assets.
3. Return to %2USS Freedom%1 and land.
str_a3_showcase_jets_bis_tskrepair_desc: Land at %2Altis International Airport%1 for %3emergency repairs%1.
str_a3_showcase_jets_bis_tskcas_desc: Provide Combat Air Support for ground units to assist the attack.
str_a3_showcase_jets_bis_tskcap_desc: Patrol the %2airspace%1 and eliminate enemy air assets.
str_a3_showcase_jets_01_intro_tower_1: Early-warning radars have a pair of unknown contacts, one hundred klicks north, approaching fast.
str_a3_showcase_jets_01_intro_tower_2: Possible CSAT strike on Altis International. Get up there and interdict - we can't let them target the airport; our entire operation would be at risk.
str_a3_showcase_jets_05_preflight_pilot_: Hornet 1, Two is spooled up and ready for take-off.
str_a3_showcase_jets_05_preflight_tower_: Hornet 1, Hornet 2, you're cleared for take-off.
str_a3_showcase_jets_05_preflight_wingma: Freeway, this is Hornet flight. Ready on the safe-shots. Over.
str_a3_showcase_jets_10_takeoff_wingman_: Hornet 1 copies. Climbing to 1500. Heading 050. Speed 720. Burner to intercept.
str_a3_showcase_jets_15_flight_wingman_1: Roger. Stay sharp. Keep your eyes open. Out.
str_a3_showcase_jets_22_reportwingmanhit: Freeway. Hornet 2. Hornet 1 is down. Advise, over!
Acknowledged, Hornet 2. Fangs out. Rerouting Eagle squadron for immediate assist.
str_a3_showcase_jets_30_reinforcements_t: Hornet 2, this is Freeway. Eagle's in the killbox and engaging bandits.
str_a3_showcase_jets_35_winchester_tower: Divert to Altis International Airport or head back here - your call. Rearm, then re-engage. Out.
str_a3_showcase_jets_40_skiesclear_pilot: All enemy jets destroyed - the skies are ours.
str_a3_showcase_jets_50_goodjobrtb_tower: Good job. Hornet 2 - come on home.
str_a3_showcase_jets_55_requestlanding_p: Freeway, Hornet 2 on approach. Request landing. Over.
str_a3_showcase_jets_55_requestlanding_t: Go ahead, Hornet-2. Your signal's Charlie.
str_a3_showcase_jets_60_castask_tower_0: Hornet-2, ground forces are reporting CSAT armor on Hill 87. I'm retasking you to take them out. How copy? Over.
str_a3_showcase_jets_65_minordamage_towe: Message received, Hornet-2. Abort mission. Over.
str_a3_showcase_jets_70_majordamage_pilo: Mayday! Mayday! Mayday! This is Hornet-2, losing altitude!

str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_jets_pare: Arma 3 Jets takes to the skies with the following premium content and platform additions:
str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_jets_pard_list7: %1 and %2 (same as for flaps) now control the VTOL vectoring angle in manual mode
str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_jets_pard_list6: %1 deploys available air brakes (this was decoupled from throttling)
str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_jets_pard_list5: %1 was previously used for auto elevation, but now also controls range measuring and weapon Fire Control Systems
str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_jets_pard_list4: %1 switches any available active radar on or off (an active radar can also reveal your position to more threats)
str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_jets_pard_list3: there exist controls to switch to the previous info panel module or to close them directly, but these are not mapped by default
str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_jets_pard_list2: %1 or %2 switch the mode of the left or right info panels where available (e.g. zoom)
str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_jets_pard_list1: %3 or %4 switch the left or right info panels to the next module where available (GPS, radar, off, etc.)
str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_jets_pard: With the addition of these new features and deepening of existing gameplay, there have been several <t color='%1'>control additions and tweaks</t>. You can inspect these in the CONTROLS section of the OPTIONS menu. It's also possible to reset to the Arma 3 or now standard Arma 3 Apex PRESETS, but please be aware that doing so will remove any customized control bindings.
str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_jets_parc_list8: optional new throttle behavior, new airplane animation and MFD sources for modders, tweaked controls, and more!
str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_jets_parc_list7: a more appropriate scripted emergency bail-out procedure for airplanes
str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_jets_parc_list6: scripted support for carrier launching and automated landing of naval aircraft
str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_jets_parc_list5: fast movers now benefit from a better speed of sound simulation and distance-based sound effects
str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_jets_parc_list4: more simulated weak-spots for airplanes, ranging from single engine failure to fuel leaks and HUD malfunctions
str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_jets_parc_list3: customize variable vehicle loadouts in Eden Editor (selecting aircraft pylon ordnance being the highlight)
str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_jets_parc_list2: enables vehicles to transmit their sensor data to other vehicles for advanced cooperation
str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_jets_parc_list1: a new radar interface for targeting guided weapons (used by a variety of vehicles, including jets, helicopters and tanks), powered by advanced Active Radar and Infrared sensor technology
str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_jets_parc: We're pleased to have been able to provide the entire Arma 3 player-base with a solid set of features in the form of a <t color='%1'>free platform update</t>. Not only do these improvements complement the premium aircraft splendidly, but they can and will be deployed for certain other existing vehicle types and (we hope!) by mod teams as well:
str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_jets_parb: As you've come to expect from our DLC strategy, this major release brings great new <t color='%1'>premium content</t> for DLC owners and enhances the sandbox for all Arma 3 players. With Arma 3 Jets, our goal was to deliver air superiority jets capable of combat beyond visual ranges. Owners will gain unrestricted access to <t color='%1'>3 new fighter aircraft</t> and an <t color='%1'>Unmanned Combat Air Vehicle</t>. You can experience the enhanced aerial gameplay in the dedicated <t color='%1'>Showcase</t>, or if you're looking for a quick hands-on preview, boot up the Virtual Arsenal mode to try the assets without restriction.
str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_jets_para: Scrambling all pilots! We've launched the Arma 3 Jets DLC for immediate interdiction. We hope this first huge milestone on our 2017 roadmap will please fans of vehicle gameplay and those looking for an even deeper combined arms experience. For the first time in Arma 3's development, this DLC was created together with a third-party external team: BRAVO ZERO ONE Studios, led by Make Arma Not War winner Joshua "Saul" Carpenter. We would like to thank these talented developers for their hard work! Inspect the strong line-up of new assets and features below, or jump right into the cockpit for takeoff!
str_a3_rscdisplaywelcome_jets_pare_list1: use the Y-32 Xi'an aircraft to support friendly troops on Tanoa against NATO forces (bonus for Apex owners)
STR_A3_CfgHints_PremiumContent_PremiumJe: Dominate the skies over the battlefield in 3 new fighter aircraft and an Unmanned Combat Air Vehicle. Fly fast and agile air superiority jets to provide air support in the dedicated Showcase, and more, in the Arma 3 Jets DLC.%1%1%2F/A-181 Black Wasp II - a fifth generation NATO carrier-based fighter jet%1%2To-201 Shikra - a fifth generation CSAT air superiority fighter jet%1%2A-149 Gryphon - an advanced fourth generation AAF fighter jet%1%2Sentinel - a NATO carrier-based Unmanned Combat Air Vehicle%1%2Deck Crew Vests - colored vests for various characters roles on the carrier%1%2Showcase Fighter Jets - take to the skies over Altis and engage in Air-to-Air and Air-to-Ground operations%1%2Official Sound Track - a new music track befitting the jets theme%1%2Achievements - a set of extra Steam Achievements%1
STR_A3_Ship_Gun_01_hint_description: The Mk45 Hammer 120mm naval gun provides NATO naval vessels with heavy firepower capability in close and medium ranges. Capable of both direct fire and artillery fire control this powerful gun is essential both in fleet-defence and fire-support roles. This asset is normally deployed on Liberty class destroyers.
STR_A3_Land_Destroyer_01_DLCbrowser_desc: This ship serves as a naval-support platform for NATO forces and as additional support for the Carrier Strike Group.
STR_A3_Ship_MRLS_01_hint_description: The Mk41 Vertical Launch System provides NATO naval vessels with a precision strike capability in medium to long ranges. Armed with 18 MLRS missiles, this asset is normally deployed on Liberty class destroyers.
STR_A3_Ship_Gun_01_DLCbrowser_descriptio: 120mm naval gun provides NATO naval vessels with heavy firepower capability, designed for use with Liberty class destroyers.
STR_A3_Land_Destroyer_01_hint_descriptio: The USS Liberty is one of several newly-built ships of its class. This powerful destroyer serves as part of "NATO Strike Group 14". It can carry troops, equipment and a helicopter on board allowing the battlegroup to perform its vital support roles. With a length of 155 meters and beam of 45 meters it can operate close to shore for rapid amphibious assaults.
STR_A3_Ship_MRLS_01_DLCbrowser_descripti: This missile system was designed to provide NATO naval vessels with a precision strike capability, designed for use with Liberty class destroyers.
STR_A3_Ship_Cruise_01_hint_description: The Mk41 Vertical Launch System provides NATO naval vessels with a precision strike capability in medium to long ranges. Armed with 18 cruise missiles, this asset is normally deployed on Liberty class destroyers.
str_a3_missile_cruise_he_x18_magazine_de: Long-range, data link guided, surface-to-surface missile with high-explosive warhead
str_a3_missile_cruise_c_x18_magazine_des: Long-range, data link guided, surface-to-surface missile with cluster munitions
str_a3_hint_targetingcamera_desc: Some aircraft are equipped with high-magnification cameras with day, night and thermal modes. Coupled with a laser designator, they can be used to 'paint' targets for your weaponry or for other friendly units.%1<t></t>1. Use %11 to switch to and from the targeting pod.%1<t></t>2. To stabilize the camera on an area press %12%1<t></t>3. To re-center camera to boresight or marked target press %13
str_a3_hint_sensortypes_tip: %1%2Laser and Strobe - detect targets that are lased or designated by IR grenades.%1%2Footmobiles - special sensor for detection of human targets, used primarily on small UAVs.
str_a3_hint_sensortypes_desc: Vehicle sensor suites often consist of several individual sensor types. Each sensor has different properties and indicators on the Sensor Display.%1%2Infrared (red) - detects heated targets.%1%2Visual (yellow) - detects any visible target, becomes less effective in the dark.%1%2Active Radar (cyan) - detects any target beyond visual range. Can be switched on/off.%1%2Passive Radar (green) - detects activated Radars at max. twice their own range.
str_a3_hint_sensors_tip: Different sensors have different ranges and conditions for successful target tracking.
str_a3_hint_sensors_desc: Some vehicles have sensors to detect and track targets automatically.%1<t></t>1. Switch to Sensor Display %11.%1<t></t>2. Press %12 to mark next target.%1<t></t>3. You can also use %13 to mark a target under your cursor.%1<t></t>4. Marked target is indicated on both the display and in the scene.%1Any guided weapon you select will now try to lock onto this target. Some unguided weapons may provide a lead computation.
str_a3_hint_sensordisplay_desc: Sensor Display (SENS) shows synthesized target and threat information from all the vehicle's sensors from a top-down perspective.%1%2Dashed sectors indicate sensor ranges, flashing sectors indicate threats%1%2%11 Air%1%2%12 Ground%1%2%13 Footmobile%1%2%14 Friendly (same-side)%1%2%15 Ambiguous%1%2%16 Confirmed hostile%1%2%17 Incoming missile%1%2%18 Marked target%1%2%19 Assigned target%1%2%20 Threat sector %1%2%21 %22 Laser and IR strobe %1%2%23 Target with an active Radar
str_a3_hint_panels_desc: %1%2Press %11 or %12 to toggle panel modules. Depending on the vehicle or items, this can be a GPS, Sensor Display or one of the remote camera feeds.%1%2Press %13 or %14 to toggle mode (e.g. rotation in GPS, Sensor display range resolution or spectrum of the camera feeds).
str_a3_hint_loadout_desc: A vehicle can come with different weapon loadouts and ammunition; bombs, rockets, missiles, cannon - all are interchangeable and can be assigned to fit the vehicle's role in any given mission. Check your weapon stores at the beginning of a mission, before engaging the enemy.
str_a3_hint_ilslanding_desc: To help you land at night or in adverse conditions, your HUD will enter the ILS mode when the landing gear is down. Providing you with:%1%2An outline of the runway to see where you're going to land.%1%2Glideslope deviation guides; fly them to form a cross at the center of the HUD.%1%2Angle-of-attack indication next to your flight path vector.
str_a3_hint_huds_desc: Head-up displays provide you with critical flight and weapons data as you look outside. The most important elements are: %1%2Airspeed%1%2Altitude%1%2Heading%1%2Pitch%1%2%11 Boresight or waterline, showing where the aircraft is pointing%1%2%12 Flight path vector (FPV), showing where the aircraft is going%1%2Climb rate%1%2Weapon and ammo count%1%2%13 Target box%1%2Threat and stall warnings
str_a3_hint_fcs_tip: %2Does the measured speed and range seem valid? If not, start over.%1%2GND SCT indicates terrain reflections.%1%2Keep in mind that the FCS may not provide a fire solution for targets that are too far away or are moving too fast.
str_a3_hint_fcs_desc: More advanced weapons have a Fire Control System (FCS). It provides weapon zeroing and automatically calculates lead time for your target.%1%2Aim at your target and press %11 to lase it and log its speed and range.%1%2Keep tracking the target under your crosshair.%1%2Shoot when 'RDY' appears on the screen.%1If the target suddenly changes speed or direction, you need to start over.
str_a3_hint_datalink_desc: Optionally a vehicle can be set up to broadcast its position and/or targets tracked by its sensors.%1%2Go to the Sensor Display %11 to see targets shared by others.%1%2Targets acquired only via data link have hollow symbols.%1%2These targets can't be marked until acquired by one's own sensors.
str_a3_hint_carriertakeoff_desc: To take-off from the carrier:%1<t></t>1. Align the aircraft with one of the four catapults.%1<t></t>2. Use %3Launch%4 in the action menu when aligned with the direction of the launch catapult.
str_a3_hint_carrierlanding_tip: Practice touch-and-go landings on the deck. This will familiarize you with the procedure and will enable you to perfect your approaches.
str_a3_hint_carrierlanding_desc: Landing on the short deck of a ship is challenging.%1<t></t>1. Follow the standard landing approach.%1<t></t>2. Deploy %3Tailhook%4 via action menu.%1<t></t>3. ILS may help you maintain the needed precision and stability.%1<t></t>4. Line up the aircraft behind the ship at about 10 degrees right of the ships line.%1<t></t>5. Aim for the field of three wires which is located about 20 percent of the way down the length of the landing deck.%1<t></t>6. Be ready to go full throttle if you miss the wires. Go around and try again.
str_a3_hint_bombs_tip: You can try dropping a bomb, so it detonates on the reverse side of a salient feature, such as a hill. If a small X appears inside the CCIP cross in your optics, then it shows that the bomb will land beyond the terrain in front of you.
str_a3_hint_bombs_desc: A bomb is an airdropped explosive munition. After releasing, it follows a ballistic path. Where the bomb will land, if released at the given moment, is shown by a continuously-computed impact point (CCIP) in your HUD - a small crosshair or circle with a dot.%1%1Guided bombs can make corrections to this path to achieve better precision or to strike a moving target. At certain altitude a laser guided bomb (LGB) will automatically home in on the nearest laser spot (marked by your own targeting camera or friendly JTAC).%1 1. Press %11 to mark a lased spot.%1 2. Maneuver to bring the CCIP and marked laser together.%1 3. Release the bomb once the icons overlap or are reasonably close together.
str_a3_hint_airplanedamage_desc: While military aircraft can strike fast, hard and precisely, they are relatively fragile.%1Several hits into their engines, flaps, or elevators will make the aircraft hard or impossible to operate, forcing their crew to return for repairs or bail out from their uncontrollable machine.
